流星劍譜=Meteor Sword Manual

君子論劍=Gentleman Discusses Swordsmanship
一代儒俠曾文先生所著，總結四書五經十三經，論君子慎其獨，由心而表於體，由知而形於禮，不亢不卑，言行如一。月換星移由他，江山易主隨你，我自本心，修養自己。\n人間再好，我亦不過是我而已；世道再壞，我亦不過是我而已。捨此色身，亦復如是。\n凡我練劍習武之人，當守本心，以劍鋒兩刃為鏡，不恥問亦求諸己，謙而自強不息，處患難不憂，當宴遊惕慮，遇權豪無懼，是為君子劍。=The renowned Confucian hero Mr. Zeng Wen wrote this work, distilling the Four Books, the Five Classics, and the Thirteen Classics. It holds that a gentleman is watchful even in solitude, that the heart shows itself in conduct and knowledge takes form in ritual, that he is neither arrogant nor servile, and that his words and deeds are one. Let the months and stars turn as they will; let mountains and rivers change hands as they may—I hold fast to my own heart and cultivate myself. However good the world, I am still only myself; however wicked the age, I am still only myself. And should I shed this mortal frame, it would remain so. All of us who study the sword and the martial arts must guard our true heart, take the sword's two edges as a mirror, never be ashamed to ask and always seek the answer within ourselves, stay humble yet never cease striving, feel no dread in hardship, remain watchful even at feasts and revels, and show no fear before the powerful. This is the Gentleman's Sword.

孔夫子劍=Confucius Sword

Conducting oneself with reverence, contending with none, favoring neither this nor that, unshakeable when great principles are at stake—this is called the sword of humility and harmony, the gentleman's sword.

那由它劫指=Nayuta Kalpa Finger

'Nayuta' is a Buddhist term for a number, meaning countless beyond reckoning. 'Kalpa' is the general Indian term for an age of time; after the phases of formation, existence, destruction, and emptiness, one such cycle makes a great kalpa. To practice this skill, then, one must fathom the essence of Zen, realize the state beyond birth and death, and endure endless kalpas in the flesh before attaining the Great Way.

全真派的輕功兼腿法，逍遙遊出自莊子一書，亦是古琴曲。全真派弟子每日練功時會由傳功師父奏曲，鯤化為鵬、翼若垂雲、將徙天地、上干青霄、扶搖萬里、御風冷然、氣適北溟、磅礡萬物、翱翔廣和九段奏完，方始收功。=The Qinggong and leg technique of the Quanzhen Sect. Carefree Wandering takes its name from the book of Zhuangzi, and is also a piece for the guqin. Every day when Quanzhen disciples practice, the master of transmission plays this piece — through its nine movements, The Kun Becomes a Peng, Wings Like Trailing Clouds, Journeying Across Heaven and Earth, Soaring to the Azure Heights, Riding the Whirlwind for Ten Thousand Miles, Gliding Cool upon the Wind, Breath Settling over the Northern Sea, Might Overwhelming All Things, and Soaring Free in Vast Harmony — only once all nine are played do they conclude their exercises.
八荒奪路逃=Eight Wildernesses Escape
丐幫中人約定成俗的逃跑技巧，人多時使出非常壯觀，一哄而散，四面八方奪路而出，如有心有靈犀般指東跑西，教敵人難以一網打盡，最終總會有落網之魚可以回家通風報信。\n這逃法以歌訣形式傳唱，歌云：「眼看東邊走西邊，無處可逃上樹顛，三五成群鐵沒命，生死有數莫拖牽。」詞雖俗俚淺白，卻不單有詭道、還提前做了萬一落網的心理建設。=The Beggar Sect has established customary escape techniques that are particularly impressive when employed by a large group. In such situations, they scatter like a startled flock, bursting out in every direction, feinting east while bolting west as though of one mind, making it difficult for enemies to net them all at once; there is always some fish who slips the net and lives to carry word home. These escape methods are passed down through song, with the verse going: Look to the east while running west, nowhere to hide up in a tree's height, three or five together defy ironclad fate, life and death preordained no need to hesitate. Though the words may be simple and straightforward, they contain cunning strategies and also provide psychological preparation for the possibility of being caught.
阿摩搪牆拳=Amotang Wall Fist
羅漢拳譜=Luohan Fist Manual
嵩山寺中被盜出的拳經，是嵩山武功之根本，易學難精。\n流轉民間的羅漢拳譜在數百年間衍生出諸多套路，各領風騷，每本都不太一樣，你也不知手裡這本是否原版，你既然撿到了這本拳譜，你就有佛緣，練它。=The Fist Classic stolen from Songshan Temple is the foundation of Songshan's martial arts, easy to learn but difficult to master. The Luohan Fist manual that has circulated among the people has given rise to many different forms over the centuries, each with its own unique flair, and each version is somewhat different. You cannot be sure if the manual in your hands is the original. Since you have come across this manual, you have a connection to the Buddha; practice it.
飛天腳=Flying Heaven Kick
崆峒派‧飛天門的秘笈。\n是先掌派人將《仙鶴迷蹤拳》簡化以傳授弟子的入門版本。\n略去迷蹤與拳路，僅就下盤輕功鍛鍊，淺顯易懂。=Kongtong Sect · Flying Heaven Gate's secret manuals. The Former Sect Leader simplified 'Immortal Crane's Elusive Fist' into these versions for initial discipleship instruction. They omit the bewilderment and fist routines, focusing solely on lower‑body Qinggong training, making them simple and easy to understand.
仙鶴迷蹤拳=Immortal Crane's Elusive Fist
崆峒派．飛天門的傳世武學。\n身法輕靈，拳快步鬆，最是敏捷多變。時而漫步閒遊，時而振翅急襲，叫人捉摸不透，防不勝防。\n只是這路拳法過於複雜，共有三十六路、七十二變、百零八種後著，甚難熟練，因此飛天門中反倒鮮少有人深入鑽研。=Kongtong Sect. Flying Heaven Gate's martial art passed down through the generations. Their agility is light and graceful, with quick punches and loose steps, making them most nimble and versatile. At times they move like a leisurely wanderer, at others like a bird suddenly diving into attack, leaving one unsure and constantly on guard. However, this style of fist technique is overly complex, consisting of thirty‑six paths, seventy‑two transformations, and one hundred and eight subsequent moves, making it very difficult to master. Therefore, few within Flying Heaven Gate ever delve deeply into it.
曾經名動一時的怪盜鐵面人所獨創的爪功。\n不循正理，而是劍走偏鋒，潛於昏冥，化身為影，遁入黑夜，施以致命一擊。\n鐵面人受命於龐太師，意欲襲殺包拯，反心折於包公鐵面無私的氣魄，不願以私戕害青天，亦不敢背信，遂自捨優勢，暗中行出，向南俠展昭請戰，敗得光明正大，自斷十指，包拯遂赦免死罪。\n鐵面人歸隱於崆峒，請人鑄造鐵爪義手，寫就此書。=The claw technique uniquely created by the once-renowned, enigmatic thief known as Iron-Face Man. Rather than following orthodox principles, it strikes from unconventional angles — lurking in darkness, becoming one with the shadows, slipping into the night to deliver a single fatal blow. Iron-Face Man was ordered by Grand Tutor Pang to assassinate Bao Zheng, but was instead won over by Lord Bao's awe-inspiring impartiality. Unwilling to harm the Blue Sky for a private grudge, yet unwilling to break his word, he gave up his advantage and went forth in secret to challenge Southern Hero Zhan Zhao, losing the bout honorably and cutting off his own ten fingers in atonement. Bao Zheng then spared his life, and Iron-Face Man withdrew into seclusion at Kongtong, had an iron claw forged as a prosthetic hand, and wrote this manual.
鐵臂神拳=Iron Arm Divine Fist
相傳是陷空島五義之一，排行老三的「穿山鼠徐慶」所擅長的武功。\n徐慶是鐵匠出身，力大無窮，有異術能鑽地，故稱穿山鼠，五鼠歸順開封府，輔佐包拯。\n嘉祐七年，包公病逝，次年歸葬合肥，五鼠一路相送，叩首拜別，各奔東西。\n及後徐慶歸隱崆峒，傳下鐵臂神拳與鐵匠技術，逝於鐵拳巷大鐵鋪。\n修練者須雙臂塗油，穿入鐵環，運功令雙臂充血堅硬，再使勁掄打木樁；掄斷了木樁以後，掄石樁；掄斷了石樁，掄鐵樁。萬一斷的是手臂，就塗藥膏待好了繼續掄，久而久之，雙手就會變得像鐵一樣。=It is said that this is the martial art practiced by Xu Qing, the third of the Five Heroes of Xiankong Island. Xu Qing, born to a blacksmith, possessed immense strength and had the unique ability to burrow underground, earning him the nickname Mountain‑Burrowing Mouse. The Five Rats pledged their loyalty to the Kaifeng Prefecture and assisted Bao Zheng. In the seventh year of the Jiayou era, Lord Bao passed away, and the following year he was buried in Hefei. The Five Rats accompanied him on his journey, bowing in farewell before parting ways. Later, Xu Qing retreated to Kongtong, passing down the Iron Arm Divine Fist and blacksmithing techniques, and he passed away at the Great Iron Forge in Iron Fist Alley.   Practitioners must apply oil to both arms, pass them through iron rings, and circulate their energy to make their arms engorge and harden. They then strike wooden stakes; after breaking the wooden stake, they move on to stone stakes; after breaking the stone stake, they strike iron stakes. If an arm breaks, they apply ointment and continue training until healed. Over time, their hands will become as strong as iron.
白猿通臂拳=White Ape Connecting Arms Fist
峨嵋派白猿祖師的成名絕技，嚴格來說也算是一種猴拳，卻與民間所傳的猴拳南轅北轍。勁由背發，經肩過肘通達手指，是為通臂。=The signature skill of the White Ape Patriarch of the Emei Sect is, strictly speaking, a form of monkey fist, yet it diverges significantly from the folk versions of monkey fist. Its power emanates from the back, travels through the shoulder and past the elbow to reach the fingers — hence its name, Through-Arm.
江湖第一美人奪魄幽蘭的成名絕技。\n揉合奪魄門暗襲之術與雪山派內功，身法如鬼魅，能勾人魂魄。\n摧心、蝕骨、銷魂、奪魄四式，一招狠似一招，極其毒辣，習之恐怕有傷天和。=Jianghu's foremost beauty, Soul-Stealing Orchid, is renowned for her signature skill. Combining the Snow Mountain Sect's Internal Skill with the Soul-Stealing Gate's stealth techniques, her agility is like that of a ghost or demon, capable of ensnaring one's soul. The four devastating moves — Crumbling Heart, Corroding Bone, Soul Devouring, and Soul-Stealing — are each more ruthless than the last, extremely poisonous. Practicing them might even harm the harmony of heaven.
登雲踏．望月=Ascending Cloud Step · Moon Gazing
你唐門大師兄登徒子行徑中自創的武功，收錄於登雲梯續集。為了求見美人，可以登雲上樓台，其中踏月式是由這路輕功衍生出的攻招，「月」指光輝，暗喻所有加諸於己的兵刃。故而踏月式的真義是專門踏到別人兵刃上，居高臨下踩人臉面。=This move, called the Treading-on-the-Moon Style, was devised by your eldest senior brother of the Tang Clan amid his skirt-chasing escapades, and is recorded in the sequel to the Cloud-Ascending Ladder. To catch a glimpse of a beauty, one could scale the clouds atop the Cloud-Ascending Ladder to reach her balcony; the Treading-on-the-Moon Style is an offensive move derived from this Qinggong. Moon here refers to brilliance, a veiled reference to any blade brought against oneself — thus the true meaning of the Treading-on-the-Moon Style is to step squarely onto an opponent's weapon and tread down upon their face from on high.
你恩師夏侯蘭集奪魄、雪山兩家之神髓，去蕪存菁，又揉合了控鶴氣功，終於創制出的神技。\n旨不在殺傷，乃是專門對付高手用的武功，就算是天下最高明的輕功，也捉得到。\n發力恰似飛鴻踏雪泥，泥上偶然留指爪，鴻飛那復計東西？輕描淡寫抓出，力使三分藏七分，後著隱於無形。破壞敵人架勢，而我迅速回氣，施以奪命猛襲。=Your mentor, Xiahou Lan, gathered the essential spirit of both the Soul-Stealing School and the Snow Mountain Sect, refined away the dross to keep only their essence, and blended it with Crane-Controlling Qigong to finally create this divine skill. Its purpose is not to kill but specifically to deal with experts; even the most skilled Qinggong techniques in the world cannot escape its grasp. The force is akin to a flying goose treading on snow, leaving only the faintest traces on the mud, while the goose itself pays no mind to east or west. With a light touch, it captures its target, revealing three parts of its strength while holding back seven, and the follow‑up move is hidden, unseen. It disrupts the enemy's stance while I swiftly recover my energy, launching a deadly assault.
千刀萬剮殺=Death by a Thousand Cuts
極度瘋狂的刀法，乃是一名身負奪妻之恨的三流刀客所創。\n受冤下獄13年間，在心中揣想過幾千次敵人的武功路子，在腦海中將奪妻的仇敵凌遲幾萬次。\n他出獄後不久，驚動江湖的血案「碧血狂殺」案件旋即爆發。=This extremely deranged Blade Technique was created by a third‑rate blade-wielder consumed by the hatred of having his wife stolen from him. During his 13 years of wrongful imprisonment, he pondered his enemy's fighting style thousands of times in his mind, and imagined torturing the man who took his wife tens of thousands of times more. Not long after his release, the shocking bloodbath known as the 'Crimson Blood Massacre' erupted, sending shockwaves through the Jianghu.
赤腳神通=Barefoot Divine Power
龜息功=Turtle Breathing Technique
經典江湖鬼蜮伎倆，很多小人都會用。\n敵人太強，不敵之時，便抓準時機，自行運功封阻體內經脈，使氣血凝滯，脈搏暫時停止，便好似死了一般。\n待敵人離去後，再藉由預先藏於掌心的石灰發熱將自身喚醒。\n不過使用這套內功風險頗高，萬一喚醒的機關不太靈驗，醒來後也會因為腦缺氧從此變得痴痴呆呆；又萬一招惹了狠角色，見你倒下了二話不說便先補個兩刀子，假死就便真死了。=A classic dirty trick of the Jianghu, favored by many a scoundrel. When the enemy is too strong to fight, seize the moment to seal off your own meridians, stilling the blood and stopping the pulse, so you seem as good as dead. Once the enemy leaves, quicklime hidden in your palm can be heated to revive you. But this Internal Skill carries great risk: should the revival mechanism fail, oxygen deprivation to the brain may leave you addled for life. And should you cross a truly ruthless foe, seeing you fall they may finish you off with two more blows without a word — turning a feigned death into a real one.
蓮花落=Lianhua Lao
丐幫人人都會唱的幫歌蓮花落，其實是講究求生技巧的一部內功歌訣。\n每夜收工以後，由輩分較老的乞丐帶著小輩齊唱，邊唱邊以筷敲碗，以此掌握節拍，配合歌曲換氣，吐納習慣自然養成。\n只不過歌詞往往粗鄙不堪，有辱斯文，有些對著姑娘家唱還會被報官。=Lianhua Lao, the anthem every beggar in the Beggar Sect learns to sing, is in truth an Internal Skill chant built around the art of survival. After each night's work, elder beggars lead the younger ones in singing it together, tapping chopsticks on their bowls to keep time; matching breath to the song lets proper respiration take root naturally. The lyrics, though, are often crude and hardly fit for polite company — sung to a young lady, they might even get you reported to the authorities.
全真劍法=Quanzhen Sword Technique
全真教為了推廣教義，開民智，而刻意外傳的養氣內功。\n將劍訣刪減，雜以養命之道，以淺白口語重新編譯過，淺顯易懂，可以初窺道學，延年益命。\n鄉親父老人手一本，人人有功練，堪稱國民健康操，但想要以此克敵制勝，恐怕是行不通的。=The Quanzhen Sect deliberately spread this Qi-cultivating Internal Skill beyond its walls to promote its teachings and open the minds of the common people. They pared down the sword formulas, blended in methods for nurturing life, and rewrote it all in plain speech anyone could grasp — a first taste of Daoist learning that also lengthens one's years. Every village elder owned a copy, and everyone practiced it, a national health exercise in all but name. But hoping to defeat an enemy with it would likely prove futile.
傳自西域密宗的神祕禪功，習練方法與中原武術截然不同，不單姿勢古怪，遣詞亦十分晦澀，最終二章譯得牛頭不對馬嘴，難以閱讀。\n練此禪功講究身體力行，需點燃炭木，鋪以尖銳碎石，再於石上練功，練功者必須潛運內功，將熱力排出體外，否則必將引火燒身。\n據聞修練至最高境界可以打坐浮空、手腳關節脫臼伸長打人、口吐烈火。\n但不知最後二章的內容，這個境界是無論如何難以得見的。=This mysterious Chan technique, transmitted from the Western Regions, is utterly unlike the martial arts of the Central Plains — not just in its strange postures, but in its obscure phrasing; its last two chapters read like a horse mouth stitched to a cow's head, all but unreadable. Practicing this Zen technique demands real physical toil: one must light charcoal, lay a bed of jagged stones, and train atop them, all while channeling Internal Skill to vent the heat from the body — or risk being burned alive. It is said that at its highest realm one can sit in meditation and float, dislocate and extend the joints to strike, and breathe raging fire. But with the final two chapters lost to translation, no one truly knows if that realm can ever be reached.
楊家練兵操=Yang Family Military Drill Manual
北宋楊門忠烈的練兵體操。號稱體操，然而為了確實提高沙場生還率，本操的鍛鍊強度不僅遠超朝廷正規軍，甚至比武林中小門派的功法還要嚴格，雜以棍操、一百零八陣操、銅錘十八打，這套體操即令是武林中人，怕也沒幾個受得了。=The military training exercises of the Yang family from the Northern Song Dynasty, known for their loyalty and bravery, are referred to as gymnastics. However, in order to truly enhance survival rates on the battlefield, the intensity of this training far exceeds that of the Imperial Court's regular army and is even stricter than the techniques of smaller sects in the Wulin. It incorporates staff techniques, the One Hundred and Eight Formation drills, and the Eighteen Strikes with the bronze hammer. This set of exercises would be challenging for even those from the Wulin to endure.
道門蒼龍吟，是以九霄龍吟為譬，形容得道之人飛升清嘯，有如龍吟破空般清亮。\n此功須由丹田內氣外發，與人交手之際，發功呼嘯，聲如雷霆疾瀉千里，使人心魄為之所奪，甚至還能造成內傷。=Daoist Azure Dragon's Cry is likened to the Nine Heavens Dragon's Roar, describing a cultivator ascending to transcendence with a clear and resounding exhalation, akin to a dragon's cry piercing through the air. This cultivation technique requires the internal qi from the dantian to be externally emitted. When engaging in combat, one releases this power with a fierce howl, the sound like thunderbolts cascading for miles, capturing the opponent's soul and even causing Internal Injuries.
混元童子炁=Primordial Youth Qi
雖然效果強大、流傳亦廣，卻沒人要練的氣功。這是因為此功乃是一門童子的緣故，殊為可惜。\n聽說一旦成親，苦練而來的功力就會散去，任誰都不想孤獨終老，所以沒人願意修練這套武功，然則這是世人的誤解。所謂童子功，是指留守先天之氣以養後天，故而由兒童時期起練最有效果的意思。若打娘胎出生便開始練，不出十二年即可大成。若志學之年起練，筋骨已成，先天之氣逸散，則效果半減，而立之年再學，已無用處。\n跟成親與否其實沒有關係。=Although the effects are powerful and widely known, no one wishes to practice this qigong. This is because it is the Virgin Boy Skill, which is quite regrettable. It is said that once a man marries, the hard‑earned power from practicing will dissipate. No one wants to end their days alone, so few are willing to train in this martial arts skill. However, this is a misunderstanding. The term Virgin Boy Skill refers to preserving the primordial energy to nourish the body's vitality since childhood. Thus, it is most effective when started from a young age. If one begins practicing immediately after birth, they can achieve great success within twelve years. Starting at the age of adolescence will reduce the effectiveness because the muscles and bones are already formed, and the primordial energy has dispersed. After reaching the age of thirty, there is no point in learning it at all. It has nothing to do with whether one marries or not.
巫山洞府九寶圖=Nine Treasures of the Wushan Grotto
藏於巫山與長江流域交會的鐘乳洞中，繪於壁上的神祕武功，不知來歷為何，亦不知歷時幾朝，以九張連環圖畫演示修練法門，似乎亦正亦邪，絕非尋常練功法門，然則言簡意賅，有發聾振聵之效。\n被一名失足落水的漁夫發現以後，誊拓下來，上交朝廷換得獎賞，而朝廷亦不重視，這套武功就此被埋沒於達官貴人的書架之上。\n而那鐘乳洞亦因水位上升，已被徹底淹沒。=Hidden in a stalactite cave where the Wushan mountains meet the Yangtze, a mysterious martial art is painted across the walls, its origin and age both unknown. Nine drawings unfold the training method as a connected series — at once righteous and depraved in flavor, certainly no ordinary path of cultivation, and yet so terse and pointed that a single glance can jolt the mind awake. A fisherman who lost his footing and fell into the water discovered it, traced the drawings, and presented them to the Imperial Court for a reward. The court thought little of it, though, and the technique was left to gather dust on the shelves of nobles and officials. As for the cave itself, rising waters have long since swallowed it whole.
鐵琵琶功=Iron Pipa Skill
習練者需單腳立樁，以腿托琵琶，這是飛天門「鶴樁」的輕功；若要掀動鐵琴弦，需先習練奪魄門「霜刀破竹指」；再來要鼓動音箱，便須運使玄功門內力，使其共振；禦敵時，更能抄起琵琶作為武器，施展鐵拳奇門「如意砸」的招數，打爆敵人腦袋瓜。\n功成心念一動，百脈齊鳴，動如響弦，歷久彌衰，是為崆峒第一神功。=Novices must stand on one leg, supporting a pipa with their thigh—this is the Qinggong 「Crane Stance」 of the Flying Heaven Gate. To pluck the iron zither strings, one must first master the 「Frost Knife Shatters Bamboo」 finger technique of the Soul-Stealing Gate. To resonate the sound box, one must channel the Internal Force of the Mysterious Arts Sect. In combat, one can even seize the pipa as a weapon, unleashing the technique 「As You Wish Smash」 from the Iron Fist Odd Arts, shattering an enemy's skull.\nUpon achieving mastery, a mere thought sets a hundred meridians ringing, moving like a resonant string, enduring for ages—this is the supreme skill of Kongtong.
焚心火印=Heartburn Seal
雪山心法=Snow Mountain Internal Method
現今已不存在的雪山派心法，修練方法非常特殊。需吸足真氣，赤身裸體、頭下腳上插進雪中，只將腳掌露在外邊，再由旁人以艾炙足底湧泉穴，使修練者運使心法借艾炙的熱力溫經通絡，調適體溫、抵禦冰雪。\n沒有雪水的話，就近找條清涼的溪流，也可以替代。=The Internal Method of the now non‑existent Snow Mountain Sect is practiced with very special methods. One must first inhale true qi deeply, then strip naked and insert their body upside down into the snow, only exposing their feet. Someone else would then apply moxibustion to the Yongquan acupoint on their soles, using the heat from the moxa to activate the meridians and adjust their body temperature to resist the cold and ice. If there is no snow water available, a nearby cool stream can be used as a substitute.
玄燭心經=Mysterious Candle Heart Sutra
南宮心法=Nangong Internal Method
南宮家世代承傳的家學心法，人手一本，歌訣大方的抄錄在書本內頁。\n揉合道家思想，萬變猶定，神怡氣靜，意守玄關，降伏邪氣，虛懷若谷，心神清明。\n以守心為本，而後護身、保家、衛國，是南宮家學的根基。=The Nangong family's generational legacy of the Internal Method is passed down, with each person receiving a copy, and the verses elegantly transcribed on the inner pages of the book. It blends Daoist philosophy, emphasizing that amidst countless changes, one remains steadfast; tranquility of spirit leads to calmness of mind, guarding the mysterious gateway, subduing malevolent energies, maintaining humility, and achieving clarity of heart and mind. The foundation of the Nangong Family Teachings lies in safeguarding the heart, followed by protecting oneself, preserving the family, and defending the nation.

論語=Analects
以春秋思想家孔子的言論彙編，\n為儒家最重要的經典之一。\n這是三師兄當私塾先生時，\n為了教授不識字學童而編輯的簡單白話本。=Composed from the sayings of Confucius, a prominent thinker of the Spring and Autumn period, this text is one of the most important classics in Confucianism. This simple vernacular version was compiled by Third Senior Brother when he served as a private school teacher to instruct children who could not read.
孫子兵法=Sun Tzu's Art of War
春秋兵聖孫武所著，是為中原最早的兵書，被兵家奉為經典。\n一共十三篇，論述軍事，總結戰爭經驗，對後世軍策影響極其深遠。=Written by Sun Wu, the Sage of War of the Spring and Autumn period, Sun Tzu's Art of War is the earliest military treatise in the Central Plains, revered as a classic by strategists. It comprises thirteen chapters discussing military strategy and summarizing the lessons of war, exerting a profound influence on military thought for generations to come.
十八種奇兵鍛法雜記=Notes on Eighteen Exotic Weapon Forging Methods
崆峒鐵拳門當代掌門雷謙所書的雜記。\n他自知資質愚鈍，唯恐先代巧藝失佚，雖無能開創新局，卻發偌大宏願，將諸般奇兵鑄法整匯於此書之中。\n這是一部寫給凡人的書。=Notes written by Lei Qian, the current Sect Leader of the Kongtong Iron Fist Gate. Aware that his own talent is unremarkable, he fears the refined skills of earlier generations may be lost forever. Though he cannot break new ground himself, he has resolved on a grand ambition: to gather every manner of forging method for exotic weapons into this one book. This is a book written for mortals.
江湖鬼蜮錄=Records of Jianghu Ghosts and Spirits
記載了種種江湖伎倆的醒世錄，撰書人本意是提醒無辜百姓，莫受人欺，須知人心隔肚皮，害人之心不可有，防人之心亦不可無。\n奈何此書落到壞人手裡，登時就變成詐騙寶典，怎麼帶勁怎麼來。=A chronicle of various tricks and schemes in the Jianghu, the author's intent was to warn innocent Commoners not to be deceived by others and to remember that one should not have thoughts of harming others but must always be wary. Unfortunately, this book fell into the wrong hands and was instantly transformed into a fraud manual, employing whatever means necessary to maximize its potency.
江湖鬼蜮錄．續=Records of Jianghu Ghosts and Spirits: Continuation
江湖鬼域錄不具名受害者以口代手，咬筆所寫的陳情錄。\n書中陳述他如何從一個天真無邪、四肢健全的孩童，被詐騙得家破人亡，流落異鄉，自食其力卻又被人構陷盜竊，獲罪入獄，斬去雙臂。\n最終他逃出生天，以獄中苦練的核棗釘報仇雪恨。=Records of Jianghu Ghosts and Spirits: Continuation is an anonymous victim's plea, written by holding the brush in his mouth in place of his missing hands. It recounts how he went from an innocent, able-bodied child to a man swindled into ruin, his family destroyed, and cast adrift in a foreign land. Struggling to survive on his own, he was then falsely accused of theft, thrown into prison, and had both arms cut off. In the end he escaped with his life and took his revenge with the Jujube-Pit Dart he had painstakingly mastered in prison.
儒家戰神孟子周遊列國之時舌戰群雄、以唇槍舌劍嘴誅口伐，平定中原的語錄。來源不可考，不過在鄉野傳說中，象棋裡的「炮」指的其實就是孟子的嘴，可以隔空殺人，而且恐怖之處在於方位拿準了，誰都殺得了。\n無論對方地位如何尊崇、請教的態度如何謙恭，都會慘被孟子教訓，他甚至在吵架時甚至用上了孫子兵法和內功，讓人被罵時都回不了嘴，被活活罵死都不奇怪。\n罵遍諸子百家，卻不許旁人非議他，怒駁：「予豈好辯哉！？予不得已也！！」乃成千古絕響。=During his travels among the states, the Confucian war god Mencius bested one rival after another in debate, using pointed words as blades to bring peace to the Central Plains. The source of these sayings is unknown, but local legend holds that the 'cannon' piece in chess actually represents Mencius's mouth-it can strike from afar, and the truly terrifying part is that once the angle is right, no one is safe. No matter how exalted the opponent's standing or how humbly they sought his counsel, they would still be soundly lectured by Mencius. He is even said to have drawn on Sun Tzu's Art of War and Internal Skill while arguing, leaving people unable to talk back, and it would hardly be strange if some were scolded to death. He railed against every school of thought, yet would not suffer anyone to criticize him, snapping back in fury: "Am I fond of debating? I have no choice in the matter!" And so his words became an echo that has rung through the ages.
南宮風流扇=Nangong Dashing Fan
名聞天下的南宮家學，莫看紙扇搖搖，一派儒雅若不經風，實則非同小可。\n扇法攻防一體，扇柄能打穴，扇面翩飛更藏後手，實為虛，虛為實，內力強者光憑搧風即可憾人，脫手飛旋來去，更是難防難閃。難得的是深有儒風，不驕不餒，謙遜致和。=Renowned throughout the realm, the Nangong Family Teachings should not be judged by its fan's gentle, scholarly sway-it is nothing to be trifled with. The fan technique unites offense and defense: the handle can strike acupoints, while the fan's fluttering motion conceals a follow-up strike. Feint becomes real, and real becomes feint; a master with strong Internal Force can harm an opponent with nothing but the wind of the fan. Once loosed, it spins and darts unpredictably, making it hard to block or dodge. Rarest of all is its deep scholarly bearing-never arrogant, never disheartened, humble and at peace.
崆峒玄兵鍛法=Kongtong Arcane Weapon Forging Method
記載了崆峒四門秘傳奇兵的鍛造方法，其中頗有機巧之術，鬼斧神工。\n子母鴛鴦鉞、機關鋸、鉤繩飛爪均有所載。\n你雖不使這些兵器，但造出來琢磨研究，精進自身技藝卻是可以。记载了崆峒四门秘传奇兵的锻造方法，其中颇有机巧之术，鬼斧神工。\n子母鸳鸯钺、机关锯、钩绳飞爪均有所载。\n你虽不使这些兵器，但造出来琢磨研究，精进自身技艺却是可以。=It records the forging methods of the legendary weapons of the Four Gates of Kongtong, containing ingenious techniques and masterful craftsmanship.\nThe Child-Mother Mandarin Duck Axes, Mechanical Saw, and Hooked Rope Flying Claw are all documented within.\nThough you may not wield these weapons yourself, crafting them for study and refinement can certainly improve your own skills.
南宮武備論=Nangong Martial Preparedness Treatise
南宮高祖，武林盟主南宮智的手書抄本。\n筆力雄健，一撇一捺宛若橫掃千軍，常為南宮族人習帖練字所臨摹。\n雖不記載武功，卻雜記了南宮智生平所悟，有兵法、學問、醫術、心路歷程、當代流行穿搭、笑話。\n其實這書還滿好看的。=A hand-copied manuscript by Nangong Zhi, founding patriarch of the Nangong family and Wulin Alliance Leader. His brushwork is bold and forceful, each stroke sweeping like an army on the march, and it is often used by Nangong clan members as a model for practicing calligraphy. Though it records no martial arts, it gathers Nangong Zhi's reflections on life-his military strategy, scholarship, medical knowledge, personal musings, the fashions of the day, and jokes. Truthfully, it's a rather entertaining read.
溫陽活血符=Warm Yang Blood Circulation Talisman
泥教天道的魔教心法。\n一部由醫書演變出來的養生氣功，以中醫「溫法」為基礎，用有溫、辛性質的藥物艾炙穴道，驅散寒氣，亦能補氣養血，十分靈驗，有回陽就逆之效。=The Heavenly Way internal method of the Mud Cult, a Demon Cult. A qi-cultivation technique developed from medical texts, grounded in the traditional Chinese medicine principle of the 'Warming Method.' It uses warm, pungent herbs to moxa the acupoints, dispelling cold qi while also replenishing qi and nourishing the blood-remarkably effective, with the power to restore yang and reverse collapse.
備急千金要方=Essential Formulas for Emergency Treatment
藥王孫思邈所著，驗方經方俱備的醫學巨著。\n此書基於《黃帝內經》臟腑學說，蒐羅醫論、醫方、用藥、針灸，共有二百三十門，藥方五千三百首。\n開卷《大醫精誠》一文，首論醫德，仁懷天下，影響後世深遠。=The Medical Classic written by the Medicine King Sun Simiao is a monumental work that encompasses both empirical and theoretical prescriptions. This book is based on the organ theory of the Huangdi Neijing, collecting medical theories, prescriptions, medicinal uses, and acupuncture techniques, totaling two hundred and thirty categories and five thousand three hundred prescriptions. The opening chapter, On the Absolute Sincerity of Great Physicians, discusses medical ethics and the compassion for the world, leaving a profound impact on future generations.
傷寒雜病論=Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases
東漢醫國手張仲景所著，是漢醫學經典。原典因戰火輾轉而失佚，此書是後人集《傷寒論》與《金匱要略》所編撰而成。=Written by Zhang Zhongjing, the Eastern Han dynasty's renowned Healer of the Nation, this is a classic of Han medicine. The original text was lost amid the chaos of war, and this book was later compiled by scholars from the Shanghan Lun and the Jingui Yaolue.
唐門藥典=Tang Clan Pharmacopoeia
唐門祖傳醫書，當世唯一以毒用藥的醫書。揉合苗疆、佛家學說，觀一碗水有八萬四千蟲，蟲即為毒，亦分五行六合，對應五臟六腑，多則害，少則病，盡則虛，錯則狂。\n人非不害於五毒，實乃毒性未發而已，唯得用藥養之，使其順心不逆，軀毒為己用，則百病難侵。=The ancestral medical book of the Tang Clan is the only one in the world that uses poison as medicine. It combines the teachings of the Miaojiang and Buddhism, observing that a bowl of water contains eighty‑four thousand insects, which represent poison. These poisons are also categorized into the five elements and six harmonies, corresponding to the five organs and six viscera. Too much leads to harm, too little results in illness, depletion causes weakness, and imbalance leads to madness. It is not that people are not harmed by the five poisons; rather, their toxic properties have yet to manifest. Only by using medicine to nurture them, allowing them to flow harmoniously, can one turn poison to their advantage, making it difficult for a hundred ailments to invade.
宋詞選集=Selected Lyrics of the Song Dynasty
魏菊精選的當代傑出文人詞集，節錄宋詞一百闕，平理若衡，照辭如鏡。\n所錄未必皆是名家手筆，但必為傑作。\n此書是魏菊手抄，字跡娟秀，有如美女簪花，又似鸞飄鳳泊，鬱鬱不能得志，但凡文人雅士，見此冊無不欣喜若狂，唯獨贈了你這江湖中人。\n她謹守誓約，卻藏了一點私心，以「佚名」身份，私心收錄了自己舊時著作。=Wei Ju carefully selected a collection of contemporary outstanding literary works in verse, excerpting one hundred Song Dynasty ci poems. Her curation was precise and balanced, akin to a mirror reflecting the words with clarity. Not all of these may be penned by renowned masters, but they are certainly masterpieces. This book is a hand‑copied edition by Wei Ju, with delicate handwriting that resembles flowers adorning a beautiful lady, as graceful as a phoenix's flight or a swan's wander, frustrated in its ambitions. Yet any literati would delight upon seeing this volume; it alone was given to you, a person of the Jianghu. She adhered to her vow but harbored a private desire, secretly including some of her own old works under an anonymous name.

It is made by boiling lamb, costus root, almonds, and other medicinal ingredients until tender, then brewing it with millet. 人生如萍，飄泊無定，且就相聚此刻，縱情高歌。\n你們師兄弟聚在這間山村小店裡，吃麵喝酒唱山歌，好不快活。\n即使將來分別了，『今日』也會在記憶深處熠熠生輝。=Life is like drifting duckweed‑rootless and unsettled. So let us seize this moment and sing our hearts out. 你的回合=Your Round

人各有各的緣法，既然如此，老衲也不便強求。\n那麼，老衲與師姪孫，就此與少俠別過。=Everyone has their own fate; since that is so, this old monk will not press the matter. Now, this old monk and my grand-nephew disciple shall take our leave of the Young Hero.
趙施主，暫別了，岳陽再見。=Benefactor Zhao, farewell for now. See you again in Yueyang.
恭送二位法師。=Respectfully seeing off the two Dharma Masters
只是留學的話，自然十分樂意=If it's just studying at another sect, I'm naturally more than willing.
能上嵩山留學，是晚輩的榮幸，哪有拒絕的道理。=Being allowed to study at Songshan would be this junior's honor ‑ how could I possibly refuse?
阿彌陀佛，善哉。\n如此，我們便約定好了，只要江湖太平，國泰民安，風調雨順，\n天下用不著趙少俠捨身的時候，你便來嵩山學法。=Amituofo, well said. Then it is settled: so long as the Jianghu is at peace, the nation prosperous and the people secure, and the weather favorable — in short, while the world has no need of Young Hero Zhao's sacrifice — you shall come to Songshan to study the Dharma.
那麼，趙施主也算是我嵩山弟子了。=Then, Benefactor Zhao can also be counted as one of my Songshan disciples.
還未是。=Not yet
須菩提，過去心不可得，現在心不可得，未來心不可得。=Subhuti, the past mind cannot be grasped, the present mind cannot be grasped, the future mind cannot be grasped.
多謝師叔祖點化。=Many thanks, Grand Martial Uncle, for enlightening me
趙施主，你身於濁世，難得心清如鏡不染塵埃。\n今朝種善因，來日正心正意，必結善果。\n老衲欲將此書，贈與施主。=Benefactor Zhao, you live in a turbid world; it is rare that your heart remains clear as a mirror, unstained by dust. By sowing a good cause today and keeping your heart and intention right in the days ahead, you will surely reap good fruit. This old monk wishes to present this book to you, Benefactor.
這、這不是嵩山鎮派神技嗎？\n大師怎能傳我這外派之人？=Th‑this isn't Songshan's signature sacred technique, is it? Master, how could you pass it on to me, an outer disciple?
非也。老衲所傳者，不是你。=No. The one this old monk passed it on to was not you.
此書所傳者，是將來入嵩山，成就戒、定、慧，捨身救世的大俠趙活。\n傳此絕技，是活一人，亦活無數善眾，施主你說是嗎？=This text speaks of a future Great Hero, Zhao Huo, who will attain precepts, concentration, wisdom, and self-sacrifice to save the world by entering Songshan. Teaching this unique technique is to save one person, as well as countless good beings. Benefactor, is that correct?
弟子拜謝大師。=This disciple bows in thanks, Master.
施主請起，汝有慧根，當不被俗相所迷。\n跪父母，跪菩薩，不跪眾生。=Benefactor, please rise. You possess a root of wisdom and should not be misled by worldly appearances. Kneel to your parents, kneel to the Bodhisattvas, but do not kneel to ordinary beings.
是，謹遵大師教誨。=Yes, I will respectfully follow the Master's teachings.
老衲見著了你，心願已了，去不去武林大會，已無所謂。\n這便啟程回返山門，誦經祈禱，祝願天下太平，\n好教你我鑽研佛法那日早些到來。=Now that this old monk has seen you, my wish is fulfilled; whether I attend the Wulin Assembly no longer matters. I will set out to return to my mountain gate, chant sutras and pray for peace throughout the land, so that the day when you and I can delve into the Dharma may arrive sooner.
小僧一同告辭。=This humble monk shall likewise take his leave.
恭送覺醒法師、福韞法師。=Respectfully bidding farewell to Dharma Master Juexing and Dharma Master Fu Yun.
嵩山派與唐門分道揚鑣，慈眉善目的老和尚獨行回寺。=The Songshan Sect and the Tang Clan parted ways, and the Old Monk, with a kindly face, returned alone to the monastery.
老和尚直到圓寂，也沒能等到你來，對你卻始終深信不疑。\n善因種下，不必由我見證，且待枝繁葉茂，留蔭後人。=The Old Monk never lived to see you arrive, yet he never doubted you. The seeds of a good cause have been sown; they need no witness from me—let them grow into flourishing branches and leaves, leaving shade for those who come after.
嵩山僧人與唐門有諸多因緣，不忍見唐門凋零。\n一路隨行，欲以佛法薰陶，勸導你等改邪歸正。\n師弟妹們耳濡目染，日漸失卻鬥爭之心，甚至萌生出家的念頭。=Songshan monks have many karmic ties with the Tang Clan and cannot bear to see the Tang Clan decline. They accompanied you along the way, hoping to use the Dharma to influence you and urge you all to abandon evil and return to the right path. The junior disciples, having been continually exposed to this, gradually lost their fighting spirit and even began to contemplate entering monastic life.
途中遭遇夏侯蘭的仇家，怒喝：「惡貫滿盈的奪魄幽蘭！妳不得好死！」\n瞥眼又看見你，怒喝：「獐頭鼠目，一看就知不是好人！你也去死！」\n夏侯蘭冷然推了你一把。=On the way, you ran into an enemy of Xiahou Lan's, who roared in fury, 'Soul-Stealing Orchid, your crimes are unforgivable—you'll come to a wretched end!' Catching sight of you next, she snarled, 'Rat-faced and shifty-eyed—one look and I can tell you're no good either! You can die too!' Xiahou Lan coldly shoved you aside.

你放走了挑戰者，因為是你應付的敵人，\n夏侯蘭雖然不滿，倒也沒有埋怨。=You let the challenger go, since they were the opponent you had to deal with. Xiahou Lan, though displeased, did not complain.
犯我師者殺無赦=Anyone who harms my master shall be killed without mercy.
明知奪魄幽蘭殺人不眨眼，還敢攔路辱罵，意圖行兇。\n想來是生死置之度外，你沒因對方是女子而心存蔑視，\n一劍成全了她的覺悟。=Fully aware that Soul-Stealing Orchid kills without blinking, she still dared to block your path and hurl abuse, intent on violence—as if she'd already resigned herself to death. You didn't scorn her for being a woman, and with a single stroke of your sword, you granted her that resolve.
途中遭遇覬覦夏侯蘭美色的淫賊，意圖下藥行兇。\n夏侯蘭明知茶水有毒還讓你喝，又推你上前擋刀。=On the way you encountered a lecherous bandit who coveted Xiahou Lan's beauty and intended to drug and assault. Xiahou Lan, knowing the tea was poisoned, still made you drink it and pushed you forward to take the blade.
你愛心氾濫，被罪犯一番說詞感動，輕易縱放，\n夏侯蘭極度不滿，對你大失失望。\n吩咐你原地等候，追上去把人給殺了。=You're too softhearted, moved by the criminal's talk into letting him go easily,\nand Xiahou Lan is furious, deeply disappointed in you.\nShe orders you to stay put, while she goes after him herself and kills him.
你一劍制裁惡賊，為民除害。=With a single stroke of your sword you brought the evil bandit to justice, ridding the people of a menace.
你將那淫賊一劍捅死，搜刮了他身上的財物。\n雖是黑吃黑，但也算得上是為民除害，功過相抵……吧？=You killed that lecherous bandit with a single thrust of your sword and looted the valuables on his body. Though it was still one criminal robbing another, it could be considered ridding the people of a menace, so the good cancels out the bad... right?
捉去見官=Arrest them and take them before the magistrate.

你對他的際遇深表同情，錯不在他，錯在師父太過美貌。\n他聽你這麼一說，登時痛哭流涕，與你惺惺相惜，握手言和。\n夏侯蘭冷眼旁觀，無言以對。=You felt deep sympathy for his plight; it wasn't his fault, but his master for being too beautiful. 你才不管他是否情有可原，一劍反殺，抹掉血跡，棄屍於地。=You didn't care at all whether he had any excuse; with a single stroke of your sword you cut him down, wiped away the blood, and left his corpse on the ground.
你搶回了方才被奪的錢財。=You snatched back the money that had just been taken.

唐門掌門獨生愛女。\n掌門憂其身嬌體弱，故閉關苦思三年，\n立基於獨門武功，另闢蹊徑，\n創制出「天地無聲勢」授予愛女。\n修練者必須全身繫上七串鈴鐺，苦練至急奔縱躍、投擲暗器皆不激響的境界，方使大功告成。受此心訣影響，生性淡漠，不常表露感情，不喜言語，亦不苟言笑。興趣是摺紙。=The Tang Clan Sect Leader's only beloved daughter. Worried over her frail, delicate health, the Sect Leader secluded himself for three years of meditation, and from his own unique martial art forged an entirely new path, creating the 'Heaven and Earth Soundless Force' for his beloved daughter. Its practitioner must tie seven strings of bells about her body and train relentlessly until she can sprint, leap, and throw hidden weapons without a single chime -- only then is her training complete. Shaped by this mental formula, she has grown detached by nature, rarely shows her feelings, dislikes conversation, and seldom smiles. Her hobby is paper folding.
從小耳濡目染，而又聰敏機靈，善用家族財產與人脈，習武有家主親授，練字有名家點撥，吃穿用度無一不是比照臨安貴冑，雖無功名在身，日子過的卻比秀才都滋潤。\n以人上人自居，處世頗有紈絝之嫌。\n與上官獨女上官螢有婚約，但二人見面不是吵架就是大打出手。=Grown up hearing and seeing the ways of the world, and being both intelligent and quick‑witted, they adeptly utilized family assets and connections. They learned martial arts directly from the Family Head and practiced calligraphy under guidance from a master. Their lifestyle was as luxurious as that of the nobility in Lin'an, despite lacking official titles or honors. Considering themselves above others, they often displayed a certain level of worldliness in their dealings. They had an engagement with Shangguan Ying, the only daughter of Shangguan Family, but their meetings were either arguments or physical confrontations.
懵懂記事之初，就跟著母親。\n那時不知貧窮為何物，日子單純而美好，他相貌長得好，又活潑聰明，心地善良，人見人愛，鄉裡孩子都愛跟他玩。\n那時他不叫南宮淺，似乎有別的乳名，如今已經不記得了。\n某天他玩得一身泥回家，好奇問了母親一句：「為何我沒有爹爹？我爹爹上哪兒去了？」\n他美好的童年就此戛然而止。=In his earliest memories, he was with his mother alone. Back then he knew nothing of poverty; life was simple and good. He was good-looking, lively, clever, and kind-hearted -- everyone loved him, and the children of the village all wanted to play with him. He wasn't called Nangong Qian back then; he seems to have had another childhood name, though he can no longer recall it. One day he came home covered head to toe in mud and asked his mother, out of curiosity, 'Why don't I have a father? Where did my father go?' That was the moment his happy childhood came to an abrupt end.
少時曾先後拜馬鈺、劉處玄為師，但都被父母抓回家鎖在柴房裡，家人見他求道之心迫切，才終於放生。=In their youth, they had successively taken Ma Yu and Liu Chuxuan as teachers, but were caught by their parents and locked in the woodshed. Seeing their urgent desire to seek the Dao, their family finally let them go.
天資聰穎，嘴力驚人，常在峨嵋、崆峒之間來回遊走，一邊弘揚佛法，一邊籌募善款修建嵩山寶剎。\n與良善之人相處抱持敬意，對頑劣之輩卻咄咄逼人。\n他對待的你的態度，取決於你的人品，一樣不免要嘮叨，差別在於用詞遣字氣不氣人。=Gifted with sharp intellect and Mouth Power, he frequently traversed between Emei and Kongtong, promoting Buddhism while soliciting donations to construct temples on Songshan. He treated good people with respect but was stern with those who were obstinate. His attitude toward you depended on your character; he would inevitably chatter, though the difference lay in whether his words irritated you or not.
點蒼派第一快劍手，\n當今武林最負盛名的年輕俠客之一。\n稱謂之來，是世人讚他有骨氣，如松柏般蒼勁有力，迎風而不曳。\n劍術才華出類拔萃，自十來歲拜入點蒼山門以來，短短幾年之間即閱遍點蒼山松雲閣中所藏一十七部劍譜。\n莫說同輩弟子望塵莫及，即便是其業師亦自嘆弗如。=The Diancang Sect's foremost swift swordsman, one of the most celebrated young heroes in today's Wulin. His title comes from the world's admiration for his unbending character, as hardy and resolute as pine and cypress, standing firm against the wind. His swordsmanship is exceptional -- since joining the Diancang Sect in his early teens, within just a few years he had read through all seventeen sword manuals held in the Songyun Pavilion on Diancang Mountain. Not even his fellow disciples can keep pace with him, and even his own master admits to falling short.
來自丐幫，近年來崛起的江湖新秀。他堅信弱肉強食的道理，弱者注定受人欺壓，唯有強者才能在這世道生存。莫欺他個頭矮小，打起架來卻有如狂犬一般，拳爪膝肘牙樣樣皆來，端的是天不怕地不怕，狠的要命。不知打哪學來的一套《揍狗拳》，命名粗俗，卻拙中有巧，講究一字心訣：「狠」，招招都把人往死裡揍。曾經趁一名年邁的八袋長老半夜起身如廁時尾行其後，將其狂毆透扁，打斷四肢推進糞坑。此後幫中即令是老資歷的多袋長老，也不敢在他面前倚老賣老，因為這人是瘋的。別說不管男女老少，只怕這人連大宋皇帝都敢打。=From the Beggar Sect, a rising new talent in recent years in the Jianghu. He believes in the survival of the fittest. The weak are destined to be oppressed, while only the strong can survive in this world. Don't underestimate him just because he is short; when it comes to fighting, he fights like a Mad Dog, using every part of his body‑punches, claws, knees, elbows, and teeth. He is fearless, ruthless, and deadly. He learned a set of 'Dog-Beating Fist' from somewhere, the name crude but cleverly devised, emphasizing a Mental Formula: 'ruthlessness.' Each move aims to finish the opponent off. Once, he followed an elderly Eight-Bag Elder at midnight as he went to use the bathroom, brutally beat him until he was unconscious, breaking his limbs and pushing him into a latrine. Since then, even the long‑tenured Many-Bag Elders in the sect dared not act old‑fashioned or presumptuous in front of this man, for he is mad. Not only would he dare to fight anyone regardless of gender or age, but rumors have it that even Emperor of the Great Song might be within his reach.
眼神慵懶，消極頹廢，嗜好是釣魚。\n自稱不愛喝酒，但是經常爛醉如泥。\n王二壯是丐幫由黑轉白的關鍵，統帥丐幫以來，大力宣揚俠義，令年輕丐幫弟子眼裡重新有光，願意相信自己身陷泥濘，仍能出淤泥而不染。\n只要心懷俠義，便是鶉衣百結也能自豪，那些最清廉的官兒，可不就是兩袖清風嗎？\n新派崛起，一掃丐幫從前惡習，所行無不光明正大，再也不幹偷雞摸狗的事，恨不能行俠仗義。\n老派依然勢眾，一邊斥罵新派不倫不類，淪為乞丐還自命清高，一邊又坐享新派掙來的美名。=His gaze is lazy, tinged with defeat and gloom, and his one passion is fishing. He claims not to care for drink, yet he's often blind drunk. Wang Erzhuang was the linchpin in the Beggar Sect's turn from darkness to light -- since taking command, he has championed chivalry with all his might, rekindling the light in young Beggar Sect disciples' eyes and convincing them that even mired in filth, one can still rise unstained. So long as one's heart holds to chivalry, even rags can be worn with pride -- after all, aren't the most incorrupt officials the ones with empty sleeves? The new faction has risen and swept away the sect's old vices; everything it does is now open and above-board, with no more petty thievery, only a hunger to right wrongs. The old faction, still strong in numbers, sneers that the new lot are neither one thing nor another -- mere beggars putting on airs of nobility -- even as they bask in the good name the new faction has earned.
豪爽而憨厚老實，一心求仙，跟隨火龍仙君修真，對於自己修練多年始終不能噴火感到十分羞愧。\n雖然修練仙法不成，實則是福緣深厚之人，機緣巧合習得風刀火劍，為業師所妒，遂以「要突破大乘期就必須累積功德」、「最快累積功德的辦法就是上戰場救國」為由，騙到宋金戰場去送死。\n但他常住戰場，始終沒死，反而深受官兵將士信賴，被譽為「道法將軍」，戰功彪炳，連襄陽守將趙方老將軍都破格禮遇。=He was straightforward, honest, and single-minded in his pursuit of immortality, following the Fire Dragon Immortal Monarch in cultivation, and deeply ashamed that after all his years of training he still could not breathe fire. Though he never mastered the immortal arts, he was in truth a man of great fortune: by pure chance he learned the Wind Blade and Fire Sword, which stirred his master's envy. So his master told him that to break through to the Mahayana stage he needed to accumulate merit, and that the fastest way to earn merit was to go fight for the nation -- and with that excuse, sent him off to the Song-Jin battlefield to die. Yet he lived on at the front and never died; instead he won the deep trust of officers and soldiers alike, earning the title 'General of the Dao,' with a record of victories so distinguished that even old General Zhao Fang, the defender of Xiangyang, showed him extraordinary respect.
常有女香客為了爭睹他的英俊面容，佯稱被妖魔纏身，上青城求他施法解救，申屠龍明知是假，卻照顧大家的心情從不拆穿。\n青城道士以降妖除魔為己任，但申屠龍壓根不信世上有妖怪。\n要說世上真有什麼稱得上邪惡，那便是人。=It was common for female admirers to feign being tormented by demons in order to catch a glimpse of his handsome face, pretending to seek his magical help at Qingcheng. The Daoist priests of Qingcheng took it upon themselves to exorcise demons and eliminate evil, but Shentu Long did not believe in the existence of such creatures. If there were truly anything in the world that could be deemed evil, it would be humanity itself.
他曾是故事中人，嵩山寺達摩院首席，法名覺空，名列武林十大高手之一。\n覺空禪師身兼七十二武技之七，尤以外功龍爪手最為拿手。\n武功之高，不下於方丈師兄。\n位高而德重，等閒不在江湖中行走，及至天命之年後，辭退首座一席，遠赴襄陽六道峽挑戰泥教天王，及後不知所蹤。\n再出沒時已然還俗，改號自稱鷹人。=He was once a figure in tales, the chief of the Dharma Hall at Songshan Temple, with the dharma name Juekong. 石公遠少年時，曾投身軍旅，\n為名將畢再遇軍中小卒。\n及後逃兵，落草於茂州茂濕山，成為山賊。\n石公遠胸無大志，過得一日是一日，與幫眾成日飲酒吃肉，醉生夢死，以逞凶為勇，\n橫練外功有成，生得孔武有力，\n更加肆無忌憚。\n更曾大膽劫持徒步上任的新知州，強娶知州千金為壓寨夫人。=Shi Gongyuan, in his youth, had once joined the military, serving as a minor soldier under General Bi Zaiyu. 官拜和安至保安郎，雖是從七品，但加個御前帶刀的頭銜，便是當朝一品大員也不能對他任意辱罵，他可是官家的刀，也以此為豪。\n除非天子，否則對誰都不亢不卑，這既是官家的期許，也是他自江湖熬來的膽氣。\n要是查明貪官污吏，王爺都敢捉拿，反之也極富人情味，宋刑統倒背如流，可遇著於法難容，但情有可原的情況，也常睜一隻眼閉一隻眼，或求情請從寬發落。=Though only a Seventh-Rank Security Officer by rank, the added title of Imperial Swordbearer means not even a first-rank official can insult him as he pleases -- he is, after all, the emperor's blade, and he wears that pride openly. 解無塵雖是正派中人，但是為人好勝好戰，每逢成名高手必要糾纏挑戰，為此沒少受挫折。\n獨門絕技《風雷神腳》乃是由家學《風神步》與峨嵋絕學《雷神腳》合一演變而來，施展開來可以邊踢邊借力，騰空踢到出人命。\n「風神」的別稱是花了五兩銀子請人幫忙傳誦的，不然哪來這麼威風的外號。=Xie Wuchen, though a member of the righteous sects, is competitive and eager for a fight; whenever a famous master appears, he can't resist picking a challenge, and it's cost him more than a few defeats. 他爹還沒加入丐幫以前，曾有功名在身，只得李富貴一個兒子，所以極其寵膩，李富貴不學無術，不到五歲就會掀姑娘的裙子。\n後來千金叟散盡家才，加入丐幫，李富貴依然跋扈任性，仗著他爹的臉面狐假虎威，直至王二壯掌斃千金叟，奪權霸佔幫主寶座，再也無人撐傘，李富貴才收斂氣焰，改名易姓認王二壯作父，意圖行刺。\n殊不知他這點心機，王二壯全都看在眼裡，還以為此子能夠臥薪嘗膽，孺子可教，不想李富貴半點沉不住氣，認父當晚就行刺，結果當然是功敗垂成。\n罰當然是要罰的，但不是打罵殺，而是逼他讀書、學武，摧殘他的心智、煎熬他的肉體。=Before his father joined the Beggar Sect, he had held official rank and position. Unbeknownst to Li Fugui, Wang Erzhuang had been watching all this carefully. He believed that such a boy could endure hardships and was worth training. 瑞笙的紅顏知己之一，苗疆巫靈教聖女。\n還在娘親腹中便被族中巫婆指作蛟龍妻。瑞笙與三五好友入苗疆，闖越五仙陣，揮劍斬大蛇，揭穿金蟾娘子和銀蛇公子的陰謀，喜聞樂見的英雄救美。\n和其他幾位紅顏知己鎮日爭風吃醋，可惜嘴巴壞，心腸卻軟，終究狠不下心下蠱相害，只得委屈自己終生鬱鬱。=One of Rui Sheng's beautiful confidantes, the Holy Maiden of the Miaojiang Witch Spirit Cult. 年紀輕輕，不知怎地一身武功高得出奇，自言出身孤雲山派，可任誰也沒曾聽聞這名不見經傳的小門派。\n對江湖充滿憧憬，揹著寶劍四處遊歷，好管閒事，愛打抱不平，處世謙抑而重情義，人緣絕佳，各派都結識了朋友。\n出山以來，對他一見傾心的女子大有人在，可他在意的小娘子，全都不是易與之輩，因此備受挫折。=At a young age, he somehow came to possess an extraordinary level of martial skill. 那一年的大雨涼亭中，與唐中翎相逢忘機，暢談天下事，好不快哉。\n一個寒窗窮書生，一個落拓江湖人。\n一文一武，縱然見地相左，\n也互生了敬重之意。\n縱然拜入唐門習武，二人相處卻更似忘年知己，經常一塊品茶話春秋。\n大師兄、二師兄都在他眼皮子底下長大，\n雖然位份高，卻從來不敢以兄長自居。\n只可惜起步習武太晚，要與天下英雄爭高低，終究是遲了。\n話雖如此，他天性也不愛逞強鬥狠便是，\n孫子兵法有云，上兵伐謀。\n不打架的才是贏家。=That year, under a pavilion in the pouring rain, he met Tang Zhongling by chance, and the two talked freely of the world's affairs — what joy that was! One a poor scholar, the other a drifter of the Jianghu; one lettered, one skilled in arms. For all their differing views, a mutual respect grew between them. Even after he joined the Tang Clan to study martial arts, the two got on more like old friends than anything else, often sharing tea and talk of passing seasons. The Eldest Senior Brother and Second Senior Brother had grown up right under his eye, and though they now held high standing, he never once presumed to call himself their elder. The incense burned in the Zhengxin Hall is precisely this one.

\n你獨行至後山，眺望遠山，月換星移，山河猶在，只是故人已往。\n正自不勝唏噓，卻有人不期履至，正是你朝思暮想的人兒。\n只是今時此刻的她，已有了歸宿而已。=You walked alone to the back mountain, gazing at the distant peaks. The moon changed and the stars shifted; the mountains and rivers remained—only the old friends were gone. As you stood lost in sorrow, someone came upon you unlooked-for: the one you had thought of day and night. Yet by now, she had already found a home of her own.
在酣鬥之中，記憶如潮湧現，你想起了學過的武功、作戰的方法、錯過的人。\n高興的事、悲傷的事、一生難忘的誓約、豪情萬丈、大雨中的嚎哭、重大的失去，還有放棄。\n你在一個什麼也來不及的時代清醒過來。=In the midst of fierce combat, memories flooded back—the martial arts you had learned, the ways of war, the people you had missed. Joys, sorrows, vows sworn for life, boundless passion, sobbing in the rain, great losses, and moments of letting go. You awoke in an age when there was no time for anything at all.
如今的你，早已今非昔比，甚至可以正面戰勝三師兄。=Now you have surpassed the past, and can even defeat the Third Senior Brother head‑on.
\n這一日，有人來喚你前去參加唐門會議。\n你如今是開會時不可或缺的一員。=One day, someone came to summon you to the Tang Clan council. You had by now become an indispensable member of these meetings.
昔日不入流的小幫會，不過短短幾年，已成為名震江湖的大幫派。\n聞此，你不得不心有戚戚，恍如隔世。=A once obscure, third‑rate gang, in just a few short years, had become a faction whose name shook the Jianghu. Hearing this, you couldn't help but feel a pang of melancholy, as if a lifetime had passed.
你不怕死的率眾反過來襲擊了飛石幫，大鬧了一番以後逃之夭夭。\n直把飛石幫主石公遠氣得七竅生煙，繼大師兄之後，你獲得了飛石幫頭號仇敵的榮譽頭銜。=Fearless of death, you led your followers in a counter-raid on the Flying Stone Gang, tore the place apart, and vanished before the dust settled. You left its leader, Shi Gongyuan, fuming with rage fit to burst—and after Eldest Senior Brother, you earned the dubious honor of the Flying Stone Gang's number-one enemy.
\n你獨行至後山，眺望遠山，月換星移，山河猶在，只是故人已往。\n正自不勝唏噓，卻有人不期履至，正是你朝思暮想的人兒。\n=You walked alone to the back mountain, gazing at the distant peaks. The moon changed and the stars shifted; the mountains and rivers remained—only the old friends were gone. As you stood lost in sorrow, someone came upon you unlooked-for: none other than the one you had thought of day and night.
她似從前一般，恬靜又溫馴，人畜無害。\n饞你手裡的烤魚的眼光依然那麼好懂，怕燙小口小口的吃著的模樣，\n就像時光倒流，回到了一切都還很美好的從前似的。=She was just as before—calm, gentle, harmless as ever. The way she eyed the grilled fish in your hand was as easy to read as always, and the way she nibbled it in small, careful bites for fear of burning her tongue made it feel as though time had turned back to those better days of old.
你們相互有千言萬語，有來不及想明白便錯身而過的心意。\n只是一切都已成了定數，無論當局者怎生掙扎，也贖不回從前。\n此刻你明白了嗎？愛與緣皆是掌心裡的流沙。=You both have a thousand words to say, yet the feelings that couldn't be fully understood pass each other by. But everything has already become fate; no matter how desperately the involved parties struggle, they cannot reclaim the past. Do you understand now? Love and fate are both sand in the palm.
即使是心思單純的小師妹，再後知後覺也明白了你的心意。\n思及從前種種，恍如隔世，不勝唏噓，唯有滿腔感激。\n你慎重地道別了你的夢想，你的歲月，你在唐門的盛夏光年。=Even the simple‑minded Junior Martial Sister, though slow to realize, eventually understood your feelings. Reflecting on past events, it felt as if they belonged to a different era, overwhelming with sorrow, yet filled only with deep gratitude. You solemnly bid farewell to your dreams, your years, and the golden summer years of the Tang Clan.
小師妹有如驚弓之鳥地從你身邊逃開了。\n這便是你們此生最後一面。=The Junior Martial Sister fled from your side like a bird startled by a bowstring. This was the last meeting of your lives.
你告白被拒絕，竟意圖用強。\n而且還打不過人家，興許是你不忍對心上人動起真格，總之是你輸了。=You confessed and were rejected, yet you resorted to force. Moreover, you couldn't even beat them. Perhaps you couldn't bring yourself to fight seriously against your beloved, in any case, you lost.
你告白被拒絕，竟意圖用強。\n可縱忍屠害萬民，卻不捨傷害心上的人兒。\n最終你放了她歸去，徒留你在原地，不勝寂寥。=Your confession was rejected, and you resorted to violence. Yet, even if you were willing to slaughter thousands, you could not bear to harm the one you loved. In the end, you let her go, leaving you alone, overwhelmed by loneliness.
\n這一日，便是武林盟剿滅唐門之日。\n練武場上瀰漫慷慨蕭條的氣氛，任誰也知道這一回留在此地有死無生。=This was the day the Wulin Alliance came to destroy the Tang Clan. A mournful, defiant air hung over the training grounds; anyone could see that to stay here was to die.
然而誰也沒有挪開腳步，人人視死如歸，胸中豪情萬丈，慷慨激昂。\n唐門走到了末路，起初是一家人，最後也是一家人。=Yet no one budged; every one of them looked on death as but a homecoming, hearts ablaze with boundless valor, fierce and unshaken. The Tang Clan had reached its final road — a family from the very start, and a family to the very end.
有些人走了，他們並非不講義氣，只是人之常情。\n剩下的人視死如歸，他們入門的時日有長有短，卻無一不是把唐門視為家園，以姓唐為榮。=Some had left; this was no want of loyalty, only human nature. Those who remained faced death as if returning home. Though they had joined the Tang Clan at different times, every one of them had come to call it home, and took pride in bearing the name Tang.
多數的人跟隨四師兄的腳步離去了，三師兄因此吁了一口長氣。\n無須怨懟，畢竟人生聚散如萍，該散的宴席始終會散。\n他們的旅途還長，也許你們的故事，能從他們口耳相傳中繼續承傳。=Most followed Fourth Senior Brother's lead and departed, and Third Senior Brother heaved a long sigh. There was no cause for resentment—meetings and partings in this life drift like duckweed on water, and every banquet must end. Their road still stretched on ahead, and perhaps your story would live on, passed from mouth to mouth along their way.
為著你們平日裡的多行不義，唐門早已人心渙散，\n大難臨頭，做鳥獸散，孤獨地死去原是該你的結局。=For your daily transgressions, Tang Clan has long suffered from a fractured spirit. Facing impending doom, scattering like birds and beasts to die alone was your destined end.
你與三師兄各自接戰20名各派弟子，縱使擊敗一人，立即又會有弟子遞補，\n前仆後繼，攻勢源源不絕，刀光劍影鋪天蓋日，殺聲震耳欲聾。=You and Third Senior Brother each faced twenty disciples from the other sects; even as you cut one down, another stepped up to take his place. Wave after wave they came, the assault without end, blade-light and sword-shadow blotting out the sky, and the roar of battle deafening.
你和三師兄合鬥名滿天下的三位大俠，時而各自為戰，時而聯手擊敵。\n酣鬥到尾聲，三師兄先你一步離世，捨身殉派，完竟了他代掌門的使命。\n三師兄前半生為大宋操心，後半生為唐門勞形，不似尋常江湖人那般身著華衫，仗劍爭名，卻一生磊落。=You fought alongside the Third Senior Brother against three renowned Great Heroes, sometimes fighting separately and sometimes uniting to defeat enemies. As the battle neared its end, the Third Senior Brother died first, sacrificing himself to the Tang Clan and completing his mission as the Acting Sect Leader. For his first half of life, he worried about the Great Song, and for the latter half, he labored for the Tang Clan. Unlike ordinary Jianghu figures who wear fine robes and wield swords to compete for fame, he lived a life of integrity.
你了結了一段忘年的宿緣。\n面對江湖最頂尖的高手，你的敗北順理成章，縱有不甘亦無可奈何。\n你被拿去和某個遙不可及的英雄人物比較。\n無論是在前輩萬里鵬程心目中、在小師妹的心中、在任何人心中，總有人比你更重要。\n似乎那人才是這個江湖的主角，天縱英才，日月星辰都為他而轉。=You have concluded a bond spanning generations. Facing the finest masters of the Jianghu, your defeat was only natural, and however unwilling you were, there was nothing to be done. You were held up beside some hero forever out of your reach. Whether in Senior Wanli Pengcheng's eyes, in Junior Martial Sister's heart, or in anyone else's, there was always someone who mattered more than you. It seemed he alone was the true protagonist of this Jianghu, a heaven-favored genius, with the sun, moon, and stars turning for him.
你了結了一段忘年的宿緣。\n從未想過有此結末，你戰勝了畢生所見最強的高手，卻仍是輸家。\n無論是在前輩萬里鵬程心目中、在任何人心中，總有人比你更重要。\n似乎那人才是這個江湖的主角，天縱英才，日月星辰都為他而轉。=You have closed the book on a bond spanning generations. You never imagined such an ending: you overcame the fiercest master you had ever faced in your life, and still you were the loser. Whether in Senior Wanli Pengcheng's eyes or in the hearts of everyone else, there was always someone who mattered more than you. It seemed he alone was the true protagonist of this Jianghu, a heaven-favored genius, with the sun, moon, and stars turning for him.
\n你半開玩笑的提議了乾脆直接投靠魔教，\n借泥教的力量抵禦武林盟的進攻。\n當然是立刻被否決了。=You half‑jokingly suggested directly surrendering to the Demon Cult and using the Mud Cult's power to counter the Wulin Alliance's attack. Of course, it was immediately dismissed.
三師兄對魔教疾之如仇。\n你卻不以傳聞為意，反嗆了三師兄道聽塗說。=Third Senior Brother despised the Demon Cult like a blood enemy. Yet you brushed off the rumors, and sharply accused Third Senior Brother of trading in hearsay.
閒聊之際，說起你曾被大蒙古國成吉思汗下令通緝的偉業，驚掉了三師兄的下巴。\n旋即知道你之所以被通緝，是為天下蒼生喉舌之故，不禁為此紅了眼況，心深處對你這位師弟的敬佩之心更深了幾分。=In casual conversation, mentioning your past as the target of a warrant issued by Genghis Khan of the Great Mongol Empire caused Third Senior Brother's jaw to drop.\nHe soon learned that you'd been hunted only for speaking up on behalf of the common people, and couldn't help but feel his eyes redden — his respect for you, his junior brother, deepening in his heart.
閒聊之際，說起你曾見過餓鬼道法王劉顎的事情。\n你刻意隱瞞了你和劉顎聯手對嵩山派福建分院住持施暴的惡行。=During idle chatter, Third Senior Brother brought up how you had once met Dharma King Liu E of the Hungry Ghost Path. You deliberately hid the fact that you and Liu E had once joined forces to attack the abbot of the Songshan Sect's Fujian branch.
\n為了向飛石幫求和，你與四師兄二人一同下山，到了飛石幫指定的酒館。\n本該是你們作的東道，都早了一個時辰，不想飛石幫卻老早便到場了，頗有喧賓奪主的味道。=To sue for peace with the Flying Stone Gang, you and Fourth Senior Brother went down the mountain together to the tavern the Flying Stone Gang had named. You arrived a full hour early, since hosting duties fell to you, but the Flying Stone Gang had gotten there even earlier still — rather as if the guest had usurped the host's role.
攜來的禮物是大師兄遺下的珍釀葡萄酒。\n他生前愛這葡萄酒甚逾自己性命，飛石幫主似乎也知道它的價值，老實且客氣的收下了。=The gift was a precious vintage grape wine left by Eldest Senior Brother. He loved the wine more than his own life, and it seems that the Flying Stone Gang Leader also recognized its value, humbly and politely accepting it.
攜來的禮物是你熬夜打造的機巧飛蝗。\n會拍翅膀、跳躍、發出聲音，但被飛石幫主嫌棄視為玩具。=The gift you brought is the mechanical locust you crafted after staying up all night. It can flap its wings, jump, and make sounds, but was despised by the Flying Stone Gang Leader and considered a toy.
攜來的禮物是新出爐的活龍丹。\n由於飛石幫主不信任你們，所以不肯收下，甚至要求你們當場服下。\n你登時就變強壯了。=The gift you brought was a fresh batch of Living Dragon Pills. Because the Flying Stone Gang Leader didn't trust you, he wouldn't accept them, and even demanded you swallow them then and there. You felt yourself grow stronger at once.
你以口若懸河的嘴上功夫對飛石幫主曉之以理，這魁梧大漢越聽越沒火氣，竟給你說服了。\n你言談間試探了他的底線，他的底線則是沒有底線。有道是男兒膝下有黃金，石公遠堂堂一幫之主，為了挽回妻子，卻寧可給跪。\n你也暗暗為大師兄向石公遠還敬了一點顏色，若讓這人拜於大師兄墳前，想必大師兄九泉之下也能瞑目了。=You reasoned with the Flying Stone Gang Leader with your silver tongue, and the more the burly giant listened, the more his temper cooled, until he was won over despite himself. In conversation you tested his limits, and found his only limit was having none. As the saying goes, a man's knees are worth their weight in gold — yet Shi Gongyuan, for all his standing as a gang leader, would sooner kneel than lose his wife. On Eldest Senior Brother's behalf, you quietly gave Shi Gongyuan a taste of his own medicine; if this man were ever made to bow before Eldest Senior Brother's grave, surely Eldest Senior Brother could rest easy in the afterlife.
你不畏強橫，為大師兄出聲辯白，不惜為此和飛石幫主石公遠大打出手。\n此時意料不到的強援忽然介入，為你的說法提供強力佐證，終於勸退了飛石幫主。\n龍湘向你道別，這一生已不會再來唐門了。=You feared no bully, speaking up in Eldest Senior Brother's defense, and even came to blows with Flying Stone Gang Leader Shi Gongyuan over it. Just then, unexpected reinforcements stepped in, lending powerful weight to your case and finally persuading Shi Gongyuan to back down. Long Xiang bid you farewell, vowing she would never return to the Tang Clan in this lifetime.
你和四師兄均無話可為大師兄分說。\n此時一名白衣女子登場，聲稱來自錦香宮，曾與大師兄一戰不分上下，\n未決勝負便陰陽兩隔，興許是惺惺相惜，為此求戰飛石幫主以正聲名。\n她獲得壓倒性的勝利之後，拂衣而去，徒留飛石幫主陷入沉思。=You and Fourth Senior Brother had nothing to say in Eldest Senior Brother's defense. At that moment a woman in white appeared, claiming to hail from Jinxiang Palace and to have once fought Eldest Senior Brother to a draw, their contest cut short when he passed from this world before a victor could be named. Perhaps moved by that mutual respect between rivals, she challenged the Flying Stone Gang Leader in turn, to vindicate his name. Having won an overwhelming victory, she swept away, leaving the Flying Stone Gang Leader lost in thought.
\n在你的提議下，被遺忘已久的段考重新施行。=Under your proposal, the long-forgotten mid-term exam was reinstated.
你首度擔任教官，意外發掘出自己也沒想到的才能。\n在指導旁人這件事情上，展現了優秀水平，受你指點的師弟妹們豁然開朗，武功突飛猛進，對你莫不欽佩得五體投地。=This was your first time serving as instructor, and you unexpectedly uncovered a talent you never knew you had. You proved excellent at guiding others: the Junior Martial Brothers and Sisters under your instruction were suddenly enlightened, their martial arts advancing by leaps and bounds, and every one of them came to admire you to no end.
你首度擔任教官，指導旁人練功，結果一蹋糊塗。\n儘管你努力表達，卻始終言不及義。\n非但沒有幫助，還引人誤入歧途。=This is your first time serving as an instructor, guiding others in their cultivation, but the result was a complete disaster.\nDespite your efforts to explain, your words consistently fell short of the meaning.\nYou not only failed to help, but also led people astray.
三師兄擔任考官，在眾弟子的見證下，你和四師兄捉對演武。\n你等二人的攻防蘊含了唐門武功的神髓，眾弟子各有感悟。\n只是四師兄始終不願拼命，不免成效有限。=Third Senior Brother served as the examiner, and you and Fourth Senior Brother sparred in front of all the disciples.\nYour combined offense and defense contained the essence of the Tang Clan's martial arts, and the disciples each gained their own insights.\nHowever, Fourth Senior Brother consistently refused to fight with all his might, so the results were inevitably limited.
四師兄擔任考官，在眾弟子的見證下，你和三師兄捉對演武。\n你等二人的攻防蘊含了唐門武功的神髓，眾弟子各有感悟，對你和三師兄的武功感佩於心。=Fourth Senior Brother served as the examiner, and you sparred with Third Senior Brother before the gathered disciples. Your techniques embodied the essence of Tang Clan martial arts, and each disciple gained insights, deeply admiring your and Third Senior Brother's skills.
四師兄擔任考官，在眾弟子的見證下，你和三師兄捉對演武。\n你等二人的攻防蘊含了唐門武功的神髓，眾弟子各有感悟。\n而你壓根無視大局，毫無顧忌地在眾目睽睽之下擊敗了代理掌門三師兄，卻挫折了同門師弟妹們的信心。=Fourth Senior Brother served as examiner, and before the assembled disciples, you sparred with Third Senior Brother. The two of you exchanged blows that embodied the essence of Tang Clan martial arts, leaving every disciple with insights of their own. But you gave no thought to the bigger picture, and without any restraint, defeated the Acting Sect Leader Third Senior Brother in full view of everyone — shaking the confidence of your fellow junior disciples.
唐門家門衰敗，債台高築，往日鼎盛風光不再，如今只剩寥寥幾人。\n你作為最後一位外姓弟子，故事從此開始。=The Tang Clan's family has declined, burdened by a mountain of debts, its former glory long gone, now leaving only a few remaining. You, as the last non‑clan disciple, mark the beginning of the story.
\n這日夜裡，你忙完回寢室，卻不見有人。\n正迷惑之間，四師兄便進來喊你。=On this night, after you finished your tasks and returned to the dormitory, you found no one there. Just as you were confused, the Fourth Senior Brother entered and called you.
你不由分說，立馬主張自己的清白。\n然而卻立馬被四師兄揭穿，教你好生尷尬。=You insisted without giving a chance to argue, immediately claiming your innocence. However, you were immediately exposed by the Fourth Senior Brother, leaving you in a very awkward situation.
你心慌之下自曝了先前失手燒掉字畫的秘密。\n燒了一幅字畫本來還不打緊，壞就壞在你自己胡亂畫了一幅，還冒名前朝詩人的名義。\n更慘的是那幅字畫還因為無法鑑定，被人用高價買回去考究。\n這事倘若被掌門知道，你可能會因敗壞師門名譽，被打斷手腳逐出師門。=In your panic, you confessed the secret of accidentally burning a piece of calligraphy. Burning it wasn't the real problem — the trouble was that you'd painted a replacement yourself and passed it off as the work of a poet from the previous dynasty. Worse still, the painting couldn't be authenticated and was bought back at a high price for further study. If the Sect Leader finds out, you could be expelled from the sect for disgracing its name, your limbs broken to boot.
\n卻原來不為別的，乃是臨時召集的唐門會議。\n以往都是門中耆老、各有職司的掌令使才能以參與，入室弟子等閒也不得旁聽，遑論外姓弟子。\n你來到唐門這許多年，這還是頭一次參與。=It turned out to be nothing else but a temporarily convened Tang Clan meeting. You have been in the Tang Clan for many years, and this was your first time participating.

\n商議到後來，大師兄忽然語出驚人，提議去殺南宮世家的仇家為太上家主賀壽。\n說著，便牽扯出十多年前一件江陵府官道上的劫糧案。\n相傳此案，是昔日極樂教在幕後，指使南宮叛徒南宮禹設伏所為，為的是要糧草招兵買馬，準備造反推翻大宋，其後東窗事發，南宮禹畏罪自盡，南宮世家又捐了大筆家財打點，官府方才罷休。\n那殉職運糧官的遺孤，惱恨朝廷竟不追究一介江湖世家，一怒之下落草為寇，自號牛魔王。十多年後卻意外打劫到夔州大俠譚霸刀的妻兒，見到刻有自己名字的長命鎖，認得那是從小佩戴的事物，方知原來真兇另有其人。\n他寫信向南宮世家求證、動用綠林渠道追尋真相，都未能取得關鍵的證據，南宮世家雖與他同仇敵愾，但顧忌名聲，沒有鐵證便不能向譚霸刀興師問罪，遑論那牛魔王混跡綠林，好事多為，天下誰能信他這個山賊，不信大俠譚霸刀呢？\n自知終生不能討回公道，遂向傳說中的南陽杏花仙求問，得錦囊授意，要他至夔州自首。\n他照辦了，卻始終等不到正義。就在問斬之前，絕望之際，曾經討厭得要死的飛俠唐布衣卻吊兒郎當拎著酒壺，下到地牢來為他送行。\n牛長壽臨行前的那一刻，受萬民唾罵，卻含笑而終。\n若他能為自己所為付出代價，那始作俑者也應當如此。\n大宋王法能縱放那個惡徒；恢恢天網能疏漏那個禍首，但好管閒事的唐布衣，絕對會跟那個人玩命。=After much discussion, the Eldest Senior Brother suddenly made a shocking suggestion: to kill the enemies of the Nangong family to celebrate the Retired Family Head's birthday. As he spoke, he brought up a grain robbery case from over ten years ago on the official road of Jiangling Prefecture. It was said that this case was orchestrated by the Supreme Bliss Cult, secretly ordering the Nangong traitor Nangong Yu to set an ambush, aiming to seize provisions to recruit troops and prepare a rebellion against the Great Song. When the plot came to light, Nangong Yu, fearing punishment, took his own life, and the Nangong family donated a large sum of money to settle the matter with the authorities. The orphan of the slain grain officer, enraged that the Imperial Court would not pursue a mere Jianghu family, took to the mountains in anger and called himself the Bull Demon King. Over a decade later, he unexpectedly robbed the wife and child of the great hero Tan Badao in Kuizhou. Seeing a longevity lock engraved with his own name, one he had worn since childhood, he realized the true culprit was someone else. He wrote to the Nangong family for verification and used his connections in the Green Forest to seek the truth, but could not obtain crucial evidence. Though the Nangong family shared his hatred, they were wary of their reputation and, lacking hard proof, could not accuse Tan Badao-especially since the Bull Demon King himself ran with bandits and had done plenty of wrong; who in the world would believe this mountain bandit over the great hero Tan Badao? Knowing he could never win justice in his lifetime, he sought guidance from the legendary Nanyang Apricot Blossom Immortal, who gave him a Brocade Pouch instructing him to surrender himself in Kuizhou. He did so, but justice never came. Just before his execution, in a moment of despair, the once-despised Flying Hero Tang Buyi came sauntering down into the dungeon with a wine flask to see him off. In the moment before Niu Changshou's death, reviled by the masses, he still died smiling. If he could pay the price for what he'd done, then the true instigator ought to as well. The laws of the Great Song may have let that villain go free; heaven's vast net may have missed the true culprit, but the meddlesome Tang Buyi would surely risk his life against that man.
你聞知此事義憤填膺，當即附和大師兄的提議。=You heard of this matter and were filled with righteous indignation, immediately agreeing with Eldest Senior Brother's suggestion.
你聞知此事雖也感到不平，但細想又覺不妥。\n那總是別人的家事，與唐門無關，貿然插手，似有越俎代庖的嫌疑。=Though you heard of this matter and felt it unjust, upon reflection, you found it inappropriate. After all, it's always someone else's family affair, unrelated to the Tang Clan. To meddle recklessly would seem like overstepping one's bounds.
至於結論如何，端看掌門定見。\n掌門年邁病重，胸中豪氣依然不減，聞知此事不假思索，便應允大師兄所請，派遣二師兄同往調查，倘若屬實，便誅此天人共憤之偽君子，即使不能使真相昭雪於世人眼前，亦足告慰南宮禹、牛長壽等人在天之靈。\n你正訝異從來不對盤的大師兄、二師兄竟要一同出任務，豈知你也莫名被捲進了這場風波之中。=As for the conclusion, it depends on the Sect Leader's judgment. Though elderly and ill, his indomitable Qi remains unshaken. Upon learning of this matter, he did not hesitate and readily agreed to the Eldest Senior Brother's request, sending the Second Senior Brother to investigate together with him. If the allegations prove true, they will execute this fake gentleman who has incurred the wrath of heaven and humanity. Even if the truth cannot be revealed to the world, it would at least bring solace to the spirits of Nangong Yu and Niu Changshou. You were surprised that the Eldest Senior Brother and Second Senior Brother, who had never gotten along, were going on this mission together, but you didn't realize that you too had been inexplicably drawn into this turmoil.
\n你去煉丹房報到，按吩咐另起子爐，準備就緒，二師兄鄭重囑咐你稍後爐鼎一開，你務須眼明手快，以剪子分藥，切莫耽擱使藥力逸散。\n你聚精會神，聽二師兄號令，待爐鼎一開，便一剪子下去──=You went to report to the alchemy room and started a new Child Furnace as instructed, making everything ready. Second Senior Brother solemnly warned you that once the furnace opened, you had to be sharp-eyed and quick-handed, cutting the medicine apart with scissors without delay, lest its potency escape. You focused intently, listening for Second Senior Brother's command, and the moment the furnace opened, you made a single cut with the scissors-
然而剪得太多了，二師兄怔了一怔，怒上心頭，將你臭罵了一頓。\n事已至此，唯有接受事實，遂命你將剪下的藥一分為二，製成二丸，以免藥力過猛，不能及時提煉，服之非但無益，反而有害。\n二師兄又吩咐了一些細節，便將子爐交你看掌，你再也不敢怠慢，打起十二分精神，試圖補救。=However, too much had been cut, and the Second Senior Brother was taken aback, his anger rising. He scolded you harshly. With matters now settled, there was no choice but to accept the situation. He ordered you to divide the cut herbs into two portions, making two pills, to prevent the medicine's potency from being too strong. If not properly refined in time, taking it would not only be ineffective but harmful. The Second Senior Brother gave further instructions and then handed you the Child Furnace to oversee. You no longer dared to be careless, putting in your full effort to make amends.
費時長達一個月，終於平安無事將子丹練成。\n你喜孜孜叫來二師兄，卻被命令當場服下一顆試藥，縱使不安，但在脅迫之下，還是吞下了丹藥。\n萬幸那丹藥力雖強，使你好一陣難受，不多時便漸趨溫和，二師兄命你打坐運功吸納藥力，你喜出望外，沒想到竟因禍得福，分得了這罕世靈丹的好處。=It took a month to finally successfully cultivate the Lesser Pill without incident. You joyfully called the Second Senior Brother, but were ordered to take a test pill on the spot. Though uneasy, you swallowed the pill under duress. Fortunately the pill's power though strong, made you feel unwell for a while, but soon the effects eased. The Second Senior Brother ordered you to meditate and absorb the pill's energy. You were overjoyed, never expecting to benefit from the mishap and gain the rare Spirit Pill's advantages.
你剪得恰到好處，二師兄鬆了一口氣，你也如釋重負。\n二師兄又吩咐了一些細節，便將子爐交你看掌。=You trimmed it just right, and Second Senior Brother let out a sigh of relief. You also felt relieved. Second Senior Brother then gave some more instructions and handed you the Child Furnace to oversee.
經歷數日熬煮，子丹如期完成，二師兄很是滿意，你也領會了一些煉藥的心得。=After several days of simmering, the Lesser Pill was completed on time. Second Senior Brother was very satisfied, and you have also grasped some insights into alchemy.
你一面讀閒書排解無聊，一面掌火，二師兄也沒什麼意見。\n經歷數日熬煮，子丹依然如期完成。=While reading leisure books to relieve boredom and holding the fire, Second Senior Brother had no objections. After several days of boiling, the Lesser Pill was still completed on time.
你剪得未免太少了些，遠不如預期，本來以為要挨罵了，沒承想，抬頭反見二師兄和顏悅色。\n原來他正愁此藥珍貴，剪去太多未免可惜，你的失誤反而合他心意。\n當下便要你搗些生藥油膏進去把丹藥弄大些，反正南宮世家也不知此藥本來該有多厲害。\n二師兄又吩咐了一些細節，便將子爐交你看掌，不消幾日，此丹便已完成。=You trimmed it a bit too little, far short of what was expected. You thought you would be scolded, but to your surprise, you looked up to see Second Senior Brother looking pleased. It turned out he had been worried this herb was too precious to cut away so much of; your mistake actually suited his plans. He immediately had you grind in some raw herbal paste to make the pill bigger-after all, the Nangong family had no way of knowing how potent this herb was meant to be. Second Senior Brother gave a few more instructions, then handed you the Child Furnace to oversee, and within a few days, this pill was completed.
\n大功告成，你問起此丹來歷，二師兄才肯說與你知。\n原來此丹大有來歷，原是二十年前曾經為禍武林的舊魔教右護法所用的奇毒《屍心蟲》，用以支配正道武林人士為己所用。\n如今極樂教覆滅，右護法被掌門擊殺，此毒物亦隨之消聲匿跡，再也無人問津。\n二師兄卻看中此毒的特性，展開研究，將此毒蟲煉製成丹。=The great task is done. Only then did Second Senior Brother agree to tell you the origin of this pill. It turned out to have quite a history: it was once the poison called the Corpse Heart Worm, used twenty years ago by the Right Guardian of the Old Demon Cult to control righteous Wulin martial artists for his own ends. Now that the Supreme Bliss Cult has fallen and the Right Guardian was killed by the Sect Leader, this poison too vanished without a trace, and no one gave it another thought. But Second Senior Brother took an interest in its properties, researched it, and refined the worm into this pill.
你對二師兄的遠見表示激賞。=You express great admiration for Second Senior Brother's vision.
你對二師兄毫不忌諱以此邪物煉丹的作法抱持中立意見。\n二師兄卻不在意世人眼光，甚至遠眺後世，只盼此藥終有一日能夠普惠世人，好教後世皆知唐門的仁心仁術。=You hold a neutral stance toward the Second Senior Brother's method of using this sinister substance for alchemy. The Second Senior Brother, however, does not care about public opinion and gazes into the future, hoping that this medicine will one day be accessible to all people, so that future generations will recognize the Tang Clan's benevolence and medical expertise.
你心直口快，直接說出了二師兄最不願聽到的話語，不出意外激怒了他，對你口出惡言，被搶白了一番，你覺得很受傷害。=You were straightforward, directly saying the words the Second Senior Brother most didn't want to hear, which inevitably angered him, leading him to speak harshly to you, reprimanding you, and you felt hurt.
\n大師兄向來率性，不打算拖泥帶水，便欲速戰速決，開門見山去質問譚霸刀。\n為免那譚霸天矢口否認，你便給出了一個計策，好去套他的話。\n二師兄與你剖析了一番他與大師兄武功的特性，不適合群毆，故此先由大師兄獨自出陣，倘若不敵，自己再出手收尾。\n而你的職責，則在掠陣保護舫上無辜百姓。=The Eldest Senior Brother has always been impulsive; not wanting to dawdle, he intended to force a swift resolution and confront Tan Badao head-on. To keep Tan Badao from flatly denying it, you came up with a plan to draw out the truth from him. The Second Senior Brother explained to you how his and the Eldest Senior Brother's fighting styles weren't suited to group combat, so the Eldest Senior Brother would go out alone first, and if he couldn't win, the Second Senior Brother would step in to finish it. Your job was to stay back and protect the innocent commoners on the boat.
當夜你們施展輕功，登上畫舫，譚霸刀對你等不速之客絲毫不懼，有恃無恐，端的是霸氣橫溢，無愧為成名的江湖老手，見慣了風雨，縱受包圍亦渾不改色。=That night, you all used qinggong to climb aboard the painted boat. Tan Badao showed not the slightest fear of you, his uninvited guests; brimming with confidence, he radiated an overpowering air of dominance, truly living up to his fame as a seasoned veteran of the Jianghu who had weathered every storm, unmoved even when surrounded.
直至大師兄依你計策，摸出了偽造的牛長壽遺書，當面說破譚霸刀從前所為惡事，他才為之動容。=Not until the Eldest Senior Brother followed your plan, producing the forged will of Niu Changshou and exposing Tan Badao's past misdeeds to his face, did he finally react.
可惜他遇見大師兄：天下第一氣人能手。開門見山便一副理所當然的模樣，指稱譚霸刀是兇手，又提及他贈親兒佩帶的長命鎖是牛長壽所有，令其心生忌諱，兩下子便將人給激怒了。=Unfortunately, he ran into the Eldest Senior Brother: the world's foremost master at getting under people's skin. Without any preamble, he flatly declared Tan Badao the murderer, as if it were simply obvious, and then mentioned that the longevity lock he had given his own son had belonged to Niu Changshou — striking a nerve, and in two moves flat, enraging him completely.
你又推波助瀾，與大師兄唱雙簧，差點沒把譚霸刀直接氣到升天。=You added fuel to the fire again, playing along with the Eldest Senior Brother in a well-rehearsed double act, and nearly made Tan Badao so furious he could have ascended straight to heaven.
譚霸刀俠名遠播，給人奉承慣了，黑白兩道都賣他面子，行事作風霸道，向來說一不二，壓根沉不住氣，言行之間暴露了許多破綻，但仍抵死不認，反叫出暗伏的殺手，意圖將你們殺人滅口。\n你和二師兄飛身躍回岸上，與刺客廝鬥，使大師兄無有後顧之憂，全心去接譚霸刀的寶刀。=Tan Badao's fame as a hero had spread far and wide. Long used to flattery, he was given face by both the law-abiding and the underworld alike. Domineering by nature, he always got his way and never once could hold his temper, and in the course of it all he let slip more than a few tells — yet he still refused to admit anything, and instead called out the assassins he had hidden away, meaning to kill you all to silence you for good. You and the Second Senior Brother leapt back to the shore and fought off the assassins, freeing the Eldest Senior Brother to focus entirely on meeting Tan Badao's treasured blade.
待你收拾了那二名刺客，回到船上，大師兄已受了傷，似乎屈居下風。\n譚霸刀得意洋洋，暗想你們三人之中最厲害的也不過爾爾，縱使三人齊上，又何足懼哉？\n大師兄早知慣用的金錢鏢不能治他，唯有祭出絕招──飛燕流星翎。\n二師兄聞言當機立斷，拉了你又躍回江邊，你還摸不清頭腦，只見那畫舫竟似被利刃盤旋切割，眨眼便支解傾塌。\n大師兄捉了重傷瀕死的譚霸刀，躍回岸上，二師兄當即為他施治。=After you dealt with the two assassins and returned to the boat, the Eldest Senior Brother was already injured and seemed to be losing ground. Tan Badao gloated, thinking to himself that even the strongest of you three amounted to little, and that all three together were nothing to fear. The Eldest Senior Brother already knew his usual Coin Dart could not bring him down, so he had no choice but to unleash his ultimate move — the Flying Swallow Meteor Feather. The Second Senior Brother acted at once, pulling you back with him to the riverbank; before you could make sense of it, the painted boat seemed to be sliced apart by whirling blades, and in the blink of an eye it broke apart and collapsed. The Eldest Senior Brother caught the badly wounded, dying Tan Badao and leapt back to shore, where the Second Senior Brother began treating him at once.
你與二師兄相處日久，見他臉色，便知情急，連忙下場幫忙。=Having spent so much time with the Second Senior Brother, you could tell from his expression that things were dire, and rushed in to help.
你潛心記住了二師兄施以急救的手法，暗想難保將來不會派上用場。=You diligently remembered the emergency treatment methods Second Senior Brother had used, secretly musing that it was hard to guarantee they wouldn't come into use in the future.
眼看不久之前還耀武揚威的譚霸刀，眨眼便成了這副悽慘模樣，不禁心下徬徨。\n無論你是好人、是壞人，武功多高，地位多尊崇，到頭難免一死。\n大師兄傷重之餘，也良言善勸你趁早退出江湖，莫要沾惹是非。這便是他此行真正想帶你看見的事情──武林不是只有風光體面、快意恩仇，人的性命便只一條，行走江湖，從來不是兒戲。=Watching Tan Badao — who only moments ago had been so full of swagger — reduced to this pitiful state in the blink of an eye, you couldn't help but feel shaken. No matter whether you're a good person or a bad one, no matter how high your martial arts or how exalted your standing, in the end none can escape death. Despite his severe injuries, the Eldest Senior Brother also gently urged you to quit the Jianghu while you still could, and not go looking for trouble. This was what he truly wanted you to see on this journey — the Wulin isn't only about glory and honor, or scores settled with relish; a person has but one life, and walking the Jianghu has never been child's play.
你默默的聽了進去，嚮往江湖的心因此淡了幾分。\n但捨了唐門，還能去哪兒呢？=You listened in silently, and the longing for Jianghu in your heart dimmed a bit. But if you gave up the Tang Clan, where else could you go?
你陪大師兄出生入死，冒險犯難，豪情充臆心間，將大師兄的話付之一笑。\n大師兄心知勸不了你，也尊重你的決定，就此不再多言語了。=You had risked life and death alongside the Eldest Senior Brother, braved every danger without hesitation, and with your heart full of resolve, you brushed off his words with a laugh.
