The rare fragrance wafted through the air, refreshing and invigorating. Even the old Jianghu hand Tan Badao never expected he himself would fall for such a trick. By the time he came to his senses and threw down his cup to disperse the smoke, the poison had already taken hold in his body, and suddenly his whole body went numb, leaving him unable to exert any strength.
你又加油添醋宣揚了一下二師兄辣手相公的名聲，直把譚霸刀冷汗都驚了出來。=You further embellished and spread word of the Second Senior Brother's reputation as the Ruthless Young Master, until Tan Badao broke out in a cold sweat with fright.
可那譚霸刀畢竟是道上打滾多年的老練人物，驚而不亂，當下腳下一踏，兩名暗伏的刺客應聲竄出水面。=However, Tan Badao was indeed a seasoned underworld veteran with years of experience. Remaining composed, he took a step forward, and the two hidden assassins burst out of the water in response.
雖說譚霸刀身中麻毒，但能追你上岸，便說明他猶有餘力，你頂著殺身的壓力，奮勇相抗，竟讓你擊敗了這位成名多年的大俠。\n大師兄、二師兄收拾了刺客隨後趕至，見此情景均自詫異。\n為防生變，遂將譚霸刀點穴生擒了。=Though Tan Badao had been struck with the paralytic poison, the fact that he could still chase you ashore showed he had strength left in him. Facing down mortal danger, you fought back with all your courage and managed to defeat this Great Hero who had made a name for himself over so many years. The Eldest Senior Brother and the Second Senior Brother, having dealt with the assassins, arrived soon after and were astonished at the sight. To guard against any further trouble, they sealed Tan Badao's acupoints and took him captive alive.
辦妥事情，再行幾日，終於到了江陵府南宮世家的地頭。\n但見城市石子鋪路，家家門戶都漆得新亮，人來人往，熱鬧非凡，與唐門山下小鎮的純樸風光截然不同。=After finishing the task and traveling for several days, they finally arrived at the Nangong family's territory in Jiangling Prefecture. The city featured stone‑paved roads, with every household's door freshly painted, bustling with people coming and going, lively and vibrant, completely different from the simple scenery of the Tang Clan's mountain village below.
\n這一日你出客棧，到鬧街閒遊，正讚嘆大城市風光，卻碰見兩名儒生裝扮的生人說你閒話。=This day you left the inn to wander the bustling street, and just as you were admiring the sights of the great city, you ran into two strangers dressed as Confucian scholars gossiping about you.
你只道大城市裡的人不愁吃穿，做學問的人多，人人都像三師兄那樣謙仲知禮，怎知道頭還是以貌取人，若天下人皆如此，那麼去到再遠的地方、再繁華的城市，於你也是同樣荒涼。不由得心灰意冷，遊覽的興致全無，就是向那臨安府的嚮往，也頓時淡了幾分。=You had assumed that in a big city, people wouldn't have to worry about food and clothing, that there'd be many scholars about, and that everyone would be as courteous and refined as Third Senior Brother. Little did you know that people still judge by appearances after all — and if that's true everywhere, then no matter how far you travel or how prosperous the city, it will feel just as bleak to you. You couldn't help but feel disheartened, all interest in sightseeing gone, and even your longing for Lin'an Prefecture faded a little.
你可沒打算容那二人無端說道，遂尾行其後，行至巷中，便忽然出手施襲。=You had no intention of allowing those two to speak without cause, so you trailed them, arriving at an alley, and then suddenly launched an attack.
\n你正想去喝杯茶，卻意外碰上了熟人。\n原來是早已離家的唐儒師姐，如今她已嫁作人妻，是為鍾少夫人。\n她容貌清減了幾分，似有風霜，卻比從前高高在上的姿態更可親了些。\n聽說她如今幫襯著夫家，承包安濟坊的飲食，本來便不得清閒日子，南宮壽宴將近，丐幫的弟子更是將安濟坊當作免費客店來投，累得她日日都忙得焦頭爛額，恨不得多生出幾條臂膀。\n她想起你從前在唐門做慣了粗活庶務，該是個好幫手，便開口邀請你前去幫傭。=You were about to go drink a cup of tea when you unexpectedly ran into an old acquaintance. It turned out to be Senior Sister Tang Ru, who had left home long ago. Now she had married into the Zhong family and was known as Young Madam Zhong. Her appearance had lost a bit of its former luster, as if touched by the winds of hardship, yet her demeanor was more approachable than before. It was said that she now helped her in‑laws, taking charge of the meals at Anji Hall, which already kept her busy. With the Nangong's birthday banquet approaching, the disciples of the Beggar Sect had turned Anji Hall into a free guesthouse, leaving her exhausted every day, wishing she had more arms to handle the workload. She recalled that you had once been accustomed to the rough labor and mundane tasks at the Tang Clan, and considered you a good helper, so she invited you to come and assist her.
\n你正想去喝杯茶，卻被一位商人裝束的陌生人喊住，道了身份，乃是當地漕運行會的行老。=You were about to go drink a cup of tea when a stranger dressed in merchant's attire called you out, revealing his identity as the head of the local Grain Transport Guild.
一問才知，是上官螢向他介紹了你。\n在你所不知道的地方，那姑娘似乎不像表面上那樣時時挑剔的樣子，反而向人說了不少你的好話，你既覺訝異，又感欣慰。=It turned out that Shangguan Ying had introduced you to him. In ways you weren't aware of, that girl seemed not to be as picky as she appeared on the surface, but instead spoke highly of you to others. You were both surprised and relieved.
那姓江的行老遂娓娓道來：原來是那上官千金在送壽禮前來的路上，碰見了非得親自操持不可的要事，彼時正吹北風，便將壽禮託付給船會運送。\n可那分舵通知的信鴿卻不知上哪去野了，姍姍來遲，導致同個船會的商船在江上相遇，竟起了衝突。\n要知船會為了獨攬漕運生意，不知花了多少黃金白銀打點，才取信朝廷，焉能容旁人假借船會的名義，來分這塊餅？水手們登時便狠霸霸的要強行登船，強徵過江費。\n豈料對面船上的，都是上官世家麾下的滄幫中人，雖不是海盜，也不是甚麼善茬，哪肯答應，一惱之下，竟反將對面船隻上的米糧、藥材、乾貨等等一應都扣押住。\n這下可不得了，那些米糧、乾貨，都是南宮世家的姻親鍾家所訂，鍾家承包官府所派的安濟坊生意，他們屆時前來討要米糧，江行老必定拿不出來，只愁的度日如年。\n只得將主意打到你頭上，想借你唐門的餘威，壓一壓這兩家人的氣焰。\n看看能否大事化小，小事化無。\n你好生為難，雖是個容易賺錢的生意，但貿然介入這種生意糾紛，又怕給師門添亂。=The man named Guildmaster Jiang spoke at length: It was Shangguan Qianjin who, on her way to deliver birthday gifts, encountered an urgent matter that required her personal attention. At the time, a north wind was blowing, so she entrusted the gifts to a ship company for transport. However, the homing pigeon sent by the branch office to notify them went missing, arriving late. This led to a collision between the same ship company's merchant vessels on the river. The ship company had spent a great deal of gold and silver to secure the exclusive right to transport grain, having won the trust of the Imperial Court. How could they allow others to use the ship company's name to share in the profits? The sailors immediately demanded to board the ship by force, demanding tolls for crossing the river. Unbeknownst to them, the people on the opposing vessel were members of the Cang Gang, under the Shangguan family's command. Though not pirates, they were no saints either, and they refused to comply. In a fit of anger, they seized all the grain, medicine, and dried goods on the other ship. This was a problem, as those goods were ordered by the Zhong family, a relative of the Nangong family, who had contracted the official Anji Hall business. When the Zhong family came to collect the goods, Guildmaster Jiang would be unable to deliver them, and he would be in a desperate situation. He had no choice but to turn to you, hoping to use the remaining prestige of the Tang Clan to suppress the fury of these two families. He hoped to downplay the issue and resolve it quietly. You were in a difficult position. Though this was a profitable business, you were hesitant to get involved in such a dispute, fearing it might cause trouble for your family.
並且洗劫了他們的銀兩，押去飛石幫當地的分舵，把他們倆給賤價賣掉了。\n那二名文人幾經波折，才終於見到飛石幫主說明原委，被放歸江陵府。\n只知吟詩做文章的書生身體力行做了幾個月粗工，身體結實了不少。\n也知曉了所謂『民生疾苦』，不單只是紙上四個墨水字。\n其中一人後來發憤圖強，果真考取功名，成為為民喉舌的棟樑之臣。\n另一人索性棄了書本，真的加入了飛石幫，不出幾年便壯得和牛似的。=You looted their silver taels, took them to the local branch of the Flying Stone Gang, and sold them at a low price. After many twists and turns, the two scholars finally met the Flying Stone Gang Leader to explain the situation and were released back to Jiangling Prefecture. The scholar who only knew how to compose poetry and write articles put theory into practice by working as a laborer for several months, becoming much stronger. He also realized that the so‑called hardships of the common people were not just four inked characters on paper. One of them later determined to strive, indeed passed the imperial exams and became a pillar of the state, the people's voice. The other person simply gave up books and joined the Flying Stone Gang, becoming as strong as an ox within a few years.
虧你習武之人，對付兩個弱不經風的儒生，也未能及時震懾，由他們大呼小叫引來街坊、捕快，將你緝拿歸案。\n若非南宮世家出面斡旋，你還不知道要在牢裡蹲多久。=It's a shame you, a martial artist, failed to subdue two frail scholars in time, letting them shout and cause a commotion that drew in the neighborhood and the constables, leading to your arrest. 宋總捕頭與你也算有交情，信你並非渾不講理的人，便良言勸了你。=Chief Inspector Song has some camaraderie with you and trusts you aren't someone who ignores reason, so he kindly advised you.
豈知你似笑非笑，說今日這幾下子，是為天下百姓打醒那二位書生的。他們將來若真能考取功名，能入朝為官、協助官家治理天下，豈能僅因擦肩而過，便以貌取人，輕言貶低他人？試問如此人品，真能愛民嗎？\n所以要趁當前打得，先教他們記住庶民拳頭的滋味，教他們知曉人人皆是血肉之軀。人皆可畏，莫要自視甚高，否則腹中空有詩書，說來頭頭是道，卻不心懷仁善，為官也只會誤國。\n輕描淡寫幾句話，似有無窮力量，彷彿天下蒼生皆在你背後。\n宋大人啞口無言，只是顧念官身，只能微微頷首表示敬意，他倒不是認同你的手段，卻是欽佩你這人。=Who would have guessed that you, with a smile that was not quite a smile, said these few blows today were meant to awaken the two scholars, done for the sake of the common people. If they truly attain official status in the future, if they enter government service and assist the Emperor in governing the country, how could they, merely because they passed each other by, judge others by appearance and speak lightly of them? Ask yourself, can such a person truly love the people? Therefore, we must take advantage of this moment to let them remember the taste of the commoners' fists, to make them understand that all people are flesh and blood. All people are to be feared; do not look down upon yourself. Otherwise, with only poetry and books in your belly, speaking eloquently, yet without a heart of benevolence, when you hold office, you will only mislead the country. A few words spoken lightly, as if carrying infinite strength, as if all the people of the world stand behind you. Commander Song fell silent, only considering his official position, and could only nod slightly in respect. He did not agree with your methods, but he admired your character.
你訕訕一笑，聽視聽了，下回究竟能不能忍，卻是未知數。=You smiled sheepishly, having heard him out, but whether you could hold your tongue next time remains uncertain.
\n你依著二師兄的指示，到他從前作過客席大夫的民間醫館見習。=You followed the instructions of the Second Senior Brother and went to the folk clinic where he had once served as a guest doctor, to gain experience there.
你於醫、毒之術頗有研究，兼之身具內功，號脈精準，眼光毒辣。\n擅長以毒攻毒，見效神速，頗有昔日名醫辣手相公的作派。\n在千金方坐診不過一個月，『鬼面郎中』的名聲便傳遍了江陵府，輾轉傳入二師兄耳中，就連向來嚴厲的人都難得莞爾。=You have extensive research in medicine and poison, and with your internal skill, your pulse diagnosis is precise and your discernment sharp. Within a month of practicing at Qianjinfang Clinic, the reputation of the Ghost-Face Physician spread throughout Jiangling Prefecture, eventually reaching the ears of the Second Senior Brother. \n你一到安濟坊，就碰見丐幫弟子在騷擾那鍾家少夫人，出言齷齪，渾沒將她鍾家少爺放在眼裡。\n那鍾少爺頑劣不堪，少時好勇鬥狠，曾加入丐幫，你師姐未嫁之時，見那鍾少爺渾身潑賴勁，似乎頗有幾分大師兄的不羈氣魄，又感念那人對自己關懷備至，終於答應委身，殊不知她眼光差了遠去。\n同樣是玩世不恭，大師兄任俠四方，她夫郎卻只是狐假虎威、色厲內荏之輩。在丐幫中不過是給丐頭跑腿的嘍囉，若非南宮世家出面，連脫離丐幫都辦不到，自家媳婦給人欺負仍是唯唯諾諾，既怕惡人，又愛惡人。\n辛儒師姐再遲鈍，也知自己嫁錯了人，只是不甘心，逢人便說自己過得好，今日受惡丐所辱，既不能求助於夫家，向南宮世家投訴也只能換得個息事寧人的結果，到頭還要反受夫君責難，說她小題大作，掃了鍾家顏面。\n可她不僅是鍾家的媳婦，也是從唐門出嫁的女兒。\n你挺身而出，威風凜凜護在她的身前。=As soon as you arrived at Anji Hall, you found Beggar Sect disciples harassing Young Madam Zhong, hurling crude insults with no regard at all for her husband, Young Master Zhong. 隨即搬出二師兄的名號嚇人，管用倒是十分管用，但你師姐的眼神登時便死了。=You immediately invoked the name of the Second Senior Brother to intimidate them, and it worked all too well — but your Senior Sister's eyes immediately lost their spark.
剛嚇退那惡丐，你還得理不饒人，竟趁人不備，將刀子抹了口水便毫不留情向人捅去，簡直惡得夠勁，那惡丐懂得陰損伎倆也不算少，就沒見過你這麼厚顏無恥的款，當場便給你戳了個半死。=Having just scared off that thug, you still pressed your advantage without mercy — catching him off guard, you wet your blade with saliva and stabbed at him without hesitation, truly vicious to the core. 你手底功夫如何姑且不說，嘴皮功夫卻著實了得，又是幾句話迫得那惡丐又怒又怕，鬥也不是、退也不是，心下已怯了，卻仍拉不下臉，索性跟你拚了。=As for your hand skills, let's not discuss them, but your verbal skills are truly impressive. 你得理不饒人，出言擠兌，要他向師姐道歉，豈知那惡丐也不是吃素的，給逼急了，惡向膽邊生，心想你二師兄再可怕，打你一頓便逃之夭夭，他也不見得有興致為你這廝千里緝凶報仇。=You pressed your advantage without mercy, taunting him with words and demanding he apologize to your Senior Sister. 你膽氣豪壯，誰欺了你唐門中人，誰的娘親就得遭你問候。\n當場大罵一聲，便與那惡丐動起手來。=You are brave and bold; whoever dares insult a Tang Clan member will have their mother suffer your wrath. He roared a curse on the spot and immediately engaged the evil beggar in combat.
\n你與師姐二人一時無法拾奪那惡丐，讓他搬弄是非，叫了許多幫手出來。\n眼見勢危，你正想思忖退路之際，大師兄突然現身援手，屈指連彈金錢鏢，輕易打退了群丐。\n他來得突然，去得也快，你師姐還想敘舊，大師兄已不見人影了。=You and your Senior Sister were unable to retrieve the evil beggar at that moment, allowing him to spread rumors and summon many helpers. 你打得那惡丐悻悻然而去，師姐好不詫異，幾年不見，你武功竟變得如此高強。=You defeated the wicked beggar, who left grumbling, and the senior sister was quite surprised. After several years apart, your martial arts have become so strong.

Watching the ferry workers and hired members of the Flying Stone Gang toil busily, drenched in sweat, while you lounged leisurely, you felt a bit uneasy. Though not a scholar by background, Guildmaster Jiang had considerable business acumen, and every day he taught you to appreciate ceramics and antiques. After several days of deep discussions, your eyes were truly opened.
你應邀來到渡口，擔任江行老的保鑣。\n他有求於你，將你奉為上賓對待，還專程去茶館請茶博士來沏熱茶。\n你哪曾受過這般禮遇，眼看渡口水手與受雇的飛石幫眾忙進忙出，汗流浹背，你卻在此悠閒自得，不禁有點兒心虛，主動請纓去做粗工。\n飛石幫本來與你唐門頗有嫌隙，可都不是針對你個人。最初幾日還對你冷嘲熱諷，但他們都不是城府深沉之輩，與你做著一樣的苦力活，日日吆喝著揮灑汗水，完事收工後去酒肆沽些便宜黃酒痛飲，要不多久，便與你打成一片了。=You were invited to the ferry dock to serve as Guildmaster Jiang's bodyguard. He had a favor to ask of you, treating you as a guest of honor and even going to the tea house to invite the Tea Server to brew a pot of hot tea. You had never been treated so generously before. Watching the ferry workers and the hired Flying Stone Gang members toil back and forth, sweating profusely, while you lounged comfortably, you felt a bit uneasy and volunteered to take on the rough labor. The Flying Stone Gang had long had tensions with your Tang Clan, but not with you personally. In the first few days, they mocked and jeered at you, but they weren't deep‑thinking people. After working alongside you on the same grueling tasks, shouting and sweating day after day, and then drinking cheap yellow wine at the tavern after finishing their work, they soon became close to you.
這一日，算來便是借予滄幫的大船即將到港靠岸的日子，江行老既緊張、又自豪，命手下眾人兩行排開迎接，豈料船上下來的，並不是滄幫弟子，亦非他船會的水手，二話不說提刀便砍，幸虧你及時出手，才及時救他性命。=That day, the ship lent to the Cang Gang was about to arrive at the shore. 你與飛石幫眾好不容易才擊退了這群無法無天的劫船惡匪，只是自己也損傷慘重。=You and the Flying Stone Gang members managed to repel these lawless pirates who attacked ships, but you yourselves also suffered severe injuries.

你試著勸白鯊幫眾以自身性命為眾，他們卻拒絕了你，這可不是他們能夠置生死於度外，而是因為他們幫主比閻王還可怕。\n閻王能令你投胎變畜牲，白鯊幫主能令你後悔出生，求生不得，求死不能。\n你無話可說，只能退讓到一邊，置身事外。=You tried to persuade the White Shark Gang members to risk their lives for the group, but they refused. 此後那群白鯊幫眾在江陵城中瞎闖亂撞，跑給官兵追，百忙中往安濟坊投了米糧，又得丐幫相助，終於逃出生天。=After that, the group of White Shark Gang members ran around aimlessly in Jiangling City, fleeing from the pursuit of the Imperial Soldiers. 小師妹和你都是生平第一次搭馬車，對這趟旅行雀躍不已。=Junior Martial Sister and you were both riding in a carriage for the first time, and you were both thrilled about the trip.

這幅字畫來之不易，你也有一份功勞。=This artwork is hard to come by, and you also have a share of the merit.
要知耕陽讀書齋的文人，心氣之傲舉世無雙，齋中皆是才華冠絕當代的隱士。\n躬耕在野，不戀浮華，不慕功名，宰相史彌遠派人延請，都被亂棍轟出書齋。\n齋主曾曰昇平能歌舞，亂世不作詩。寧當治世無能輩，不作昏朝有用臣。\n要待世間再無凍死骨，方才出山，歌頌四海昇平，否則寧死不食朝廷一石米俸祿，以彰顯自己讀書是為侍奉天地人三才，而非事一介人君。\n此書齋向來只寫江湖快報，其它墨寶萬金難求。\n南宮家主得此墨寶，驚喜若狂，當著賓客的面，對唐門賀禮大加讚賞，引來無數目光。\n賓客就算沒有文采的，也看過江湖快報；沒看過江湖快報的，也懂看南宮家主的臉色。\n都說唐門雖不如從前那般勢大，結交的朋友卻均非尋常人物，殊不可侮。=To know the scholars of Gengyang Reading Studio is to recognize their unrivaled pride of spirit; within the studio are reclusive talents unmatched in their era. Tan Badao, the instigator who had ruled for years by sheer force, finally surrendered as the tide turned. Your performance, interwoven with thunderous applause, resonated through the Jianghu, bringing a perfect and triumphant close.
此宴盛大，是南宮世家不惜血本，請四司六局安排。有上席招待官府貴冑、各派掌門、武林名宿等貴賓；次席招待各幫各派門人弟子、頗有名氣的獨行俠客；下席在府外擺桌，招待不拘禮節的江湖草莽、丐幫，乃至鎮上村民都可隨興過來分一杯羹。=This banquet is grand, organized by the Nangong family at great expense, with arrangements made by the Four Offices and Six Bureaus. \n席間各派門人吵吵嚷嚷，既沒人看得起你前來客套一番，你索性便自得其樂，吃你自己的酒菜，不亦樂乎。=At the banquet, disciples from various sects were noisily arguing, and since nobody thought you worth a polite word, you simply amused yourself, eating your own food and wine, quite content.
\n席間各派門人吵吵嚷嚷，既沒人看得起你前來客套一番，你索性便自得其樂，吃你自己的酒菜，不亦樂乎。\n怎料他們聊著聊著，忽然把矛頭齊齊指向了與世無爭的你，言語之間，甚至辱及師門。=At the banquet, the disciples from various sects were clamoring and making a fuss, with no one bothering to acknowledge you with any pleasantries. You simply decided to enjoy yourself, savoring your own food and drink, feeling quite content. Unexpectedly, as they chatted away, they suddenly turned their attention towards you, who had always been indifferent to worldly affairs, and their words even insulted your sect.
你讀了這許多書，也不是白讀的。\n當下也不發火，沉著性子，不亢不卑曉以大義，闡明道理，有古時聖人背書，無懈可擊，\n這等江湖草莽，壓根無言可對，想找麻煩反碰得一鼻子灰，聽是沒聽進去，卻對你這人生了幾分敬畏之心。=You've read so many books; it's not in vain. These outlaws of the Jianghu had no words left to counter, trying to stir trouble only to end up with their noses in the dirt. 他們肆無忌憚議論著江湖有名的女子，又將話頭談到唐門頭上，你一氣之下搬出了小師妹，反讓小師妹被人譏嘲，說她從未下山走動，必是貌醜見不得人。\n辱你無妨，辱你師門者可恨，辱你小師妹者不共戴天。\n你當即拍案而起，將人摁到地上瘋狂毆打。\n南宮族人連忙趕至，將你倆分開。兩方各執一詞，一時難分對錯，又有眾口鑠金，你反被冤枉。除了大師兄之外，其他師兄都不免怨你衝動，有損師門名譽。=They spoke freely about the famous women of Jianghu, and then turned the conversation to the Tang Clan. In a fit of anger, you brought up your Junior Martial Sister, which only led to her being mocked, with people saying she had never left the mountain and must be ugly and unpresentable. It was one thing to insult you, but to insult your sect was despicable, and to insult your Junior Martial Sister was unforgivable. You immediately slammed your hand on the table and pinned someone to the ground, beating them furiously. The Nangong clan members rushed over to separate you both. Each side held firm to their own words, making it difficult to determine right from wrong, and with many voices chiming in, you found yourself wronged. Except for the Eldest Senior Brother, the other Senior Brothers couldn't help but blame your impulsiveness, saying it tarnished the sect's reputation.
他們肆無忌憚議論著江湖有名的女子，又將話頭談到唐門頭上，你一氣之下搬出了小師妹，反讓小師妹被人譏嘲，說她從未下山走動，必是貌醜見不得人。\n辱你無妨，辱你師門者可恨，辱你小師妹者不共戴天。\n你當即拍案而起，想和此敵同歸於盡，小師妹卻在此時飄然而至。\n那幾人見了小師妹的容貌，登時無話可說，後悔不該貿然出言相譏，紛紛辯解，唐門對頭點蒼派的甚至起了歹心想博得美人青睞，背叛了方才新結交的朋友們，混亂廝鬥起來。\n小師妹卻自始至終不將他們幾人言語放在心上，為你拍拍順氣，勸你不要生氣，便回去了。=They spoke freely about a famous woman in the Jianghu, and then turned their talk to the Tang Clan. 旋即，小師妹去而復返，原來是看你桌上菜色不如上賓席，心有不捨，便去拿了一碟栗子米糕給你，你還沒入口，便覺得心頭甜甜暖暖的，甚是受用。=Soon, the Junior Martial Sister returned. 你處世豪爽，懶得多費唇舌，開宗明義要就打，不打就閉嘴。一番搶白便令他們再也不敢言語，他們倒非真怕了你這個名不見經傳的小人物，怕只怕鬧大開罪南宮世家。\n當下悻悻然不再答話，卻暗暗將你記下了，來日江湖再見，再找你算帳不遲。=You are plain-spoken and couldn't be bothered wasting words, making it clear from the start: fight, or shut up. 說的就是你。\n全場只有你一人睡著，連大師兄這等不羈之人都對你的行徑驚佩交加。\n大家都在猜想，南宮世家究竟對你做了什麼，令你這樣不給老前輩面子，委實猖狂。=That's you. 空前絕後。=Unparalleled in history
震古鑠今。=Shaking the ancient and shining in the present.

但你性情堅毅，反正回不了家，索性便將愁緒拋諸腦後，暫且不想了。\n好手好腳，總是餓不死的，沒什麽好怕的。\n從此天寬地廣任你行，你已是自由之身了。=But your temperament is resolute; after all, you can't go back home. 你又把今天的事，從前的事想過一遍，心中兀自憤憤難平。=You went over today's events and the old ones once more, your heart still churning with resentment you couldn't shake.

昔日你死活不肯離開唐門，老是拿小師妹當藉口，實則你心底早已不再牽掛她了。=In the past, you were dead set on not leaving the Tang Clan, always using Little Junior Sister as an excuse; in reality, your heart had long since stopped caring for her.

那三人的陣型就算缺了一個玄功門的位置，畢竟還是三打一，你應接不暇，苦苦支撐數個回合，忽有一名縞衣劍少見不慣人多欺負人少，便躍入場中助你，那三人一見他面目生得俊美，頓時調轉槍頭，六拳六腳都指向他招呼過去。\n好在那人武功頗高，只守不攻，讓你騰出手來拾奪了他們。\n其後互道姓名，才知道這路見不平的少年是來自名不見經傳的小門派，名叫瑞笙。\n他怕你下回又不明不白給人打了，便好心提醒你崆峒掌派人迎娶四姝的典故。\n他性情坦率可親，又是初出茅廬的武林新人，你見他這時，只覺與他說談無甚壓力，殊不知這一會，便是你與一代江湖傳說命運交錯的瞬間。=Even short one Mystic Skill Gate fighter, the three's formation was still three against one, and you struggled to keep up, barely holding on through several rounds. 魏掌門將你強留下來，是有苦衷的。\n只是她不便直說，要等親信的弟子過來，再請她向你交代。=Sect Leader Wei had her reasons for keeping you here against your will.\nShe just couldn't explain it to you directly, and wanted to wait for her trusted disciple to arrive and have her explain it to you instead.

In the Tang Clan, you were either scolded for being ugly, stupid, lazy, or a monster, or something like that. In any case, no one had ever praised you so kindly as Sect Leader Wei did. 在此之前，她考較了你的功夫進展。\n你雖是為了學藝才來，但基於種種情由，她上回所贈的秘笈你練得並不熟練，特別是後半部份壓根沒記全，只有隨興發揮，感覺該怎麼接，便怎麼接，勉強演完了整套武功。\n本以為要挨罵了，豈知魏掌門仍是笑容可掬，絲毫不以為意，還誇你進步快，建議你旁徵博引。=Before this, she tested your progress in martial arts. 在此之前，魏掌門為你泡了一壺餐前淡茶墊胃，這樣容易飽，便吃不胖，是維持體態的訣竅。=Before that, Sect Leader Wei brewed a pot of light tea for you to aid digestion, making it easier to feel full and thus avoid gaining weight, a trick to maintain one's figure.

這是你第二次喝魏掌門親手點的茶，她的茶濃時有如潑墨揮毫厚，淡時又似江上煙雨薄。\n茶中有四季，有山水，亦有歲月無憂。\n不言不語，才氣橫溢，多好的人兒。=This is the second time you've had tea brewed by Sect Leader Wei's own hand. 翌日一早，你應掌門召喚前往正心堂，還沒踏進去就見到許多師兄弟大包小包下山而去。=Early the next morning, you were summoned by the Sect Leader to Zhengxin Hall. Before you even stepped inside, you saw many fellow disciples heading down the mountain with bags big and small.

你離開唐門，封劍退隱，一生不再與人動武，活到天命之年。=You left the Tang Clan, sheathed your sword for good, and never fought again for the rest of your life, living to the age of fifty.
你一時沒回過神來，錯過了拜別而去的時機。=You were momentarily out of it, missing the opportunity to bid farewell and depart.

Narrator: The Beggar Sect's Li Fugui fulfilled his duty by putting aside family ties for righteousness; the Beast Path Dharma King Wang Erzhuang was finally slain. 抓獲了今日在場將近一半的惡丐，丐幫元氣大傷，看來短時間內難以再來滋擾江陵。=Nearly half of the evil beggars present today have been captured, severely weakening the Beggar Sect. It seems they won't be able to trouble Jiangling for a while.
忽聞人聲嘈鬧，卻見樊嘯天去而復返，只因他到了藏身處才發現，他阿叔竟然沒來會合，不假思索便隻身來自投羅網。\n你有意相救，只是他動手毆打官兵乃是事實，當此情況，你不便出聲，以免給人扣上犯上作亂的帽子，再想救人可就難上加難了。=Suddenly, the sound of people shouting and clamoring was heard, but Fan Xiaotian had gone and returned, for upon reaching his hiding place, he discovered his uncle had not come to meet him, and without hesitation, he alone walked into the trap. You intend to rescue him, but the fact that he attacked the officials is undeniable; in this situation, you cannot speak up, or you risk being accused of rebellion, making it even harder to save him later.
多虧唐門及時出手，才避免官兵被泥教賊人剿滅，今日功績，說是救江陵百姓於水火之中亦不為過。=Thanks to the Tang Clan's timely intervention, the officials and soldiers were spared from being wiped out by the Mud Cult's villains. Today's achievements can be said to have saved the commoners of Jiangling from the jaws of water and fire without exaggeration.
你得意忘形，對著逃竄乞丐求追猛打，豈料竟反中了對頭埋伏，回首才驚覺自己竟是孤身一人。=You're overconfident and arrogant, pursuing the fleeing beggar with fierce attacks, only to fall into the enemy's ambush, and upon turning back, you realize you're alone.
你滑不溜丟，這麼多人圍毆你，竟也能讓你夾縫求生、苟延殘喘。\n不是他們不想將你挫骨揚灰，實在是時間緊迫，不想因你這無足輕重的小子耽誤光陰，遂不再理你，轉眼就走個一乾二淨。\n你餘悸猶存，一面跑一面回顧，直到入城才相信自己當真順利脫險。=You're slippery and evasive, managing to survive amidst so many attackers, clinging to life in the narrowest of escapes. It's not that they didn't want to crush you to pieces and scatter your bones, but time was pressing, and they didn't want to waste precious moments on an insignificant fool like you. Thus, they left you be, vanishing without a trace. Still shaken, you ran, glancing back all the while, only believing you had truly escaped when you finally entered the city.
此戰告捷，入得城中，南宮家大公子親來相吟，滿臉堆歡，言談著實客氣。=The victory in this battle secured our entry into the city. The Eldest Young Lord of the Nangong family greeted us personally, his face beaming with forced cheer, and his words were genuinely polite.
不單南宮世家、城中百姓熱烈歡迎，就連御賜御前帶刀、天下捕役總指揮宋大人也來嘉勉，沐浴在掌聲、喝采聲中，唐門弟子均覺臉上有光，意氣風發之極。=Not only did the Nangong family and the city's commoners welcome them warmly, but even Commander Song, the imperially bestowed Swordbearer to the Emperor and Supreme Commander of All Constables, came to commend them. Bathed in applause and cheers, the Tang Clan disciples all felt a sense of pride, at the peak of their spirits.
入得城來，大公子南宮深親來迎接，對全真、峨嵋兩派弟子好生熱情，奉為上賓，對唐門藏身暗處按兵不動的作為，卻深不以為然。=Upon entering the city, the Eldest Young Lord Nangong Shen personally welcomed them, showing great enthusiasm towards the disciples of the Quanzhen and Emei sects, treating them as honored guests, yet he strongly disapproved of the Tang Clan's strategy of remaining hidden and taking no action.
縱令你剖析利害，他亦充耳不聞，在他眼中，你們便只是貪生怕死，背信忘義的小人，往昔唐門家道中落時，南宮世家是如何扶持你們的，竟得你們今日如此相報，直惱得他恨不得大開城門，將你等轟出江陵。=Even if you analyze the pros and cons, he remains deaf to it. In his eyes, you are nothing but cowardly, faithless villains. When the Tang Clan was in decline, how did the Nangong family support you? Yet you repay them with such treachery today, infuriating him so much he wishes to open the city gates and drive you out of Jiangling.
你們來助陣，反而給丐幫打得落花流水，大公子流露出鄙夷眼色，連客套話都懶得與你們這群無能之輩多說，便拂袖而去。=You came to lend support, but instead, you were beaten by the Beggar Sect until you were left in disarray. The Eldest Young Lord showed a look of disdain, too lazy to exchange even pleasantries with you incompetent lot, and then he waved his sleeve and left.
總算在旁隨侍的家丁尚算知禮，替大公子分辯幾句，安撫你們，才領到院中赴宴洗塵。=Finally, the household servant accompanying them was still somewhat polite, defending the Eldest Young Lord a few words and soothing you, only then leading you to the courtyard for a banquet to wash away the dust.
\n你們一行人退到臨鎮，只見鎮上一片蕭颯寂寥，人煙稀少，地上到處都有落下的事物，顯是唯恐江陵戰火延燒至此，才倉皇避難。\n萬幸鎮上客站還有開張，乃是掌櫃的愛惜性命丟下店不要，小二才冒險接了店鋪。\n你們也沒心思吃酒喝肉，只叫了茶水，愣愣發呆，正愁不知江陵後續如何，南宮世家家丁模樣的人便進了店，原來唐門前腳一走，全真、峨嵋兩派強援後腳便到，堪堪將丐幫打退，才解了眼下之危。\n南宮家丁見了你們狼狽的表情，也沒好氣，冷言冷語譏嘲，向店小二豪擲重金，要他整頓房間，準備接待江湖俠士，又補充了一句所謂江湖俠士並不包含唐門。下人敢如此放肆，恐怕是他主人已對唐門心灰意冷了吧。\n那家丁交代完事情，也不急著就走，他有心顯擺、刺激唐門，不料這一停留，丐幫就進了店中討茶水喝。\n唐門、南宮家丁、丐幫三方一怔，都汗毛直豎，雖還沒動上手，但情勢劍拔弩張，只要有一方動靜稍大，只怕瞬間就會演變成激戰，誰也不敢輕舉妄動，那南宮家丁方才冷嘲熱諷，這當兒立刻又巴望唐門大俠出手救他小命了。=You and your party retreated to Linzhen, only to find the town desolate and eerily quiet, sparsely populated. Scattered belongings littered the ground, clearly indicating that people had fled in haste, fearing the war from Jiangling would spread here.\nFortunately, the inn was still open, the proprietor having abandoned the shop to save his own life, and the shopkeeper bravely took over.\nYou were in no mood for food or drink, simply ordering tea and staring blankly, worried about the future of Jiangling. Just then, a man resembling a member of the Nangong family's guards entered the inn. It seemed that as soon as the Tang Clan left, reinforcements from the Zhengyi and Emei sects arrived, barely managing to drive back the Beggar Sect and avert immediate danger.\nSeeing your disheveled appearance, the Nangong guard was unimpressed and sneered coldly, tossing a large sum of money to the shopkeeper, demanding he tidy up rooms and prepare for visiting martial artists – adding that these martial artists did not include the Tang Clan. The guard's audacity suggested his master had likely given up on the Tang Clan.\nAfter giving his instructions, the guard didn't leave immediately; he seemed eager to show off and provoke the Tang Clan. However, just as he lingered, the Beggar Sect entered the inn to ask for tea.\nThe Tang Clan, the Nangong guard, and the Beggar Sect were all taken aback, their hairs standing on end. Though no one had started a fight yet, the atmosphere was tense, and any sudden movement could erupt into a fierce battle. No one dared to make a move. The Nangong guard, who had previously mocked you, now desperately hoped a Tang Clan hero would intervene to save his life.
唐門與丐幫各據客棧一角，彼此不相交談，可是空氣中卻瀰漫著肅殺之氣，你唯恐待會就要打起架來，先提一提大師兄，讓對方心有忌憚也好。\n你謊稱大師兄就在左近，只是尋友去了，丐幫弟子聽了嗤之以鼻，他哪裡不知你是想借飛俠的名聲壓他們氣焰？反嘴就提起不久之前正道俠士慘遭餓鬼道法王當眾折辱的糗事損你士氣，那俠士不是別人，還正是與飛俠齊名的風神解無塵。\n殊不知大師兄在附近雖然是你胡謅的謊話，可那解無塵竟然當真就在左近，聽了這話飄然現身，以為大師兄真在找他，不由得喜出外望，滿腔熱血，自顧自替你們出頭，你們無法可想，唯有硬著頭皮跟上。\n所幸解無塵敗給劉顎不假，一身本領卻也是貨真價實，尋常丐幫弟子根本不是對手，被飛腿踢得東倒西歪，落荒而逃。\n解無塵為人最好名聲，本想吹噓一下，又想起自己敗給劉顎之時，堂堂「風雷神腳」被強迫改名「很是用力踢」，登覺臉上無關，將你叫到跟前，強行用一千文價格把《很是用力踢》祖傳秘笈賣斷給你，便悻悻然而去了。=The Tang Clan and the Beggar Sect each occupied a corner of the inn, not speaking to each other, yet the air was thick with a sense of impending conflict. You feared that a fight might break out at any moment, so you mentioned your senior brother, hoping to instill some caution in the other side. You falsely claimed that your senior brother was nearby, just out looking for friends. The Beggar Sect disciples scoffed at this; they knew you were trying to leverage the reputation of the Flying Hero to intimidate them. They retorted by bringing up the recent humiliation of a righteous hero at the hands of the Dharma King of the Hungry Ghost Path, which dampened your spirits. That hero was none other than the Wind God, Xie Wuchen, renowned alongside the Flying Hero. Unbeknownst to you, although your claim about your senior brother being nearby was a fabrication, Xie Wuchen actually was close by. Upon hearing your words, he appeared, thinking your senior brother was indeed looking for him. Overjoyed and filled with enthusiasm, he stepped forward to defend you, leaving you with no choice but to follow along. Fortunately, while Xie Wuchen did lose to Liu E, his skills were nonetheless genuine, and the average Beggar Sect disciple was no match for him. They were sent fleeing, knocked about by his flying kicks. Xie Wuchen, known for his good reputation, initially wanted to boast a little, but then recalled how he had been forced to change the name of his signature move, 'Wind-Thunder God Kick,' to 'Very Forceful Kick' after losing to Liu E. Embarrassed, he called you over and insisted on selling you the ancestral secret manual for 'Very Forceful Kick' for a thousand coins, before leaving in a huff.
一度避戰，這時再入江陵，你們一行人都有點兒心虛，所幸那家丁蒙你們所救，心懷感激，將唐門大力誇獎了一番，大公子聞言，立時換了好臉色，前來見禮，前倨後恭，難免牽強。\n你們一行人只道大公子勢利，非得有點功勞才能得他正眼相看，不由得都看輕了這位貴公子，以為他是個紈絝草包。殊不知南宮深的心思遠比你們所想更深，他態度傲慢，並非輕視唐門，而是打從心底懷疑唐門是魔教奸細。\n由著四師兄出言相稽也不著惱，是為了他自己心理平衡。=Having once avoided battle and now re‑entering Jiangling, your group felt a bit guilty. Fortunately, the retainer was grateful for being saved by you and greatly praised the Tang Clan. Upon hearing this, the Eldest Young Lord immediately changed his expression to one of friendliness and came to greet you with courtesy. His change from arrogance to humility seemed somewhat forced. You all believed that the Eldest Young Lord was opportunistic and only showed favoritism after achieving some merit, thus unconsciously looked down on this noble prince, thinking him a spoiled good‑for‑nothing. 一度避戰，這時再入江陵，你們一行人都有點兒心虛，南宮大公子見了你們，亦沒好臉色，原來他老早就掌握唐門的行蹤，疑心你們消極作戰，似有魔教黨羽之嫌，即令不是，如此背信忘義的行徑，也不配與南宮世家論交。\n你們怯戰是事實，登時語塞，話說到這步田地，等如決裂，正心寒時，南宮老太爺便得了消息，持杖打了過來，往孫子頭上掄，只是南宮深成見已深，這一杖未能收當頭棒喝之效，好在被你和四師兄勸住了，否則他若不將孫子捶死，自己也會氣死。\n及後四師兄飽含歉意地說明了原委，老太爺年逾百歲，卻老而不朽，心靈通透的很，絲毫不以為意。言道：人皆有畏死之心，你等遠道而來，已足感盛情，一時使不上力，也不算什麼罪過──說到底，又不是你唐門圍的江陵。\n這一席話只把你們小夥子都感動壞了。=Having avoided battle once, you all felt a little guilty coming back to Jiangling this time. He said: everyone fears death; that you had come so far already showed great goodwill, and being unable to fight all-out for a moment was no great sin — after all, it was not your Tang Clan that laid siege to Jiangling. 在無人街道一番激戰過後，終於憑著硬功夫彌平了人數劣勢，將丐幫擊退。\n南宮家丁此時已換了一張嘴臉，一口一個大俠，馬屁連發，哄得眾人心胸舒坦。=After a fierce battle on the empty street, you finally overcame the numbers with sheer hard technique and drove back the Beggar Sect. The Nangong Family Servants had already changed their tune, calling you "Great Hero" with every other word, showering you with flattery until the whole crowd felt pleased with themselves.
南宮家丁看你們一來二去，動個不停，怕心濺去，反覺好笑，以為你們是在跳舞，忍不住想摻一腳，也賣弄起隨性舞姿，殊不知你們雙方早就陷入僵局，誰也不服誰，正愁無法下台，不約而同便將怒火轉向那家丁，痛扁一頓撒氣以後，丐幫等的茶水也來了，總算沒和唐門動起手來，和平落幕。\n只有南宮家丁受傷的世界完成了。=The Nangong Family Servant watched you two sides going at it nonstop, and rather than fearing he might get splashed with blood, he found it funny, taking it for dancing. 你默不作聲，卻和帶頭的丐幫弟子互相打量對方，用眼神較勁，靠著微小的肢體線索，揣測對方心態，不斷相互刺探，在思想中進行了一場殊死決戰。=You remained silent, but locked eyes with the leading Beggar Sect disciple in a silent contest, sizing each other up through the smallest cues, probing each other's mindset again and again, waging a life-and-death battle within your thoughts.
你和對方思想戰中轉瞬拆了十幾二十招，暗暗心驚，均覺對方武功高強，起了相敬之心，你有意點到為止，故意賣了一個小小空子，對方會意，也不趁勝追擊，也退了一步，放下手中杖碗，對你拱手作揖。\n丐幫等的茶水也來了，總算沒和唐門動起手來，和平落幕。=You and the opponent exchanged over ten moves in the clash of thoughts, each secretly impressed by the other's formidable martial arts skills, and both felt mutual respect. 萬萬沒想到你目光凶光乍現，趁他放下兵器接連擺了幾個全無退路的進手架式，招招都是致人於死地的狠招。=Never expecting it, a fierce glint suddenly flashed in your eyes — taking advantage of him lowering his weapon, you struck one merciless, no-retreat stance after another, every move meant to kill.
你們三人武學見識均不相同，即使起初幾招可以見微知著，演變到後來，勢不可免便會出現分歧誤解，早已面目全非，但憑心證而已。\n十餘招後，恐懼的心情充斥著你們三人的心，特別是那丐幫弟子，回家以後接連作了好幾天噩夢，對唐門的邪門手段多年無法釋懷。\n雖然不知道他在想什麼，不過你嚇退了敵人。在那之後，關於你的奇怪傳聞也在江湖不脛而走。=The three of you had very different levels of martial understanding; even though the first few moves showed hints of what was to come, as the bout wore on, divergence and misunderstanding were bound to arise, until the true shape of things was long lost, leaving only each person's own sense of it. After a dozen-odd moves, fear filled all three of your hearts, especially the Beggar Sect disciple's — back home he had nightmares for days on end, and could never shake off the Tang Clan's sinister methods for years after. Though no one knew what he was thinking, you had scared off your enemy. After that, strange rumors about you spread through the Jianghu like wildfire.
\n武林各派齊聚江陵，大公子意氣風發，居中指揮，調度各派人馬潛伏，只待明日丐幫自投羅網，屆時各派便可響應官兵，從四面八方斷其後路，將丐幫人馬一網打盡。\n這一次動手，再也不是從前那般互相忌憚，小打小鬧，捉了人又放，放了又捉，始終留有底線。而是明刀明槍上沙場拚生死的。\n在座俠士均摩拳擦掌，熱血沸騰躍躍欲試，料來以雙方覺悟之差，又打他個措手不及，屆時定能將那泥教畜牲道殺個措手不及，掃蕩群邪，還中原武林一片清明氣象。=Wulin sects gathered in Jiangling, with the Eldest Young Lord in high spirits, directing operations and deploying each sect's forces into hiding, waiting only for the Beggar Sect to walk into the trap the next day. Once it sprang, every sect would move together with the Imperial Soldiers, cutting off their retreat from every direction and wiping out the Beggar Sect's forces in one sweep. This time it would be nothing like before, when both sides had held each other in check, sparring in small skirmishes, catching and releasing prisoners, always leaving some room to back down — this time it would be an open fight to the death on the battlefield. The heroes gathered there all itched for action, blood boiling with eagerness, reckoning that with the gap in resolve between the two sides, they could catch the Mud Cult's Beast Path completely off guard, sweeping away the wicked and restoring the Central Plains Wulin to a clean, bright order.
你卻對諸俠激昂情緒不以為然，丐幫勢強時不曾強攻奪城，如今正道集結，便不留餘地，高嚷著要趕盡殺絕，未免有違你心中所認定的俠義。=You, however, are not in agreement with the passionate sentiments of the heroes. When the Beggar Sect was strong, they never launched direct attacks on cities. Now that the righteous forces have united, they leave no room for mercy, loudly demanding total annihilation, which seems to contradict the chivalry you uphold.
你和眾位師兄弟也都受群情鼓譟，鬥志昂揚，恨不得此刻就上戰場，弄死那群沒人愛的臭乞丐。=You and your fellow martial brothers were all whipped up by the crowd's fervor, itching for battle, wishing you could storm onto the battlefield this instant and kill off that pack of unloved, stinking beggars.
商議既定，各自人馬便紛紛告辭，枕戈待旦。=Once the discussions were finalized, each respective force began to bid farewell one after another, ready for battle at dawn.

連此前捉獲的樊嘯天，都被老太爺向官府要了出來。=Even Fan Xiaotian, who had been captured earlier, was gotten out of the authorities' hands by the Old Patriarch.
你倆人見面好生歡喜，老太爺知他是你朋友，有意把功勞轉嫁幾分給你，向樊嘯天說是看了你的面子，才去牢裡放他。樊嘯天對你更敬佩了。=The two of you were overjoyed to see each other again. 這位老師兄刀子嘴豆腐心，說是要一刀剁了你的頭，實則招招留手，\n他雖多年不與人動武，但功力深厚，絕非新人可比，你被打得節節敗退，落荒而逃。=This Senior Brother is sharp‑tongued but soft‑hearted; he claimed he would chop off your head, but every move he held back. 這位老師兄功力深厚，只可惜多年不與人動手，難免生疏，非你敵手，敗下陣來只道要完，怎料你一陣亂揮，便收起小劍，言道叛徒已誅，從此除名。\n如此一來，便絕了將來掌刑使找上門來問罪的隱患。\n老師兄望著你離去的身影，感慨萬千，他從前可是欺負過你的，不只一次想趕你下山，你卻仍念著舊情，令他不由得自慚形穢，除下了身上的藍色制服，再也不打著唐門的幌子做生意，改稱乃受唐門恩惠的市井小民。=This Senior Brother's Power ran deep, but after years without a real bout he had grown rusty, and was no match for you. 萬幸這二人感情深篤，彼此都是真心實意，爭論到頭，終於達成共識。\n師姐隨你上山，之後這位峨嵋師兄自會再找媒人上門說親。=It's a relief that these two share a deep bond, both sincere in their feelings. After a prolonged debate, they finally reached a consensus. 那二人吵得狠了，均覺對方面目可憎，枉費了彼此三年青春。\n你師姐悲從中來，含淚負氣而走。=The two of them argued fiercely, both finding the other repulsive, having wasted each other's three years of youth. Your Senior Sister's grief welled up within her, and she left with tears in her eyes and a sullen heart.
你擇不願對人糾葛輕言置喙，拱手告辭而去。=You decided it was not your place to comment lightly on others' entanglements, so you simply cupped your fist in farewell and departed.
你焉能坐視本門同胞受人欺侮？欠她的公道，自然要討，拔出刀子，便與那峨嵋中人廝鬥。=How could you stand by and watch a sister of your own sect be wronged? The debt of justice owed to her demanded repayment — you drew your blade and fought that man from Emei.
然而你卻低估了對手的實力，反被打得四腳朝天。\n總算對方念及兩派情誼，沒有對你痛下殺手。=However, you underestimated your opponent's strength and were knocked down. Fortunately, the opponent took into account the bond between the two factions and refrained from delivering a killing blow.
對方雖不是好相與的貨色，但你也非昔日廢材，加上他心緒浮躁，自然敗在你手上。=Though the man was no easy mark, you were no longer the washout you once were, and his mind was restless besides — naturally, he fell to your hand.

你倒不是非得要他性命不可，只是見不得自己人受委屈，拿刀威脅對方去向師姐道歉，反被師姐攔住。\n回家途中，嘴上不說，心下卻頗為感激，以前從沒正眼看過你這人，嫌醜、嫌賤、嫌噁心，如今才覺得，你這師弟其實也沒印象中那麼惹人嫌。=You didn't necessarily mean to take his life — you simply couldn't bear to see one of your own wronged, so you threatened him with your blade to make him apologize to your Senior Sister, only to have her stop you. 你見對方輸了一副萬念俱灰的模樣，料來對你師姐也不是全無真心，收起兵器，默默離去，殺他容易，只是殺了，這兩人的故事便再也沒有後續。=Seeing your opponent utterly defeated, wearing a look of despair, you judged that his feelings for your Senior Sister were not without sincerity after all. \n那對俠侶吵到後來，不約而同將矛頭指向了你，都怪你不該來，累得他們情侶反目，當即向你齊齊攻來。\n這位師姐乃是已故師伯的愛徒，論武功，在方今唐門之中堪稱佼佼，而她情郎的武藝亦不相伯仲，一人使拳，一人使小劍，配合的天衣無縫，你與二人相鬥，就像被四人圍攻一樣狼狽。總算他們這套武功新創，還未打磨，你覷出破綻，方始僥倖破了他們拳劍合璧之術，氣得他倆負氣而走，自創的秘笈也丟下不要了，反正連一個外姓弟子也拿捏不了，算是什麼絕招？\n殊不知你幾乎要被打得魂飛魄散，這套武功雖還說不上驚世駭俗，揚名立萬足矣。=That Heroic Couple, quarreling on, turned as one to blame you, both insisting it was your fault their romance had turned to ruin — and at once, together, they attacked you. \n你打開了二師兄費盡心血照料多年的主爐，裡邊藏著掌門延命的關鍵，與唐門存續亦息息相關。=You opened the main furnace that Second Senior Brother had spent years tending with painstaking care; hidden within lay the key to the Sect Leader's longevity, bound up with the very survival of the Tang Clan.
然後你就把木瓜放進去了。=Then you just put the papaya in.
然後你就把活的雞放進去了。\n那雞還敢掙扎，你給了牠一拳，牠才吐血變得老實，不打不成器。=Then you put the live chicken in. It still dared to struggle, so you gave it a punch; only then did it cough up blood and settle down — spare the rod, spoil the child.
你趁二師兄不在家，偷拿他珍藏的胡椒粉調味料。\n從前人少的時候，無論你整啥菜色，他都拼命往裡加，還深諳獨樂樂不如眾樂樂的至理，別人不吃，他還會愀然不樂。\n只因近來本門新人漸多，二師兄才稍微收斂。\n若知你懷念他的調味，料他非但不以為意，還會暗暗竊喜。\n你將胡椒粉揉進肉餡，用麵團包著，做成了胡椒餅，蹲在廚房裡獨享。=While Second Senior Brother was away from home, you secretly took his treasured Pepper Powder. Recently, as more newcomers joined the sect, Second Senior Brother had begun to restrain himself a bit. 你剛咬一口，葉雲裳就聞香破門而入。\n你見狀一驚，唯恐她來與你爭搶，別過身去狂吞虎嚥，一點屑都沒給她留下。\n她倒不是真的貪圖你的點心，但見你如此自私，也不禁生氣，有種被你欺侮的委屈，無處訴說。=You just took a bite, and Ye Yunshang caught the scent and burst in through the door. 你剛咬一口，葉雲裳就聞香破門而入。\n有道是見者有份，你只得將胡椒餅對半切成兩份，將沒就口那一半遞給她。=You just took a bite, and Ye Yunshang smelled the aroma and burst through the door. As the saying goes, those who see share; you had no choice but to split the pepper cake in half, offering the untouched half to her.

不料雲裳嫌辣，只咬了一口，就不吃了。\n你眼珠子咕嚕一轉，像是要給老天爺聽的似的，言道不該暴殄天物，只能替她吃了。=Unluckily, Yunshang found it too spicy, took a bite, and stopped eating. Your eyes rolled, as if putting on a show for Heaven itself, and you declared it a shame to waste food — so you simply ate it for her.

不料雲裳嫌辣，只咬了一口便不吃，將餅塞你手裡便跑了。=Unluckily, Yunshang found the food too spicy, took a single bite and then refused to eat more, slipped the pancake into your hand and darted away.
你倒不是忌憚世俗禮教、男女之嫌，只是忌憚她兄長的無情快劍，於是你將雲裳咬過的部分切掉，扔進廚餘桶中。=You weren't held back by worldly propriety or scruples between men and women — only by dread of her brother's merciless, lightning-fast blade. So you cut away the part she had bitten and tossed it into the scrap bin.
雖然浪費可惜，可是防於禮教，你只有忍痛將她咬過的部分切掉，扔進廚餘桶中。=Wasteful as it was, propriety left you no choice: gritting your teeth, you cut away the part she had bitten and tossed it into the scrap bin.

然則掌門所說的話，卻又令眾弟子啞然寒心，聽他言下之意，自承老邁體衰，已無力再領銜唐門，要派門中弟子下山去尋那多時未曾露面的大師兄回來，承襲掌門之位。=Yet the Sect Leader's words left the disciples speechless and chilled to the bone. Before anyone could respond, an old monk with a kindly face came shuffling into the Tang family courtyard, chanting a Buddhist invocation — none other than the renowned Chan Master Shi Ming of the Songshan Sect's branch. With his backing, Tang Shan's identity was beyond doubt, and those who had been seething with anger could hardly denounce him to his face before a revered monk of Songshan.
繼二人以後，還有一人盈盈步入院中，紫衣華服，鳳眼櫻唇，容姿秀美，既有大家閨秀的氣度，亦有巾幗英雄的凜凜威風，正是你朝思暮想的上官家千金，上官螢。=After the two of them, a third figure glided into the courtyard — clad in fine purple robes, with phoenix eyes and cherry lips, of striking and elegant bearing, carrying both the poise of a great lady and the commanding air of a heroine among women. She was none other than the Shangguan family's cherished daughter, the one you had longed for day and night: Shangguan Ying.
繼二人以後，還有一人盈盈步入院中，紫衣華服，鳳眼櫻唇，容姿秀美，既有大家閨秀的氣度，亦有巾幗英雄的凜凜威風，正是武林三大世家，上官家千金，上官螢。=After the two of them, another figure glided into the courtyard, clad in fine purple robes, with phoenix eyes and cherry lips, her features delicate and beautiful, carrying both the refined bearing of a great lady and the commanding spirit of a heroine among women. She was Shangguan Ying, daughter of the Shangguan family, one of the Wulin's three great clans.
眼看來者不善，你也懶得虛情客套，也不管高僧在旁，一上前便惡言相向，先來個下馬威。\n此舉正合二師兄心意，難得破例與你一搭一唱，令那唐衫還未說話，心下先怯了幾分。=Seeing that the newcomer meant trouble, you didn't bother with false courtesy — high monk or no, you strode forward and let loose with harsh words, delivering a show of force before he could open his mouth. This suited Second Senior Brother down to the ground; rarely did he break form to play along with you, and it left Tang Shan quailing inwardly before he'd said a word.
上官螢與你交情匪淺，今日站在你的對面，這位從來神采飛揚的巾幗丈夫難得露出了難堪的畏縮神色，與你對上眼，便慌忙別開，彷彿心中有愧似的。=Shangguan Ying and you went back a long way. Standing across from you that day, this ever-spirited heroine, who was rarely anything but radiant, wore for once an awkward, shrinking look. The moment her eyes met yours, she glanced away in haste, as though a guilty conscience weighed on her.
\n釋明大師與掌門一陣寒暄，此二人雖屬舊識，卻非友非敵。\n掌門年輕時，曾千里追殺一名輕薄你師娘的登徒貴公子，誰來相勸都不買帳，迫得對方落荒而逃，遠避嵩山派福建分院，尋求住持釋明方丈庇蔭。\n掌門雖亦正亦邪，對佛門中人卻禮敬有加，薄薄一面木門，一踹就開，他卻安份在外扣了上百回，日夜聽僧人誦經，其後南宮、上官兩家家主齊齊來勸，這才買帳，悻然而歸。\n掌門在長夢之中，也曾夢見釋明。\n那一年他新任住持，頗有雄心魄力，說不開門，就不開門。\n今日卻已將衣缽傳人，離寺雲遊多年，變得慈眉善目，老態龍鍾。\n伊人已逝，往昔種種，皆如雲煙，恍如隔世為人，往昔對他的氣惱，也淡泊許多，再也恨不起來了，就連當年追殺的那位貴公子生作什麼模樣，都記不清了。\n釋明卻不知掌門思緒萬千，寒暄幾句，便切入正題，他攜上官世家嫡女偕來，為的便是要為這自稱唐門分家的弟子撐腰，使他無有後顧之憂，能暢所欲言，力諫掌門。\n那唐衫得掌門允可，便飛身上了正心堂簷，提氣朗聲發言，力陳利弊，他口口聲聲以唐門子弟自居，憂心忡忡，雖說大師兄為人慷慨仗義，卻豪爽不羈，自律尚且難能，何況管束門人？江湖一波未平，一波又起，若不選任一名德高望重、在江湖說得上話的人物接任掌門，只怕唐門百年基業，朝不保夕！=Master Shi Ming exchanged pleasantries with the Sect Leader. Although the two were old acquaintances, they were neither friends nor enemies. In their youth, the Sect Leader had once pursued a frivolous young lord who had disrespected his master's wife for a thousand miles. No matter how many people tried to persuade him, he would not listen, forcing the young lord to flee in disgrace to the Fujian branch of the Songshan Sect, seeking refuge under Master Shi Ming. Though the Sect Leader was both righteous and unrighteous, he held great respect for those of the Buddhist order. He kicked the thin wooden door open with a single blow but remained outside, knocking hundreds of times, listening day and night to the monks reciting scriptures. Eventually, the heads of the Nangong and Shangguan families came to persuade him, and only then did he relent, returning with some reluctance.  In a long dream, the Sect Leader had once seen Master Shi Ming. That year, he had just been appointed as the abbot and was quite ambitious, declaring that he would not open the door. Today, however, he had passed on his robes and bowl to a successor, having traveled for many years, and had become kind and benevolent, showing signs of age. The person he once knew was gone, and all the past seemed like smoke, as if it belonged to another world. The anger he once felt towards Shi Ming had faded significantly, and he could no longer summon any hatred, not even recalling what the young lord he had pursued looked like.  Unbeknownst to Shi Ming, the Sect Leader was lost in thought. After exchanging a few more pleasantries, Shi Ming got straight to the point. He had brought the legitimate daughter of the Shangguan family with him to support a disciple who claimed to be from the Tang Clan, ensuring that they could speak freely and advise the Sect Leader without worry. Once the Tang Shan received the Sect Leader's permission, they leaped onto the eaves of the Zhengxin Hall, gathering their breath to speak loudly and clearly, presenting the pros and cons. They repeatedly identified as a disciple of the Tang Clan, expressing deep concern. Although the eldest senior brother was generous and righteous, they were also free‑spirited and undisciplined, making it difficult to manage the disciples. With the Jianghu still turbulent, if a person of high virtue and reputation was not chosen to succeed the Sect Leader, the century‑old foundation of the Tang Clan might be in jeopardy!
他此話雖然在理，卻不在情。\n要知唐門乃是世家，並非尋常門派，自家人不護著自家人，還叫什麼世家？唐門上下一心，聽了這席話，哪裡還不群情洶湧，人人都想搶上前去，將那唐衫揪下地來，亂拳打個半死再看他有何話說。=His words, though logical, lacked sentiment. After all, the Tang Clan was a noble family, not an ordinary sect. If their own wouldn't protect their own, what would they be called? United as one, the Tang Clan heard these words and erupted in fury. Everyone wanted to rush forward, grab Tang Shan by the collar, and beat him to a pulp before he could speak another word.
上官螢見此情景，不憂反喜，暗中長吁一口氣。\n如此一來，無論她如何巧舌善辯，都難力挽狂瀾，那便不至於對不起你們了。=Seeing this situation, Shangguan Ying felt joy instead of worry and secretly let out a long sigh. In this case, no matter how eloquently she spoke, it would be difficult to turn the tide, so she would not have to feel guilty towards you all.
如意算盤打壞了，唐衫氣急敗壞，從袖中抽出暗箭，射向天空，當空綻出劈啪火花。=His scheme in ruins, Tang Shan flew into a rage, drew a hidden arrow from his sleeve, and loosed it into the sky, where it burst into crackling sparks.
他此言正中唐門諸人心坎，唐門內憂外患良多，門人苦不堪言。不約而同均想：自己心慕唐們威名上山拜師學藝，卻不想百年世家，竟淪落到今日田地，半點威風沒有，行走江湖還處處受人冷遇。\n大師兄那人，往好處想是隨和率性，往壞處考量，確實沒半分威嚴可言，由他統領唐門，如何教人放心？適逢江湖風波不斷，人心更難安定。=His words struck at the heart of everyone in the Tang Clan. Internal troubles and external pressures plagued the sect, and the disciples suffered greatly. They all thought, without speaking amongst each other: They sought the Tang Clan's renowned name and traveled up the mountain to learn the arts, yet they never imagined that a prestigious clan of a hundred years would fall to this sorry state, lacking even a shred of prestige, and facing coldness and disrespect wherever they went in Jianghu.\nThe eldest senior brother, when considering things positively, was amiable and easygoing, but when considering them negatively, he certainly lacked any sense of authority. How could people feel at ease with him leading the Tang Clan, especially with the constant upheaval and instability in Jianghu?
上官螢見狀，便上前一步，侃侃而談。\n她自幼學商，代父操持上官產業，不過桃李之年，便儼然隱有女當家氣派，最是能說會道，又是世交嫡女，由她從旁舉薦唐衫的師父，聽來最公道不過。\n一時之間，人人都覺她言之有理，那師叔唐守鴻樂善好義，江湖名聲好，又有佛緣，與嵩山高僧交情深厚，得此庇蔭，唐門何愁不能安然渡過江湖大浪？\n唯獨二師兄依然不假辭色，冷言相激，上官螢卻悠然自得，輕描淡寫便化解了他的話碴。=Shangguan Ying stepped forward, speaking confidently. She had been raised in the business world, managing her family's affairs since childhood. Though still in her early twenties, she already exuded the air of a capable leader, eloquent and persuasive. As the daughter of a prominent family with longstanding ties, she was the ideal person to recommend Tang Shan's master. Her suggestion seemed entirely reasonable. At that moment, everyone found her arguments convincing. Martial Uncle Tang Shouhong was a kind‑hearted man with a good reputation in Jianghu, blessed with a deep connection to Buddhism and close ties with monks from Songshan. With such support, the Tang Clan would surely weather any storm in Jianghu. Only the Second Senior Brother remained unmoved, speaking coldly to challenge her. Yet Shangguan Ying remained calm and composed, effortlessly countering his objections.
上官螢自幼學商，代父操持上官產業，不過桃李之年，便儼然隱有女當家氣派，最是能說會道，又是世交嫡女，本來由她從旁舉薦唐衫的師父，聽來再公道不過，所以才被釋明攜來助言。\n可她上官家表態，不代表她個人的心願，滿腹說詞，不怕憾不動唐門弟子的心，卻怕一席慷慨陳詞背叛了自己。\n就是掌門溫言勉勵，仍支支吾吾了半天，半晌說不出半句不利唐門的話來。\n釋明見狀不耐，便搶著替她把話說了，一力保薦昔年叛出唐門的棄徒唐守鴻，言道此人樂善好義，江湖名聲好，又有佛緣，若由他出任掌門，唐門何愁不能得嵩山高僧庇蔭？\n這席話是沿途同上官螢那兒聽來的說詞，可是由他來說，卻不免惹人議論，心細點的，登時便嗅到了可疑味道，聞起來有點像陰謀，又有點像銅臭。\n這位得道高僧周身光芒登時銳減。=From a young age, Shangguan Ying studied commerce and managed the Shangguan family's business on behalf of her father. Yet, despite her youthful years, she already possessed the demeanor of a capable matriarch. She was particularly articulate and persuasive, and as a close friend's daughter, her recommendations regarding Tang Shan's master seemed perfectly reasonable. That's why Shi Ming brought her along to offer advice.\nHowever, the Shangguan family's endorsement doesn't necessarily reflect her personal wishes. She prepared a multitude of persuasive words, confident in moving the hearts of Tang Clan disciples, but fearful that her impassioned speech would betray her own feelings.\nEven when the Sect Leader offered encouraging words, she stammered and hesitated for a long time, unable to utter a single sentence that would be detrimental to Tang Clan.\nSeeing her hesitation, Shi Ming eagerly took over and forcefully recommended Tang Shouhong, the former disciple expelled from Tang Clan. He declared that this man was benevolent, righteous, and enjoyed a good reputation in Jianghu, and also had a connection to Buddhism. If he were appointed as Sect Leader, what reason would Tang Clan have to fear failing to gain the patronage of the Shaolin monks?\nThis speech was largely comprised of words she had heard from Shangguan Ying. However, hearing it from him, it inevitably provoked discussion. Those with a keen sense immediately detected a suspicious odor, reminiscent of both conspiracy and greed.\nThe aura surrounding this enlightened monk visibly diminished.
你在旁聽著，眉頭緊皺，見掌門無動於衷，按理沒有你這晚輩說話的餘地，可聽對方越說不像話，便是有道高僧，也沒有欺入別人家門指指點點的道理，再也按捺不住，反脣相稽。\n你話說得客氣，卻一針見血，釋明老臉一紅，嘴上告罪，轉頭又提醒掌門管束你，沒想到卻碰了釘子，在掌門眼中，即令是如你一般的外姓弟子，也大於不請自來的不速之客，管他有道高僧、武林名宿，都一視同仁，不給面子。\n心知討不了好去，釋明臉一沉，便招呼唐衫發射信號。=You listened in silence, furrowing your brows. Seeing the sect leader remain unmoved, there was, by rights, no place for you, a junior disciple, to speak. Yet as the other party's words grew increasingly unreasonable, even a virtuous monk had no right to force his way into another's house and lecture them. You could no longer restrain yourself and retorted. Your words were polite yet sharp, cutting to the heart of the matter. Shi Ming's face flushed red; he apologized aloud, then turned to remind the sect leader to discipline you. He did not expect to hit a wall. In the sect leader's eyes, even an outer-clan disciple like you outranked an uninvited guest. Whether the intruder was a revered monk or a renowned figure of the Wulin, he was treated the same, and given no face. Knowing he couldn't win the argument, Shi Ming's expression darkened, and he immediately signaled Tang Shan to send a message.
你在旁聽著，眉頭緊皺，見掌門無動於衷，按理沒有你這晚輩說話的餘地，可聽對方越說不像話，便是有道高僧，也沒有欺入別人家門指指點點的道理，再也按捺不住，破口大罵。\n哪管他什麼大師，欺上門來指手畫腳，這還不是欠罵？=You sat listening, furrowing your brows, watching the Sect Leader remain unmoved. By rights, there was no place for you, a junior, to speak. Yet as the other person's words grew increasingly unreasonable, even a seasoned monk would not dare intrude into someone else's domain and offer unsolicited advice. Finally, you could no longer restrain yourself and burst into a tirade. Who cares if he was a master? To intrude and meddle was surely deserving of a scolding.
你抽出白鯊幫給的切魚刀比劃幾下，看看這位嵩山福建分院的大和尚認不認得這柄刀子，上官螢卻大受觸動。\n雖說上官授意支持唐守鴻奪權，可她當日受縛於白鯊幫，凶多吉少，若非得你相護，焉能逢凶化吉。自忖身受唐門恩惠實多，又欠了你的深情難償，無論如何，也做不出忘恩負義的事來，當即臨陣倒戈，站到你的身側，氣得釋明直跳腳，當即翻臉，招呼唐衫發射信號。=You drew out the Fish Knife given to you by the White Shark Gang and brandished it a few times, to see whether this senior monk from the Fujian branch of Songshan recognized the blade. Shangguan Ying was deeply moved. Though the Shangguan family had intended to support Tang Shouhong's bid for power, she had been captured by the White Shark Gang that day, facing dire circumstances, and without your protection, she would never have turned misfortune into good fortune. Reflecting on the many favors she had received from the Tang Clan and the unrepayable debt of feeling she owed you, she could not bring herself to act ungratefully. She immediately switched sides in the middle of the fight, standing by your side. Shi Ming, enraged, stamped his feet and immediately turned hostile, signaling Tang Shan to send a signal.
釋明成名以來，人人都尊稱他為大師，即便是不信佛的，也不敢失了禮數。\n哪曾見過你這等劈頭蓋臉便罵的，臉上一陣青一陣紅，惱怒至極。\n你都不見三師兄人在階下，已給你駭得魂飛天外。\n唐衫見老禪師臉色不對，連忙插嘴，提醒掌門管束你，沒想到卻碰了釘子。\n在掌門眼中，即令是如你一般的外姓弟子，也大於不請自來的不速之客，管他有道高僧、武林名宿，都一視同仁，不給面子。\n心知討不了好去，釋明臉一沉，便招呼唐衫發射信號。=Since Shi Ming became famous, everyone has respectfully called him Master, even those who don't believe in Buddhism dare not lose decorum. You didn't even notice Third Senior Brother standing below, already scaring you so much that your soul has flown to the heavens. 你在旁聽著，眉頭緊皺，見掌門無動於衷，按理沒有你這晚輩說話的餘地，可聽對方越說不像話，便是有道高僧，也沒有欺入別人家門指指點點的道理，再也按捺不住，他能扮得道貌岸然，你也不怕陪他合唱大戲。\n假意附和，其實字字句句都點明對方不懷好意，字裡行間每個含糊的字眼都被你放大，唐門弟子中那些本來心存忐忑的聽了，登時恍然大悟，原來這壞和尚滿嘴仁義，竟然一肚壞水，便都絕了投靠的念頭。=You stood by, furrowing your brows, watching the sect leader remain unmoved; by rights, there was no room for you, a junior disciple, to speak. 心知討不了好去，釋明臉一沉，便招呼唐衫發射信號。=Knowing he had nothing to gain, Shi Ming's expression darkened, and he signaled to Tang Shan to send a signal.
\n當下便有身穿唐門衣色的陌生人，和一眾武僧四面八方湧入唐門，顯是埋伏已久，亂戰一觸即發！=At that moment, strangers clad in Tang Clan attire, along with a band of martial monks, surged into the Tang Clan from every direction — clearly having lain in ambush for some time — and a chaotic battle was about to erupt!

There were things he hadn't told you then: 「I hope you still believe in hope.」 「Good things will come.」 「You are very brave.」\nFrom that moment on, the Sect Leader subtly began to fill the role of a father in your heart.\nWhat you didn't know was that the day you left home, your biological father tossed and turned sleeplessly, suddenly rising to tell your mother he needed to go out. He carried the family's few poultry and followed you all the way from Mianyang, secretly protecting you. He dared not help you when you stumbled, nor acknowledge you when you cried, fearing he would be unable to bear the separation from his own flesh and blood.\nThe Sect Leader only knew that your father carried two chickens, and silently lowered his head, seeking the Sect's assistance in caring for you.\nHowever, the request of that humble farmer was quite the opposite.\nHe believed you were of dull intellect, and would amount to nothing even if you learned martial arts, that one day you would die on the roadside, your death unnoticed. He therefore sought a vow from the Sect Leader not to take you as a disciple, to keep you away from the turmoil of Jianghu, to make you an unaffiliated disciple, serving as a beast of burden for the heroes, and that would be the destiny for your farmer's child.\nWhen you grew a few years older, he would let you go down the mountain to find your own way in life. He didn't expect you to achieve fame and fortune, returning home with rich rewards, only that you would not contend with others, suffer no calamities or I’llness, and grow up safely and peacefully in a place he couldn't see.\nOnly now do you learn the truth, feeling both sorrow and anger, overwhelmed with conflicting emotions. The image of your biological father has gradually faded, but his wishes of long ago still dictate your life.\nThe Sect Leader had only expected you to grow weary and seek another master.\nBut the Tang Clan's influence has waned, and yet you remain at his side. Everyone laughed at your ugliness, but the Sect Leader took pride in you, watching you grow up, knowing that even if you didn't learn martial arts, you would still amount to something.\nHe knew his life was nearing it's end, and feared that after his passing, you would have no protector. He wished you would be more outgoing, find a good place to go, fly far away, and not be so preoccupied with the Tang Clan, lest you waste your life.\nBut if you wished to stay, the mountain gate would always be open to you, even if you didn't bear the Tang surname, you would still be family of the Tang Clan.
\n你第一個想到的，便是小師妹。她自小受掌門嚴教，若無師兄姊相伴，便是唐家大院的門口也不讓出，直至今日依然認不清山路，她一個人迷失在山林之中，不知可有多慌張，便自請去接小師妹回家。\n掌門向來都最著緊這掌上明珠，今日卻一反常態，強留住你。\n掌門固然不放心小師妹，可也不放心你。=The first person you thought of was the Junior Martial Sister. Raised under the Sect Leader's strict discipline, she had never once been allowed past the gate of the Tang Family Courtyard without an elder brother or sister at her side, and even now she still couldn't tell one mountain path from another. Lost alone somewhere in the woods, there was no telling how frightened she must be, so you asked to go and bring her home yourself. The Sect Leader had always doted on this precious daughter of his above all else, yet today, quite unlike himself, he insisted on keeping you there instead. It was not only the Junior Martial Sister he was anxious about—he was worried for you as well.
二師兄不在，本來不該造次，可是你實在憂心掌門情況，便斗膽請脈。\n掌門訝然失笑，當即便許了，招你上前，將脈門交你。\n他一生樹敵頗多，不曾輕易將脈門要害交諸人手，除恩師、亡妻、二師兄之外，便只你了。=Second Senior Brother isn't here, so it wasn't supposed to be done, but since you're really worried about the Sect Leader's condition, you dared to ask for a pulse check. The Sect Leader was surprised and laughed, immediately agreed, called you forward, and handed over the pulse gate. He has many enemies in his life and never easily handed over the Pulse Gate to others, except for his master, his deceased wife, and Second Senior Brother, only you.
你恭恭敬敬上前搭脈，不由得心驚色變，但聞脈位表淺，微弱至極，卻又心律過速，顯非尋常，乃是絕脈，象徵掌門氣血已盡，內力耗竭殆盡，單憑人間凡術已無力回天，只怕頃刻之間，便會仙遊而去。=You respectfully stepped forward to take the pulse, your heart suddenly filled with alarm. The pulse was superficial, extremely weak, yet the heartbeat was abnormally rapid, indicating a severed pulse. This signified that the Sect Leader's qi and Lifeforce had completely depleted, their Internal Force utterly exhausted. Ordinary human techniques could no longer save them, and within moments, they might ascend to the heavens.
你恭恭敬敬上前搭脈，不由得心驚色變，但聞脈位表淺，微弱至極，卻又心律過速，顯非尋常，乃是絕脈，象徵掌門氣血將盡，凶險至極。\n幸虧掌門功力深湛，強行以內力續命，否則換作旁人，只怕已挨不到此刻。=You respectfully approached to take the pulse, and couldn't help but feel alarmed and pale. But upon feeling the pulse, it was shallow, extremely weak, yet accompanied by a rapid heartbeat. This was no ordinary condition‑it was a cut‑off pulse, symbolizing the Sect Leader's qi and Lifeforce nearing exhaustion, an extremely perilous situation. Fortunately, the Sect Leader's profound Internal Force allowed him to force the use of Internal Force to sustain his life; otherwise, no ordinary person would have survived until now.
掌門問及症狀，有心考較於你，你卻心軟說不出話來，只推說學藝不精，不識此脈，須等二師兄回來，再行診斷。\n你心虛的撒了謊，掌門了然於胸，只付之一笑。=The Sect Leader inquired about the symptoms, intending to test you. You hesitated, unable to speak, and instead claimed you were not skilled enough in your craft, unable to recognize this pulse, and insisted that Second Senior Brother must return to make the diagnosis. Your nervous lie did not escape the Sect Leader's notice, who merely smiled knowingly.
掌門問及症狀，有心考較於你，你卻心中大慟，眼淚收不住的奪眶而出。=The Sect Leader inquired about your symptoms, intending to test you, yet you were overwhelmed with grief, tears bursting forth uncontrollably.
\n二師兄顧不得自己傷重，行色匆匆疾步踏入殿中，推你一把推開，去搭掌門脈象，悚然色變，你和三師兄還盼他妙手回春，卻不料二師兄忽然沒頭沒腦，問起掌門信物一事，一得掌門答覆，便毫不留情，將一粒丹藥強行塞入掌門口中，摀嘴迫他服下。\n三師兄認出那丹藥來歷，欲加制止已然不及，又驚又急、又悲又怒，喝問二師兄究竟是何居心？原來那丹藥正是二十年前，極樂教為禍武林之際，用以支配江湖人士的活毒『屍心丹』。\n此毒遇血化開蠟封，便破繭而出，竄入人體，隨即偽裝成人身血肉，醫術再高明的大夫，亦難驅逐，若被毒蟲鑽入腦中，不得施術者允可，縱想自我了斷也是癡人說夢，可謂窮凶極惡。\n三師兄曾見過無數硬朗豪傑被此毒折辱得人不像人、鬼不像鬼，就是當年師娘也是身中此毒，受制於人，才肇生無窮憾事。\n極樂教覆滅以後，還道此毒已付之一炬，豈料多年以後，卻被施加在自家掌門身上，如何能不教他驚怒交加？=Second Senior Brother, disregarding his own severe injuries, hurried into the hall and pushed you aside to reach the Sect Leader's pulse. You and Third Senior Brother still hoped for a miraculous recovery, but instead Second Senior Brother suddenly and without warning asked about the Sect Leader's token of authority. Third Senior Brother recognized the pill and tried to stop him, but it was already too late; shocked, urgent, grieved and furious all at once, he demanded to know what Second Senior Brother meant by this. The pill was the Corpse Heart Pill, the living poison the Supreme Bliss Cult had once used to control figures of the Jianghu twenty years ago, in the days it plagued the Wulin. On contact with blood this poison breaks its wax seal and bursts free, burrowing into the body and disguising itself as living flesh; no physician, however skilled, can drive it out. Once the poison-worm has lodged in the brain, the victim cannot even end their own life without the poisoner's leave—it is a thing of utter malice. Third Senior Brother had seen countless hardened heroes reduced by this poison to something neither man nor ghost; even the Master's late wife had once been struck by it and held in another's power, the root of endless sorrow to come. After the Supreme Bliss Cult fell, he had believed this poison burned with it—never dreaming that, years later, it would be used against his own Sect Leader. 唐門之中，便屬你挨二師兄罵得最多，交情深了，隱約也能窺其鐵面之後的醫者仁心，你對他的信賴，絲毫不亞於大師兄。=Among the Tang Clan, you are the one who gets scolded the most by the Second Senior Brother. 你和三師兄今日連番力戰，早已精疲力盡。何況你聞知身世，心相震盪，又受二師兄麻毒所害，再也無力追擊，只能眼睜睜看著二師兄揚長而去。=You and Third Senior Brother have fought battle after battle today and are already exhausted. 三師兄持掌門交託的令牌，號令弟子下山追擊，卻都無功而返。\n小師妹狼狽不堪趕回家中，卻趕不上和父親說上一句話，怔怔伏在床邊，小手輕輕拍打掌門身驅，無聲的眼淚撲簌簌落在襟前。\n沒了掌門，眾弟子頓失倚仗，兼而大師兄失蹤，二師兄叛逃。唐門內憂外患實多，就是驅散強敵，亦無半分可喜，無一人不是憂心忡忡，神情肅穆。\n那一天夜裡，許多弟子不告而別。=Third Senior Brother held the token entrusted by the sect leader, commanding the disciples to descend the mountain in pursuit, yet all returned empty‑handed. Without the sect leader, the disciples lost their support, and with Eldest Senior Brother missing and Second Senior Brother having defected, the Tang Clan faced internal and external troubles. Even if they drove away the strong enemies, there was no cause for celebration; no one was without worry, their expressions solemn. That night, many disciples left without saying goodbye.
你悠悠醒轉，已是隔日。\n同門師兄弟前來召喚，你還道掌門復甦，喜不自勝，隨即才知道一切你所畏懼的，都是現實。\n美好的昨日已離你遠去，人間一夕色變，縱使我們竭力抵抗也勒不住韁繩，只能身不由己，任由巨大洪流將你沖垮，載浮載沉，口裡嚐到的淚水，既苦且鹹，如今才恍然大悟，這便是江湖的真貌。=You slowly regained consciousness the next day. The pleasant days of the past were now distant memories. Society suddenly changed, and even though we tried our best to resist, we could not hold back the tide. \n你來到正心堂中，參見代掌門。師兄弟昨日才見，今朝碰面，卻覺不勝唏噓。\n唐門內戰，到處狼藉，血汙滿地，便只正心堂中，依舊輕煙裊裊，悠然隔世，只是人事已非。\n明明擊退了強敵，卻勝得悽慘，形如喪家之犬。被那釋明禪師逃逸而去，四處散播謠言，顛倒黑白，一邊是慈眉善目的方外高人，一邊是亦正亦邪的武林世家，任誰都會偏信前者。\n一夕之間唐門罔顧恩義、濫殺同門的流言便廣為流傳，唐門乃是魔教黨羽的傳聞亦夾雜在此中，不脛而走。\n都說唐家掌門戾氣太重，釋明禪師縱有佛法箴言，亦度化不得。最終導致自食惡果，走火入魔，一代怪傑從此臥病在床，淪為廢人。\n值此強敵環伺之際，三師兄倘若懲罰了這群上門滋事的冒牌唐門，便如坐實謠言，自曝其短，將來嵩山派、南宮世家上門來勸解，又該怎生交代？\n三師兄左右為難，唯有凡事留一點餘地，也收回了搜尋大師兄的號令，令弟子回守山門，以免遭敵人趁虛而入。=You arrive at the Zhengxin Hall to pay respects to the Acting Sect Leader. 上官螢雖臨陣決意，倒戈向唐門，但充其量也是她一己之見。亂戰之際，她所帶來的滄幫弟子皆奉家主之命，袖手旁觀，就算兩不相幫，亦足表明態度。\n那日帶領廣州唐門前來鬧事的棄徒唐守鴻，以及釋明禪師都是閱歷深厚的老江湖，與飛石幫主那等初生之犢截然不同，他們見過如日中天的唐門，見過全盛時期的唐中翎。\n那時的唐家掌門比鬼神更兇，他與正道同一陣線時，群邪辟易；他與正道為敵時，連六大派高手都得請出南宮世家調停。\n就因唐中翎坐鎮掌門之位，幾十年來，那二人連蜀中地界都不敢接近。今日若非上官世家撐腰，怎有膽識欺上門來滋事？\n追根究柢，上官世家責無旁貸。\n上官螢使喚不動下人，又不能罔顧世家威信，示弱於人，強忍唐門弟子的指指點點，聽聞你醒來了，喜不自勝，匆匆踏進正心堂，卻馬上被逐客令請了出去。\n上官螢下令不讓下人近身，與你並肩而行，一言不發，心懷惴惴，隱約知道事已無可挽回，與你訣別的時刻到了。\n你何嘗不想與她攜手同遊，一直縱情歡笑，可是人並非總為自己一人活著，你的身後有唐門，她的身後有上官世家。\n與她訣別，劃清界線，便是你保護她的方法，這樣好的人兒，還是離江湖紛擾越遠越好。=Shangguan Ying, though she had decided at the last moment to switch sides and support the Tang Clan, at most it was just her own opinion. How could you not want to travel with her, to laugh and enjoy life together? Yet, people do not live solely for themselves. Behind you was the Tang Clan, and behind her was the Shangguan family. Parting from her and drawing a clear line was your way of protecting her. Such a good person should stay as far away from the chaos of the Jianghu as possible.
臨去以前，上官螢驀地回頭，自顧自說起自己的事。\n她曾有過一個隨身丫環，情同姊妹，名叫書蓉。\n雖然萬般不捨，可是她終究不能違抗家主命令，只能眼睜睜看著隨身丫環被送讓旁人，在那之後，再多再好的人，也填不了書蓉的缺。\n南宮大公子不要她，可是上官螢依然念念不忘；魏菊魏掌門是她認定的至交，無可取代。\n與你的緣份，也是她千金不換的寶藏。\n即使你不領情，她也一定要幫你，誰還沒叛逆過，跟爹娘頂嘴呢？\n上官螢與你分別後第一件事，便是去尋唐門債主呂翁，以滄幫船會總籌名義，允諾讓利，以此免除唐門部分債務。\n呂翁聞知掌門重病一事，感慨萬千，也慷慨解囊，免去了唐門上代借款買米，賑濟荒年的那筆陳年舊債。=Before leaving, Shangguan Ying suddenly turned back, speaking to herself about her past.\nShe once had a personal maid, inseparable like sisters, named Shurong.\nThough she was heartbroken, she ultimately couldn't defy the patriarch's orders, and could only watch helplessly as her personal maid was given to another. After that, no matter how good or numerous they were, none could replace Shurong.\nNangong's eldest son didn't want her, but Shangguan Ying still couldn't forget him; Wei Ju, the head of the Wei Sect, was someone she considered an irreplaceable confidante.\nYour fate with her is also a treasure she wouldn't trade for anything.\nEven if you're ungrateful, she still insists on helping you – who hasn't been rebellious and argued with their parents?\nShangguan Ying's first act after parting with you was to seek out Lu Lao, the creditor of Tang Clan, under the guise of being the overall treasurer of the Cang Gang, promising concessions to exempt a portion of Tang Clan's debt.\nHearing about the head's illness, Lu Lao was deeply moved and generously contributed, forgiving the old debt from previous loans used to buy rice and relieve the famine years.
\n自大師兄身影自江陵消失以後，偌大中原武林，便再也不曾聽人講起飛俠事跡，就像這人憑空消失了似的。\n這一來，可急壞了你三師兄，那飛石幫主石公遠，曾與大師兄約好決鬥，石攻遠定日期，大師兄定地點，你大師兄從來不是怯戰之人，孰料竟爾爽約。\n尋常武林人士約好決鬥，有一方不到，\n那公證人便會判定敵手怯戰，不戰而敗，傳出去，比打輸了還丟人。\n若能就此平息事端，雖然丟臉，亦未嘗不可。可無奈的事大師兄將人家夫人請去，至今下落不明。\n夫人一日未歸，那石幫主焉能贏了面子便善罷干休，再三寫戰書寄唐門，大師兄都不曾屢約，不由得氣急敗壞，這次信中省去江湖客套，挑明若再不應戰，那便舉飛石幫全幫之眾，攻上唐門，血洗唐家大院。縱令你們武藝高強，無懼飛石幫，也要用人海戰術，堆屍壓垮你們山頭，兩敗俱傷亦再所不惜。=Since Grandmaster's figure vanished from Jiangling, the entire Wulin of Central Plains ceased to speak of the Flying Hero's exploits, as if he had simply disappeared into thin air.\nThis deeply troubled your third senior brother, the leader of the Flying Stone Gang, Shi Gongyuan. He had arranged a duel with Grandmaster, setting a date. Shi Gongyuan chose the location, and Grandmaster never shied away from a challenge.\nIn a normal Wulin duel, if one party fails to appear,\nthe witness would declare the opponent a coward, losing before a single blow – a far greater shame than an actual defeat.\nIf the matter could be settled with this disgrace, it would be acceptable. But unfortunately, Grandmaster brought the man's wife away, and her whereabouts remain unknown to this day.\nAs long as the wife doesn't return, how could Stone Sect Leader save face and let things rest? He repeatedly sent challenge letters to Tang Clan, but Grandmaster consistently ignored them, infuriating him. This time, the letter omitted the usual Jianghu pleasantries, plainly stating that if he didn't respond to the challenge, he would lead the entire Flying Stone Gang to attack Tang Clan and bathe Tang Clan Courtyard in blood. Even if you possess exceptional martial prowess and are not afraid of the Flying Stone Gang, he would use a swarm of soldiers to overwhelm you, sacrificing both sides if necessary.
你和三師兄何曾沒有試圖息事寧人，可惜好說歹說，人家夫人就是不知所蹤，你再有誠意，也形同空談。=It isn't as though you and Third Senior Brother didn't try to make peace—but plead as you might, the man's wife was simply nowhere to be found, and however sincere you were, it came to nothing.
你幾度欲言又止，雖知大師兄去向，可是念及掌門有意不令門人知曉，即使是三師兄、四師兄，你也說不出口，唯恐流言四起，門人自亂陣腳。=You've hesitated to speak several times, though you know the Eldest Senior Brother's whereabouts. However, considering the Sect Leader's intention to keep the disciples unaware, even the Third Senior Brother and Fourth Senior Brother cannot speak out. 三師兄、四師兄都是方今唐門中碩果僅存的資深師兄，他們伴隨著唐門由盛轉衰，又起死回生，挨至今日，江湖閱歷豐富，深知本門與飛石幫之爭，絕非大師兄劣行肇致，那充其量不過是個由頭，真正的原因，說穿了還是名利二字。\n要知本門在蜀中生根，信用、人望都是幾代累積下來的，凡我地界之內，鄉里村人代代均受唐門恩澤，當代年輕人或許還不清楚，老一輩的都知道，唐門盛時那威風，遇有天災、人禍，不先問官府，反去求唐門。\n衙門裡官官相衛求不得的公道，到了唐門，沉冤必定昭雪，三大世家，也只有唐門敢和朝廷正面對壘。\n而今飛石幫要想得人心，拓展地盤、成為武林一流大幫，那蜀中唐門便是頭號勁敵。即便唐門無心相爭，飛石幫亦決計不能見容，一待窺見良機，便會尋釁發難，擊敗唐門，取而代之。=Third Senior Brother and Fourth Senior Brother are the only senior brothers left in the Tang Clan today. They have witnessed the Tang Clan's decline from prosperity, its resurrection, and its survival to this day. With rich Jianghu experience, they understand that the conflict between our clan and the Flying Stone Gang is not solely due to the misconduct of Eldest Senior Brother. At most, it's just a pretext. The real cause, in truth, lies in fame and profit. You must know that the Tang Clan has taken root in Shu, and our reputation and influence have been built up over generations. In our territory, the people of the villages and towns have received the Tang Clan's kindness for generations. Though the younger generation may not yet realize it, the elders do. When the Tang Clan was at its peak, its prestige was unmatched. In times of natural disasters or human calamities, people would not first turn to the authorities, but instead seek the Tang Clan. The official court is full of officials who collude and cannot deliver justice, but at the Tang Clan, grievances are surely resolved. Among the three great families, only the Tang Clan dares to confront the Imperial Court head‑on. Now, if the Flying Stone Gang wishes to gain people's support and expand its territory to become a top‑tier martial gang in the Wulin, the Tang Clan of Shu is its number one rival. Even if the Tang Clan has no intention of competing, the Flying Stone Gang will certainly not tolerate it. Once they spot an opportunity, they will provoke a conflict, defeat the Tang Clan, and take its place.
倒不如該謝大師兄洞燭機先，拐了人家幫主夫人藏匿起來，令飛石幫主投鼠忌器，不敢輕易取人性命，局勢才能維穩至今。\n只可惜你無從得知那位石夫人的藏身之處，否則將人拿來施毒用刑，看那石幫主還敢不敢再咄咄逼人。=It would be better to thank Eldest Senior Brother for his foresight. He lured the gang leader's wife away and hid her, leaving the Flying Stone Gang Leader too wary of endangering her to act rashly, and that is why the situation has held stable until now. Unfortunately, you have no idea where Lady Shi is hiding. Otherwise, you could capture her, poison her, and torture her, and see if Gang Leader Shi still dares to be so aggressive.
倒不如該說是大師兄洞燭機先，拐了人家幫主夫人藏匿起來，令飛石幫主投鼠忌器，不敢輕易取人性命，局勢才能維穩至今。=Perhaps it is more accurate to say that Eldest Senior Brother saw the situation clearly and lured the Gang Leader's wife away into hiding. 正當你三人議論局勢不休，賭咒許願大師兄速速歸來時，那人就似往常一樣若無其事忽然現身了。\n霎時間，你等三人又喜又怒，喜的是飛俠歸來，本門等如有了主心骨；怒的是他一聲不吭消失偌久，杳無音訊，還道他在外遭遇危險，顯然都是白擔心，此人便是個不可靠的浪蕩子而已。\n說也奇怪，他不在時總盼他只是貪玩誤時才遲遲不歸，真見了他嘻皮笑臉晃蕩回家，心中那個殺意卻又壓抑不住油然而生。=As the three of you argued the situation without end, swearing oaths and praying for Eldest Senior Brother's speedy return, he suddenly appeared, as unconcerned as always, as if nothing had happened. In an instant, you three felt both joy and anger: joy that the Flying Hero had returned, giving the sect a pillar to lean on; anger that he had vanished for so long without a word, leaving you all needlessly worried he had met with danger, only to find it was all for nothing, for he was simply an unreliable wandering rogue. It was strange, really. Whenever he was away, you always hoped he had merely been delayed by pleasure and was simply late to return, yet the moment he came swaggering home with that foolish grin, the urge to kill him surged up despite yourselves.
大師兄聽聞了唐門近日接連噩耗，依然面不改色，教你師兄弟三人既生氣又安心，彷彿天還沒塌，這些於他而言就只是小事。\n大師兄婉拒掌門信物，仍由三師兄代掌，自忖決策不如三師兄，不如各司其職，安內交由三師兄，至於攘外，那便交他處理。\n匆匆議定以後，大師兄便上樓去探望掌門，而你等三人則去告知大師兄歸來的消息，門中上下為之振奮。=Eldest Senior Brother heard of the Tang Clan's string of recent misfortunes yet remained as calm as ever, leaving the three of you brothers both angered and reassured, as if the sky had not yet fallen — mere trifles to him. Eldest Senior Brother politely declined the Sect Leader's token, letting Third Senior Brother go on holding it in his stead; he judged his own judgment inferior to Third Senior Brother's, so it was best each attend to his own charge — internal affairs to Third Senior Brother, and outside threats to himself. Once this was swiftly settled, Eldest Senior Brother went upstairs to see the Sect Leader, while the three of you went off to spread word of his return, and the whole clan was lifted in spirit.
大師兄這次下樓來，卻是帶著小師妹的。=This time, Eldest Senior Brother came downstairs with Junior Martial Sister in tow.
大師兄不願讓她糾纏，遂驅之，小師妹也不執著，鬆開大師兄衣襬，就來捉著你。你受寵若驚，還道她長大了，再也不會這樣依賴自己，沒想到今日心情激盪，還是情不自禁捉住你衣角，可見她平日雖然修心克己，心底依然十分依賴你，無關你相貌如何，只要親近你，便足教她心安。=Eldest Senior Brother didn't want her clinging to him, so he shooed her off. Regardless of your appearance, as long as you are close to her, it's enough to set her mind at ease.
小師妹見大師兄回來，好不歡喜，大師兄卻不願讓她糾纏，遂驅之，小師妹欲拍拍而不得，無所適從，只得鼓著腮幫子生悶氣，退到一邊。=Junior Martial Sister was overjoyed to see Eldest Senior Brother return. 大師兄渾不將本門大患飛石幫當作一回事，他自有妙計能兵不血刃、化敵為友。\n有道是解鈴還須繫鈴人，他如此胸有成竹，大家便都鬆了一口氣。\n再論二師兄一事，大師兄似乎若有所思，不肯便信他二師弟會欺師叛出唐門，此中必有隱情，待當務之急解除，遲早要踏上旅途，將他揪出來毒打一頓，逼他說出實情。=Eldest Senior Brother treats the Flying Stone Gang, the sect's great looming threat, as nothing at all; he has his own clever plan to subdue them without bloodshed and turn foe into friend. 大師兄繪聲繪影，從江陵消失以來的千里決行說起。\n先是亂入襄陽戰場，為宋兵助陣，擊退金軍，與道法將軍丹霞子、襄陽守將趙方結識痛飲，又在翌日清晨不告而別，一路向北，沿途隨緣照拂幾間青樓生意，順便從金人遊客身上妙手空空，拿去撫卹最是難得恩賞的青樓姊妹。\n席間酒酣耳熱，打聽到應天、開封、河南、河中的山賊，似要聯合起來舉辦誓師大會，卻不知要做什麼大買賣，再三打聽，才知道那完顏珣不知得了何人密信，臨時起意前往對宋前線慰問將士。\n眾山賊在宋是反賊，在金便是義士，所以聯合，自是打算商議，幹這一票天大的買賣，成則名利雙收，名垂青史亦未可知，敗則身死而已。\n大師兄眼睛一亮，遂隻身闖入山賊大本營，以武會友，饒是他武功高強，亦難隻身鬥盡眾山寨來的綠林好漢。\n大師兄行事輕狂，卻絕非莽夫，那日也唯有捨身，才能訴盡欽佩之情。\n他以一擋百，視死如歸，眾山賊弟兄伏擊金國皇帝車駕，那也同樣是慷慨赴義。\n若非戰到力竭恍惚，這群綠林好漢豈能光憑言語便對他心誠悅服？\n此戰以後，大師兄被奉為山賊王，統轄各寨綠林義士，伏擊完顏珣。\n大師兄本想效仿搏浪沙義士刺秦，在峽道上風處投擲重型暗器擊毀完顏珣車駕，不料此人多疑，竟讓隨行侍從坐主車，自己屈尊坐副車，僥倖逃過一劫。\n大師兄一擊沒有得手，便趁金國皇帝隊伍與金軍帳中主力未曾會合，招呼眾山賊下坡強襲，殺成一片，眼看難以突破重重防鎖，所幸奪旗搶馬，招引金兵來追，一面搖旗一面向軍營衝去，正出迎的元帥僕散安真見他來勢洶洶，破口大罵，開口便冤他是逆臣，而自己授命於陛下，特來帶隊捉拿，直嚇得面如死灰，哪敢反抗，心想清者自清，遂解甲就縛，大喊冤枉，請陛下明察，可惜完顏珣還沒來得及還他一個清白，他便給大師兄一刀剁了腦袋。\n雖然刺金功敗垂成，但反手宰掉他金國的兵馬大元帥，也算奇功一件。\n你等三人，連同小師妹都聽得一愣一愣。\n你姑且不說，三師兄、四師兄卻是全然不信，畢竟大師兄太愛吹牛了，可謂是劣跡斑斑。\n大師兄唯有聳肩面露苦笑，信不信由你，反正他已善盡交代義務了。=The senior disciple recounted a tale, starting with his thousand-mile flight from Jiangling.\nIt began with a sudden intrusion into the battlefield of Xiangyang, aiding the Song soldiers, repelling the Jin army, and forming a drunken camaraderie with Danxiazi, the General of Dao Techniques, and Zhao Fang, the garrison commander of Xiangyang. 三師兄受掌門囑託，要為小師妹安排終生大事。\n雖說小師妹心思單純，於男女情愛之事懵懵懂懂，未免晚熟。可是在這風雨飄搖的江湖載浮載沉，實在說不準還有多少安生日子好過，明知強敵環伺，自然要盡快決斷，若大師兄與小師妹果真無情愫可言，便要擦亮眼睛，為小師妹尋覓可以依賴的好夫婿，嫁了出去，從此便不是唐門中人，娘家恩仇，便與她隔了一道無形之牆，從此不該她管、亦不牽連她。=Third Senior Brother has been entrusted by the Sect Leader to arrange a lifelong match for Junior Martial Sister.\nAlthough Junior Martial Sister is pure of heart and naive regarding matters of the heart, she is somewhat late in blossoming. 在商量對崆峒派的方策中，你為了把大家都拖下水，將崆峒祕寶的機密說了出來。\n不久之後，此事傳開，世人均知崆峒祕寶流落在外。\n崆峒上下人心惶惶，逃難者有之、欲奪權者有之，\n魏掌門以護寶不力，飽受責難，被迫閉關於洞中，從此深居罕出，終日長吁短嘆，只嘆自己又信錯了人，男子不光貌若潘安的會說謊，相貌醜陋的也未必是好東西。=While discussing strategies against the Kongtong sect, you dragged everyone into the water by revealing the secret of the Kongtong Secret Treasure. \n到了大師兄出行那日，住大院的師兄弟姐妹們都齊聚練武場。\n大師兄與飛石幫主決鬥臥雲崗，不帶同門幫手，教人既安心又憂慮。安心者在於他似乎胸有成竹，此怨或能消解。憂慮者是沒人盯著，萬一大師兄中途又心血來潮被花花蝴蝶吸引，走岔了路消失無蹤，那該如何是好？=On the day Eldest Senior Brother was to set out, all the martial siblings living in the main compound gathered at the training ground. 三師兄實在不放心，既有同門師兄弟自請跟隨，當即便允了。=Third Senior Brother was really uneasy, and since there were fellow disciples who volunteered to follow, he immediately agreed.

大師兄點名要你同行，你一聽登時便不樂意了，誰勸也沒用。=Eldest Senior Brother specifically called out your name to join him, but as soon as you heard, you immediately didn't want to go. No one could persuade you.
