Xiaomei cherished your children even more than her own — shamelessly so — for they were, after all, the offspring of the two friends who mattered most to her. On a bright, sunlit morning, you and Xiao Zhu sat hand in hand, talking of ordinary things. As you talked, both of you grew drowsy, and leaning together you fell asleep — and never woke again.
之後匆匆數年過去，你依舊常在江邊獨坐。\n一身武功，早已被廢，軟禁在遠離紛擾的小小漁村之中。\n此地荒僻，不受宋金管轄，悠悠隔世。\n島上村民都是受過小梅恩惠，才從虎口逃生的避世之人，聽說你是她的摯友，都熱情相待，甚至有女子主動投懷，為你生兒育女。\n輾轉十幾二十年匆匆流逝，你也忘了今夕何夕。\n某一日，你依舊獨坐江邊，忽有故人來訪，小梅依舊是當年如花似玉的少女容顏，歲月竟沒留一點痕跡。\n時隔多年，她手染無數血腥，憑著功績平步青雲，地位壓過金烏上人，堂堂崆峒掌派，還得對她這位千燈樓主低聲下氣。=A few hurried years later, you still often sat alone by the river. Your martial arts had long since been stripped away, and you lived under soft confinement in a small, remote fishing village. The place was desolate, beyond the reach of Song or Jin rule, a world apart and forgotten by time. The village folk had all once owed Xiaomei their lives, spared from the tiger's mouth through her help, and now lived here as recluses; hearing that you were her close friend, they treated you with great warmth, and some women even came to you of their own will and bore you children. Ten, twenty years slipped past in a blur, until you no longer knew what year it was. Then one day, as you sat alone by the river as always, an old friend came to call — Xiaomei, still as lovely as the young girl she had once been, untouched by the years. In the time since, her hands had grown stained with countless killings, and her achievements had carried her ever higher, her standing now surpassing even Jinwu Shangren's — so that even the dignified Sect Leader of Kongtong had to bow and scrape before her, the Master of the Thousand Lantern Tower.
從她嘴裡，聽說了師父夏侯蘭去世的消息，你不由得悲從中來。\n不過師父去世以前，還為你出了一口惡氣，隻身殺到崆峒飛天殿中，左手持傘搧暈了新掌派人，右手魔爪叉著小梅細嫩脖子，將她高舉離地，碰在牆上厲聲威脅。若小梅當時再不透露你的行蹤，恐怕已被掐斷了脖梗。\n然而，就算得知你安然無恙，夏侯蘭也沒來見你，只按崆峒山規，將小梅剝光了衣裳，裸吊在懸崖邊上拷問，問的都是些無關緊要的事，重點在於拷打，羞辱小梅出氣而已。=Hearing from her lips about Master Xiahou Lan's passing, you couldn't help but feel a wave of sorrow. Yet before her death, Master had avenged you: she stormed alone into Kongtong's Flying Heaven Hall, her left hand knocking out the new sect leader with a swing of her umbrella, her right hand seizing Xiaomei's slender neck like a claw, lifting her clean off the ground and slamming her against the wall as she snarled her threats. Had Xiaomei not revealed your whereabouts then, her neck might well have been snapped. Yet even after learning you were safe, Xiahou Lan did not come to see you. Instead, following Kongtong Mountain's rules, she had Xiaomei stripped of her clothes and hung naked over the cliff's edge for questioning — trivial questions, really, for the torture and humiliation were the true point, her way of venting her anger.
小梅煎熬多年，才敢來見你。\n她因生就一副美人胚子而遭難，被千燈樓劫去，從小當作殺手培養，心中還藏有一隻屍心蠱，每次發作都生不如死。為了活命，不得不抹煞良心，總是巧笑倩兮招人喜歡，卻很少發自真心。\n生平最後悔的事，莫過於小看了你，讓你的蠢樣逗樂了自己，讓你在心底佔了一席之地，心血來潮去了唐門，卻又不得不恩將仇報。\n是以送別你之後那些歲月，都苦澀又難熬，煎熬幾十年，無一日不想：「啊，要是我當時沒那麼聽話就好了。」\n年位高權重的千燈樓主一當幾十年，還不如短短幾月在唐門的舊日時光溫暖。\n她帶來了唐門小劍，雙膝落地，盼你處死了她，就別再記恨了。=Xiaomei has endured years of torment just to see you.\nShe suffered from birth, blessed with a beautiful form, and was kidnapped by the Thousand Lanterns Guild. Raised as an assassin from a young age, she harbors a Corpse Heart Gu within her, each flare bringing unimaginable agony. To survive, she had to suppress her conscience, always smiling sweetly and charmingly, though rarely genuinely.\nHer greatest regret is underestimating you, letting your foolishness amuse her, allowing you a place in her heart. A whim led her to the Tang Clan, but she was inevitably forced to repay kindness with spite.\nThus, the years following her farewell were bitter and agonizing, enduring decades filled with the wish: 「If only I hadn't been so obedient then.」\nEven decades under the powerful and influential leader of the Thousand Lanterns Guild were less warm than those few months spent at the Tang Clan.\nShe brought the Tang Clan's small sword, knelt, and hoped you would have her executed, so that the resentment would end.
這些年來，你無一日不想對她報復，唐門覆滅，她脫離不了干係，可是如今她已有家人，你小劍揮下，未必能解心頭之恨，但她那些盼著娘親回家的孩子，都再也等步到人。\n你怎麼不知那可有多無助呢？=These past years, not a single day has passed that you haven't wanted to seek revenge on her. The downfall of the Tang Clan – she's inextricably linked to it. But now she has a family. Your blade, however swift, may not be able to fully extinguish your hatred, but her children, who long for their mother to come home, would then wait for her forever in vain.\nHow can you not understand just how helpless that would leave them?
你並沒如她所願，這可不是慈悲，你深知世上最苦的不是死別，而是生離家人。你要她留在這座島上，換她來受相思凌遲，等到十幾二十年後，想見的人再也見不到，才許回中原。\n無論她是否聽從，這一生都求不得你原諒。=You did not grant her that wish — this was not mercy. You knew well that the bitterest thing in this world is not death, but separation from kin. So you kept her on this island, to suffer in your place the slow torment of longing, until twenty years on, when those she longed to see could be found no more — only then would you let her return to the Central Plains. Whether she obeyed or not, in this life she would never earn your forgiveness.
你獨自一人啟程回返中原，路途遙遠，你不慎感染了風寒，把所有錢財都給了一個年輕力壯的飛石幫眾，請他揹你上山，如願以償病逝於唐門舊址。=You set out alone to return to the Central Plains. The road was long, and along the way you caught a chill without meaning to. You gave every coin you had to a young, strong member of the Flying Stone Gang and asked him to carry you up the mountain — and there, at the old site of the Tang Clan, you died just as you had wished.
\n及至唐門飛俠與飛石幫主約戰當日，蜀中各路豪俠皆來觀戰，共為見證。\n峨嵋、青城年輕高手如期而至，連遠在崆峒的奪魄幽蘭也到場。\n石幫主等得老不耐煩，偏生就你家大師兄這正主兒時辰將近了依然不見蹤影。=By the time the Tang Clan Flying Hero and the Flying Stone Gang Leader's scheduled duel arrived, martial artists from all over Shu gathered to witness the event, as expected. Young talents from Emei and Qingcheng arrived on time, and even the Soul-Stealing Orchid from distant Kongtong was present. The Flying Stone Gang Leader waited impatiently, yet your Eldest Senior Brother, the main event, was still nowhere to be seen as the appointed time neared.
同樣蒞臨現場的龍湘，情非所願的引人注目，錦香宮殺人魔的名聲又傳得更廣了，明明行走江湖以來，行止皆為行俠仗義之事，怎麼卻反而變得惡名昭彰？\n追根究柢，元凶便是你大師兄，這外號便是他取的。有時龍湘對你大師兄那個怨啊，是真的恨不得將他抽筋剝骨的。=Long Xiang, who also arrived on the scene, found herself unwillingly drawing every eye, and the name Murderous Demon of Jinxiang Palace spread further still. She had always walked Jianghu upholding justice — how had she ended up with such an infamous name instead? The root cause was your Eldest Senior Brother; he was the one who had coined it. There were times Long Xiang resented him so bitterly she truly wanted to strip the tendons from his bones.
同樣蒞臨現場的龍湘，則多了一個雞腿刺客的外號。\n雖然替她安這外號的人們玩笑居多，別說，她本人還挺喜歡的。\n得意揚揚之餘還賦詩半首：「殺盡天下壞心人，嚐遍地上好味雞。」傳回錦香宮，溫夫人亦為自家愛徒汗顏，命人準備好藤條，只待龍湘一回宮中便抽她個死去活來，再找私塾先生教她從頭讀書。=Long Xiang, who was also present, picked up another nickname there: Chicken Leg Assassin. Though most who coined it meant it as a joke, she rather liked it herself. Preening, she even composed half a verse: "Slay every wicked soul on earth, savor every fine chicken upon it." Word of it reached Jinxiang Palace, and Lady Wen was mortified by her beloved disciple's antics — she ordered a rattan cane made ready, meaning to thrash Long Xiang within an inch of her life the moment she returned, then hire a tutor to teach her to read from the beginning.
同樣蒞臨現場的龍湘，情非所願的引人注目，她卻不知旁人一邊欣賞她美色，一邊取笑她。\n她給人騙財的事跡，傳得比她行俠仗義之事都要來得廣，每回出門，丐幫弟子見了無不見獵心喜的，散財童女都沒這麼慷慨的。\n若非念及從前王幫主與溫夫人的交情，和錦香宮的江湖地位，說不定騙光錢財還要騙身。=Long Xiang, who was also present, drew eyes she never meant to draw — unaware that even as men admired her beauty, they laughed at her behind her back. Word of how easily she was swindled out of her money spread further than tales of her chivalry; every time she went out, Beggar Sect disciples would spot her and light up like hunters sighting game, for she was more free with her coin than the legendary alms-giving maiden herself. Had it not been for the old friendship between Gang Leader Wang and Lady Wen, and for Jinxiang Palace's standing in the Jianghu, she might well have been swindled out of not just her money, but her virtue besides.
及至時辰將過，你和大師兄才慢悠悠的道場。\n仇人見面，分外眼紅，也不講啥矯情客套話，三言兩語便動上手。\n你則退到一邊觀戰。=As the appointed time drew near, you and your senior brother arrived leisurely.\nUpon seeing your sworn enemy, animosity flared, and without any courteous formalities, a fight erupted with just a few words.\nYou stepped aside to watch.
此時一絲低沉沙啞卻又溫和甜蜜的聲音竄入耳中，頓時心中一喜，知是你師父夏侯蘭來了，遂施展輕功，縱上樹梢與她相見，你那蓬頭垢面佯裝丐兒的男裝師妹也在。=At that moment a voice reached your ears — low and rasping, yet warm and sweet — and your heart leapt with joy, for you knew your master Xiahou Lan had come. You loosed your Qinggong and sprang up into the treetops to meet her, and there too was your Junior Sister, dishevelled and disguised as a beggar boy.
此時一絲低沉沙啞卻又溫和甜蜜的聲音竄入耳中，頓時心中一喜，知是你師父夏侯蘭來了，遂施展輕功，縱上樹梢與她相見。=At that moment a voice reached your ears — low and rasping, yet warm and sweet — and your heart leapt with joy, for you knew your master Xiahou Lan had come. You loosed your Qinggong and sprang up into the treetops to meet her.
那邊廂，大師兄與石公遠已鬥了起來，兩人武功路術洽是兩種極端。\n一者輕巧靈動，似風無定；一者厚重堅實，穩如泰山。\n金錢鏢打不動石公遠的鐵布衫，鐵臂神拳也挨不著唐布衣的衣角。\n一動一靜過起招來，一時勝負難決，看眾無不大呼過癮。=Off to the side, Eldest Senior Brother and Shi Gongyuan had already begun to fight, their fighting styles two utter extremes.\nOne was light and nimble, like an unpredictable wind; the other heavy and solid, steady as Mount Tai.\nCoin Darts couldn't pierce Shi Gongyuan's Iron Shirt, and the Iron Arm Divine Fist couldn't even graze Tang Buyi's hem.\nMotion against stillness, blow for blow — for a long while neither could gain the upper hand, and the onlookers roared with delight.
一見即知大師兄未出全力，石幫主橫練硬功外壯筋骨，兼有護體氣功，體魄結實不假，可唐門乃是天下第一暗器大家，哪能便因敵人長得壯了些，便束手就擒？要以金錢鏢導力透穴，只消運上內力、巧勁便成，連你都勉強能行，遑論大師兄。=At a glance you could tell your Eldest Senior Brother wasn't fighting at full strength. Gang Leader Shi trained in an external school of hard qigong that toughened muscle and bone, backed by a body-guarding technique — his physique was solid enough, true, but the Tang Clan was the foremost house of hidden weapons under heaven. How could they simply lay down and be taken just because the enemy was built a little sturdier? Guiding force through the Coin Dart to pierce an acupoint took nothing more than a touch of Internal Force and a deft hand — even you could barely manage it, let alone your Eldest Senior Brother.
只是不知，他留手是傷重未癒，還是在藏招。=You didn't know, though, whether he was holding back because his wounds hadn't yet healed, or because he was hiding a technique.
除非他是另有所圖，有意藏招留手，這才說得過去。=Unless he has ulterior motives and is intentionally concealing a move while holding back, this wouldn't make sense.
你師父夏侯蘭看了也是興味闌珊，今日你大師兄施展的功夫，還尚且不如從前結伴行走江湖的時候，她是為了印證自身進境才來觀戰，怎能不令她大失所望。=Your master Xiahou Lan also lost interest, for the skills your Eldest Senior Brother demonstrated today still fell short of those from when they traveled together in the Jianghu. She had come to observe the battle in order to verify her own progress; how could it not leave her deeply disappointed?
一旁樊嘯天卻大呼可惜，這麼多銅錢拿來當暗器擲，就算最後撿回來，也難免失落一些，未免太過奢侈，倘若這些錢給了她，窩中那些狗兒豈不日日都有肉包吃。=Fan Xiaotian, standing nearby, cried out in dismay - so many copper coins spent as thrown hidden weapons, and even once retrieved, some would surely be lost, which seemed far too wasteful. If those coins went to her instead, wouldn't the dogs in her den get meat buns to eat every day?
鬥到酣處，大師兄亦鬥志昂揚，靈機一動，當即便使出新悟的招術。\n石公遠仗著硬功，明刀明槍的也難砍透，全然無懼，卻不想大師兄指中射出一道無形氣勁，一擊便貫穿了自身護體氣勁，破體而出。\n眾所周知，說到破體無形氣勁，唯有古今四大絕技，嵩山派奧義《金剛神槍指》了。\n只是嵩山派覆於二十年前極樂教之役，此技別說失不失傳，究竟是否真實存在亦眾說紛紜，與崆峒御劍術同為江湖傳說，方今天下，不信者居多，直到今天你大師兄在眾目睽睽之下使將出來，眾人方才相信世上真有此番神技，能殺敵於身外。\n若此技為嵩山高僧所得，世人除了欽佩仰慕，便無其他的了，但若是善使暗器的唐門中人得之，卻令人毛骨悚然。要知唐門中人可不管世俗成見，暗算、偷襲、使毒百無禁忌，暗器有形，尚且能防，可是唐布衣練就神槍指，就算脫個精光、雙手以繩縛之都能殺人，試問天下還有誰能防他？=The duel reached its peak, and Eldest Senior Brother's fighting spirit soared. A sudden inspiration struck him, and he immediately unleashed the newly mastered technique. Shi Gongyuan, relying on his solid physical training, was unafraid of direct confrontation, yet he hadn't anticipated Eldest Senior Brother's finger shooting out an invisible force that pierced through his protective aura, breaking through his body. It is well known that the only techniques capable of piercing through the body with invisible force are the four ancient supreme skills, the Songshan sect's profound secret art, the Vajra Divine Spear Finger. However, the Songshan sect was destroyed twenty years ago during the Supreme Bliss Cult's attack. This technique, whether lost or not, remains a subject of debate, and along with the Kongtong Sword-Riding Technique, it is merely a legend in the Jianghu. Today, many still doubt its existence, but now, with Eldest Senior Brother demonstrating it before all eyes, the people have finally believed that such a divine skill truly exists, capable of killing an enemy from a distance. If this technique were in the hands of Songshan monks, the world would only admire and respect it. But if the Tang Clan, masters of hidden weapons, were to possess it, it would be terrifying. For the Tang Clan has no regard for social conventions; they are unafraid of ambushes, treachery, or poison. Even their visible weapons can be defended against, but Tang Buyi, having mastered the Vajra Divine Spear Finger, could kill even if stripped naked and bound with ropes. Who in the world could possibly defend against him?
別說你驚呆了，連你師父夏侯蘭都為之色變。\n還道一別多年，自己神功大成，今非昔比，你大師兄若不痛下苦功，便非抗手。先前還看得昏昏欲睡，直到此技一出，便知是她也驚得差點從樹上掉下來。=Never mind that you were stunned - even your master Xiahou Lan changed countenance. She had believed that after all these years apart, her own martial arts had grown immeasurably, far beyond what they once were, and that unless your Eldest Senior Brother trained himself half to death, he would be no match for her. Moments before she had been drowsing with boredom, but the instant this technique appeared, you realized she too was so startled she nearly toppled out of the tree.
你簡直驚呆了，萬萬想不到大師兄還藏這一手絕招，這可絕計不算唐門武功啊。=You're absolutely stunned, never imagining that your Eldest Senior Brother still has this ultimate move hidden away - this certainly isn't Tang Clan martial arts at all.
周遭觀戰的武林人更是亂作一鍋粥，均沒想見今日來此，竟然有幸目睹四大絕技現世。=The Wulin onlookers all around dissolved into chaos, like a pot boiled over, for none of them had expected that coming here today, they would have the good fortune to witness the emergence of the Four Supreme Techniques.
可是壞就壞在，大師兄全然不知魔教畜牲道法王也曾在江陵使過此技，不免引人猜忌，眾議紛紛，雖無證據，可是捕風捉影，越講越真。\n唐門飛俠與魔教法王關係匪淺的傳聞由此傳開。=But the trouble was that your Eldest Senior Brother had no idea that the Beast Path Dharma King of the Demon Cult had once used this very technique in Jiangling. This inevitably raised suspicions, and speculation among the crowd grew rampant, even though there was no evidence. Nevertheless, unfounded rumors spread far and wide, until at last the whisper took hold that the Tang Clan's Flying Hero shared some close, ill relationship with the Dharma King of the Demon Cult.
再論那石公遠，一副大老粗模樣，耐打程度有目共睹，非要逼人連神槍指都祭出來才收拾得了，已算輸得不冤，雖敗猶榮。=As for Shi Gongyuan, he looked every bit the rough, brutish sort, his sheer toughness plain for all to see - forcing his opponent to resort even to the Divine Spear Finger just to bring him down. To lose like that was no disgrace; though defeated, he lost with honor.
可是奪妻之恨，不共戴天，不是光分勝負便能握手言和，石公遠顫巍巍起身，誓與大師兄拚個你死我活。=However, the hatred of having his wife taken from him was one that could not exist under the same sky. Winning or losing was not enough to settle it. Shi Gongyuan rose to his feet, trembling, and vowed to fight your Eldest Senior Brother to the death.
飛石幫眾雖說龍蛇混雜，大抵是不學無術的流氓，卻非不講道義，往昔受你唐門的恩情，點點滴滴都記在心裡，眼看今日事難善罷，紛紛跳出來勸阻自家幫主。\n那石公遠乃是極重情義之人，如今夫人跟人離家出走，自家兄弟又紛紛唱反調，心中又悲又怒，什麼榮華富貴、功成名就的全都不想要了，自暴自棄，揮拳亂砸，什麼勸也不肯聽，只想與仇家同歸於盡。=Though the Flying Stone Gang's members were a mixed lot, mostly unschooled ruffians, they were not without a sense of honor. They remembered every kindness the Tang Clan had once shown them, and seeing that today's trouble could not be easily settled, they rushed out one after another to hold back their Gang Leader. Shi Gongyuan was a man of deep feeling and loyalty; now that his wife had left with another man and his own sworn brothers were turning against him, grief and fury warred within him. All thought of glory, wealth, and renown fell away. He gave himself over to despair, swinging his fists and smashing everything in reach, deaf to every plea, wanting only to perish together with his enemy.

\n煉丹房中，大師兄昏迷不醒，傷臥在榻，呼吸短促，臉色蒼白。\n渾無半分平時興風作浪，天不怕地不怕的神氣。\n大師兄敗於人手，身受重傷，瀕死而歸，這是誰也料想不到的結局。\n然而不爭事實便擺在眼前，觀其胸骨吋裂，確是被極霸道的外門硬功所傷不假，無疑便是崆峒派鐵拳門的鐵臂神拳。\n如今鐵拳門已沒人會使，秘笈流落江湖，反而是飛石幫主恃之成名，於臥雲崗眾目睽睽之下戰勝了大師兄。\n與大師兄隨行的同門弟子不知所蹤，青城不忍見唐門飛俠傷重而亡，便出面相護，又四處延請大夫為他醫治，無奈地處偏僻，沒有良醫，能醫跌打風寒，對大師兄所受的重傷卻一籌莫展。\n恰逢此時有二名行腳郎中途經此地，聞知此事，便上前自薦。\n青城中人鑽研丹道，於藥理亦粗有涉獵，見二位大夫所開方子無不對症，施針用藥以後，唐布衣傷勢即刻見好，疑竇盡去，往唐門一路都好生相待，及至後來二人自白，乃是來自六道峽，才驚覺這兩人並非尋常大夫。\n那六道峽是什麼所在？那是方今武林最大禍患泥教「天道」的大本營。\n坐落襄陽宋金交征之地，荊山如冠，群峰簇擁，易守難攻。\n受兵禍波及者，多數流亡至此，宋金均不敢輕犯，都說六道峽中有魔法，能惑人心智，有進無出，極為神秘，惹世人非議，武林中人尤為忌憚。\n倘若不是先和這二位郎中相識，心有敬意，縱是青城派這等修道之人，只怕也難免俗，先入為主，不以自身明辨而信人云。\n然則，青城有雅量能信人，崆峒卻未必能有，不知何處得聞此事，只道青城泥教狼狽為奸，而唐門飛俠失陷魔爪，命在旦夕，念及武林同道之誼，不能不管，遂快馬加鞭，攔路向青城要人。\n彼時青城一行已經行至唐門活動地界，在山腰茶肆歇息，整肅衣冠，準備先遣人上大院送拜帖，再由唐門知客弟子下山接引，方合禮數。\n崆峒一行人氣勢洶洶來到，兩派倒不是立刻就翻臉的。\n崆峒見青城渾無半分心虛神色，一派悠哉在喝茶，那唐布衣雖然面乏血色，卻還能談笑風生調戲路過女子，顯然沒有性命之憂，何況他們去向正是唐門。崆峒諸俠再莽，此時也隱約猜到傳聞有誤。\n而青城人馬聽崆峒言明來意，不怪他們魯莽，反而好生欣慰，均想崆峒派如此講究武林道義，很是值得結交。\n正想以茶代酒，結交朋友，那邊廂唐布衣卻忽然一口血嘔將出來，傷勢驀地爆發，頃刻之間便即昏迷，觀其症狀、聽其脈象，無疑是散功現象。\n二位郎中立時斷言，這是茶中藥性所致，而此藥正是泥教知名的「五色泥」，能治百病，與唐門萬靈油有異曲同工之妙。\n不同者在於萬靈丹是以毒攻毒，如非中毒之人，服之有害，這五色泥卻不受此限，可以外用止血，內服養生，補益之效顯著，乃是集古今醫術大成之惠世靈藥。\n偏生就是此藥，於唐門中人，無異於猛毒。\n要說為何，便是因為唐門修習內功不按常理，而是另闢蹊徑，起草之後便不下苦功，而是仰仗藥膳，日夜以胡椒粉毒溫養內息，可謂一身是毒。\n你大師兄便是誤服此藥，導致散功，一身內力渙散不能凝聚，無法抑制傷勢。才導致傷勢爆發。\n崆峒、青城各自色變，本來已握手言和，終究還是大打出手。\n一方認定對方下毒相害，不懷好意，要搶人急救；一方百口莫辯，想勸對方罷鬥，救人要緊，卻怎麼辯白都不是。\n勝負未分曉，茶肆中人已受波及，或死或傷，更是一發不可收拾。\n如今大師兄體力衰弱至極，又為五色泥藥力所苦，不能再施以毒攻毒的法子，是以萬靈油亦無用場，更不能再輕易用藥，以免肝、腎無法消受，雖被接回唐門，大夥卻都束手無策。=Within the alchemy room, the Senior Brother lay unconscious, wounded on the bed, breathing shallowly, his face pale. \nHe was utterly devoid of the usual confidence, the fearlessness that usually defined him. \nThe Senior Brother had fallen to a man's hand, grievously wounded, returning from the brink of death—an unexpected and unthinkable conclusion. \nYet the truth was plain: he had been defeated, and his whereabouts were known. \n如今二師兄不在，無人能應付如此難症，你正想將二位郎中請來商議，他們便自己上門了。\n這二位大夫不同於尋常江湖郎中，頗有傲骨，來到蜀中是為求學，自認禮數、誠意十足，沒有半分欠了你們的。\n打定了主意，倘若你唐門如世俗庸人一般嘴臉，不由分說便認定泥教是仇敵，咄咄逼人，那便是打殺了他們，也別想讓他們配合。\n然而你的氣量，卻遠超二人意料之外，心下感念，故此知無不言，首先便開門見山，說明了下藥之事，非他二人所為。\n那五色泥是泥教所有，天下只此一家，旁人順理成章便認定鐵定與他們二名現行犯脫離不了干係，然則事實不然，二位郎中在茶肆中飲茶時，便認出了五色泥中特有的蓮花香氣，還道唐門名不虛傳，竟然殊途同歸，調製出了成份相近的藥草茶，只因此茶於人大有裨益，又已到了唐門地界，心防鬆懈，是以不曾多想，沒想到著了別人的道，此茶誰也不害，就是覷準了唐門煮的。\n而下藥之人，不是旁人，正是你。\n或者該說是某個與你形貌相似、刻意冒充，存心讓人誤以為是你的人。\n這便是二位郎中見你之時，為之一怔的緣故。\n此事說來蹊蹺，委實令人難以置信，但是硬要細究，也算得上絲絲入扣。二位郎中既說明了原委，已盡道義，至於你信與不信，卻不甚在意，反正此番西行早有赴死覺悟，你若待不信，就怕縱放了幕後真兇，責任在你而不在他們。=Now that the Second Senior Brother is away, no one can handle such a difficult case. 這一字說得簡單，實則難如登天。\n大師兄所受傷勢雖沉，卻無暗勁、後勁的隱患，若能運使內功強行壓制，便不致害命，難在他此刻散功，真氣並非消散於無形，旁人貿然輸送內力，必會引得反激，稍有不甚，到時經脈寸斷不說，連相助之人亦有性命之憂。\n因此這個人選，必須是修練同系法門的唐門中人，以同種真氣相助，所受衝突最小，這道理淺顯得很。\n然而，這都不是其中最難為的事。\n真正最令人束手無策者，在於唐門內功是以毒藥所養，所以唐家子弟掌力均有毒性，既然有毒，必為五色泥所剋，一旦真氣入體，立即逸散，要想以之救人，根本癡心妄想。=This one word sounded simple, but achieving it was as hard as scaling heaven itself. That earlier strike had already exhausted his vital force, and he was on the precipice of death.\nYou remained unconscious, while your senior brother felt his true qi dissipating, nearly depleted, and could no longer suppress the self-consuming poison. 被烈陽槌所傷，暈厥的時候，你作了一場漫長的大夢。\n夢中的趙活是所有兄弟姐妹中，最得爹娘寵愛的。\n到唐門拜師，也被破格提拔，早早就成為了入室弟子，改宗姓唐。\n掌門、師娘、小師妹都對趙活另眼相看，唐門沒有內憂外患，所向披靡，分舵、分家遍布中原，是江湖第一大派。\n趙活福緣深厚，無往不利，迷路也能誤闖洞天福地，能得到隱居高手青睞，無償傳授八十載功力，而且習武資質超凡，什麼樣的武功秘笈到手，看一眼就能學成，就算不去苦練，四處閒逛遊玩，武功也一天強似一天，別人刻苦修練，在趙活看來就像個猴兒一樣可笑，這群猴子三不五時就需要被教訓，好凸顯趙活的武功有多麼高強。\n夢中的趙活，在武林大會上大出風頭，名聲壓過大師兄，江湖俠士無不景仰，武林俠女無不傾慕。\n趙活有四個嬌妻，唐門小師妹、點蒼明珠葉雲裳、錦香宮龍湘女俠，連上官世家聽了趙活的名聲，都恨不得把千金上官螢塞進趙活幃帳之中，為此開罪南宮世家也不足惜。\n江陵戰場上，趙活孤身一人單挑上萬乞丐，以趙活三千年修為的神掌，將泥教法王王二壯轟碎成渣，永世不得超生，轟到他下輩子還得再當乞丐，餘勢未衰，幾百里外的六道峽也受波及，那些素未謀面的魔教螻蟻，全都灰飛煙滅。\n趙活被奉為武林盟主，崆峒四姝爭先恐後向你諂媚，連當朝官家在趙活跟前，都只敢低頭注視趙活的腳尖，乖乖禪讓。\n趙活坐擁一切，財富、名聲、美人、武功、權勢、江山，卻悵然若失，下一步該去哪裡，是該飛升仙界、大鬧天宮，把玉皇大帝也擠下玉座嗎？\n無窮欲望的盡頭，是一片虛無。\n唐突現身的大師兄，要找的可不是這位武林盟主、大宋官家，找的是你。\n趙活見到大師兄，自卑、羞恥油然而生，想將大師兄排除在美夢之外，可是大師兄沒像旁人一樣被轟得魂飛魄散，只是上前賞了他一巴掌，罵一句賤人閉嘴，你的心魔便消散無形了。\n你憧憬大師兄，而他也從沒看輕過你。拉著你四處胡鬧、偶爾開你玩笑、陷害你、連累你，也同樣尊重你、支持你，替你撐腰。\n這是他真心把你當作朋友的緣故。\n你多年心結消解，今日方始醒悟，擺脫世人加諸於你的陰影，身為自己而活。=Struck down by the Blazing Sun Hammer, you fell into a swoon and dreamed a long dream.\nIn the dream, Zhao Huo was the most favored of all his brothers and sisters, cherished above the rest by his father and mother.\nWhen he went to the Tang Clan to become a disciple, he was given an exceptional promotion, made an inner disciple early on, and took the Tang surname.\nThe Sect Leader, his Master's wife, and his Junior Martial Sister all held Zhao Huo in special regard. The Tang Clan faced no trouble from within or without, unstoppable in every battle, its branches and offshoots spread across the Central Plains—the greatest sect in the Jianghu.\nZhao Huo's fortune ran deep and never failed him; even when he lost his way, he would stumble into some hidden paradise. He won the favor of reclusive masters who freely passed on eighty years of cultivation, and his gift for the martial arts was beyond compare—he had only to glance at any manual to master it at once. Even without hard training, wandering idly from place to place, his skill grew stronger by the day. To Zhao Huo, those who trained hard and diligently looked as laughable as monkeys, needing a lesson now and then just to show off how mighty Zhao Huo's own skill truly was.\nIn the dream, Zhao Huo stole the show at the Wulin Assembly, his fame eclipsing Eldest Senior Brother's; every hero of the Jianghu revered him, every heroine adored him.\nHe had four radiant wives: the Tang Clan's own Junior Martial Sister, Diancang's Pearl Ye Yunshang, and Jinxiang Palace's Long Xiang. Even the Shangguan Family, hearing of Zhao Huo's fame, longed to push their daughter Shangguan Ying into his bedchamber, willing to offend the Nangong Family over it.\nOn the Jiangling battlefield, Zhao Huo single-handedly took on ten thousand beggars. With a divine palm honed over three thousand years, he smashed the Mud Cult's Dharma King Wang Erzhuang to dust, damning him never to be reborn—blasting him so thoroughly that even in his next life he'd have to be a beggar again. The force of the blow carried for hundreds of miles, rocking Six Paths Gorge, where countless unseen Demon Cult vermin were blown to ash.\nZhao Huo was hailed as the Wulin Alliance Leader; the Kongtong Four Maidens vied to flatter him. Even the reigning Emperor dared not lift his eyes past Zhao Huo's toes, meekly abdicating the throne to him.\nZhao Huo possessed everything—wealth, fame, beauty, martial power, authority, the realm itself—yet felt hollow, at a loss for what to do next. Should he ascend to the heavens, storm the Celestial Palace, and knock the Jade Emperor off his own throne?\nAt the end of boundless desire lay nothing but emptiness.\nThe Eldest Senior Brother who abruptly appeared wasn't looking for this Wulin Alliance Leader, this Emperor of Great Song—he was looking for you.\nSeeing him, shame and self-loathing welled up in Zhao Huo, and he wanted to shut Eldest Senior Brother out of the dream. But Eldest Senior Brother wasn't blasted to nothing like everyone else—he simply stepped up and slapped him, snapping 'shut your mouth, you wretch'—and your inner demon dissolved into nothing.\nYou looked up to Eldest Senior Brother, and he never once looked down on you. He dragged you into mischief, teased you, sometimes got you into trouble or dragged you down with him—but he respected you and stood behind you all the same.\nThat was because he truly counted you as a friend.\nOnly today, with your knot of years finally untied, did you understand—you could shed the shadow others had cast over you, and live as yourself.
大師兄用僅存的力氣，啪啪連環賞你幾巴掌，不許你就此睡去。你哭笑不得，這人都要死了還能鬧騰，真不知前世欠了他什麼，今生才會給人家這樣糟蹋。\n大師兄與你都受了重傷，呼吸都痛，不過死到臨頭，還是要說點幹話才過癮。\n哭著來的，起碼要能笑著走。\n眼看你氣息漸低，漸漸不行，大師兄才容許你閉眼，說要傳你心訣，讓你想像唐門後山，天還沒亮，你們師兄弟承著涼風再喝酒，就像從前一樣。\n彌留之際，你的想像比現實還要清晰，彷彿真的回到了家。\n他問你，喝的是什麼酒？=Eldest Senior Brother used the last of his strength to slap you again and again, refusing to let you drift off to sleep. You didn't know whether to laugh or cry—the man was dying and still causing trouble; you had no idea what debt from a past life had earned you such treatment in this one. Both of you were badly hurt, and every breath was agony, yet even with death closing in, he still had to crack a few crude jokes to feel like himself. Those who arrived in this world crying ought, at the very least, to leave it laughing. As your breath grew shallow and you began to fade, Eldest Senior Brother finally let you close your eyes, saying he would pass on his Mental Formula—telling you to picture the Tang Clan's back mountain before dawn, the two of you brothers drinking in the cool night wind, just like old times. In your final moments, that imagined scene felt clearer than reality itself, as though you had truly come home. He asked you: what wine was it you were drinking?
你答道：是他偷藏的猴兒酒。大師兄也不吝惜，指點你去拿，就在山壁上三丈高，風雨不侵的的凹陷處。\n你彷彿真的施展了輕功，有驚無險地拿到了。=You answered: it was the monkey wine he'd secretly stashed away. Eldest Senior Brother didn't hold back, and pointed you to where it was—three zhang up the cliff face, tucked in a hollow shielded from wind and rain. You seemed to summon true Qinggong, and retrieved it without mishap.
你答不上來，大師兄便替你決定了，喝的是臨安府正店所釀的羊羔酒，這酒價值不斐，尋常人家一年到頭都未必喝得上一壺。\n你雖沒喝過，不知是何滋味，反正此刻圖的不是酒香。=You couldn't answer, so Eldest Senior Brother decided for you. You drank Lamb Wine brewed by the government‑run wine shop in Lin'an Prefecture. This wine was quite expensive; ordinary households might not even get to taste a single pot in a whole year. Though you had never tasted it before and didn't know its flavor, you weren't after the wine's aroma at the moment.
你答道：是蒙古馬奶酒，皮囊壺裝著，喝起來既有奶的滋味，也有酒的芳醇，是大漠和草原的味道。\n大師兄一怔，這酒連他也沒喝過，連連追問，你回想起當時大漠風光，緬懷一笑。=You answered: it was Mongol kumis, carried in a leather pouch—it had both the taste of milk and the mellow warmth of wine, the flavor of the desert and the steppe. Eldest Senior Brother was taken aback; even he had never tasted this wine, and pressed you with questions. You recalled the desert scenery from that time, and smiled, lost in memory.
斟滿酒水，舉杯飲盡，好不痛快。\n你二人雖然流浪在外，心卻已經到家了。\n面臨死亡的恐懼之心漸淡，遠方天色濃黑，不消誰說，也知道訣別時刻已至。\n大師兄指著前方的壓境的鉛雲，對你預告即將破曉。\n你若不逃，那就挺身而戰吧。\n世人都說唐門人才凋零，可是你還在。他的戲份演完了，要下台看著，為你喝采鼓掌，下一齣該你主演，你的時代，就是現在。=You filled the cup and drained it in one draught—there was nothing so satisfying. Though the two of you had been wandering far from home, your hearts had already returned. The fear of death faded slowly; the sky in the distance had turned a deep black, and neither of you needed to say it—you both knew the moment of parting had come. Eldest Senior Brother pointed at the leaden clouds pressing down ahead, telling you dawn was near. If you would not flee, then you should stand and fight. The world said the Tang Clan's talents had withered away, but you were still here. His part in the play was done; he would step down and watch from the wings, cheering you on. The next act was yours to lead. Your time was now.
\n你獨自爬上了正心樓頂，眺望遠方。=You climbed alone to the top of Zhengxin Tower and gazed into the distance.
也不顧自己內力全失，手腳尚且不如不懂武功的莊稼人靈便，稍有不甚就會一頭栽到樓下去，你就是想看看唐家大院的景色。=You paid no mind to having lost all your Internal Force, your hands and feet clumsier now than a farmhand who'd never learned martial arts—one careless step could send you tumbling headfirst from the tower. You just wanted to see the view of the Tang family compound.
小師妹也心有靈犀，上到樓頂才發現你，一言不發來到你身邊，靜靜在旁邊呆著。=Junior Martial Sister seemed to sense it too, and climbing to the rooftop, found you there. She said nothing, only came to your side and stayed quietly beside you.
你的背影在夕陽照耀下，陰影濃黑，小師妹油然而起一絲膽怯，怯生生的牽住了你的衣角，既怕你掉下去，也害怕連你都會消失不見。\n你任由她牽著，看著她從小長大，既羨她武功日益高強，也憐她始終柔弱無助，她最怕孤獨。\n心中愛念無極，即使自知沒有資格與她攜手偕老，也想自告奮勇守護她，向她宣言自己那兒也不會去，會陪伴她，直到她有自己的歸宿，不再需要自己，才會鄭重的道別，把回憶收摺放入心底，淚流滿面而去。\n她不知你的覺悟，沒考慮一切言外之音，僅是認真聽著你的話語，惶惶不安的心致此終於逐漸安定，她遠比你所知曉的更要依賴你。=Your figure, silhouetted against the setting sun, cast a dark shadow. Junior Martial Sister felt a sudden wave of Timidity and timidly clutched at your sleeve, afraid you'd fall, and that even you would vanish.\nYou allowed her to cling, watching her grow from a child. You envied her ever-improving martial arts, and pitied her persistent vulnerability. She fears loneliness above all.\nAn endless longing filled your heart. Even knowing you were unworthy to walk by her side, you wished to volunteer to protect her, to declare that you wouldn't leave, that you would stay with her until she found her own place, until she no longer needed you, then to bid her a solemn farewell, folding memories away within your heart, and departing with tears streaming down your face.\nShe doesn't know your resolve, hasn't considered the unspoken words behind your actions. She simply listened to your words, her anxious heart finally finding a gradual sense of peace. She is far more reliant on you than you realize.
責任真的落在你肩上的時候，你才知道，原來背負著旁人的期望並不逍遙。=Only when the responsibility truly settled on your shoulders did you understand that carrying the weight of others' expectations was no easy freedom.
四師兄在下邊見到你，心中驀地一怵，旁人上去還不打緊，你爬這麼高，卻令人心驚膽跳，連忙將你喊了下來。\n你沒施展輕功，而是老實的從樓梯上下來。=Fourth Senior Brother, down below, caught sight of you and felt a sudden jolt of alarm—others climbing up wouldn't have troubled him, but seeing you at such a height set his heart racing, and he hurriedly called you down. You didn't use Qinggong, but climbed down the stairs like anyone else.
四師兄找你，是為了傳達福韞法師圓寂的事情。\n他苦熬多日，終究扛不過劇毒煎熬，萬靈丹也救不了他性命。\n嵩山派弟子來了，見自家師弟死狀悽慘，是在唐門地盤裡中的毒、丟的性命，怎能不遭人疑？嵩山眾僧認定唐門害死了福韞，將他遺體接出山門，就近僻處誦經火化。=Fourth Senior Brother came to inform you that Fu Yun has passed away. He endured many days of suffering, but ultimately couldn't withstand the torment of the poison; even the Panacea Pill couldn't save his life. The Songshan disciples arrived, saw their junior brother's tragic death, which occurred on Tang Clan territory and resulted from poisoning. How could they not suspect the Tang Clan? The Songshan monks concluded that the Tang Clan had killed Fu Yun, took his body out of the mountain gate, and burned it in a secluded place after chanting scriptures.
你與福韞法師也是知交，救不得他，卻想至少送他一程。\n你不敢過份靠近，只在遠處喃喃禱祝。\n眼看熊熊烈火焚此殘驅，福韞法師捨此色身，登臨西方極樂，你卻還在人間受苦，受憂怖左右，不得解脫。=You are also a close friend of Master Fu Yun; though you could not save him, you at least wished to see him off. You dared not get too close, only murmuring prayers from afar. Watching as the fierce flames consumed his withered body, Master Fu Yun relinquished this physical form, ascending to the Western Paradise, while you remained in the mortal world suffering, tormented by fear and distress, unable to attain liberation.
四師兄找你，是為了告訴你福韞法師清醒的事。\n本門最擅用毒、用藥之人叛逃，其他人都是半桶水的學徒，解尋常毒症可以，遇著這西域火蠍王毒，卻都一籌莫展。\n所幸那唐守鴻師叔先前因你一席話若有所悟，雖不算洗心革面、痛改前非，卻也不再故意作對，更聽聞佛門弟子有難，旋即出手相救，保住了他的性命，也令唐門嵩山不致嫌隙，且以他的方式，為唐門盡了一份心力。=Fourth Senior Brother sought you out to inform you of the awakening of Dharma Master Fu Yun.\nThe most skilled in poisons and medicine within our sect betrayed us. The others are mere apprentices; they can handle common ailments, but are utterly stumped by the venom of this Western Fire Scorpion King.\nFortunately, Martial Uncle Tang Shouhong previously gained some enlightenment from your words. While he hasn't completely reformed, he no longer deliberately antagonizes, and upon hearing of the plight of the Buddhist disciples, he swiftly intervened to save them, preserving his life and preventing a rift between the Tang Clan and Mount Song. And in his own way, he has contributed his efforts to the Tang Clan.
四師兄找你，是為了告訴你福韞法師清醒的事。\n你聞此終於放下心頭大石，萬幸這位青年僧人總算吉人天相，沒有喪生於此，否則令人惋惜不說，唐門更是跳進黃河也洗不清。=Fourth Senior Brother has come to inform you that Fu Yun the monk has regained consciousness. Upon hearing this, you finally put down the heavy stone on your heart. Fortunately, this young monk has been protected by heaven and survived the incident. Otherwise, it would be a great pity, and the Tang Clan would be in an even more dire situation, as even jumping into the Yellow River wouldn't wash away the stain.
你急忙去見，福韞見你無恙，心中亦喜。\n敘話一陣開導於你，福韞便向你辭行，畢竟生者在世，尚且有能為力。\n不能以江湖紛擾誤國害民，事不宜遲，他要隨眾師兄巡訪各派，遊說各派齊心共抗魔教。=You hurried to see Fu Yun, who was pleased to see that you were unharmed. After a brief conversation to ease your mind, Fu Yun bid you farewell. After all, those alive still have duties in the world to attend to; they cannot allow Jianghu disputes to harm the state and its people. Time is of the essence, for he must join his fellow brothers to tour various sects and persuade them to unite against the Demon Cult.
臨去前他又不免嘮叨一句，這次不是說之以理，乃是動之以情，盼你念著曾經患難與共，往後處世多留人幾分餘地，莫再行惡，否則終有一日惡貫滿盈。=Before he left, he couldn't help but add one more word—not reasoning with you this time, but appealing to your heart, hoping you'd remember the hardships you'd shared and endeavor to leave others a little room in your future dealings, to do evil no more, lest the day come when your sins overflow their measure.
你人雖惡，卻重情義，當即一口答應。\n福韞笑顏逐開，口稱善哉，合十一拜離去。=Though you are wicked, you hold fast to loyalty and sentiment, and agreed at once. Fu Yun's face broke into a smile; he uttered "Excellent," pressed his palms together in a single bow, and took his leave.
你雖重情義，但人委實太壞，所以不肯答應。\n福韞長嘆一口氣，心想你心中惡念皆其來有自，六根不淨，是受世俗所染，人間一日不清明，你便要還以顏色。這原也不能一味怪你，只能將來再以佛法薰陶。合十一拜離去。=Though you cared for loyalty and sentiment, you were simply too wicked at heart, and so refused. Fu Yun let out a long sigh, thinking that the evil in your heart had its roots—your six senses unclean, stained by the dust of the world; so long as the world remained unclean, you would answer it in kind. This could not be laid wholly at your feet; only the teachings of the Buddha, in time, might yet temper you. He pressed his palms together, bowed once, and departed.
你嘴上說好，心下卻不以為然，隨口撒謊敷衍罷了。\n福韞察言觀色，知你敷衍，心中長嘆，能勸的也都勸了，善有善報，惡有惡報，只盼你好自為之。合十一拜離去。=You said yes with your mouth, but did not mean it in your heart—only a careless lie to brush him off. Fu Yun read your face and knew you were merely humoring him; he sighed inwardly. He had already given what counsel he could—good deeds bring good returns, evil deeds bring evil ones—and could only hope you would look after yourself. He pressed his palms together, bowed once, and departed.
四師兄找你，是為了告知龍湘拜別離去的事情。\n她在唐門除大師兄和你，再也不識旁人，自然該由你出面送她一程。=Fourth Senior Brother sought you out to tell you that Long Xiang was leaving and had come to bid farewell. Within the Tang Clan she knew no one besides the Eldest Senior Brother and you, so naturally it fell to you to see her off.
龍湘與你一見，只是打聲招呼，不必相送，臨行勸你勿再為惡，倘若被她撞見，頭一次會饒你，第二次就不留情面了。\n她笑著說的，你卻不寒而慄，你知道她絕不是說笑，也沒得商量。=Long Xiang greeted you with just a nod, needing no farewell. As she was about to leave, she warned you not to do evil again. Should she catch you, she would be merciful the first time, but not the second. She said it with a smile, yet you shivered with fear. You knew she was not joking, and there was no room for negotiation.
龍湘與你一見，只是打聲招呼，不必相送，就此拱手作別。=Long Xiang met you with just a greeting—no need to see her off—and so parted with a bow.
你急急而至，龍湘見你過來，嫣然一笑，央你陪她再走一小段路，二人一路閒談，都心有靈犀，絕口不提大師兄的事。\n送到半途，龍湘便手一拱，與你話別，你戀戀不捨，還想多送一程，也被婉拒。=You hurried over, and Long Xiang, seeing you approach, smiled brightly and asked you to walk with her a little further. The two of you chatted idly along the way, each understanding the other without needing to speak of the Eldest Senior Brother. Halfway there, Long Xiang raised her hands in a bow and bid you farewell. Reluctant to part, you wished to see her further still, but she politely declined.

龍湘聞言一怔，旋即啞然失笑。=Long Xiang was stunned upon hearing the words, then burst into laughter.

You spoke one after another, and Junior Martial Sister herself hadn't expressed her opinion, yet you two had already thought ahead to her grandchildren. 此時你雲裳妹子手裡捉了一根棍棒，一邊揮舞一邊搶進大院，揚言要讓求親的人都有來無回，誰敢覬覦她摯友默鈴的美色，就必須死。\n你和三師兄相顧汗顏，她兄長連忙將人拉住，連番道歉，一波未平，這小娘子忽然又靈光乍現，語出驚人，勸自己哥哥把你小師妹娶了，從此不就是一家人了？\n這種渾話豈能當著人家掌門的面說？葉雲舟差點沒暈倒，恨不得把她點了啞穴拖回去打爛屁股。=Just then, your Yunshang came charging into the courtyard swinging a staff, declaring that any suitor who showed his face would leave in a box—whoever dared covet her dear friend Moling's beauty would have to die. You and Third Senior Brother exchanged mortified looks. Her elder brother hurried to pull her back, apologizing over and over, but no sooner was that settled than the girl had another dazzling idea, blurting out something scandalous: that her brother should marry your Junior Martial Sister, and then wouldn't they all be one family? Such foolishness, said in front of the Sect Leader himself! Ye Yunzhou nearly fainted, longing to seal her mute acupoint and drag her home to thrash her.
葉雲裳出賣哥哥還不滿意，忽又話鋒一轉，把自己也給賣了。\n一派天真爛漫，說她也嫁了你，那便親上加親，她所重視的人們全都在一塊兒了。\n要不是她劣跡斑斑，你只怕真就相信她了。=Ye Yunshang, not content with having sold out her brother, promptly turned around and sold herself as well. With utterly guileless cheer, she declared that if she married you too, it would tie the families closer still, gathering everyone she cherished under one roof. Had she not had such a checkered history, you might almost have believed her.
你受寵若驚，就算知道她又在玩弄你，這短短一剎那，也足令你含笑而逝。\n可惜這畢竟是夢，你一認真起來，她登時又反悔了。=You were flattered beyond measure, even though you knew she was playing with you; in that fleeting moment, it was enough to make you die smiling. Unfortunately, this was just a dream. As soon as you took it seriously, she instantly regretted it.
你這人用情不專，心上分明掛念別的小娘子，偏又把雲裳哄著寵著，她何等聰明，一見你臉色，便猜出你底細，不由得又好氣、又好笑。\n微微慍怒，但也如釋重負。=You are fickle in love, plainly pining for another young lady even as you flatter and indulge Yunshang. She is clever enough that one look at your face told her exactly where she stood, leaving her both exasperated and amused—faintly vexed, yet also relieved.
她兄長唯恐再耽擱下去，這小丫頭又說出什麼不遜話語來，拱了拱手，便強行把妹妹拉走。\n葉雲裳被拖行一陣，轉身跟上兄長，把自己小手塞進哥哥手心裡。\n回眸對你吐舌，狡黠一笑。=Her elder brother feared further delay might lead the young girl to say something disrespectful, so he bowed and forcibly pulled his younger sister away. Ye Yunshang was dragged for a while before turning around to follow her brother, slipping her small hand into his. She glanced back, sticking out her tongue at you with a mischievous smile.
你不敢太過鬆懈，睡不到天亮便醒，和守更師弟閒談，今日雖忙，卻沒啥要緊大事，有些媒人心急，想偷塞紅包打點，提前和代掌門見面說談，不讓進，就硬是往大門塞紅包。\n這種場面，你從前倒也不是不曾見過，從前本門有位特別美貌的師姐出嫁，也是如此盛況。\n和他信口說些舊事，有說有笑，不知不覺，你也是資深門人了。\n見他實在倦了，就勸他去睡，你來替他守更。=You dared not let your guard down, waking before dawn to chat with the Junior Brother on watch. Busy as the day was, nothing urgent was afoot—only a few impatient matchmakers hoping to bribe their way to an early audience with the Acting Sect Leader by slipping him red envelopes, and when turned away at the gate, simply forcing the envelopes through the Main Gate anyway. Such scenes were nothing new to you; years ago, when a particularly beautiful Senior Sister of the sect had married out, there had been just such a spectacle. You traded old stories with him, laughing and joking, until, almost without noticing, you too had become a senior disciple. Seeing he was truly worn out, you told him to go rest while you took over the watch.
這幾日以來，唐門上下都在忙著籌辦婚事，他也算有些資歷，自然步上你的後塵，能者多勞，既要接待客人，又要守更，已經接連幾日沒好覺睡，見你如此慷慨，不由得大為感動。=These past few days, the whole Tang Clan has been busy preparing for the wedding. He too has some seniority now, and so, naturally, he followed in your footsteps—the capable always end up shouldering the most. Between entertaining guests and keeping watch, he had gone several nights running without proper sleep, and seeing you so generous now, he was deeply moved.
他怔了一怔，固然很累，卻滿腹狐疑，沒有一口答應，而你也只是心血來潮隨口說說，話一出口就覺後悔，正好反悔。\n這幾日以來，唐門上下都在忙著籌辦婚事，這位師弟也算有些資歷，自然步上你的後塵，能者多勞，既要接待客人，又要守更，已經接連幾日沒好覺睡，見你轉身要走，連忙喊住，換上一張陪笑嘴臉，盼你不要收回成命。\n你對同門師兄弟雖然講義氣，可是本性惡劣，順勢就向他勒索。=He was startled for a moment—exhausted as he was, doubt filled his mind, and he did not agree outright. You, for your part, had only spoken on a whim, and regretted it the instant the words left your mouth, glad of the chance to take it back. These past few days, the whole Tang Clan had been busy preparing for the wedding, and this Junior Brother, with some seniority of his own, had naturally followed in your footsteps—the capable always shoulder the most. Between entertaining guests and keeping watch, he had gone several nights without a proper sleep. Seeing you turn to go, he called out at once, plastering on an ingratiating smile, hoping you wouldn't take back your offer. You were loyal enough to your fellow disciples, but your nature was rotten at the core, and you seized the chance to extort him.
一勒再勒，=Squeeze after squeeze,
完全不懂見好就收，勒到別人跟你翻臉大打出手為止。=you never knew when to stop, wringing him dry until he was ready to turn on you and come to blows.
勒到數目令你心滿意足為止，才放他去睡。\n那師弟肚裡暗罵，你和四師兄是如出一轍的貪財嘴臉，四師兄坑蒙拐騙，而你是直接明搶，行徑更惡劣幾分。=You squeezed until the sum satisfied you, and only then did you let him go to sleep. The Junior Brother cursed you silently: you and Fourth Senior Brother wore the same greedy face—Fourth Senior Brother swindled and cheated, while you simply robbed people outright, your conduct even fouler than his.
你為了一點小錢無情無義的打倒了同門師弟，還嫌他躺在地上礙眼，特地拎回弟子房去了。\n大師兄瀟灑而不負責任；二師兄謹慎卻冷淡刻薄；三師兄溫文博學但是迂腐；四師兄和誰都好說話，偏偏勢利眼。本門幾位師兄，每個人都有好處，也有缺點，唯獨你例外，你只有缺點而已。\n為這點小錢就打人，之後同門師兄弟都說你是本門最可惡師兄，不單缺德，還很醜。=You beat your fellow Junior Brother black and blue over a paltry sum, with no thought for decency, and finding him an eyesore lying there on the ground, you hauled him back to the disciples' quarters yourself. Eldest Senior Brother is dashing but irresponsible; Second Senior Brother is careful but cold and cutting; Third Senior Brother is cultured and gentle but hidebound; Fourth Senior Brother is easy with everyone—except when it comes to money. Every senior brother in the sect has his virtues and his flaws, but you alone are the exception: you have nothing but flaws. Beating a man over so small a sum—after that, your fellow disciples all agreed you were the most detestable senior brother in the sect, not only rotten of character, but ugly to boot.
這一夜風平浪靜。\n唐家大院熄了燈火，就只風聲吹樹葉的颯颯響聲。\n夜越深越靜，回憶就越是吵嚷，你想起許多年前，辛儒師姐新嫁之時，唐家大院鑼鼓喧天，熱熱鬧鬧，好多賓客到訪。\n二師兄難得臉帶笑意，掌門也顯得有點坐立不安，四師兄說迎親的轎子到門前了，還沒開席，大師兄就喝醉了要掀新娘子的紅蓋頭，二師兄頓時大怒，更不打話，與他當眾互毆越打越遠。\n那年小師妹身骨未長，比現在更為嬌小，在賓客中間被推來擠去，見了這麼多陌生人，心中害怕，喊了聲爹爹，掌門連忙跑將過去，牽著她的小手，告訴她師姐為何要走，那是因為師姐有了新的家人。\n遲早也會輪到她離家，承諾到時一定要給她辦得風風光光的，比今日還要熱鬧，讓天下人都來祝福她。\n回憶裡的笑聲、曲聲消散如煙，你的思緒回到此刻，冷冷清清的唐門大院之中。\n韶光易逝，掌門允諾女兒的那一天，匆匆一瞥就已經到了眼前。=That night was calm and still. The lanterns had gone dark throughout the Tang Family courtyard, leaving only the rustle of wind through the leaves. The deeper the night, the quieter it grew, and the louder your memories became. You recalled how, many years ago, when Senior Sister Xin Ru had newly married, the Tang Family courtyard rang with drums and gongs, bustling and joyous, thronged with guests. Second Senior Brother, for once, wore a smile; the Sect Leader seemed unable to sit still. Fourth Senior Brother announced that the bridal sedan had reached the gate, and before the feast had even begun, Eldest Senior Brother, already drunk, tried to lift the bride's red veil—Second Senior Brother flew into a rage on the spot, and without a word the two of them brawled in front of everyone, trading blows further and further from the hall. That year, Junior Martial Sister had not yet grown into herself, smaller even than she is now, jostled about among the guests; frightened by so many strangers, she cried out for her father. The Sect Leader hurried over at once, took her small hand, and told her why her senior sister had to leave—because her senior sister now had a new family of her own. One day it would be her turn to leave too, he promised, and when it came, he would give her an even grander send-off than this one, so that all under heaven would come to wish her well. The laughter and music of memory dissolved like smoke, and your thoughts returned to the present—to the cold, silent courtyard of the Tang Clan. How swiftly the years slip by: the day the Sect Leader promised his daughter has arrived in what feels like a single fleeting glance.
夜半有人敲窗，你睡得正香，哪裡會醒？外邊人又怕吵醒旁人，猶豫片刻，大起膽子把小手伸進窗裡推了推你，你試圖抵抗，她也鍥而不捨，非把你推醒不可。\n你怒不可遏，翻身而起，起床氣都沒撒就被外邊那人點了穴，拖出窗去才解穴，還倒是來了敵人，不料意外訪客竟是小師妹。=In the dead of night someone knocked at the window—you were sound asleep, how could you wake? The person outside, wary of disturbing others, hesitated a moment, then screwed up the courage to slip a small hand through the window and shake you. You tried to resist, but she wouldn't be put off, determined to wake you no matter what. Furious, you sat bolt upright, but before you could even vent your morning temper, the person outside struck your acupoints, hauled you out through the window, and only then released them—as if set upon by an enemy. Yet the unexpected visitor turned out to be none other than Junior Martial Sister.
問她為何來訪不走正門，卻道三師兄告誡必須防於禮教，不敢深夜還來敲門見面。=She was asked why she had come without using the main gate, and she replied that the Third Senior Brother had warned her to be cautious about etiquette, so she dared not come knocking at night to meet him.
她渾然沒意識到自己半夜從窗邊點穴捉人，私下見面，更加不妥。=She never once realized that landing an Acupoint Strike on you and hauling you out the window in the dead of night, just to meet you alone, was far more improper than what she'd been trying to avoid.
她渾然沒意識到自己待嫁之身，半夜與男子見面敘話，本來就不妥，容易被有心人曲解、誇大其辭。這不，人家好端端找你說話，你就認定是幽會了嗎？=She never stopped to think that, as a woman already spoken for, meeting a man alone at night for a talk was improper to begin with, easily twisted and exaggerated by those with ulterior motives. And yet—here she was, simply wanting a word with you, and you went and assumed it was a secret rendezvous?
問她為何來訪不走正門，卻反一臉狐疑，問你從前晚上找她，又為何不走正門？她還道這是默契來著。\n你聞言吃了一大驚，半分睡意也沒有了，小師妹亦為之啞然，怎麼，你在她窗下蹲哨，竟不知道她知道嗎？不只她知道，全寢師姊妹都知道啊，只是認定你無害的時候，會睜一隻眼閉一隻眼而已。=You asked again why she hadn't come through the main gate, but she turned the question back on you with a suspicious look, asking why you too had never used the main door when you used to visit her window at night. She said it had simply become an unspoken understanding between you. You were taken aback, all trace of sleep gone. The Junior Martial Sister was equally stunned—had you really kept watch outside her window without knowing she was aware? Not only she but all the sisters in the dormitory knew; they simply looked the other way once they judged you harmless.
追問她既然知情，何以先前蹲哨時一字也不和你說？\n小師妹被問得滿腹委屈，你不是也沒說話嗎？她還道你就是不想說話，所以也不出聲打擾你。\n你倆都被真相震驚得不行。=You pressed her further—if she'd known all along, why hadn't she said a single word while you kept watch? The Junior Martial Sister felt hard done by. But you didn't say anything either! she protested. She'd thought you simply didn't want to talk, so she'd kept quiet rather than disturb you. The truth left you both stunned.
你這般矯揉，自然不能輕易認罪，立時裝出一副了然於胸的模樣，小師妹又不是真傻，見你態度轉變得如此生硬，也不由得將信將疑，狐疑之色更濃幾分。=Being so pretentious, you couldn't easily admit to it, and at once put on an air of knowing understanding. But the Junior Martial Sister was no fool—seeing your manner shift so stiffly, she couldn't help but doubt you, her suspicion deepening all the more.
不說這個，且問小師妹深夜來訪，是想作甚？\n她反倒被你問著了，支支唔唔半晌說不出所以然來，反讓你猜她來意。=Let that be, then—instead you asked the Junior Martial Sister what had brought her here so late at night. Caught off guard, she stammered for a good while without managing an answer, leaving you to guess her intentions.
你微微一怔，頗感新奇，小師妹一向冷淡克己，從來不說這種俏皮話，莫非是受了雲裳那丫頭的不良影響嗎？\n聽你拿雲裳和自己相論，小師妹喜色難禁，她對自己沒有很自信，卻認定雲裳是世上最惹憐、最招人喜歡的姑娘，要不然怎能到處惹事還不受責打？\n說自己像她，那是往自己臉上添金。=You were mildly taken aback, finding it rather novel—the Junior Martial Sister was always so reserved and disciplined, never one for such playful remarks. Could Yunshang's mischief have rubbed off on her? Hearing you liken her to Yunshang, the Junior Martial Sister couldn't hide her delight. She had little confidence in herself, yet was certain Yunshang was the most endearing girl in the world—how else could she get away with so much trouble? To be told she resembled her felt like the highest compliment.
你膽子恁大，隨自家小師妹也敢調戲，心隨意動隨口一句「妳又何嘗不是？」羞得小師妹滿臉通紅。=You were bold indeed, daring to tease even your own Junior Martial Sister, and on impulse you said, What makes you any different? The words left her blushing scarlet.
其實比起雲裳，你更愛小師妹這般恬靜溫柔的女子，只是念及她待嫁之身，不敢軒之於口，只得將這份情意深藏在心。=In truth, you favor girls like Junior Martial Sister – gentle and serene – more than Yunshang. However, mindful of her betrothal, you dare not speak it aloud, and must bury this affection deep within your heart.
有一剎那你甚至懷疑她是別人喬裝打扮的，畢竟最近江湖事多，冒充、臥底的伎倆時而有之，你不由得緊張。\n好在眼前這尊確實是小師妹本人，獨一無二，如假包換。=For a moment you even suspected she was someone else in disguise—after all, with so much turmoil in the Jianghu of late, tricks of impersonation and infiltration were not unheard of, and you couldn't help but tense up. Fortunately, the one before you truly was the Junior Martial Sister herself, one of a kind, no mistaking it.
你猜她餓了，似乎沒猜著，但一提到烤魚，她登時就笑顏逐開，這姑娘雖然不貪吃，卻對送到嘴邊的食物來者不拒，從不挑食，好養得很。=You guessed she was hungry—wrongly, it seemed—but the moment grilled fish came up, her face lit with a smile. This girl was never one for gluttony, but she never turned down food put before her, never picky, easy to please.
這麼晚了，摸黑去溪邊捉魚未免異想天開，好在明日要招待客人，魚早捉好放在伙房大水缸裡了。\n偷偷給她烤一條，諒必沒人察覺。=It was so late that going to the stream to catch fish in the dark was out of the question. Fortunately, with guests to entertain tomorrow, the fish had already been caught and were sitting in the big water vat in the kitchen. You'd grill one for her in secret; surely no one would notice.
這麼晚了，摸黑去溪邊捉魚未免異想天開，好在明日要招待客人，魚早捉好放在伙房大水缸裡了。\n你身為大廚，早就習慣公器私用，經常以發明菜色為由，任意擺佈食材，這次也偷偷藏了一尾魚來醃漬，用油布包裹隔絕水氣，吊在井底冷藏。\n本來想自己留著享用，想不到先祭了小師妹的五臟廟。=It was so late that going to the creek to catch fish in the dark was out of the question. Fortunately, the fish for tomorrow's guests had already been caught and were sitting in the big water vat in the kitchen. As head chef, you were long used to putting public stores to private use, often taking the excuse of inventing new dishes to do as you liked with the ingredients. This time too you'd secretly set aside a fish to marinate, wrapped in oilcloth to keep out the damp and hung at the bottom of the well to keep cool. You'd meant to save it for yourself, but it ended up feeding the Junior Martial Sister's hungry stomach instead.
魚烤好了，小師妹呵去熱氣，小口小口淺嚐，本來不餓，但烤魚實在太香，越吃越開胃，臉上洋溢笑容。=The fish was cooked. Junior Martial Sister blew away the steam and took small bites. Though she wasn't hungry at first, the grilled fish was so delicious that the more she ate, the more her appetite grew, with a smile spreading across her face.
今日的烤魚，可不是尋常貨色，是你秘製的新菜，用醬油、白酒、橙汁橙皮加梅肉冷藏醃漬入味，再以火烤，香氣非比尋常，既有魚肉鮮美，又有甜蜜果香，不嚐則已，淺嚐一口，就徹底淪陷，都想手舞足蹈起來，本來不餓的，越吃越饞，吃完了烤魚，舔舔手指，意猶未盡。\n你見她悵然若失，只笑了笑，又變戲法一般拿出一尾烤魚，小師妹喜出望外，心想事成，彷彿這夜都因此明亮。\n她固然好養不挑食，但嚐到美食，也會心花怒放。=Today's grilled fish was no ordinary dish—it was your secret new recipe, marinated in soy sauce, white wine, orange juice, orange peel and plum flesh until the flavor set in, then grilled to perfection. Its aroma was extraordinary, blending the freshness of fish with a sweet fruitiness. One bite and there was no resisting it; even without hunger, she was hooked, craving more with every mouthful. Once the fish was gone, she licked her fingers, still wanting for more. Seeing her wistful look, you only smiled, and as if by magic produced another grilled fish. The Junior Martial Sister's eyes lit with joy, as though her wish had come true, and the night itself seemed to brighten. She was never picky, but faced with good food, her heart still danced with delight.
你趁她進食，自去收拾殘局，熄了火，再把灶台擦抹一遍。\n小師妹盯著你做事，從小就見慣了的背影，如今卻顯得既熟悉又陌生，想到她嫁作人婦，從此不能再這樣若無其事任你寵著，驀地悲從中來，烤魚也不香了，甚至苦得難以下嚥。\n她默默走到你身後，把小手按在你背上，也不是尋常的拍拍，就只是輕輕的碰著，以此確認你真實存在。=While she ate, you cleared away on your own, putting out the fire and wiping down the stove once more. The Junior Martial Sister watched you work—a back she'd known since childhood, yet one that now felt both familiar and strange. The thought that she would soon be married, and could never again take your doting on her for granted, brought a sudden ache of sorrow; even the grilled fish lost its savor, turning bitter and hard to swallow. She walked up behind you without a word and laid her small hand on your back—not the usual pat, just a light touch, as if to confirm you were truly there.
家逢巨變以來，小師妹已懂事很多，認識了悲歡離合之苦，不願接受，否認、憤怒、抵抗、沮喪，最終明白了這就是人世無常。\n她將遠嫁他鄉去，今夜前來見你，所念無它，只是想和家人再相處一會兒，向你道謝而已。=Since the family's great upheaval, the Junior Martial Sister had grown up a great deal, learning the bitterness of joy and sorrow, parting and reunion. She had refused to accept it, denied it, raged, resisted, despaired—and in the end came to understand that this was simply the impermanence of the world. She was soon to be married far from home, and had come to see you tonight for no other reason than to spend a little more time with family, and to thank you.
你猜她是睡不著，出門散步，又不甘寂寞，才來騷擾自己。\n小師妹明日要選夫郎，今晚沒睡好，明日昏昏沉沉怎辦？\n你有點兒手足無措，提議說個睡前故事哄她還被拒絕，反央求你唱歌，唱得還得指定是你當年為了哄她不哭，自編自唱的山歌。\n這首山歌曾經害你挨過同門圍毆，年紀漸長以後想起歌詞，也覺得十分羞恥，恨不得撞壁而亡。\n完全料想不到小師妹會提出這種要求，想是她自知離別將近，想要撒嬌一下。\n你拗不過她，只得硬著頭皮，扯嗓清唱，渾然忘了隔著一面牆，弟子房中眾師弟都還在睡，聽到你的歌聲，師弟們都是一臉不敢置信的起來，又驚又怒，對你破口大罵。=You guessed she couldn't sleep, had gone out for a walk, and unwilling to be alone, had come to pester you. The Junior Martial Sister was to choose a husband the next day, and hadn't slept well that night—what if she was groggy and sluggish come morning? At a loss, you offered to tell her a bedtime story to settle her, but she refused. Instead she begged you to sing, and insisted it be the very song you had once made up yourself to stop her crying, a mountain song of your own composing. That song had once earned you a beating from your fellow disciples, and even now, older, recalling the lyrics filled you with such shame you wished you could dash your head against a wall. You never expected the Junior Martial Sister to ask for such a thing—no doubt she sensed the parting drawing near and wanted, just once, to be spoiled. Unable to refuse her, you gritted your teeth and sang, quite forgetting that just beyond the wall, the junior brothers in the dormitory were still asleep. Roused by your voice, they all sat bolt upright in disbelief, shocked and furious, and cursed you soundly.
你惱羞成怒，當即反唇相譏，激起眾怒。=You were incensed by humiliation and snapped back with a sharp retort, inciting widespread outrage.
你還真有點兒怕了，萬一他們群起圍攻，你就慘了。=You really began to feel afraid—if they ganged up on you, you'd be in real trouble.
你當即就想捋起袖子，進屋教訓這群不成材的師弟，師兄唱首歌不行嗎？師兄錯嗎？當年大師兄還會在外邊招惹是非，拖人出去打架啊！唱首歌擾你清夢難道就要了你們命嗎？\n小師妹連忙牽住你衣角，不消說話，只一個可憐楚楚的眼神，就打消了你施暴的念頭。=You immediately wanted to roll up your sleeves and storm inside to give these no-good junior brothers a piece of your mind—can't a senior brother sing a song? Is a senior brother in the wrong? Back in the day, the Eldest Senior Brother used to stir up trouble outside and drag people out to fight! Does one song disturbing your sleep really cost you your life? The Junior Martial Sister quickly caught hold of your sleeve; without a word, one pitiful, pleading look was enough to dispel your urge for violence.
問她好不好聽，小師妹絲毫不假辭色，直言難聽，你早料到了，羞恥得想要融進夜色裡永遠消失。\n小師妹忍俊不禁，難得笑出聲來。她從前愛哭，失恃以後，更是終日以淚洗面，能被你這首歌哄睡，不是因為好聽順耳，只是因為好笑而已，你因為這首歌犯眾怒被打的時候更加好笑。\n她輕喚你一聲，你還道她如此兇殘，竟想逼你再唱一回，卻想錯了。\n家逢巨變以來，小師妹已懂事很多，認識了悲歡離合之苦，不願接受，否認、憤怒、抵抗、沮喪，最終明白了這就是人世無常。\n她將遠嫁他鄉去，今夜前來見你，所念無它，只是想和家人再相處一會兒，向你道謝而已。=Asked if it sounded good, the Junior Martial Sister didn't spare your feelings, bluntly saying it was awful. You'd expected as much, mortified enough to wish you could melt into the night and vanish forever.\nShe couldn't help herself and laughed aloud, a rare thing. She used to cry easily, and after losing her mother she wept from dawn to dusk; if this song could lull her to sleep, it wasn't because it sounded pleasant, but because it was ridiculous—you were even more ridiculous getting beaten by everyone over it.\nShe called your name softly, and you braced yourself, thinking she meant to be cruel and make you sing it again. You were wrong.\nSince the family's ruin, the Junior Martial Sister has grown up a great deal, come to know the bitterness of parting and reunion. She refused to accept it—denial, anger, resistance, despair—before at last understanding that this is simply the world's impermanence.\nShe is to be married far from home. Tonight she came to see you for no other reason than to spend a little more time with family, and to thank you.
膽子恁肥，竟對即將出嫁的本門小師妹出言輕薄，都不檢討一下自己尊容，大言不慚猜她是嫁了以後見不到你，感到寂寞了才來的。=How bold of you to make light remarks about the soon‑to‑be married junior martial sister of our sect, not even bothering to examine your own appearance, shamelessly claiming she came because she feels lonely after marrying and can't see you anymore.
你本來也只是說笑，想她八成是忐忑難安，好奇前來求親的都有哪些人才，求你帶她下山來的。\n正想去拿盞燈籠，卻被小師妹叫住，實則她對山下那些求親的人，半點好奇心也無，反而感到畏懼。\n你那玩笑話竟說中了她的心事，她確實是怕再也見不到你才來的。=You were only joking at first, thinking she was probably anxious, curious what sort of talents had come to seek her hand, and asking you to take her down the mountain to see. Just as you went to fetch a lantern, the Junior Martial Sister stopped you—in truth she had not the slightest curiosity about the suitors below, only fear. Your joke had hit home; she truly had come because she was afraid of never seeing you again.
你本來也只是說笑，心中沒有半分奢想，卻不想你一句玩笑話，竟說中了她的心事，她確實是怕再也見不到你才來的。=You had only been joking, with no real hope in your heart, yet your single joke somehow hit the mark, revealing her true feelings‑she had indeed come out of fear of never seeing you again.
說著鈴聲響動，眼淚也撲簌簌地落了下來。\n小師妹從小嬌弱靦腆，不善表露情緒，自從《天地無聲勢》大成以後，想博她一笑更是艱難，更別提似今日這般肆無忌憚的落淚。\n她不是失眠，只是害怕闔上了眼，又是一天要過去，她能留在唐門的時光，便減一分。\n你心弦劇顫，五味雜陳，要想寬慰，卻不知該措何詞。\n最終，你來到她身後，學她那樣拍拍，想必她最清楚這個動作的含意是：「我希望妳好好的」，是純粹而無垢，沒有言語矯飾，一塵不染的善意。=Even as she spoke, the bell rang, and her tears began falling in a rush. The Junior Martial Sister had always been delicate and shy, never good at showing her feelings; since perfecting Heaven and Earth Silent Force, it had grown even harder to win a smile from her, let alone see her weep so openly as tonight. It wasn't insomnia—she was only afraid that once she closed her eyes, another day would pass, and her time left in the Tang Clan would shrink by that much. Your heart clenched, a tangle of feelings, but you couldn't find the words to comfort her. In the end you came up behind her and patted her back the way she used to pat others, certain that she, of all people, would understand what the gesture meant: I hope you are well—a kindness pure and unadorned, without a word of flattery, untouched by anything false.
你催著她離開，但也和她約定，如果她感到寂寞的話，就呼喚你的名字。\n無論天涯海角，你也會去接她回家，用盡全力。=You urged her to go, but not before making her a promise: if ever she felt lonely, she need only call your name. No matter how far the ends of the earth, you would come for her with everything you had, and bring her home.
你只退讓一次，算是報答師門恩情。\n下一次，那怕與世為敵也義無反顧，傷天害理都要搶她到手。=You yielded this once, call it repayment for your master's grace. Next time, though the whole world stood against you, you would not turn back—though it meant flouting heaven's own law, you would seize her for your own.
小師妹得了你的允諾，漸漸收住抽噎，抹去睫毛上的晶瑩淚珠，回過頭來的時候，已是平時淡漠神色。=The Junior Martial Sister received your promise, gradually stopping her sobs, wiping away the shimmering tear drops from her lashes, and when she turned around, it was her usual indifferent expression.
小師妹哭了一會兒，你也不催趕，由著她盡情宣洩，漸漸收住抽咽，抹去睫毛上的晶瑩淚珠，回過頭來的時候，已是平時淡漠神色。=Junior Martial Sister cried for a while, and you didn't rush her, letting her express herself freely. Gradually, she stopped sobbing, wiped away the shimmering tears from her lashes, and when she turned back, her usual indifferent expression had returned.
\n比武招親在武林中雖不罕見，但是唐門位居三大世家，雖不若盛時神氣，仍非小門小戶可比，聽聞唐門千金有意招親，江湖上未娶親的年輕俠士，紛紛雲集蜀中，一時之間，唐家大院給擠個水洩不通。\n練武場上搭了棚架，供求親者和媒人們遮陽，人人臉上侷促不安，商量對策的有之，聽聞要文試而臨時抱佛腳的有之，勢在必得、老神在在的亦有之。\n按冊叫名，便進正心堂自薦，由三師兄出題考其文采、談吐與見識。=Contests of arms for a bride's hand are no rarity in the Wulin, but the Tang Clan ranks among the three great families—though not as glorious as in its prime, still far beyond what any minor sect could match. Word spread that the Young Lady of the Tang Clan sought a husband, and unmarried young heroes of the Jianghu flocked to Shu from every corner, until the Tang family compound was packed to bursting. A canopy had been raised over the training grounds to shade the suitors and their matchmakers. Every face wore some shade of unease: some huddled over strategies, some crammed at the last minute on hearing there would be a literary test, and a few sat calm and certain of victory. Called forward by roll, each entered Zhengxin Hall to present himself, where the Third Senior Brother posed questions to test his literary grace, eloquence, and insight.
你和師兄弟們站在廳旁，也品頭論足一番。\n一個上午過去，見了許多奇人異士，招親既不限於武林人士，慕名而來爭睹小師妹芳容的才子、富紳公子亦在所多有，不乏有才貌雙全令人驚豔之輩，但也有令人啞然失笑的奇葩。\n舉凡談吐傲慢者、舉止粗魯者、輕浮戲謔者、浮誇矯揉者、炫富者，不問貴賤，一律請出堂去。\n今日來求親的少俠、公子之中，當屬南宮世家大公子南宮深，最被看好，無論家世、財富、名聲、武功、才學皆屬上乘，便是與他齊來的媒人，也是江湖名宿，與三師兄算得上故交，端的是無可挑剔的人選。\n惟南宮深與上官千金曾有婚姻之約，頗受爭議而已。=You stood with your fellow disciples by the hall, passing your own judgment on the candidates. The morning wore on, and you saw all manner of remarkable and eccentric characters—the search for a husband wasn't limited to martial artists, and no few talented scholars and wealthy young lords came drawn by reputation, hoping for a glimpse of the Junior Martial Sister's beauty. Some were dazzling in both talent and looks; others were laughable oddities. Anyone arrogant in speech, rude in manner, frivolous, given to empty posturing, or flaunting his wealth was shown out of the hall at once, regardless of rank. Among today's young heroes and lords, Nangong Shen, Eldest Young Lord of the Nangong family, was thought the most promising by far—unmatched in lineage, wealth, renown, martial skill, and learning. Even the matchmaker who came with him was a renowned elder of the Jianghu and an old friend of the Third Senior Brother; by every measure he seemed the perfect choice. Only one thing courted controversy: Nangong Shen was already promised in marriage to the Young Lady of the Shangguan family.
小師妹與大公子會一回見面，是在南宮壽宴。\n大公子一番美言誇獎小師妹，表露心跡，自言片面之緣，就令他念念不忘。\n小師妹那時光顧著品味佳餚，對大公子印象十分稀薄，反倒是他那位未婚妻子上官螢明豔絕倫，令她身為女子也暗生欽慕之心，一時都忘了吃飯。=The Junior Martial Sister met the Eldest Young Lord for the first time at Nangong's Birthday Banquet. The Eldest Young Lord praised her at length, laying his feelings bare, saying that even a single fleeting encounter had left him unable to forget her. At the time the Junior Martial Sister was too absorbed in the delicacies to take much notice of him. Instead she was captivated by his fiancée, Shangguan Ying, whose radiant beauty stirred a quiet admiration in her even as a woman, and she entirely forgot to eat.
南宮世家既是武林世家，也是書香門第，大公子作為次任家主接班人，自小浸淫，武功學術皆不在話下，江陵一役，還曾領袖群俠共抗畜生道侵攻，功績更不待言。\n三師兄再出經史子集相試，也無甚意義，倒顯得出題的人膚淺。=The Nangong family is not only a great house of the Wulin but also a lineage steeped in scholarship. As heir apparent to the position of Family Head, the Eldest Young Lord had been immersed in both martial arts and learning since childhood, excelling at each without effort. In the battle of Jiangling, he even led a company of heroes against the invading Beast Path, and his feats there spoke for themselves. For the Third Senior Brother to test him again on the classics and histories would mean little; it would only expose the shallowness of the examiner.
三師兄心念一轉，遂出了一道難題。\n題為『農夫耕耘種稻以養天下，樵夫伐木造紙以利學問，夫武人學成而不以之事國，何用於民生？儒能以文亂法，俠則以武犯禁，如何見容於云衢？』\n這道題一出，當堂一片寂靜。\n讀書不多的，題目都沒聽明白，聽懂了的，也是倒抽一口涼氣。\n還道這位儒俠唐三爺對大公子和顏悅色，必定有意放水，沒想到卻出了這一道難題。\n這題問的是：農夫種稻能養活百姓，樵夫伐木可以生火煮飯，造紙以利學問傳播，而我輩江湖中人苦苦修得一身武藝，卻不報效國家，只為自己爭名逐利，於蒼生有何益？莫說行俠，國有國法，家有家規，儒生以仁愛、人情為號召，尚且會妨礙朝廷以法治國，遑論俠客一身武功，能夠挑戰當局禁制，朝廷又憑何對江湖縱容至今？\n答案很簡單，但是誰都不願宣之餘口而已，一個說得不好，就得得罪天下武林人。\n南宮深略一思忖，已有計較，引禮記大學論述，侃侃而談，言道無論文武，必先格物致知，明大義，知榮辱，意誠心正，以心從文、習武，皆為脩身，成宗成派，則是齊家，唯有家齊，方能再論治國。\n苟利於國者，匹夫有責。將士攘外，俠客安內。所以我論江湖中人，無一不是為國為民。\n這一席話，把所有武林人都捧成了為國為民的英雄，往人臉上添金，博得滿堂喝采，掌聲雷動。=Third Senior Brother shifted his thoughts and presented a challenging question.\nThe question read: 『A farmer cultivates rice to nourish the world, a woodcutter fells trees to make paper, benefiting scholarship. But what use is a martial artist who attains mastery yet does not serve the nation? How can Confucian scholars disrupt laws with rhetoric, and Heroes defy restrictions? How can they be accepted under the heavens?』\nThe moment the question was posed, the hall fell silent.\nThose with little education didn't understand the question at all, while those who did gasped in surprise.\nThey had thought that the Confucian-chivalrous Third Master Tang would favor the Eldest Young Lord and surely let him off easy, but they hadn't expected him to present such a difficult question.\nThe question inquired: A farmer's rice feeds the Commoners, a woodcutter's felled trees provide fire and cooking, and paper benefits the dissemination of scholarship. But what benefit does it bring to the people when we of Jianghu toil to perfect our skills yet do not serve the nation, seeking only personal fame and profit? Don't even speak of chivalry; the state has it's laws, each family has it's rules. Confucian scholars, who advocate benevolence and sentiment, still obstruct the court's governance by law. How much more so a Hero, with their martial arts, defying official restrictions? On what basis has the court tolerated Jianghu for so long?\nThe answer is simple, but no one is willing to utter it aloud. One wrong word, and they would offend the entire Wulin.\nNanyang Shen pondered for a moment and devised a plan, citing the Great Learning from the Analects, speaking eloquently and saying that regardless of martial arts or academics, one must first investigate things to gain knowledge, understand great principles, know honor and disgrace, have sincere and righteous intentions, follow literature with the heart, and practice martial arts to cultivate the self, establishing clans and lineages—this is governing the family. Only when the family is governed can we then discuss governing the nation.\nThose who benefit the nation are responsible even for common folk. Soldiers defend the borders, Heroes maintain order within. Therefore, I argue that those in Jianghu all serve the nation and the people.\nThis speech elevated all in Wulin to the status of national heroes, adding gold to their faces, earning a full house of applause and resounding applause.
你在旁聽著，暗暗冷笑。\n你這人雖然心術不正，但是肚中卻有墨水，不會輕易被人擺弄。\n江湖人爭名奪利，何嘗不想做官飛黃騰達，只是做不了而已。又沒領朝廷俸祿，沒吃官家一粒米糧，還要為別人的江山送死？=You listened from the side, sneering to yourself. Crooked as your own heart was, you had enough learning in you not to be so easily played for a fool. Folk of the Jianghu fought for fame and fortune—who among them wouldn't rather be an official and rise in the world, if only they could? They drew no salary from the court, ate not a single grain of the emperor's rice, and yet were expected to die defending someone else's throne?
你從旁聽著，頗不以為然。\n想他胸懷磊落，或許真作如是想也說不定。\n然而事實又是如何呢？江湖之中，只考慮自己的人，十有八九啊。\n論策應以事實為本，而非夸夸其談，否則難免有矯飾之嫌。這番話能令江湖人抬頭挺胸，走路有風，卻對現況一點幫助也沒有，自私的人依然自私，朝廷依然忌憚江湖草莽，若不能容於天子，則那梁山好漢的下場，就是未遠殷鑑。=You listened from the sidelines, feeling quite skeptical. Perhaps he genuinely believed as much, given how forthright he seemed. However, what is the reality? In the Jianghu, those who only consider themselves make up the vast majority. Discussions should be based on facts rather than empty rhetoric; otherwise, they risk appearing disingenuous. Such words may inspire those in the Jianghu to hold their heads high and walk with confidence, but they provide no real help in the current situation. Selfish individuals remain selfish, and the Imperial Court continues to fear the unruly elements of the Jianghu. If they cannot find acceptance from the Son of Heaven, then the fate of the heroes of Liangshan is a cautionary tale not far off.
你在旁聽著，似也覺得與有榮焉，飄飄然想要上天。=You listened from the sidelines, feeling as if some of that glory rubbed off on you too, so pleased with yourself you could have floated up to heaven.
旋即又醒覺過來，你是什麼樣的貨色，自己清楚，連你都能誇，只能說這位大公子當真是口若懸河，好生了得。=But you quickly came back to your senses—you knew exactly what sort of person you were. If even you could feel flattered, then this Young Lord truly had a golden tongue, remarkably impressive.
三師兄聽了這席高論，不置可否，卻不深究，照樣請他入內用茶，等到飯後再武試。\n南宮深察言觀色，已知自己這話避重就輕，瞞不過儒俠法眼，卻也不以為意，今日他這番說法，已經收買了無數人心，於世家所益頗深。=Third Senior Brother heard out this lofty discourse without agreeing or disputing it, and pressed no further, inviting him in for tea as planned, with the martial test to follow after the meal. Nangong Shen, reading the room, already knew his answer had dodged the heart of the question and could not have fooled the discerning eye of a Confucian hero like him—but he didn't mind. His words today had already won over countless hearts, and that served the family well.
上官螢在唐門期間，極端溺愛小師妹，就是親姊妹，也很少有這麼寵的。\n小師妹感念於心，實在無法忍受螢姊姊為這薄情郎傷心落淚，當堂便問他為何不要上官螢，卻想娶她？\n江陵大戰以來，南宮悔婚一事眾說紛紜，但誰也不敢去打聽別人家事。\n此話一出，廳中眾人登時熱議起來。=Shangguan Ying was extremely indulgent towards her junior martial sister during her time in the Tang Clan, even more so than with close relatives. The junior martial sister, overwhelmed with gratitude, could not bear to see Sister Ying weep over this unfeeling man, and she confronted him on the spot, asking why he did not want Shangguan Ying but wished to marry her instead. Since the Jiangling battle, rumors about Nangong's broken engagement have spread, but no one dared to inquire about others' private matters. The moment she spoke these words, the crowd in the hall immediately erupted into heated discussion.
你心繫上官螢，何嘗不為此義憤填膺，聽了恨不得大叫一聲好。\n倒要看看大公子害得螢姑娘傷心落淚，還能如何詭辯，他要是說不出個所以然來，你就是把命捨了，也要討回公道。=You are deeply concerned for Shangguan Ying; how can you not feel indignant about this? 你上前勸解，試圖說之以理，問他倘若害得小師妹嫁不出去，難道還能負責？解無塵才不負責，但他還是要打架的。\n看他摩拳擦掌，恨不得把求親者全都趕回老家的模樣，三師兄的胃就隱隱作痛，不敢相信這渾人竟然是傳說中的峨嵋風神。=You stepped forward to reason with him, trying to appeal to his sense of logic, asking him if he could still take responsibility if he caused the Junior Martial Sister to be unable to marry. 之後，三師兄費了九牛二虎之力，才把人姑且勸住，勸他飯後小憩再行切磋。\n許多前來湊熱鬧、試想碰運氣的人見解無塵都來角逐，連飯也不吃，灰溜溜的下山去了。=Later, the Third Senior Brother exerted great effort, managing to temporarily persuade the person to hold back and advised him to rest briefly after dinner before proceeding with the sparring. Many people had come to join the gathering, hoping to try their luck. When they saw that Xie Wuchen was competing, they didn't even eat dinner and hurriedly left the mountain.
中午你在弟子房和同門擠在一塊，榻上地下隨意坐著。\n與外邊賓客相較，吃得也很隨意，人手一顆飯糰而已，饒是如此，這飯糰卻似別有一番滋味，大家都吃得津津有味。\n也許這樣聚在一起的時光不多了，所有人都心照不宣罷了。=At noon, you were all crammed together in the disciples' quarters, sitting casually on beds or the floor. Compared to the outside guests, the meal was very simple, with each person getting one rice ball. 你下山去外堡，訪問南宮深，一去就見到南宮家丁送來飯菜，那擔任媒人的南宮老俠一臉難堪，又不能明說防人之心不可無，他著實是忌憚唐門。=You went down the mountain to the Outer Fort to call on Nangong Shen. 你一笑置之，順他話頭給了下台階，轉身又向各路英雄致歉，請他們吃不習慣的也多海涵，眾人鬆了一口氣之餘，也覺自己小人之心度君子之腹，不由得紛紛臉紅，見你應對如此得體，更有好感。=You laughed it off, using his own words to smooth things over, then turned and apologized to the assembled heroes, asking them to forgive unfamiliar fare. 你有話要說，先禮後兵，敬大公子一杯，大公子以袖掩嘴，脖頸一仰，乍看豪爽，實則將酒都收進袖中。\n你看破卻不說破，飲盡杯中酒水。=You had something to say, but courtesy before confrontation -- you offer the Eldest Young Lord a cup. 你有話要說，先禮後兵，敬大公子一杯，大公子脖頸一仰，倒扣酒杯，以示磊落。你暗道一聲好氣魄，也跟著飲盡杯中酒水。=You had something to say, but courtesy before confrontation -- you offer the Eldest Young Lord a cup. 大公子對唐門的看法姑且不論，對你的輕蔑態度卻絲毫不加掩飾。=Setting aside the Eldest Young Lord's views on the Tang Clan, he made no effort at all to hide his contempt for you.
你也不甘示弱，當場反唇相譏。=You weren't about to back down, and right then countered with a sharp retort.

After the Jiangling battle, he had investigated far and wide, hoping to catch the Tang Clan's tell-tale sign of guilt. Heaven did not forsake those who toiled, and before long he truly did find evidence of the Tang Clan's wrongdoing -- the trouble was, the evidence was so overwhelming that none of it held up to scrutiny, and it was plain that the real culprit behind it all meant to frame them. Though he no longer suspected the Tang Clan for the time being, he still could not bring himself to trust them fully; yet even so, he had to think of the Wulin's fate, and could not let private feeling harm the public good or ignore the righteousness of the realm. 大公子獻寶也並非純粹為了交情，如今江湖紛亂不休，誰也不服誰，爭名逐利，旦夕有人家破人亡。\n正需有個德高望重者登高號令，呼籲武林同道齊心協力，共抗浩劫。\n而此人選，除去地位超然的全真丘真人，便屬三大家主地位最尊，南宮世家雖是不二人選，但老太爺去世之後，家主一蹶不振，南宮深自知閱歷尚淺，可謂孤掌難鳴。\n而上官世家退隱江湖，更有毀婚之恨，決計不能相與謀。\n因此唯有保全唐門，請唐中翎出山，與南宮世家攜手並進，方有威望整肅中原，團結共抗魔教威脅。\n贈藥雖非挾恩圖報，但來求親，卻是希望兩家結成同一陣線。\n你心中盤算，無論於公於私，小師妹嫁進南宮世家，都是善策。\n於公，兩家為世交，結成同盟以後，關係更加牢不可破，以後攜手並進退，唐門有難，南宮世家自然不會袖手旁觀，憑此關係，便能保障唐門在江湖動盪之際不被沖垮；\n於私，南宮世家交遊廣闊，家財萬貫，知交上有官府權貴，下有江湖豪傑，到哪兒都能吃得開。那泥教畜牲道攻擊南宮世家，便引得中原齊聚江陵來解圍，足見人脈。\n倘若小師妹嫁去江陵，想必一生無憂，錦衣玉食供養，丫環僕人伺候，旁人再想打她歪心思，可就難了。=The Eldest Young Lord's gift of the treasure was not purely for the sake of friendship. What was needed was a figure of great standing to rise up and call out, rallying the Wulin's fellows to stand together against the coming calamity. 然而你心中就是難以釋懷。\n非是你有意刁難，但南宮深當眾悔婚，置上官螢於無地自處的窘境之中，乃是事實。你怎能相信他不會辜負小師妹呢？\n南宮深深深嘆了一口氣，也不相瞞，倒不如說他這番話想要傾訴於人，已經很久很久了。\n與上官螢訂親，那是他說了算的事嗎？不過就是某一天被爹喊去拜見上官世伯，被告知「這是你未婚妻子」而已。\n本來上官螢天生麗質，他一見了就喜歡，兩小無猜，倒是投緣。上官螢脾氣倔了點，也無傷大雅，讓她一下，等她氣順了，就會加倍溫柔報答。\n二人還結伴去耕陽讀書齋求學，與崆峒玄功魏掌門為同窗好友。\n隨著年紀漸長，上官螢出落得越發貌美，明豔不可方物，大公子身為未婚夫，既驕傲又自卑，只因上官螢小小年紀便代父操持家業，走南闖北，把家族事業整頓得井井有條。\n反觀大公子一日不當家主，就一日只是大公子，在江陵投資了幾間鋪子、酒樓，還未必都賺錢，還要未婚妻時時來幫襯、提點。\n才幹如此懸殊，如何不令他慚愧？\n他勸上官螢不要在外拋頭露面，既是不願她的美貌被世人惦記，也怕她太過有能，讓自己望塵莫及，婚後難以管束，說穿了全是私心作祟。\n何況上官螢商場歷練之後，益發頑固、剛愎，對上端莊得體，對下則傲慢無禮。斤斤計較，善妒潑辣，又愛搬正論、擺架子說教。\n平輩之中，也只有崆峒魏掌門說的話，勉強能入她耳。\n南宮深去結交樂伎，本意是為了讓上官螢心存忌憚，收斂一點氣焰，此法果真奏效，惹哭了上官螢，既覺痛快又感安心。\n冷戰期間，南宮深、南宮淺二兄弟遭遇蒙面人襲擊，被打得落花流水。\n上官螢聞訊也顧不得賭氣，慌慌張張前來探傷，一見到未婚夫躺在踏上，鼻青臉腫的慘樣，就悲從中來，氣急敗壞，明明想好了許多寬慰的體己話，脫口而出的卻盡是埋怨、教訓，在他朋友面前罵他結交狐朋狗友，在他授業長老面前罵他學藝不精。\n試問南宮深要如何能夠不心寒？=However, you found it hard to let this go.\nIt was not that you meant to make things difficult, but the fact remained: Nangong Shen had broken the engagement in public, leaving Shangguan Ying with nowhere to hide her shame.
