It could not match the Nangong family's lavish spending, but everyone did their part all the same.
正要進屋吃飯，忽然有個師弟打著燈籠慌慌張張跑上山來報訊。\n言道是崆峒金烏上帶人來鬧事，正在外堡大吵大鬧，揚言要挑戰唐門第一高手。\n任誰都知道這人不壞好意，早不來挽不來，偏偏挑在這節骨眼過來，分明是知道唐門要辦喜事，故意尋釁滋事來的。\n四師兄正在外堡招待賓客，見狀立時帶人攔住，可是對方顯然有備而來，勢不可擋，只能勉強攔住，派人上山搬救兵。=Just as I was about to enter the house for a meal, a junior martial brother hurried up the mountain, lantern in hand, to report a message.\nHe said that someone from Kongtong had brought people to cause trouble at the Outer Fortress, causing a commotion and declaring they would challenge the top martial artist of the Tang Clan.\nEveryone knew these people had no good intentions; they arrived late when they could have come earlier, and specifically chose this time, clearly knowing that the Tang Clan was celebrating and deliberately seeking to provoke a conflict.\nFourth Senior Brother was entertaining guests at the Outer Fortress. Seeing this, he immediately went to intercept them with his people, but the opposing side was clearly prepared and unstoppable. He could only barely hold them back and sent someone up the mountain to call for reinforcements.
你聞言怒不可遏，大師兄之死還沒曾找他算帳，竟然還敢欺上門來，可謂囂張至極。=Hearing this, you flew into an uncontrollable rage: you hadn't yet settled the score for Eldest Senior Brother's death, and now here he was, daring to bully his way right up to your door—arrogance beyond enduring.
你先是一怔，隨即大怒，就算兩派相張，也沒存心挑再人家辦喜事的日子前來鬧事的理。=You were initially taken aback, then immediately furious. Even if the two factions were at odds, one wouldn't intentionally choose to stir up trouble at another's wedding.
你先是一怔，壓根摸不著頭腦，想不清唐門幾時開罪過崆峒派了。=You were taken aback first, completely at a loss as to why the Tang Clan had ever offended the Kongtong Sect.
你雖忐忑，卻知避無可避，三師兄要坐鎮大院，不能指望他下山迎敵，以免驚動了與宴賓客，從而影響小師妹的清名。\n言念及此，你只得鼓足勇氣，為師門挺身而出。=Anxious as you were, you knew there was no avoiding it—Third Senior Brother had to hold the compound, and could not be expected to come down the mountain to face the enemy, lest it alarm the wedding guests and tarnish the Junior Martial Sister's good name. With that thought, you could only steel your courage and step forward for the sect.
\n小師妹對著三個夫婿人選，食不下嚥，飯席上茫然若失，大家只道她是害羞，不以為意，渾然不知她如坐針氈。\n藉口說要獨自想想，到窗台透氣，倚著欄杆，看樓下賓客歡聲笑語，依稀又是從前光景，正自惆悵，此時眼角瞥見你提著燈籠，大步邁出山門，小師妹沒來由一陣心悸恐慌，不假思索便飛身追上，幾個幾落，已搶到你前面。\n你吃了一驚，緊急煞住腳步，後邊跟來的師弟們措手不及，全都撞成一團，把你壓在底下，脫手鏢還紮在你身上。\n小師妹將你扶起，旁人見她找你有事，便紛紛離去。=The Junior Martial Sister found it impossible to eat, her face pale at the sight of the three prospective husbands. Everyone assumed she was merely shy and paid it no mind, unaware that she felt as though she were sitting on a bed of needles.\nShe excused herself, claiming a need for solitude, and went to the windowsill to catch some air. Leaning against the railing, she watched the laughter and merriment of the guests below, a familiar scene from her past. Lost in melancholy, she suddenly caught sight of you striding out of the mountain gate, a lantern in your hand. A wave of unease washed over her, and without a second thought, she chased after you. A few quick steps and she was already ahead.\nYou were startled and abruptly halted your pace, causing the Junior Brothers following you to stumble and collide in a heap, pinning you down and dislodging a dart that embedded itself in your arm.\nThe Junior Martial Sister helped you up. Seeing her seeking you out, the other guests gradually dispersed.
小師妹攔住你，盤問你去向，勸也勸不聽，空前絕後的任性。\n她拙於表達，言不及意，急得淚花滾滾打轉。\n一直都在山上，連回家的路也記不得。\n每次目送一些人出門，說不定就再也等不回來，先是她的娘親，然後是爹，接著是二師兄，最後連大師兄也不見了，再也見不到了。\n如今連你也要一聲不響就走嗎？\n既是她的大好日子，難道你不該陪著她嗎？要不然的話，起碼也應該帶著她。\n把心聲喊出口的同時，眼淚也撲簌簌落下，鈴聲輕響，天地無聲勢應聲破功。=Junior Martial Sister blocked your path, demanding to know where you were going, and no amount of persuading could change her mind. Her stubbornness was unprecedented. She was inept at expressing herself, her words falling short, her eyes brimming with tears. She had been on the mountain all along, and had even forgotten the way home. Every time she watched someone leave, she feared they might never return-first her mother, then her father, then Second Senior Brother, and finally even Eldest Senior Brother vanished without a trace, never to be seen again. Now, would you also leave without a word? It was her joyous day; shouldn't you stay by her side? If not that, then at least you should take her with you. As she cried out her feelings, tears cascaded down her cheeks, the bell chimed softly, and the Heaven and Earth Silent Power broke at the sound.
這時瑞笙忽然翩翩落在前頭，小師妹嚇了一跳，立刻縮在你背後尋求庇護。\n他見小師妹離席，良久不回，與兩名競爭者、三師兄面面相覷，話翻來覆去都在客套，不由得氣悶，便借尿遁出門散步，遠遠看到幽深林道上火光點點，想是有人打著燈籠下山，好奇心起，就信步飄落。他內功深厚，還未靠近，便聽見你們說話，又是詫異，又是慚愧，又是羨慕，又是欣慰，還隱隱覺得好笑，端的是百感交集。\n他刻意現身出來，自告奮勇要為唐門驅散敵人，不等你勸留便施展輕功下山而去。\n你和小師妹也只得跟上。=At this moment, Rui Sheng gracefully landed ahead, startling Junior Martial Sister, who immediately crouched behind you for protection. He had seen Junior Martial Sister leave her seat and fail to return for a long while, and had exchanged awkward glances with the two competitors and Third Senior Brother, their talk circling endlessly through empty pleasantries, until he could not help but feel stifled. Excusing himself under pretense of relieving himself, he slipped out to stroll, and from afar spotted flickering lights along the deep forest path-likely someone descending the mountain with a lantern. Curious, he drifted down to look. His Internal Skill was so deep that before he had even drawn near, he overheard your conversation, and felt astonishment, shame, envy, and relief all at once, with a faint urge to laugh-a hundred feelings tangled together. He made a point of showing himself, volunteering to drive off the enemy for the Tang Clan, and without waiting for you to talk him out of it, he used his Qinggong to leap down the mountain. You and Junior Martial Sister had no choice but to follow.
你明知不應該，還是牽起了小師妹的小手，帶她一起下山迎敵。\n小師妹又驚又喜，終於破涕為笑。\n如你這般行事不分輕重，簡直就是唐門罪人，可是在小師妹眼裡，你卻是普天之下最值得信賴的人，把手交你牽著，刀山火海都願與你同行。=You knew it was wrong, yet you still tugged Junior Martial Sister's hand and led her down the mountain to confront the enemy. Junior Martial Sister was both startled and overjoyed, finally wiping away her tears and smiling. Acting so recklessly, you were practically a traitor to the Tang Clan. But in Junior Martial Sister's eyes, you were the most trustworthy person in the world. She would willingly place her hand in yours, ready to face any danger alongside you.
即使如此，你依舊鐵石心腸，下定決心以來，就不曾動搖。=Even so, you remained iron-hearted; since making up your mind, you had never wavered.
你雖然笑著，說著好聽的話，可是心意已決。=Although you smiled and spoke sweet words, your mind was already made up.
不惜板起臉來，兇了她，這是頭一回，大概也是今生最後一次。=You did not hesitate to put on a stern face and be harsh with her-this was the first time, and probably the last in this life.
小師妹好不容易敞開的心扉又重重封閉起來，漸響鈴鐺趨於平靜，聽話獨自回家，再也不會向人撒嬌了。=Junior Martial Sister's heart, so hard-won open, closed tightly shut once more. The soft ringing of her bells gradually settled into stillness, and she went home alone, obedient, never again to act coquettish with anyone.
\n那邊廂，金烏上人帶人在外堡鬧事，以小梅與小竹曾暫住唐門為藉口，又假大師兄素行，汙衊他意欲圖謀不軌，迫害崆峒嫡傳女弟子。=Over there, Jinwu Shangren led people to cause trouble in the Outer Fort, using the fact that Xiaomei and Xiao Zhu had temporarily stayed at the Tang Clan as an excuse, and pretended to be Eldest Senior Brother's virtuous conduct, slandering him for plotting treason, and persecuting Kongtong's Direct Disciples.
那邊廂，金烏上人帶人在外堡鬧事，以小梅曾暫住唐門為藉口，又假大師兄素行，汙衊他意欲圖謀不軌，迫害崆峒嫡傳女弟子。\n崆峒四姝皆是四門嫡傳，遲早嫁予掌派人為妻，以此鞏固自家地位的重要籌碼。\n玷污了崆峒掌派人未婚妻子，等如侮辱崆峒派，是可忍，孰不可忍，怎能不讓崆峒諸子義憤填膺。=Meanwhile, Venerable Golden Crow led his people to cause trouble outside the Outer Fort, using the pretext that Xiaomei had once stayed at the Tang Clan, and twisting Eldest Senior Brother's past conduct to slander him as harboring dishonorable designs, persecuting Kongtong's own direct-line female disciples. The Kongtong Four Maidens are all direct disciples of the Four Gates, destined sooner or later to marry the Sect Leader, serving as crucial pawns to secure their own families' standing. To defile the Kongtong Sect Leader's betrothed is to insult the entire Kongtong Sect-an outrage no one could tolerate, and how could the disciples of Kongtong not be filled with righteous indignation?
那邊廂，金烏上人帶人在外堡鬧事，以小竹曾暫住唐門留學為藉口，又假大師兄素行，汙衊他意欲圖謀不軌，迫害崆峒嫡傳女弟子。\n崆峒四姝皆是四門嫡傳，遲早嫁予掌派人為妻，以此鞏固自家地位的重要籌碼。\n玷污了崆峒掌派人未婚妻子，等如侮辱崆峒派，是可忍，孰不可忍，怎能不讓崆峒諸子義憤填膺。=On the other side, Jinwu Shangren led people to cause trouble outside the fortress, using the excuse that Xiao Zhu Zeng had temporarily stayed at the Tang Clan for study, and fabricated the master's virtuous reputation to slander him as plotting treason, persecuting the direct descendant female disciples of Kongtong. The Kongtong Four Maidens are all direct descendants of the four sects, destined to marry the sect leader, serving as crucial political pawns to solidify their family's status. Disgracing the sect leader's unmarried wife is tantamount to insulting the Kongtong Sect; what can be tolerated, what cannot? How could the disciples of Kongtong not be filled with righteous indignation?
那邊廂，金烏上人帶人在外堡鬧事，以大師兄昔年曾慕芳名，三闖崆峒派，爭睹夏侯蘭花容為藉口，又假大師兄素行，汙衊他以邪術、淫藥相害。為了讓唐門聲名毀於一旦，連自家人也拖下水，指稱二人有行苟且，傷風敗俗，夏侯蘭更因耳濡目染，變得陰狠毒辣。\n如今夏侯蘭數月不知所蹤，想來也是像那飛石幫主夫人一樣失陷於你唐門淫賊。\n夏侯蘭可不是尋常女弟子，乃是崆峒奪魄門嫡傳女弟子，崆峒四姝皆是四門嫡傳，遲早嫁予掌派人為妻，以此鞏固自家地位的重要籌碼。\n玷污了崆峒掌派人未婚妻子，等如侮辱崆峒派，是可忍，孰不可忍，怎能不讓崆峒諸子義憤填膺。\n大師兄行走江湖，本來就放浪不羈，毀譽參半，無論敵我都對他又掛念又惱恨，自覺坦蕩，卻無意招惹萬千少女將芳心暗許，忌妒他的人多不勝數，造謠抹黑者亦不在少。\n如今金烏上人他言之鑿鑿，聲色俱厲，不由得眾人不信。=Meanwhile, Venerable Golden Crow led his people to cause trouble outside the Outer Fort, using as pretext Eldest Senior Brother's old infatuation with Xiahou Lan's renown-having broken into the Kongtong Sect three times to catch a glimpse of her beauty-and twisting his past conduct to slander him for harming her with sorcery and aphrodisiacs. To ruin the Tang Clan's reputation utterly, he even dragged in his own people, claiming the two had carried on an illicit affair that corrupted public morals; and Xiahou Lan, he claimed, had been so steeped in such influence that she had turned sinister and ruthless. Now Xiahou Lan had been missing for months, and he claimed she too had fallen prey to some lecherous scoundrel of your Tang Clan, just like the Flying Stone Gang Leader's wife. Xiahou Lan was no ordinary female disciple-she was a direct-line disciple of the Soul-Stealing Gate of Kongtong. The Kongtong Four Maidens are all direct disciples of the Four Gates, destined sooner or later to marry the Sect Leader, serving as crucial pawns to secure their own families' standing. To defile the Kongtong Sect Leader's betrothed is to insult the entire Kongtong Sect-an outrage no one could tolerate, and how could the disciples of Kongtong not be filled with righteous indignation? Eldest Senior Brother, wandering the Jianghu, had always been free-spirited and unrestrained, drawing both praise and blame; friend and foe alike felt for him a mix of longing and resentment. He himself felt he had nothing to hide, yet without meaning to he had won the secret hearts of countless young women, and those who envied him, and those who spread rumors to blacken his name, were beyond counting. Now, with Venerable Golden Crow speaking so convincingly and so fiercely, everyone could not help but believe him.
大師兄行走江湖，本來就放浪不羈，毀譽參半，無論敵我都對他又掛念又惱恨，自覺坦蕩，卻無意招惹萬千少女將芳心暗許，忌妒他的人多不勝數，造謠抹黑者亦不在少。\n如今金烏上人以此說事，半真半假，煞有其事，崆峒弟子全都深信不疑，義憤填膺，連在場賓客、鄉親都不由得將信將疑。=Eldest Senior Brother, wandering the Jianghu, had always been free-spirited and unrestrained, drawing both praise and blame. Whether friend or foe, people felt for him a mixture of longing and resentment. He himself felt he had nothing to hide, yet without meaning to he had won the secret hearts of countless young women, and those who envied him, and those who spread rumors to blacken his name, were beyond counting. Now Venerable Golden Crow used this as material, half true and half false yet made to sound utterly convincing. Every Kongtong disciple believed it without question and burned with righteous indignation, and even the guests and villagers present could not help but half believe it themselves.
有了方才那些話作鋪陳，金烏上人話鋒一轉，矛頭直指小師妹。\n身穿大紅僧衣，該是修佛行善之人，說出口的話語卻極盡惡毒，竟汙衊大師兄與小師妹未婚苟合，若非小師妹已有身孕，唐門何以急於嫁女，召天下俠士齊聚蜀中，不過是詭計，實則就是要找個冤大頭，替她腹中孩兒找個便宜老子罷了。\n這番話當然是惡意捏造，經不起推敲，假以時日不攻自破的謊話，不消四師兄辯駁。\n可是金烏上人旨不在說贏，而是旨在造謠。抓準了江湖人好事、看熱鬧不嫌事大的心態，怎麼羶腥怎麼說，待消息傳開，唐門名聲必將毀於一旦。\n且看他謊言先被戳破，還是唐門先成過街老鼠人人喊打，等到真相大白，也無力回天，屆時他登任崆峒掌派人，一個反掌，就將唐門滿門滅口了。=With those earlier words as prelude, Venerable Golden Crow turned his attack, aiming it squarely at Junior Martial Sister. Clad in a bright red monk's robe, one would expect him to be a man of piety and good works, yet the words from his mouth were utterly venomous. He slandered Eldest Senior Brother and Junior Martial Sister as having lain together before marriage-if Junior Martial Sister were not already with child, why else would the Tang Clan be so eager to marry off their daughter and summon heroes from across the realm to gather in Shu? It was, he claimed, nothing but a scheme to find some fool willing to serve as a cheap father for the child in her womb. Such words were of course malicious fabrication, unable to withstand scrutiny, lies that would collapse on their own in time-Fourth Senior Brother had no need even to refute them. But Venerable Golden Crow's aim was never to win the argument, only to spread rumor. He knew well the Jianghu's taste for gossip and spectacle, and said whatever was most scandalous, so that once word got out, the Tang Clan's reputation would be ruined beyond repair. Whether his lies were exposed first, or the Tang Clan became the target everyone cried out against, by the time the truth came to light it would be too late to undo the damage-and once he had ascended to become Kongtong's Sect Leader, a single turn of his hand would be enough to silence the entire Tang Clan for good.
你洽到此時趕來，聞得此話，怒不可遏，一拳打退金烏上人。=You arrived just in time, and hearing this, you were furious and punched the Venerable Golden Crow back.
亂潑髒水誰不會？既然他不仁，休怪你不義！\n旋即一陣連珠炮價的髒話脫口而出，那金烏上人心機、口才都是極好的，你想和他正面說理，到頭只會落得跟四師兄同樣境地，但你偏不，你嘴皮子狠起來那是六親不認，本來不帶髒字都能罵死人，但這金烏上人如此可憎，你就偏要火力全開，怎麼粗俗怎麼罵，句句都帶穢字，狠辣至極。\n連金烏上人一直皮笑肉不笑，竟給你罵到原形畢露，要不是有人攔著，立刻就上前跟你拼命了。\n你這一通爆罵分毫不講道理，粗俗至極，反顯得金烏上人方才污言穢語都相形見拙，似也沒那麼可信了。=Slinging mud back was something anyone could do-since he showed no mercy, why should you show him any? A torrent of curses tumbled out of you at once. Venerable Golden Crow was both cunning and sharp-tongued; if you tried to reason with him face to face, you would only end up in the same spot as Fourth Senior Brother. But you refused to do that. Once your tongue turned vicious, you spared no one, kin or stranger alike-ordinarily you could curse a man to death without a single foul word, but Venerable Golden Crow was so loathsome that you let loose with everything you had, as crude as could be, every sentence laced with obscenities, merciless to the extreme. Even Venerable Golden Crow, who had kept up his hollow smile all along, was cursed until his true face showed through, and had no one held him back, he would have flown at you at once to fight to the death. Your tirade made no concession to reason and was vulgar in the extreme, yet it left Venerable Golden Crow's own filthy words looking feeble by comparison, as if they were no longer so credible after all.
金烏上人所以遲遲不下手，還揚言要挑戰唐門高手，就是不想落得個以多欺少的惡名，你帶人下山，正中他下懷，往自家陣營裡一站，喚來四大護法。=The reason Venerable Golden Crow had held back from striking, and instead loudly proclaimed his challenge to the Tang Clan's finest, was simply that he did not want the reputation of bullying the few with many. Your coming down the mountain with your people played right into his hands-he merely stepped back into his own ranks and summoned the Four Guardians.
你曾留學崆峒，均知這四大護法絕非等閒，都是四門中的佼佼者，實力比金烏上人更強者也未必沒有，不由得暗暗心驚。=You had once studied at Kongtong, and knew well that these Four Guardians were no ordinary men-each was among the finest of the Four Gates, and it was not impossible that some among them were even stronger than Venerable Golden Crow. You could not help feeling a secret chill of apprehension.
你性情豪烈，起是喊個名號就能駭退的，反是四師兄冷靜，連忙勸住了你，從長計議。=You have such a fierce, fiery temper that no mere name shouted in warning would ever scare you off. It was Fourth Senior Brother who stayed calm and quickly talked you down, urging a more considered approach.
這四人都是江湖上知名的高手，光看架勢氣度就與別的崆峒弟子有天壤之別。\n你和四師兄見了都暗暗心驚，一個就不好對付了，何況四個，還加上金烏上人？反觀自己這邊，人數雖眾，卻沒幾個能相抗衡的高手，打起來勝負難料，可是無論輸贏，旁人都只會笑唐門以多欺少，這豈不是既輸了面子，又輸了裏子嗎。=These four were all renowned masters of the Jianghu; their very bearing and presence set them worlds apart from the other Kongtong disciples. No matter how he was killed, he would not die, and after he mended his ways and took the tonsure, he sheltered under Kongtong's roof, so that his old enemies never had the chance to settle their scores. In his whole life he had only ever been subdued once, by Kongtong's former Sect Leader — and today he finally met his death at the hands of the Tang Clan. Everyone said even the 'Nine-Lives Leopard' could not escape death in the end, and that you must be King Yama's Emissary; bearing the surname Zhao, some whispered you might even be kin to Zhao Kui, Dharma King of the Hell Path. The Tang Clan was swept up in your notoriety because of it — its name rang louder, but its good repute took a little more damage besides.
那一日你連過崆峒四大護法，直取金烏上人，在眾目睽睽之下逼他現出真身，落荒而逃之事，轟響於江湖。\n連與你為敵的崆峒中人，都不禁佩服你的武功、氣概。\n回到山中以後，談起你過關斬將的事，都以與你過招而自豪。=That day you fought past Kongtong's Four Guardians one after another, went straight for Venerable Golden Crow, and forced him to reveal his true form before everyone's eyes, sending him fleeing in disarray — word of it spread throughout the Jianghu. Even the Kongtong disciples who had opposed you could not help admiring your skill and spirit. 鞭炮鑼鼓聲震天價響，你都置若罔聞。\n刻意不想聽聞她的消息，不願知道她最終選擇了誰。\n更不敢去送她，埋頭躲在棉被裡。=The deafening sound of firecrackers and gongs echoed through the sky, yet you ignored it. You deliberately chose not to hear about her, unwilling to know who she had finally chosen. Even more, you dared not go to see her off, hiding your head under the quilt.
不知煎熬多久，聲音漸低，歸於寂靜。\n你推門出來，兀自下著雨，但見雨中煙硝瀰漫，遍地炮仗冷清。伊人已去，故園空餘殘香。\n再不捨得，也需捨得。\n願她在四季如春的溫暖地方，笑顏如花盛放。=No matter how long the torment lasted, the sound gradually faded into silence. You pushed the door open and went outside; the rain was still falling. Amid the rain hung the smoke of spent firecrackers, and the ground lay strewn with cold, quiet debris. She was already gone, the old garden left with only her fading fragrance. However unwilling you were to let go, you had to. May she find a place where it is always spring, and may her smile bloom like flowers in full bloom.
雨聲淅瀝瀝，天涼了些，山中空氣也變得冷清。\n你和三師兄、四師兄在講經堂中飲茶，詳細說了那日經過。\n三師兄沒怪你們自作主張，而是心懷感激，有你們二位師弟分憂，才能勉強撐得起唐門。\n如今小師妹嫁了，保住唐家血脈，總算了卻一樁心頭大事。=The rain pattered softly, the sky had cooled somewhat, and the mountain air had turned chill and quiet. You, Third Senior Brother, and Fourth Senior Brother sat in the Scripture Hall drinking tea while you told them everything that had happened that day. Third Senior Brother did not blame you two for acting on your own; instead he was grateful — with you two junior brothers sharing his burdens, he could barely hold the Tang Clan together. Now that the Junior Martial Sister had married and the Tang family's bloodline was secured, one great weight was finally off his mind.
三師兄想要備酒與你共飲，可是你卻婉拒了。\n你實在太累了，這裡已經沒有小師妹了，沒法再似從前一樣，前一天受了委屈，醒來就像沒事人。\n再受一點刺激，你說不定就會猝死。\n三師兄想勸，你卻只淡然一笑，感情事，能想得通就想通，想不通的話，再有道理你也聽不懂。\n你用許多年等這一天，這是早就已經決定好的事。\n今生唯一還能為她做的，就是安靜退場。\n此刻你只想好好睡一覺，睡到自然醒，或者再也不醒來。=Third Senior Brother wanted to prepare wine to drink with you, but you politely declined. You were simply too tired. There was no Junior Martial Sister here anymore, and you could no longer be as you once were — able to wake the morning after some grievance as if nothing had happened. One more shock and you might drop dead on the spot. Third Senior Brother wanted to reason with you, but you only smiled faintly — matters of the heart, if you can understand them, understand them; if you can't, no amount of reasoning will get through. You had waited many years for this day; it was something long since decided. The only thing left you could do for her in this life was to exit quietly. At this moment, all you wanted was to sleep well, to sleep until you woke naturally, or perhaps never wake again.
是夜，三師兄、四師兄備酒與你共飲。\n說到從前唐門盛時舊事，都感慨萬千，恍如隔世，不由得悲從中來，三人搭肩大哭一場。那些熱鬧彷彿還是昨天的事，曾幾何時月換星移，偌大唐門，就剩你們三個舊人了。=That night, Third Senior Brother and Fourth Senior Brother set out wine and drank with you. Speaking of the old days when the Tang Clan had flourished, all three of you were overcome with feeling, as though a lifetime had passed; sorrow welled up unbidden, and the three of you wept together, shoulder to shoulder. Those lively days seemed only yesterday, yet the moons had waxed and the stars had wheeled on, and of the once-mighty Tang Clan, only the three of you old hands remained.
你逃離了不久之後，烈陽錘真氣發作，倒地抽搐，高燒一場，醒來以後，什麼也記不清楚了，只剩下金烏上人那張充滿惡意的笑臉，永遠揮之不去。=Not long after you fled, the Blazing Sun Hammer's true qi flared up inside you; you collapsed, convulsing, and burned with fever. When you woke, you could remember nothing at all — only the malice in Venerable Golden Crow's smile remained, and it never left you.
那金烏上人詐敗偷襲，這一錘本來沒打算要你性命，而是使上暗勁。\n雖然偷襲為人所不齒，但旁人見他沒下殺手，多半一時便無話可說，自己再裝出一副道貌岸然的高僧姿態，點醒你臨陣對敵不能掉以輕心，避重就輕，模糊事實，把黑說成白的。\n屆時你必然怒不可遏，不妨鬥上一陣，等到暗勁發作竄上腦門，你便再也沒有與抗之力，他在猛攻一陣，將你收拾，又輕輕放過。\n那旁人還不讚他慈悲為懷、氣度恢弘嗎？\n然而事情並沒如他所想，偷襲不中，登時引得賓客群情洶湧，都罵他是惡僧，大好日子鬧事不說，技不如人，竟還詐敗偷襲，堂堂崆峒，位居六大正派之一，行事作風居然如此卑鄙，寧能服眾？\n連崆峒人馬見狀，都蹙眉髮指。\n金烏上人還未登上掌派人，只是借題發揮，取信四掌門，才能意氣風發帶人遠道蜀中滋事，在人家大喜之日尋仇，本已於理欠通，決鬥落敗，更是丟人。\n勝敗乃兵家常事，若僅是如此，尚不致犯眾怒，可是他詐敗佯輸，又趁人不備，意圖施以偷襲，此等行逕卻絕非正道能容。\n見金烏中人犯了眾怒，被罵得狗血淋頭，也無法辯駁，更無臉面久留，內鬨起來，由最不服氣的玄功護法帶頭謝過唐門告辭，其後鐵拳、奪魄護法也相繼而去，就剩飛天護法顏疆依然不甘，既羞且怒。\n他雖然心中不忿，仍想迴護自家師兄，一條船上的人，自然要戮力同心。\n天大罪過，也不容外人置喙，等回到崆峒飛天殿，關上大門再請飛天掌門按門規責罰。\n他講義氣，金烏上人卻不講，他詭計失敗，被人喊打喊殺，早已氣急敗壞，見顏疆還敢來囉嗦，盛怒之下，更不容情，一錘正中胸口，打倒了人，逃逸而去。=That Venerable Golden Crow feigned defeat and launched a surprise attack. This blow was never intended to take your life, but rather to impart Hidden Force.\nAlthough a surprise attack is looked down upon, most bystanders will be at a loss for words when they see that he didn't intend to kill you, and will then feign a demeanor of righteous austerity, reminding you to be vigilant in battle, to focus on the vital points and avoid the superficial, to distort the truth, and to portray black as white.\nAt that time, you will inevitably be furious. Feel free to engage in a brief contest. When Hidden Force takes effect and surges to your forehead, you will have no power to resist. He will launch a fierce assault, subdue you, and then let you go lightly.\nThose bystanders will then praise him for his compassion and magnanimity, won't they?\nHowever, things didn't go as he planned. The surprise attack failed, immediately provoking a wave of outrage from the guests. They denounced him as an evil monk, criticizing him not only for disrupting a joyous occasion but also for being inferior in skill and resorting to a feigned defeat and surprise attack. A prestigious sect like Kongtong, one of the Six Great Righteous Sects, could actually behave with such a despicable manner – how could anyone accept that?\nEven the Kongtong disciples frowned and wrung their fingers.\nVenerable Golden Crow hadn't yet ascended to the position of head of the sect, but was merely using this as an excuse to gain the trust of the Four Sect Leaders. He could only feel confident and bring people from afar to Shu to stir up trouble on someone else's wedding day – this was already unreasonable. Losing the duel only compounded the disgrace.\nVictory and defeat are commonplace in martial arts. If it were just that, it wouldn't necessarily provoke the wrath of the crowd. However, his feigned defeat and the subsequent attempt at a surprise attack while they were unprepared were simply unacceptable to the righteous.\nSeeing that the Kongtong disciple had incurred the crowd's anger and was being berated beyond redemption, unable to defend himself or maintain his composure, infighting arose. The most dissatisfied, Xuan Gong Guardian, led the way to thank Tang Clan and bid farewell. Subsequently, Iron Fist and Seize Soul Guardians also left one after another, leaving only Flying Heaven Guardian Yan Jiang, who remained unwilling, feeling both ashamed and angry.\nAlthough he felt resentment, he still wanted to defend his Senior Brother. People on the same boat should naturally work together.\nSuch a grave offense should not be subject to outside interference. Once back at the Kongtong Flying Sky Hall, close the doors and let the Flying Sky Sect Leader administer punishment according to the sect's regulations.\nHe talks about loyalty, but Venerable Golden Crow does not. His scheme failed, and he was chased and scolded by the crowd, already furious. 那金烏上人方才不敢對你下殺手，此刻自暴自棄，殺起自己人，卻是毫不手軟。\n顏疆壓根沒想過金烏上人會對自己下手，來不及運氣抵禦、迴避卸力，被砸個正著，胸骨臟腑全都稀爛，眼看沒救了。\n他倒算是條硬漢子，要你們趁他一息尚存，把他帶遠一點，死也不願死在唐門的土地上。=Venerable Golden Crow had not dared to kill you moments before, but now, past caring, he turned on his own man without the least mercy. 你在飛天門中，也非不曾受他冷眼，但見他如此，依舊不勝唏噓。\n你想將他帶回崆峒安葬，他卻不領情，只是看你的眼神，已不再充滿敵意，你還肯叫他一聲師兄，他就當你是自己人了。\n將身上秘笈贈你，吩咐你將他火化，骨灰撒在風裡，讓他隨風飛去，羽化登仙。=You had not gone without his cold looks back at Flying Heaven Gate, yet seeing him like this, you still could not help feeling a pang of sorrow. Once you were willing to call him Senior Brother, he counted you as one of his own. 你敬他是條漢子，問他遺言，他此時看你的眼神，已不再充滿敵意，請你將他火化，骨灰撒在風裡，讓他隨風飛去，羽化登仙。=You honored him as a true man and asked for his last words. His eyes, no longer full of hostility, met yours as he asked you to cremate him and scatter his ashes on the wind, to let him fly free and ascend as an immortal.
他臨死之前，想請你將他火化，骨灰撒在風裡，讓他隨風飛去，羽化登仙。\n你才不鳥他，跑到唐門鬧事、擅自死掉，還一堆要求，臉皮真厚。\n你非但不鳥，還要將他屍身丟到路邊餵野狗。\n這話聽得他簡直死不瞑目，連四師兄也出了一身大汗，他早知到你這人狠，可是沒想到這麼狠而已，你這哪是亦正亦邪，你簡直邪惡到不行，宋王田方四大寇見了你都會駭然色變。=He wished you would cremate him before he died, scatter his ashes to the wind, let him fly away, ascend as an immortal.\nYou completely ignored him, running off to cause trouble at the Tang Clan, dying on your own accord, and making a pile of demands – quite the thick skin he had.\nNot only did you ignore him, but you also intended to leave his body by the roadside for wild dogs to feed on.\nHearing this, he truly died with regret. Even Fourth Senior Brother broke out in a cold sweat. He knew you were ruthless, but he never expected you to be this ruthless. You're not exactly righteous, you're downright evil; even the Four Great Evildoers – Song Wang, Tian, Fang – would be terrified in your presence.
雖把崆峒人馬都請走了，但事情還沒完，當務之急，還得將小師妹送回山上。=Though the Kongtong men had all been sent packing, the matter still wasn't over — the pressing task now was to get the Junior Martial Sister safely back up the mountain.
謝過瑞笙的援手，事情可還沒結束。=You thanked Rui Sheng for lending a hand, but the matter still wasn't over.
四師兄留下收拾殘局，將護送小師妹的使命交給你，這也是他一番苦心，讓你能和小師妹再獨處片刻，還有什麼話，都趁早說了，不要留下遺憾。\n今晚是小師妹人生至關重大的抉擇時刻，她得回家作出決定了。=Fourth Senior Brother stayed behind to clean up the aftermath and entrusted you with escorting the Junior Martial Sister home — a piece of quiet kindness on his part, giving you a little more time alone with her. Whatever still needed saying, better say it now and leave no regrets. Tonight was the pivotal hour of the Junior Martial Sister's life; she had to go home and make her choice.
那金烏上人這一錘本來沒打算要你性命，而是使上暗勁。\n雖然偷襲為人所不齒，但旁人見他沒下殺手，多半一時便無話可說，自己再裝出一副道貌岸然的高僧姿態，點醒你臨陣對敵不能掉以輕心，避重就輕，模糊事實，把黑說成白的。\n屆時你必然怒不可遏，不妨鬥上一陣，等到暗勁發作竄上腦門，你便再也沒有與抗之力，他在猛攻一陣，將你收拾，又輕輕放過。\n那旁人還不讚他慈悲為懷、氣度恢弘嗎？\n然而事情並沒如他所想，偷襲不中，登時引得賓客群情洶湧，都罵他是惡僧，大好日子鬧事不說，說好不傷性命點到為止的比武，都分了勝負，卻還趁人不備，偷襲追擊，這豈不是花言騙對方留手，自己卻往死裡打嗎？\n金烏上人作繭自縛，百口莫辯，又不能說他這一錘不會錘死人，只會把人錘成弱智。=Jinwu Shangren's strike was never meant to take your life, but rather to apply a hidden force. Although ambushing is frowned upon, if others saw he didn't intend to kill, they would likely say nothing at first, then pretend to be a righteous monk, warning you not to be careless in battle, to avoid the main point, to obscure the truth, and to twist black into white. At that moment, you would inevitably become enraged, and a fight would ensue. When the hidden force surged up to your head, you would no longer have the strength to resist, and he would then launch a final assault, defeating you before letting you go. His ambush failed, instantly inciting the guests into a surge of anger, who all cursed him as a wicked monk. Was this not a case of using words to trick the other side into holding back, while himself attacking with all his might? Jinwu Shangren had thus trapped himself, unable to defend himself, for he could not claim that his strike would not kill, but would only leave the opponent as a fool.
連崆峒人馬見狀，都蹙眉髮指。即便再狠戾霸道，也不能不講江湖道義。\n兩人決鬥，生死有命，半點怨不得人，但騙人收手再施以偷襲，這等行逕卻絕非正道能容。\n見金烏中人犯了眾怒，被罵得狗血淋頭，也無法辯駁，更無臉面久留，內鬨起來，由最不服氣的玄功護法帶頭告辭，其後奪魄護法也幸災樂禍而去，崆峒大勢已去，轉眼就走得乾乾淨淨，金烏上人氣急敗壞，更不敢稍留。=Even the Kongtong men who saw it frowned and pointed in disgust. 四師兄唯恐崆峒諸人去而復返，來個回馬槍，是以護送小師妹上山，還是多點人手以策萬全。\n便請你走慢幾步，殿後，前簇後擁把小師妹拱回山上了。=Fourth Senior Brother feared the Kongtong men might double back and strike again, so he wanted more hands escorting the Junior Martial Sister up the mountain, to leave nothing to chance. 四師兄本來有意請瑞笙護花，瑞笙卻以公平為由拒絕了，與你先走一步。\n行至林深處才停步說話。=Fourth Senior Brother had meant to ask Rui Sheng to escort her, but Rui Sheng declined on grounds of fairness and went on ahead with you. Only once you had gone deep into the woods did you stop to talk.
你見他莫名焦急，疑心他想趁你落單謀殺你，這雖是玩笑話，可你眼底幾分驚懼之色，仍教瑞笙啞然，自忖行在正道，不知在你眼裡怎就變得如此不堪，虧他引你為友。=You saw him grow strangely anxious and suspected he meant to murder you now that you were alone. 可是你敗給了金烏上人。\n瑞笙這才意識到，你是不行的。\n你的胸襟、豪氣，他向來佩服的，但你的內功廢了，功力大不如前，以你如今的狀態行走江湖，可謂寸步難行，若那唐姑娘跟了你，你要憑何保護他呢？=But you lost to Shangren Jinwu.\nIt was then that Ruisheng realized you weren't enough.\nHe had always admired your ambition and spirit, but your Internal Skill is ruined, your skill diminished. In your current state, traveling Jianghu would be incredibly difficult; if Miss Tang were to follow you, how would you protect her?
可是你敗給了金烏上人。\n瑞笙這才意識到，你是不行的。\n你的胸襟、豪氣，他向來佩服的，但以你如今的武功行走江湖，可謂寸步難行，若那唐姑娘跟了你，你要憑何保護他呢？=But you were defeated by the Venerable Golden Crow.\nIt was then that Ruisheng realized you weren't enough.\nHe's always admired your ambition and spirit, but with your current martial arts, you'd be stumbling through Jianghu. 你當然會說你會拚盡全力、賭上性命。\n可是這世上誰不是拼命活著呢？\n方才若無旁人介入，你便死在金烏上人手上了。\n你的全力，你的性命也不足以保護你心愛之人。\n明知道這話對你而言不公平，他還是作好了覺悟要說，不能由著你逃避，然後悔恨終生，忠言逆耳，但這是朋友的義務。=You would certainly say you'd give everything, wager your very life. 你興許是累了，也許是酒香令你醉了，提不起勁來，令你昏昏沉沉，戀棧夢鄉，捨不得醒。=You might be tired, or perhaps the wine's fragrance has lured you into a daze, leaving you drowsy and reluctant to wake up.

\n你明知小竹怕鬼，還硬要講鬼故事，故事還沒講，就被驚恐的小竹一巴掌搧得雙腳離地飛了起來，使了千金墜的功夫都止不住跌勢，撞得頭破血流，差點自己就靈魂出竅了。=You knew full well that Xiao Zhu was afraid of ghosts, yet you insisted on telling a ghost story anyway. Before you could even begin, the terrified Xiao Zhu slapped you so hard your feet left the ground; not even the Thousand-Pound Drop could halt your fall, and you crashed down bleeding from a split scalp, nearly frightened out of your own soul.
你見她氣急敗壞，既慚愧又心疼，偏還忍不住嘴硬怨你，不禁莞爾。\n又是一番花言巧語，把這容易對付的少女哄得滿臉通紅。=You saw how furious she was, yet beneath it she was as ashamed as she was worried for you; still, she couldn't help but stubbornly blame you anyway, which only made you smile. \n熱鬧過後，又漸趨寂靜，只聞廟外風雨呼嘯，不時柴火劈啪作響，各人或躺或坐，互不言語，均是心事重重，縱有想說的，也總是話到嘴邊又吞回肚裡。\n負責守第一班夜的唐門老弟子回來，料大家死氣沉沉，心底所想不外乎都是同一件事，他亦忐忑多時，一路反覆，終於把心事坦白。\n他入門比你晚，但老早便轉正入室。除你不姓唐論外，如今唐家從四師兄往下數，還活著又未離棄師門的，要數他最為資深。\n一直抱著夢想，想要揚名立萬，與天下英雄爭長短。必須出人頭地，從此才有姓名，否則庸庸碌碌拼搏半生，到死仍是唐門弟子甲，黃土一埋，轉眼就被世人遺忘。\n江陵之戰、風雨山都未缺席，總念著「這次就是我的機會了」，可惜天公不作美，總是行拂亂其所為，令他出道至今依然藉藉無名，別說比不上大師兄、二師兄，甚至連你都能憑臉出名。\n這回武林大會，他磨拳擦掌，準備大顯身手，誰料到會如此收場呢？=After the commotion faded, quiet crept back in. Outside the temple, wind and rain howled, and the firewood crackled now and then. Everyone lay or sat without speaking, each weighed down by private thoughts; whatever words rose to the lips were swallowed back down.  The senior Tang Clan disciple who had taken the first night watch came back. Guessing that everyone's silence hid the same worry, and having wavered over it himself for a long while, he finally spoke his mind.  He had joined the clan after you, but was formally admitted to the inner circle early. Leaving you aside — since you don't bear the Tang name — he was now, counting down from Fourth Senior Brother, the most senior in the Tang Family still alive and still loyal to the sect. He had always dreamed of making a name for himself, of measuring blades with the heroes of the land. He had to rise above the ordinary to earn a name of his own; otherwise, a lifetime of dull struggle would end with him still just another Tang Clan disciple, forgotten the moment the earth closed over him.  He had missed neither the Battle of Jiangling nor Fengyu Mountain, always thinking, this time will be my chance. But heaven never smiled on him, and things always went awry — to this day he remains utterly unknown, unable even to match Eldest or Second Senior Brother, while even you had won some fame on your looks alone. 唐門清白與否，居然要靠別派的人高高在上投票決定，誰能不氣？\n那釋明憑著名聲地位，無須證據便能判人生死，誰能不心寒？\n大家都心知肚明，其實各派都憎恨唐門。\n去不去武林大會，唐門都會成為武林公敵，泥教一垮，就該你們了。\n不給你們安個罪名，如何順理成章的打殺，不能懲奸除惡，如何能令俠名遠揚呢？所以你們必須是壞人。=Is the Tang Clan innocent or guilty? It's up to other sects to decide by voting from their lofty positions. Who wouldn't be angry? Shi Ming, relying on his reputation and status, can sentence people to death without evidence. Who wouldn't feel a chill? Everyone knows full well that all sects hate the Tang Clan. Whether or not they attend the Wulin Congress, the Tang Clan will become Public Enemies of the Wulin. Once the Mud Cult falls, it will be your turn. Without giving you a charge, how can they justify killing you? Without punishing villains, how can they spread their heroism? Therefore, you must be villains.
唐門清白與否，居然要靠別派的人高高在上投票決定，誰能不氣？\n那釋明憑著名聲地位，無須證據便能判人生死，誰能不心寒？\n唐門雖然倖免，但錦香宮卻險些覆滅，無關素行，僅為她們與泥教有關，所以就被株連。\n武林群俠以俠義自居，可又囿於正邪之見，冠以大義名分，便會盲目逐流。\n釋明誣陷不成，不過是因為他名望不足罷了，下回再有一個江湖地位更崇高的人物站出來控告唐門，群俠怕是問都不用問，便取任一己之見將你們滿門抄斬了。=Could the Tang Clan's innocence or guilt truly hinge on other sects voting down from their lofty perches? Who wouldn't be furious? That Shi Ming, riding on his reputation and standing, could condemn people to death without a shred of evidence — who wouldn't feel a chill? The Tang Clan escaped this time, but Jinxiang Palace nearly fell, not for any wrongdoing of their own, only for their ties to the Mud Cult — guilt by association. The heroes of the Wulin call themselves righteous, yet bound by their notions of good and evil, they follow the crowd blindly once someone dresses it up as justice. Shi Ming's slander failed only because his own name wasn't great enough. Next time some figure of even greater standing in the Jianghu steps up to accuse the Tang Clan, the heroes won't even bother asking questions before wiping out your whole clan on nothing but their own judgment.
這席話不僅代表自己，也是所有唐門弟子的心聲。\n不甘心也得承認，你們其實很弱小，就算有一兩個能打的，也不過是能打而已。\n掌門垮下以後，唐門弟子一直都是倚仗他舊日餘威行走江湖，早已也沒有桀傲的底氣。\n再不服從，等你們被摸清底細，錦香宮便是前車之鑑。=These words not only represent myself but also the sentiments of all Tang Clan disciples. Reluctantly, you must admit that you are actually weak; even if a couple of you are capable fighters, they are no more than that. Since the Sect Leader's fall, Tang Clan disciples have always relied on his former prestige to walk the Jianghu, and they no longer possess the arrogance of old. Even if you refuse to submit, once your true strength is uncovered, the Jinxiang Palace will serve as a cautionary tale.
龍湘聽著茫然若失，越發迷惘了。\n從未想過江湖原來暗流洶湧，絕非使氣任俠就好。\n真能快意恩仇的若不是本來無牽無掛，隨時準備去死，便是上天偏袒，一切都給他安排妥當，可以後故無憂去闖蕩。\n大家都是活人，都有私心，都會死，夢想一劍霜寒十四州，又不得不為現實低頭。你稱我一聲大俠，我讚你一句英雄，人多的一方就是正義，眾口可以鑠金，不消證據也佔理，如此世道，與她所知相去甚遠。\n這事兒較真起來太複雜了，龍湘著實想不透，只覺得荒唐可笑。=Long Xiang listened, growing increasingly bewildered.\nHe'd never realized the rivers and lakes held such hidden currents, that it wasn't enough to simply be a righteous and free-spirited hero.\nOnly those who were truly detached from the world could indulge in vengeance and joy; otherwise, it required the heavens to favor you, arranging everything perfectly so you could pursue your ambitions without worry.\nEveryone is alive, with their own selfish desires, and everyone will die. Dreaming of a sword that freezes fourteen provinces, yet forced to bow to reality. You call me a great hero, I praise you as a valiant one—the side with the most people is righteous, public opinion is stronger than gold, requiring no evidence to be correct. This world is far different from what she knows.\nThis matter is too complicated to truly understand; Long Xiang simply found it absurd and laughable.
一有人把話說破，唐門師弟妹們便都不安躁動起來，如果可以不死，誰捨得離去？\n來時大家躊躇滿志，歸時卻意興闌珊，彷彿心頭熱血已經不再滾燙了。\n江湖這麼冷，還剩下什麼，值得人拿性命去拼？=Once the truth was spoken, the Tang Clan's Junior Martial Brothers and Sisters grew uneasy and restless. Jianghu is so cold‑what remains worth risking one's life for?
你扳起臉來，想學二師兄威脅恫嚇，可惜臉沒半點威嚴可言，想耍狠不成，反而被大家恥笑了。=You scowled, attempting to imitate Second Senior Brother's threatening demeanor, but your face lacked any semblance of authority. Your attempt at intimidation fell flat, and you were instead met with laughter from everyone.
你善言相勸，可是他去意已決，你憑何要求他捨命相陪呢？=You tried every gentle word to persuade him, but his mind was already made up — what right did you have to demand he risk his life to stay by your side?
你善言相勸，雖你不似大師兄、二師兄那樣生來注定英雄種，即使如此，平庸如你也誓與師門共進退，正因你是凡人，會死會傷，所以需要師兄弟姐妹保護，一如你總在危難之中挺身而出，憑的不是天分，而是覺悟。\n唐門大家不只是師兄弟，也是一家人，沒有一個人無關緊要。\n你的話語誠懇殷切，感動了眾人，你不像大師兄瀟灑，也不像二師兄嚴厲，你最像你自己。=You spoke with heartfelt persuasion. Though you were never born a hero like Eldest or Second Senior Brother, ordinary as you were, you still vowed to stand or fall with the sect together — precisely because you were mortal, capable of dying and being wounded, you needed your brothers and sisters to watch your back, just as you always stepped forward in times of danger, not out of talent but out of resolve. The Tang Clan was not merely a brotherhood but a family, and no one in it was expendable. Your words were sincere and earnest, and they moved everyone. You were not carefree like Eldest Senior Brother, nor stern like Second Senior Brother — you were, more than anything, yourself.
大家都盼你說點振奮人心的話，激勵士氣，你卻揚言要帶動唱，絲毫不以為意。\n人生本來就是萍聚一場，曲終人散，雲淡風清，不也挺好嗎？\n放棄夢想需要勇氣，此路不通，另闢蹊徑也不錯。\n無人去不得。無論誰都不是非要賭上性命不可，就算是你，遲早有一天也會啟程也說不定。\n何不且就相忘於此，今朝有酒今朝醉，不吝去留。十幾年後驀然想起，打聽一下，興許還能聽見故人音訊，那豈非不勝之喜？\n沒什麼比活好當下更重要了，生活越是苦澀，越要苦中作樂。=Everyone hoped you'd say something to lift their spirits and rally their courage, but instead you declared you'd lead a sing-along, seemingly unbothered by it all. Life, after all, was only ever a fleeting gathering — when the song ends and people scatter, leaving clear skies and a light breeze behind, wasn't that fine too? Giving up a dream took courage of its own; if this road was closed, striking out on another wasn't so bad either. No one was irreplaceable. No one had to stake their life on this, not even you — perhaps even you would set off on your own path one day. Why not simply let it go for now, drink while there was wine, and not begrudge whoever stayed or left? 雲裳從錦香宮學琴，今始披露，伴隨歌聲即興彈奏，一時熱鬧無比，不會唱的也擊股應和。=Yunshang learned to play the guqin at Jinxiang Palace, and today she finally revealed her skills. 於是你起了頭，大家齊聲唱起歌來，不會唱的也擊股應和。=Then you began singing, and everyone sang together. Those who couldn't sing also clapped in response.
風雨瀟瀟，正好高歌吟嘯，愁白了青絲隨它，豈忍負杯中狂藥。\n浮沉隨浪滔滔，潮來風雲際會，潮去人散寂寥。=Wind and rain sweep wild, the hour ripe for singing and shouting to the sky; let worry turn my black hair white — how could I bear to waste the wine within this cup? \n你們終於到家了，一去一回，大家都像老了十歲。=You've finally returned home after a round trip‑everyone looks ten years older.
小師妹例外，她永遠都很美好。=The Junior Martial Sister is an exception‑she is always very beautiful.
小梅一到家，就把你髒衣服拿去洗了晾，說得輕描淡寫，可仔細確認旁人不在的時候，她就穿了你衣服，又易容成你，到處調戲女弟子，敗壞你的形象，確保沒有任何女子會威脅她的地位。\n當然這些事，當事人你根本不得而知。=The moment Xiaomei got home, she took your dirty clothes off to wash and hang them out, speaking of it lightly enough. 小竹一路提心吊膽，到家了才鬆了一口氣，打過招呼就回鍛冶場去了。=Xiao Zhu was on edge the whole way, and only let out a breath once she was home. She said her hellos, then went straight back to the forge.
葉雲裳病臥在床多年，身嬌體弱，這回出門除了坐車騎馬，也走了不少路，嫩腳丫子都快走斷了，打過招呼便去泡腳舒緩了。=Ye Yunshang had been bedridden for years, delicate and weak. 你舉薦葉雲舟加入唐門，三師兄一口應允，眼看著他身負絕世劍法，卻毫不驕矜，任勞任怨給二師兄當奴隸使喚，如此謙虛踏實，恰是君子風範，心下著實惜才。\n你便是不提，三師兄也想勸誘葉雲舟。=You recommended Ye Yunzhou to join the Tang Clan, and the Third Senior Brother agreed at once. 三師兄見上官螢又上唐門，神色登時緊張起來，又見她這回上山左右沒有滄幫人馬隨扈，更覺詫異，還道上官世家又有什麼陰謀詭計。\n待聽你說，她跟上官世家決裂，成了你的未婚妻子之後，三師兄當場便暈了過去。\n他壓力實在太大了，最近經常夢魘，以為自己又在什麼荒唐的惡夢，然而並不是，現實就是如此離奇不可理喻。=The Third Senior Brother saw Shangguan Ying heading to the Tang Clan again, his expression instantly tightening. 岳陽風雨山的事情，早已被江湖快報傳遍中原。\n三師兄亦有所聞，詳情還需找你詳談印證，但卻不急，沒什麼消息貴過你們平安回家。=The incident at Yueyang Fengyu Mountain has already been spread throughout the Central Plains by the Jianghu Bulletin. 夏侯蘭聽說你回家了，也上唐門找你，你還道她嘴上說不來，但在緊要關頭一定出現，殊不知她這次是真的閉門不出，並非無視，而是出於信賴。=Xiahou Lan heard you had returned home and also went to the Tang Clan to look for you. 樊嘯天見到恩師，也喜極而泣，縱體入懷撒嬌。\n你們師徒三人闊別多時，總算團聚。=Fan Xiaotian wept for joy at the sight of his beloved teacher, throwing himself into his arms like a spoiled child.\nThe three of you—master and disciples—had been apart for so long, and were at last reunited.
夏侯蘭叫你去洗澡，你還道她當真嫌你，其實是思念得緊了，想喚你到樹屋，抱一抱你，親一親，把你翻轉來去，檢查有沒哪處受傷害人心疼。\n小別勝新婚，你和夏侯蘭並肩躺在榻上說話、看星星。\n全武林就只你得她偏寵，知曉這位女魔吝於言表，誰也不知的似水柔情。=Xiahou Lan told you to go wash up, and you took it for her usual scolding — when really she'd missed you terribly, and only wanted to call you up to the treehouse, hold you, kiss you, and turn you this way and that checking for any wound that might ache her heart. With the worst finally behind them and an auspicious day at hand, he steeled his resolve and set the departure in motion at last, afraid that if he waited any longer he'd never bring himself to go. \n你這天剛探過掌門病情，從正心堂出來，就碰見一個冒冒失失的師弟衝入正心堂中，嚷著要找掌門。=You had just checked on the Sect Leader's condition that day, came out of Zhengxin Hall, and just encountered a clumsy junior brother rushing into Zhengxin Hall, shouting to find the Sect Leader.
他看你輸給金烏上人，沒把你當回事，等你一巴掌下去，人才變老實。=He saw you lose to Jinwu Shangren and didn't think much of you — not until you slapped him across the face did he finally behave himself.
他看你輸給金烏上人，沒把你當回事，你也不生氣，聽他沒好氣的胡亂指揮。=He saw you lose to Jinwu Shangren, didn't take you seriously, and you didn't get angry, just listened to his rude, haphazard commands.
他沒找到三師兄，可是見到你，便似吞了一粒定心丸，緩了下來。=He didn't find the Third Senior Brother, but upon seeing you, he seemed to have swallowed a calming pill and relaxed.
說是山上來了一位官爺，這可千萬怠慢不得，讓你先出門迎接，他再去講經樓請代掌門出面。=An officer had come up the mountain, he said, and this was not something to be careless about — he told you to go out and greet the man first, while he hurried to the Scripture Hall to fetch the acting Sect Leader.
你暗暗心驚，只道是哪件虧心事終於東窗事發了。=You felt a chill down your spine, thinking that some misdeed had finally come to light.
你做賊心虛，立刻就認定是官府來人是要捉拿自己的。=Your conscience was guilty as a thief's, and you immediately assumed the officials had come to arrest you.
你暗暗心驚，自忖沒做啥虧心事，可是聽見是官，心下已怯了三分。=You were secretly startled, thinking you hadn't done anything wrong, but upon hearing it was an official, your heart had already quivered.
你聞言面不改色，那師弟見你如此鎮定，僅存的憂慮也煙消雲散。=You remained unmoved upon hearing the words. That Junior Brother, seeing you so composed, felt his remaining worries vanish.
將客人迎進大院中，來人除了宋神補，還有一位滄幫弟子。\n須知上回唐門內亂，皆因上官世家為叛徒撐腰，上官娘子雖然臨陣倒戈，但滄幫弟子卻都按兵不動，這梁子終究結下了。\n同門師兄弟此時一見滄幫弟子，眼中都像要噴出火來似的。=You escort the guest into the courtyard; besides Divine Constable Song, there's also a Cang Gang disciple with him.\nRecall that the internal strife within the Tang Clan last time was because the Shangguan Family backed a traitor. Though Lady Shangguan switched sides at the last moment, the Cang Gang disciples stood by and did nothing, and that grudge has stuck ever since.\nSeeing the Cang Gang disciple now, your fellow sect brothers look ready to breathe fire.
將客人迎進大院中，來人除了宋神補，還有一位滄幫弟子。\n上回唐門內亂，皆因上官世家為叛徒撐腰，梁子結大了。\n同門師兄弟此時一見滄幫弟子，眼中都像要噴出火來似的。=Welcoming the guests into the main courtyard, among those who arrived was Divine Constable Song, along with a disciple of the Cang Gang.\nThe previous internal strife within the Tang Clan stemmed from the Shangguan Family backing a traitor, and that grudge ran deep.\nNow, whenever their fellow disciples caught sight of the Cang Gang disciple, their eyes looked ready to spit fire.
你一見是宋悲，懸著的心也落地了。\n他也聽聞了唐門近來多災多難，雖不說客套話，然而見你無恙，心下也自寬慰。=Your heart, which had been in suspense, finally settled when you saw it was Song Bei. He had heard of the Tang Clan's recent misfortunes. Though he didn't say any polite words, seeing you unharmed, he felt relieved in his heart.
你雖然見過宋神補，卻無緣結識，今日才是頭一次結交。\n他聽聞你不少事蹟，聽說你其貌不揚，可是俠肝義膽，是個人物，早就有心結交。=Though you've caught sight of Divine Constable Song before, you never had the chance to properly meet him—today is your first real acquaintance.\nHe's heard plenty about you: that you're plain to look at, yet brave and true-hearted, truly someone remarkable. He's long wanted to befriend you.
你雖然見過宋神補，卻無緣結識，今日才是頭一次交談。\n他聽聞你不少事蹟，都是惡名，見面就一番疾言厲色，給足了下馬威。=You're familiar with the legend of Divine Constable Song, yet never had the chance to meet him; today marks your first conversation.\nHe's heard quite a bit about you – all of it unfavorable – and starts with a harsh tone, making quite the display of authority.
三師兄這才出來，將二位客人迎進正心堂奉茶。\n一通寒暄，那滄幫弟子才說明來意，原來他並非尋常幫眾，而是五堂香主之一，九仙堂朱五，直屬上官家主，在滄幫之中，可說僅在一人之下。\n宋悲此行也不過是客，旨在陪同而已。\n那朱五先是自謙一番，旋即滔滔不絕說了起來，將唐門與上官的恩怨輕描淡寫帶過，口口聲聲都是大局，言道江陵圍城以來，江湖風雨有如滔滔江水，連綿不絕。\n南宮世家痛失尊長，中原正派各派亦中魔教調虎離山之計，元氣大傷，偏又明爭暗鬥，沒有武林之心居中調解，紛爭四起，要想團結一心共抗魔教，談何容易？\n倘若泥教趁著六派相互掣肘之時又再發難，率十萬部眾出山，往北滋擾襄陽，放金兵入關；向南襲襲南宮，掌握武林之心。屆時內憂外患，則大宋江山危矣。\n這不僅是朝廷的隱患，更是社稷的禍胎，是抵在天下百姓喉上的利刃。\n他說得慷慨激昂，用心已昭然，無非是想以大義名份擠兌唐門，逼迫唐門不可獨善其身。\n你和三師兄聽了都暗暗心驚，這人自稱討海人家沒讀書，可是口若懸河，真不是蓋的，所言亦都在理，叫人無法辯駁。\n他旋即又說，上官家主雖已退隱江湖，卻不忍見生靈塗炭，特此上奏朝廷，得官家聖旨授命，官升三品，召開武林大會，號召武林正派共商討逆大計。\n當著宋悲見證，送達武林大會請柬，便拱手告辭而去。=Third Senior Brother just emerged and ushered the two guests into the Zhengxin Hall to offer tea.\nAfter some pleasantries, the Cang Gang disciple explained their purpose, revealing that he wasn't just an ordinary gang member, but one of the Five Hall Masters – Zhu Wu of the Jiuxian Hall, directly under the Shangguan Clan's head. Within the Cang Gang, he was second only to one person.\nSong Bei's visit was merely as a guest, intended for accompaniment.\nZhu Wu first humbly presented himself, and then began to speak at length, glossing over the grudge between the Tang Clan and the Shangguan Clan, constantly invoking the greater good. He spoke of how since the siege of Jiangling, the storms of Jianghu had been relentless and unending.\nThe Nanyang Clan suffered a devastating loss of their head, and the righteous factions of the Central Plains were ensnared in the Demon Cult's luring a tiger away from the mountains scheme, suffering a significant depletion of their strength. Furthermore, they engaged in secret struggles, without the heart of Wulin to mediate, leading to constant conflicts. How could they unite to resist the Demon Cult?\nIf the Demon Cult were to take advantage of the six factions' mutual restraint and launch another attack, leading ten thousand troops out of the mountains to harass Xiangyang and allow the Jin army to invade; or attack Nanyang and seize the heart of Wulin – then, with internal and external worries, the Great Song would be in grave danger.\nThis wasn't just a hidden danger for the court, but a catastrophe for the dynasty – a blade at the throats of the Commoners.\nHis words were impassioned and his intentions were clear – he was trying to use a guise of righteousness to pressure Tang Clan, forcing them to involve themselves.\nYou and Third Senior Brother were both inwardly startled; he claimed to be a commoner who hadn't studied, yet he spoke eloquently, and his words were entirely reasonable, making them impossible to refute.\nHe then continued, saying that although the Shangguan Clan head had retired from Jianghu, he couldn't bear to see bloodshed. He had specially petitioned the court, received the Clan's imperial decree, and was promoted to the third rank, convening a Wulin Assembly to call on the righteous factions of Wulin to discuss countermeasures against the Demon Cult.\nWitnessed by Song Bei, he presented the invitation to the Wulin Assembly and then bid farewell.
朝廷介入江湖紛擾，明面上等如默許各大門派積攢勢力，可是何嘗沒有試探的意思？\n宋悲有官身，本來應該忠於朝廷，不該出言提醒，但念著與你的交情，仍不免暗示了幾句，勸唐門不論如何孤傲，唯獨這次必須得派人參與，否則後患無窮。=The Imperial Court's involvement in the Jianghu turmoil effectively allows major sects to consolidate their power on the surface, yet is this not also a test? Song Bei, holding an official position, should remain loyal to the court and not speak out, yet out of consideration for your friendship, he still subtly advised the Tang Clan: no matter how proud they may be, they must send representatives this time, or face dire consequences later.
\n你和三師兄商議，雖然對朝廷干預一事頗有疑慮，唐門雖不屑與官府為謀，亦從來不以正派自居，但是天下興亡，匹夫有責，捍衛家園，義不容辭。\n否則當年掌門也不會率領師門，與中原正派同一陣線，力抗極樂教，最終落得個凋零敗破的下場。\n不論如何，這武林大會都必須要去。=You and Third Senior Brother discussed it. Though you had real misgivings about the Imperial Court's interference — the Tang Clan disdains to scheme with officialdom, and has never styled itself one of the righteous sects — still, when the realm rises or falls, every commoner bears a part of the burden, and defending one's home admits no refusal. Otherwise, the sect leader of old would never have led the sect to stand beside the righteous factions of the Central Plains against the Supreme Bliss Cult, a stand that ended in the sect's own ruin. Whatever the case, this Wulin Assembly could not be missed.
\n請帖上書，武林大會將在今年十月十五，在風雨山舉辦。\n那風雨山便在岳陽以南，西接洞庭湖水之處，並非名山，頗為荒僻，上官世家擇此處召開武林大會，用心深遠，乃是借洞庭錦香宮，有心要讓南宮世家難堪。\n人盡皆知，兩大勢力因為家主、宮主舊年糾葛，使得南宮族人路過錦香宮地盤都不得不低頭，大會辦在風雨山，這是有心要損南宮世家的臉面，令他們再也不能自居武林泰斗。=The invitation states that the Wulin Assembly will be held on October 15th this year at Fengyu Mountain. Fengyu Mountain lies south of Yueyang, west of the Dongting Lake, and is not a renowned mountain, but rather a remote and secluded place. The Shangguan family has chosen this location to host the gathering, with a deliberate intent to embarrass the Nangong family by leveraging the Jinxiang Palace. It is well known that the two factions have long‑standing conflicts due to old disputes between the Family Head and the Palace Mistress, forcing the Nangong family's members to bow whenever passing through Jinxiang Palace's territory. Hosting the gathering at Fengyu Mountain is a calculated move to humiliate the Nangong family further, ensuring they can no longer claim the title of leading figure in the Wulin.
你武功雖然今非昔比，可是人品問題太多，三師兄本來屬意四師兄代表唐門，無奈四師兄遠行不在家中，此外更無大將，只得勉為其難把你放出去為禍中原。=Although your martial skill has come a long way since before, your character still raises too many concerns. Third Senior Brother originally intended Fourth Senior Brother to represent the Tang Clan, but unfortunately, Fourth Senior Brother is away on a long journey and not at home. There are no other capable leaders, so they reluctantly sent you out to wreak havoc in the Central Plains.
代表唐門參與大會的人選，捨你其誰？\n這既是你心心念念盼了多年的機會，能嶄露頭角，與此同時，你也背負著師門的名聲，榮辱皆繫於你一身。=Who else but you can represent the Tang Clan at the conference? This is the opportunity you've longed for, a chance to shine, while at the same time, you carry the reputation of your sect, and your honor and disgrace rest entirely on you.
小師妹一聽要出門，立馬躍躍欲試要跟。=Junior Martial Sister immediately became eager to try and wanted to go along.
三師兄哪裡能容這種事情發生，於公於私都不願讓小師妹與你同遊。=Third Senior Brother couldn't possibly allow such a thing to happen; on both official and personal grounds, he wouldn't want Junior Martial Sister to travel with you.
你本來就不報太大期望，被阻止輕嘖一聲，也不著惱。\n如今你雖得了小師妹的芳心，卻不得同門認可，倘若強行成親，勢必會受人白眼，武林大會正是你建功立業的大好機會，等你逮到良機大展身手，再振唐門威風，到時誰還能反對你和小師妹的大好姻緣！\n三師兄要是再不知好歹，說不定你一個不樂意，都不讓他當代掌門了呀！=You weren't expecting much to begin with, and a slight sigh escaped you when you were stopped, without much annoyance.\nNow that you're fortunate enough to have won the affection of your Junior Martial Sister, you still haven't gained the approval of your fellow disciples. Once you seize the chance to showcase your skills and restore Tang Clan's reputation, who would dare oppose your wonderful match with your Junior Martial Sister!\nIf your third senior brother is still foolish, you might just refuse to let him be the Sect Leader!
你雖盼著能與小師妹攜手同遊江湖，又怕她出門在外會吃苦頭，萬一有個閃失，你豈不成了千古罪人？既然三師兄不許她去，你便也幫腔勸她。=You long to journey through the Jianghu hand in hand with your junior martial sister, yet fear she might suffer hardship along the way. 你目光炯炯，光明又激情的矯情發言，令小師妹微微冷顫，但三師兄大受感動，暗暗叫好。=Your eyes blazed as you gave a lofty, passionate, yet utterly contrived speech, which made the junior martial sister shiver slightly, though Third Senior Brother was deeply moved and secretly cheered you on.
小師妹悶悶不樂，但仍乖順的聽從於你。=Junior Martial Sister was sullen but still obediently followed you.
三師兄對此感到十分不安，遲疑半晌，終於輕輕的放下，放她自由。=Third Senior Brother felt very uneasy, hesitated for a while, and finally gently let go, freeing her.
雖然不能再強留小師妹，但始終對你這人放心不下。對，你是勞苦功高沒錯，但這也不能抹消你人品低劣的事實，非得逼著你發誓嚴守禮教，才能容許小師妹與你同行。=Though he could no longer insist on keeping Junior Martial Sister with him, he remained uneasy about you. 誠實是美德，於是你順從心意，拒絕保障小師妹的人身安全，你可以替她遮風擋雨，但你有十足把握管不住自己。\n三師兄聞言大怒，當場將小師妹禁足。=Honesty being a virtue, you followed your heart and refused to guarantee Junior Martial Sister's safety—you could shield her from the wind and rain, but you were certain you could not control yourself. 你忍辱負重，打算先過了三師兄這關再說。\n三師兄只是勤懇老實，又不是當真讀書讀壞腦子，甭想也知你這人渾無信用可言，轉頭改去要求小師妹起誓，如果路上受你非禮，必須全力撲殺你，只要被碰到頭、手之外的地方，或者盯著她看超過半炷香，亦或者天黑趕不上住店，一律都殺無赦。\n小師妹一口答應，你頓時萬念俱灰，想要和她一口氣拉近關係的計謀胎死腹中。=You swallowed your pride, resolved to get past Third Senior Brother first and worry about the rest later. Third Senior Brother was diligent and honest, but he had not addled his wits with too much reading—of course he saw straight through your utter lack of scruples. He turned instead to make Junior Martial Sister swear an oath: should you take liberties with her on the road, she must strike you down without mercy. Touch her anywhere but her head or hands, stare at her for more than half a stick of incense, or fail to reach an inn before nightfall, and she was to kill you on the spot, no exceptions. Junior Martial Sister agreed at once, and all your hopes collapsed—your scheme to grow closer to her in one stroke was stillborn.
\n你在巨大的壓力壓迫下，三番兩次病倒，纏綿於病榻，等你病好才知道，師弟妹早就拿了請帖獨自前往岳陽，只留下少數猜拳輸掉的倒楣鬼負責照料你。\n你昔日累積的貢獻都被你的離譜行徑揮霍一空，抬頭挺胸出門，垂頭喪氣回家，連三師兄都難掩失望之色，雖沒說出口，心底卻反覆想著孔子名言：「朽木不可雕也，糞土之牆不可杇也。」反正你準是其中之一。=Under immense pressure, you fell ill again and again, laid up in bed, and only learned on recovering that your Junior Brothers and Sisters had already taken the invitation and set off for Yueyang without you, leaving behind only the unlucky few who had lost at a game of finger-guessing to nurse you. All the merit you had built up over the years was squandered by your outrageous conduct—you had gone out with your head held high and come home crestfallen, and even Third Senior Brother could not hide his disappointment, though he said nothing. In his heart he kept turning over Confucius's words: 'Rotten wood cannot be carved; a wall of dung cannot be trowled.' Either way, you were surely one of them.
行到半路，福韞法師竟不知不覺混進了唐門隊伍之中，你只留意有沒有人脫隊，渾然不覺竟然多了一個人。=Halfway along the road, Dharma Master Fu Yun slipped into the Tang Clan's ranks without anyone noticing. You only kept watch for stragglers, never realizing an extra person had joined.
\n這一日終於到了荊州地界，向茶肆小二一問，便知此去再行幾日路程，便是江陵、岳陽。=On this day, they finally reached the territory of Jingzhou. They asked a waiter at the tea house and learned that continuing for several more days would lead to Jiangling and Yueyang.
與你同行的龍湘聽見師姐們來了，喜孜孜的把雞腿一口吞掉，上前相見。\n興匆匆地介紹了你，換來的卻是二位師姐失望、落寞、不敢置信甚至忿忿難平的。\n原來龍湘提起你來，總是拿你跟大師兄相提並論，同門師姊妹沒見過你的，便都心存幻想，想像中的你，也是如唐門飛俠般俊朗瀟灑、武功高強的俠客，殊不知見了面竟是這種玩意兒，滿腔都是被騙、被玩弄的委屈，可謂是失望至極。\n這些傷人的話，你聽的夠多了，甚至習以為常。\n卻不想這次龍湘在側沒有默不吭聲，而是厲色駁斥二位師姐。\n她受恩師薰陶，從小崇拜英雄父親，認為男兒就該豪放慷慨，磊落不羈，遇不平事敢仗義挺身，為國為民，豪氣堪當江湖千重駭浪，拋頭顱、灑熱血於沙場。\n並不是靠著與生俱來的餽贈，輕鬆度日耀武揚威，而是憑你千錘百煉的自己。\n比起這些真正可貴的內涵，相貌好壞根本不值一提。=Long Xiang, who was traveling with you, heard the senior sisters approaching, gulped down her chicken leg in one bite, and hurried forward to greet them. She introduced you eagerly, only to meet with disappointment, dejection, disbelief, and even indignation from the two senior sisters. It turned out that whenever Long Xiang spoke of you, she always compared you to the senior brother, so the sect sisters who had never met you had built up their own fantasies—imagining you as dashing and skilled as the Tang Clan Flying Hero, only to find, on meeting you at last, nothing of the sort. Their hearts brimmed with the grievance of feeling deceived and made fools of; they could not have been more disappointed. You had heard such cutting words often enough to grow used to them. But this time Long Xiang did not stay silent—she turned on the two senior sisters with a sharp rebuke. Raised under her master's teaching, she had worshipped her heroic father since childhood and believed a man should be bold and generous, upright and unrestrained, ready to stand up for justice against wrongs, for country and people, with spirit enough to brave the Jianghu's fiercest storms and lay down his life on the battlefield. Such worth was not handed down at birth for one to coast through life and flaunt, but forged through your own hard trials. Beside qualities so truly precious, good looks or bad hardly bore mentioning.
那二名錦香宮女弟子見師妹發怒了，也暗暗心驚，旋即想起此行使命，萬一得罪了你，請不到唐門，那該如何是好？只得強行收斂心神，陪笑道歉。=The two Jinxiang Palace disciples saw their junior sister angry and felt a chill in their hearts. They quickly remembered why they had come: if they offended you and the Tang Clan refused their request, what then? They could only force themselves to calm down and offer smiling apologies.
錦香宮主是武林前輩，雖然深居寡出，但是江湖地位不可謂不尊。\n宮主有邀，你身為江湖後學，焉能有負？=The Palace Mistress of Jinxiang Palace is a Wulin elder; though she lives in seclusion and rarely appears, her standing in the Jianghu is by no means low. Since the Palace Mistress has extended an invitation, how could you, a junior disciple of the Jianghu, refuse to answer it?

你樣貌雖醜，卻學人到處留情，看這姑娘武功不高，渾身都是破綻，故意朝她下盤猛攻一番，害她方寸大亂，險些沒仰天摔倒，還是你伸出手臂，攬了她一把纖腰。\n那姑娘涉世未深，見你武功高強，名聲又響，雖然面目醜陋，但是舉止儒雅，給你一挑逗，登時滿臉通紅，也不知眼睛出了什麼毛病，看你的臉竟還覺得有點英俊。看她羞得落荒而逃，你得意洋洋，至於她之後被小梅拉到拐角恐嚇的事情，你自然無從知曉。=Though your appearance is unattractive, you pretend to be affectionate, taking advantage of this girl's low skill and numerous weaknesses. The girl, inexperienced in the world, sees your high skill and reputation, and despite your unattractive face, your polite manners make her blush. She can't tell what's wrong with her eyes, but she finds your face somewhat handsome. As she flees in embarrassment, you feel proud. As for the later incident where Xiaomei dragged her to the corner and threatened her, you have no idea.
\n入夜，你和小梅赴畫中仙之約，她依然笑得樂呵呵，招手邀你們出宮，到林中過招，莫看華仙兒步伐不大，但走路出奇的快，腳踏地上恍如滑行，你倆都要施展輕功才能跟上。=As night fell, you and Xiaomei met Hua Xian'er at the Painting Immortal's rendezvous. 小梅上前領教，兩代千面人魔正式交鋒，然而不論閱歷、基本功、招數巧妙、內力深淺，小梅都被全面壓制，就算使出了焚心火印催谷功力，依然不是對手。\n這固然是因為小梅所學，畫中仙瞭若指掌，也因為她自身實力強橫，戰到小梅火毒攻心，她依舊好整以暇。\n小梅倒不是沒藏心眼，故意示弱，保留了最後一搏的餘力，但是正面對決，毫無勝算可言。=Xiaomei stepped forward to accept the challenge, and the two generations of the Thousand-Faced Demon engaged in a formal confrontation. 你讓小梅掠陣，自己上前領教二代千面人魔的高招。=You let Xiaomei guard the rear while you yourself stepped forward to learn the high moves of the Second-Generation Thousand-Face Demon.

你雖然是勝者，但是獎品是為小梅準備的，你可沒份，賞你個巴掌倒是可以。\n你撫著被打的臉，有點兒心底不平衡。=You may be the winner, but the prize was meant for Xiaomei—none of it was yours. A slap across the face, though, you could certainly expect. You rubbed your stinging cheek, feeling a little hard done by.

你當即哄她放心去學，比起焚心火印，能否陪你天長地久才更要緊。\n就算她手無縛雞之力，你也許諾一定相敬如賓。\n小梅聽了反而不太樂意，其實她希望你偶爾可以強勢一點。=You coaxed her at once into learning without worry — whatever the Heartburn Seal cost her, whether she could stay by your side for life mattered far more. 你收下了秘笈，打算自己練，屆時再助小梅鎮壓體內的焚心之毒。\n這是治標不治本的笨法子，會讓小梅終生受制於你，昔日千燈樓，今日是你。\n小梅不是不知你的算計，儘管如此，還是將權柄交諸於你。=You took the manual, planning to master it yourself, so that in time you could help Xiaomei suppress the burning poison inside her. \n武林大會在即，因為有你，眾師兄弟們都信心十足，磨拳擦掌，欲在各大派門之前耀武揚威一番。=The Wulin Assembly drew near, and thanks to you, the brothers and sisters were brimming with confidence, itching for a fight, eager to show their mettle before the great sects.
\n武林大會在即，眾師兄弟們都磨拳擦掌，躍躍欲試，想闖出一番名堂來。=The Wulin Assembly is imminent, and the brothers and sisters are all rubbing their fists and sharpening their palms, eager to test themselves and make a name for themselves.
受邀在錦香宮盤桓，一住半個月，朝夕相處下來，宮人對唐門大有改觀，均覺你們不似江湖傳聞卑鄙陰毒，其中不曾出宮遊歷且心思單純的小娘子大有人在，見了你唐門男兒的氣概，芳心暗許亦不在少數。=Invited to remain at Jinxiang Palace, they stayed for half a month. 唯獨你始終孤伶伶，寂寞與你相擁天長地久。=Only you have always been lonely, with loneliness embracing you for eternity.

來客好不傲慢，竟將轎子抬進殿中。\n你如今眼界已開，一眼便看出二名轎夫渾身散發不尋常的魄力，不禁汗毛直豎，而怪溫夫人如此謹慎，若不先以內功截脈抑制心跳，只怕登時就會被這二位高手察覺。=The guests proved insufferably arrogant, having their palanquin carried straight into the hall.\nYour eyes had opened wide to the world by now, and at a glance you saw the two bearers giving off an uncanny aura of power — your hairs stood on end. 你再定睛一看，當先的婢女一身水藍衣裙，膚色黝黑，容貌甚美，卻不是久違的書蓉姑娘是誰？\n那二名轎夫，則是便是昔日達摩院首座萬里鵬程，與點蒼劍聖。\n那麼轎中之人的真身，便呼之欲出了。=You looked again, and saw the maid leading them wore a water-blue dress, her skin dark, her face strikingly lovely — who else could she be but the long-absent Miss Shu Rong?\nThe two bearers were none other than Wanli Pengcheng, once Head of the Bodhidharma Hall, and the Sword Saint of Diancang.\nThe true identity of the one inside the palanquin was all but revealed.
容姿絕俗的少女捲廉而出，霎時滿室生輝，週身繚繞著一股難以描繪的光暈似的，神聖不可侵犯，正是那南陽杏花林中神秘莫測的杏花仙。\n她稱溫夫人為師父，摒退隨從，飄然落座，拾子與溫夫人對弈。\n她與溫夫人二人對談，字字驚心動魄，你冷汗涔涔，唯恐滴落。\n今始知道溫夫人所言非虛，江湖風雨乃至四國兵禍，皆是此人藏身幕後，一手操引。\n她以萬里河山作爛柯，與溫夫人對弈；與趙擴對弈；與完顏珣對弈；與成吉思汗對弈。\n眾生皆入局，生殺不由己。\n來時天降血雨，走時遍地瘡痍──這便是人間至惡杏花仙的真容。\n她拜別以後良久，你才敢下地來，空有一身武功，卻被一名柔弱少女駭得雙腿發虛。\n溫夫人自請你留步的時候，便知此事終究瞞不過去。\n她一字也不澄清，與瑞杏針鋒相對時，已訴盡平生志願。心懷美好願景，亦有私心，狡猾虛偽，又追求和平，複雜又矛盾，這便是為人間道了。=A girl of otherworldly beauty swept the curtain aside, and in an instant the whole room filled with radiance; about her curled an indescribable aura, sacred and inviolable — she was none other than the elusive Apricot Blossom Immortal of the Apricot Blossom Forest of Nanyang.\nShe called Lady Wen Master, dismissed her own attendants, and settled gracefully into her seat to play a game of chess with Lady Wen.\nAs the two of them spoke, every word struck like a blow; you broke into a cold sweat, afraid even a single drop might fall.\nOnly now did you know Lady Wen's words were no exaggeration — the storms of the Jianghu, even the wars among the Four Kingdoms, had all been orchestrated from the shadows by this one person's hand.\nShe had used the rivers and mountains of the realm as her chessboard: playing against Lady Wen, against Zhao Kuo, against Wanyan Xun, against Genghis Khan.\nEvery living soul was drawn into her game, their lives and deaths no longer their own to command.\nBlood rained from the sky when she came, and the land lay in ruins when she left — this was the true face of the Apricot Blossom Immortal, most wicked in all the mortal world.\nLong after she took her leave, you still dared not rise from where you hid; for all your martial skill, you had been left weak-kneed with fear by one frail-seeming girl.\nThe moment Lady Wen asked you to stay behind, she knew this matter could not be hidden from you forever.\nShe cleared nothing up, but in her sharp exchange with Ruixing she had already poured out her lifelong resolve. A heart that cherished noble ideals yet harbored private designs, cunning and false, yet still seeking peace — complicated and contradictory: this was what it meant to walk the Human Path.
你想起當時大漠行，瑞杏勸成吉思汗大刀闊斧，已顯殺伐果斷的絕戾之色。溫夫人聞言卻是一愣，有別的解讀。\n她只道瑞杏選擇蒙古主宰江山，故為成吉思汗獻策，然而蒙金之戰未果，又向西爭伐，明面上似是開疆拓土，實際卻是利用局勢分化蒙古。\n那離繼承權最遠的朮赤若想自保，就會自請西征，建立功勞以自清，又遠離權力風暴，假以時日擁兵自重，則可劍指斡難河，形成正統繼承人心頭隱患，一個不慎便有內戰。\n數年之後，形式果如溫夫人所料，可是她只猜對了一半，因為瑞杏中途改變主意了。\n朮赤西征，被封到最遠的欽察作汗。\n及後朮赤被瑞杏陷害，受成吉思汗猜忌，悲痛欲絕，遭瑞杏勸殺於帳中，謊稱病逝，令成吉思汗懷疚在心，不久辭世。\n杏花仙兵不血刃毀蒙古干城，假道宋境，包抄汴京，滅金。=You recalled your journey through the vast desert, when Ruixing had urged Genghis Khan toward bold, sweeping action — already showing the ruthless, decisive cruelty behind it. Lady Wen was taken aback to hear this, reading it differently.\nShe had assumed Ruixing simply chose to back Mongol rule over the realm, and so offered Genghis Khan her strategies. But when the war against Jin stalled, the campaign turned west — on the surface an expansion of territory, but in truth a scheme to exploit the moment and split the Mongols apart.\nJochi, farthest from the succession, would seek to protect himself by volunteering for the western campaign — earning merit to clear his name while putting distance between himself and the storm at court. Given time, with an army of his own behind him, he could turn his blade toward the Onon River, becoming a lurking threat to the rightful heir — one misstep, and civil war would follow.\nYears later, events unfolded much as Lady Wen had foreseen — but she had only gotten half of it right, for Ruixing changed her mind partway through.\nJochi rode west and was enfeoffed as khan of the distant Kipchak.\nLater, Jochi was framed by Ruixing, fell under Genghis Khan's suspicion, and in his despair was, at her urging, put to death in his own tent — his death reported falsely as illness. The guilt weighed on Genghis Khan's heart, and before long he too passed away.\nWithout shedding a drop of blood, the Apricot Blossom Immortal brought down the Mongols' strongholds, then passed through Song territory to encircle Bianjing and destroy the Jin.
\n上到風雨山，但見武林大會會場各派旗幟飄盪，場中黑壓壓全是人，怕不有千人之眾。\n奉旨籌辦武林大會的上官家主雖然退隱江湖，但是餘威猶在，武林人大多都賣他面子，何況還是商議武林未來的重大會議，發出百張帖子倒有九十九張回，一時中原豪傑都齊聚在風雨山，場面空前浩大，人聲鼎沸，六大派各據一方，門人穿著各色制服，尚且還好辨識，無門無派的武林人穿著就不講究，哪還分得清誰是誰？\n資歷深的老江湖重視人情世故，見著熟人就寒暄；心氣高的年輕人則如刺蝟一般互不相讓，有些特別愛裝模作樣的，人人嘴裡都叼一根草，自詡為浪跡天涯的一匹孤狼，以無家可歸自豪，就算上有高堂也要說成家破人亡，彷彿家人沒死個乾淨就沒有面子。\n=Ascending Fengyu Mountain, one could see the Wulin Assembly's venue, where banners of various sects fluttered in the wind. The field was densely packed with people, surely numbering over a thousand. Although the Shangguan Family Head, who had been entrusted with organizing the gathering, had retired from Jianghu, his lingering authority still held sway. Most Wulin figures gave him face, especially since this was a significant meeting to discuss the future of the Wulin. Out of a hundred invitations sent, ninety‑nine were returned. At that moment, heroes from all over Central Plains gathered at Fengyu Mountain, creating an unprecedentedly grand scene, filled with the clamor of voices. The Six Great Sects occupied their respective areas, their disciples dressed in colorful uniforms, making them easily distinguishable. However, those without a sect or affiliation wore less formal attire, making it hard to tell one from another. Seasoned old hands, mindful of social etiquette, greeted acquaintances warmly. Younger, more ambitious individuals, however, were like porcupines, unwilling to yield. Some particularly liked to pretend, each carrying a blade of grass in their mouths, claiming to be solitary lone wolves wandering Jianghu, proud of their homelessness. Even if they had parents at home, they would boast of their families being destroyed, as if having a complete family was a disgrace.
你不知自己鎮定如橫的神色有多可靠。\n笑起來一如既往的醜，可偏讓人見了安心。=You had no idea how reassuring your calm, steady expression could be.\nYour smile was as unappealing as ever, yet somehow it never failed to put people at ease.
縱使你這樣見慣世面的人，也不免緊張，還想嘴硬不承認。=Even you, worldly as you were, could not help feeling nervous — though you still wanted to put on a brave face and refuse to admit it.
縱使你這樣見慣世面的人，也不免緊張，師弟妹見你如此，更加慌了。=Even though you, who have seen much, can't help but get nervous, your Junior Martial Brothers and Sisters, seeing you like this, become even more panicked.
一會兒有滄幫人手過來知客，收下請帖，領你們到涼棚下休息。=Soon, Cang Gang hands will come to receive you, collect your invitation, and lead you to rest beneath the shade pavilion.
他桃花運旺盛，竟然一次得了六位紅顏知己，言下頗有得意之色。\n你半點也不覺得奇怪，以瑞笙才貌武功，從前到處碰釘子，只能說是挑錯了對手，時運不濟，否則妻妾成群也非難事。\n本來說得好好的，可是瑞笙無心說了一句「未必便輸唐姑娘」，得罪了你這沒品的人，突然就進入戰鬥狀態。\n小師妹不知這是你們男子之間打鬧出來交情、默契，匆忙跳到中間攔住，問明原因，心底甜滋滋的。=He was blessed with extraordinary romantic fortune, and remarkably, he gained six beautiful confidantes at once; his words held a hint of pride.\nYou found it unsurprising at all; with Ruisheng's talent, martial arts, and looks, his previous rejections were simply a matter of choosing the wrong prospects or experiencing bad timing; otherwise, having a large harem wouldn't be difficult.\nHe was recounting the story quite nicely, but when Ruisheng casually remarked, 「It's not guaranteed that you'd lose to Miss Tang」, he offended you, a person lacking in refinement, and suddenly entered a battle stance.\nYour Junior Martial Sister, unaware that this was the kind of camaraderie and understanding that comes from male sparring, hastily jumped in to mediate, inquired about the reason, and felt secretly delighted.
他桃花運旺盛，竟然一次得了六位紅顏知己，言下頗有得意之色。\n你半點也不覺得奇怪，以瑞笙才貌武功，從前到處碰釘子，只能說是挑錯了對手，時運不濟，否則妻妾成群也非難事。\n本來說得好好的，可是瑞笙無心說了一句「未必便輸唐姑娘」，得罪了你這沒品的人，突然就進入戰鬥狀態，越打越好笑，搭住了肩膀哈哈大笑。\n比起碰著人就久仰久仰，他更希罕你這樣的朋友。=He has exceptionally good fortune in romance, having won over six beautiful confidantes at once, and his words carried a hint of pride.\nYou found it unsurprising at all; with Ruisheng's talent, martial arts, and good looks, his previous rejections were simply a matter of choosing the wrong people or lacking good timing—otherwise, a large harem would have been easily attainable.\nHe was speaking smoothly enough, but Ruisheng carelessly remarked, 「It's not guaranteed that you'd lose to Miss Tang」, offending you, a person lacking in refinement. Suddenly, he entered a combat stance, and the situation became increasingly amusing as you laughed heartily, slapping him on the shoulder.\nHe values having friends like you more than merely hearing of their renown.
\n小竹日漸與你相熟，也是會說笑的。=Xiao Zhu is gradually becoming familiar with you and can also be humorous.
\n小菊面有愧色向你請罪，她本來擬好方略，要利用全真、嵩山、點蒼、崆峒四派壓力煽動群情，迫使大會脫離朝廷掌控，助你登上武林盟主之位。\n萬料不到全真、全真二話不說便退出競爭，如此一來，處境相似甚至因為廣納各國流民，爭議有過之而無不及的崆峒派登時便站不住腳發聲，是以大會全程崆峒都默不吭聲。\n不幸中的大幸是南宮世家奪魁，按人情、地理，唐門料必無患，這才心下稍安。=Xiao Ju came to you shamefaced to confess. She had planned to use pressure from the Quanzhen, Songshan, Diancang, and Kongtong sects to stir the crowd and force the assembly free of the court's control, helping you rise to Wulin Alliance Leader. She never imagined that Quanzhen and Songshan would withdraw from the contest without a second thought, leaving Kongtong—caught in a similar bind, and more contentious still for having taken in refugees from every land—unable to find its footing to speak up. So for the whole assembly, Kongtong stayed silent. The one saving grace was that the Nangong Family carried the day; by both sentiment and geography, the Tang Clan should be safe from harm, which finally set her mind somewhat at ease.
你聽她言下之意，似對南宮世家讚譽有加，不由得憂心忡忡，怕她給南宮大公子拐了去。\n你試探得很委婉，可是小菊一葉知秋，頓時就知你心裡藏著什麼事，不由得暗暗好笑，又甜甜的頗為受用，還怕分隔數月之久，掌派人就見異思遷忘了自己。\n君子惡稱人之惡者，她本來雅不願抨擊別人，但為了表明心跡，毫不保留的剖明了自己對大公子的想法，有如滔滔江水般的怨言傾瀉而出，你聽得啞口無言，還道這位魏才女好說話，原來對人品要求如此嚴格，暗暗慶幸自己還算得上踏實，這才沒有被討厭。\n這席話她連摯友上官螢都沒透露過，畢竟大公子曾是上官螢的未婚妻。\n她嘴裡說的是別人的壞話，卻覺得自己把柄被你捉住了。=You caught the admiration in her words for the Nangong family, and couldn't help worrying she might be swept away by the Nangong family's eldest son. Your probing was carefully oblique, but Xiao Ju read the situation at a glance and knew at once what was on your mind—secretly amused, and rather pleased besides, though she also worried that after months apart, you might have grown fickle and forgotten her. A gentleman disdains to speak ill of others, and she herself was loath to criticize anyone, but to lay her heart bare she held nothing back, and her complaints about the eldest son poured out like a river in flood. You were left speechless—you'd thought this brilliant lady of Wei was easygoing, only to find her standards for character so exacting, and you quietly congratulated yourself for being steady enough not to have earned her dislike. She had never told even her closest friend, Shangguan Ying, any of this, since the eldest son had once been Shangguan Ying's betrothed. Though the words out of her mouth spoke ill of another, she felt as if you now held something over her.
魏菊與你說了一會兒話，見你沒有責難之意，終於放下心來。\n其實她這一來就不打算走了，按照約定，崆峒一切執掌都交接完畢，之所以沒帶包袱細軟過來只是怕你嫌棄而已，你若不嫌，那從今往後她便不再是魏掌門，只是你的小菊而已。=Wei Ju talked with you a while, and seeing you showed no sign of holding it against her, she finally relaxed. In truth, she had come meaning never to leave. As agreed, she had already handed over everything at Kongtong; she simply hadn't brought her belongings along, for fear you might not want her. If you didn't mind, then from today she would no longer be Sect Leader Wei—only your Xiaoju.
正道決出了武林盟主，唐門就算沒打算言聽計從，好歹也要走動走動，和各派打交道，彰顯存在感。=The Righteous Path had chosen its Wulin Alliance Leader, and even though the Tang Clan had no intention of obeying his every word, they still had to make the rounds, deal with the other sects, and remind everyone they existed.
\n你有意去拜見嵩山高僧，略表欽佩之情，迎面卻碰上福韞法師，勸你別去了。\n覺慧方丈性喜清靜，不與江湖中人結交。回山不久就要交卸衣缽，無意沾染凡塵。\n你想和嵩山僧人打交道，那跟他打交道不也一樣嗎？反正將來八九不離十，他會當上嵩山方丈。\n你吃了一驚，暗道這年輕僧人恁地狂妄，就算有野心，怎能當眾宣之於口？卻不想是你小看了他。\n福韞所以發下豪言，是深知身在其位方能有所作為，欲整飭僧眾，訂定字輩，發心振作，弘揚佛法，那就必須先掌權，以身作則，所以方丈之位，勢在必得。\n若有意往而諱其言，反倒不夠誠實了。\n待到大會結束以後，他昔日發願心起行將近十年的雲遊便告一段落，要回寺中精進佛法。\n你若不到嵩山來，下一面就不知會是許多年後了。\n你與他一僧一俗，可是頗為投緣，交往至今情誼不可謂淺，聞言不禁悵然。=You meant to pay your respects to the eminent monk of Songshan, to show a measure of admiration, but ran into Dharma Master Fu Yun on the way, who urged you not to go. You said you'd hoped to deal with the monks of Songshan—but wasn't dealing with him just the same thing? After all, it was all but certain he would become abbot of Songshan himself one day. Fu Yun spoke so boldly because he understood that only by holding the position could he accomplish anything: to reorganize the monks, set the generational naming order, rouse them to renewed spirit, and spread the Dharma, he would first have to hold power and lead by example—so the abbot's seat was something he meant to claim. If you did not come to Songshan, your next meeting might not be for many years. \n你到丐幫打招呼，李幫主也是年輕人，在武林大會上顯得忐忑又謹慎，見你過來滿臉堆笑迎了上來。=You went to greet the Beggar Sect. Gang Leader Li was a young man who appeared hesitant and cautious at the Wulin Assembly. When you approached, he greeted you with a beaming smile and came running up.
旋即發現你身邊的小菊，吃了一驚，低下頭去。\n原來李富貴從前家道尚未中落，也曾真的富貴過，隨狐朋狗友一塊兒慕名去詩會見過這位大才女，為她驚世才華傾倒。\n那時就自慚形穢，如今成了乞丐頭子，更是唯恐被她認出來。=He caught sight of Xiaoju at your side and flinched, startled, and lowered his head. 從前一起搶菜打鬧吃火鍋的大義分舵老朋友衝了出來，口裡罵著藍色混蛋，淚水卻盈滿眼眶，世事變化無常，有若白雲蒼狗。不單是唐門物是人非，他們丐幫大義分舵又何嘗不是呢？\n王幫主死去了，舊派老叫花重攬大權，刻意打壓，大義分舵如今死剩沒幾個舊人，與你相見，當真是恍如隔世。\n那情緒激動之下，自然要捶你幾拳，試試你是否依然如當年那樣抗打。=Old friends from the Dayi Branch—the ones who'd once scrapped over food and shared hot pot with you—came rushing out, cursing you as a Blue Devil, tears brimming in their eyes all the same. 葉雲裳見你挨打，立刻提棍子從背後給你來一下。\n她打你可是有深意的，料定你會一臉愕然回頭質問她，她便好當眾回答：「打是情，罵是愛。」所以她打你是提醒你自己心意，至於你丐幫朋友罵你藍色混蛋，顯然是愛你。\n此話一出，在場眾人登時啞口無言，再怎麼親暱也打不下去、罵不出口了。\n雲裳用她的法子保護了你。=Ye Yunshang saw you getting beaten and at once grabbed a staff to strike you from behind. 錦香宮殺人魔的鼎鼎大名，響徹江湖，自己幫眾當她作肥羊，坑、蒙、拐、騙，從她身上偷了不知多少錢財，這仇結得可深了，她不知道找誰報仇，找自己這個幫主償命，總之不會錯。\n牛頭馬面沒見過，真正的死神穿著白衣。萬一動上手，丐幫今日就得另選新幫主。\n李富貴霎時駭得臉色鐵青，連連後退，這活是不論如何不敢接了。=The name of the Murderous Demon of Jinxiang Palace rang through the Jianghu. 溫夫人見愛徒出手，不喜反怒，她好不容易才把龍湘趕走，保她平安，這天真的少女還是沉不住氣，匆匆趕回來送死，如何令她不怒。\n龍湘自幼失怙，是溫夫人一手帶大，名曰師徒，情同母女，極得偏寵，就算是處罰也從不責打。\n知道她怎麼勸也不會聽，溫夫人怎麼也不願她誤入歧途，唯有狠心出掌將她打醒，這一掌使了內力，下手頗重，龍湘猝不及防被印了一掌，當場內傷嘔血，騰騰退出幾步，滿臉不敢置信。\n龍湘再度被驅趕，感覺茫茫天地，再無一處是家。\n孤伶伶的站在遠處，不敢再靠近，也不捨離開。這一日風雨山陽光普照，可她往後餘生想起今天，總記得是狂風暴雨。=Lady Wen saw her beloved apprentice act, and instead of being pleased, she grew angry. 溫夫人忖度情勢，陣法以破，宮人死傷亦多，她更身受內傷，再使音波功也難力挽狂瀾，可以說是大局已定，深深長嘆一口氣，可是依然從容，自言納命可以，卻不甘死於刀劍之下，若朝廷與武林盟不能縱容人間道眾生離風雨山，一定要趕盡殺絕，那不如自己一把火帶走宮人，去也去得唯美。=Lady Wen assessed the situation: the formation was broken, many palace servants had died, and she herself was gravely wounded — even her Sound Wave Skill could not turn the tide. 當今天子趙擴欲和武林人重修舊好，便須立信於江湖，頒佈聖旨之前，特別點名唐門，吩咐上官隼務須格外包容，至少不能在武林大會上對唐門出手，否則江湖人士難免都有唇亡齒寒之憂。\n上官隼唯有強捺怒火，對你沉聲警告，你若識相便該急流勇退。\n溫夫人長長鬆了一口氣，竟也幫著勸你明哲保身，你已仁至義盡，再頑固也不過殉死而已，與其拖累你們，還不如就此作別，將一線曙光留在人間。=The reigning Emperor Zhao Kuo wished to make peace with the Wulin, and so had to earn trust in the Jianghu. 龍湘泣不成聲，死死拽著溫夫人的衣袖不肯鬆手，不捨就此分別，溫夫人微微一笑，替她梳攏髮絲，攜手便似從前，再走一小段路回家。=Long Xiang wept silently, gripping Lady Wen's sleeve tightly, unwilling to part ways. Lady Wen smiled gently, smoothing Long Xiang's hair, and together they walked a short distance home, just like before.

正當南宮遠左右為難，而上官隼逐漸不耐，想要快刀斬亂麻，將這群中毒之人全數殺死，避免情況更加惡化的時刻，忽然又有一個白袍貴婦施展輕功，躍入場中，高舉手中藥瓶，揚聲便說她有解藥，不必向妖人屈服。\n眾人定睛一看，無不錯愕難當，還道是眼花，眼前之人無論相貌、衣著、氣度、聲調，無不和溫夫人如出一轍，孿生姊妹都沒這般相像，對面一站，根本分不出真假。\n然而一個尖酸惡毒，欲以解藥要脅眾人服毒；一個正氣凜然，願意無償為大家施救，不論是誰都更願意相信後者才是本尊。\n而溫夫人亦親口證實了大家猜想，面露猙獰之色，似乎情急之下脫口而出，自曝了身份，當下眾人更無懷疑，都認定新來的溫夫人才是真正的錦香宮主。\n但聽溫夫人說她如何被人間道法王囚禁於錦香宮地底，連錦香宮人也是被屍心丹和魔音所操縱，而這妖女今日又想故技重施，迫害天下英雄，有她在此，絕計不能得逞。\n眾人聞此言，無不歡呼，方才為了乞命變節的人也紛紛改口，為了自清，不住口宣稱自己也是被人間道法王以魔音所惑，方才說的都做不得準。\n溫夫人聽了只是肚裡暗笑，往後用不著宮人自證，這些中計的江湖成名俠客也會拼命為錦香宮人辯白。\n面上卻得裝出詭計被破壞、氣急敗壞、惱羞成怒的模樣，指著眼前易容成自己的畫中仙破口大罵，咒得雖然狠毒，卻都指名道姓蘇迎香，罵的全是自己。\n她說：「妳這該死的賤婦！早在二十年前，就應該清白的死去！」，又說「我留妳一條賤命，苟延殘喘至今，妳竟不知道感激！人盡可夫的蕩婦！」無一不是對自己的痛責、詛咒。\n畫中仙自己挨罵都沒有聽她自責難受，與溫夫人拆招鬥將起來。=Just as Nangong Yuan and his companions found themselves in a difficult position, and Shangguan Sun grew increasingly impatient, wanting to cut through the chaos and kill the poisoned individuals to prevent the situation from worsening, suddenly another noblewoman in white robes used her Qinggong to leap into the midst, raising a medicinal potion and proclaiming she had the antidote, and there was no need to yield to the demons.\nEveryone examined her closely, all astonished and disbelieving, thinking they were seeing things.
