To flee, even if you live, is as if you have died. But with a clear conscience, unashamed before heaven and earth, even if condemned by thousands and opposed by all, let them be nothing but wind.
\n唐門一身傲骨，但也不是明知必死還自尋死路，知其不可而為之，不見得都有好下場。\n你們早想過遲早會有今日，只是誰也不先開口，就怕心氣散了，再也聚還不來。唐門列祖列宗泉下有知，都拊膺頓足，戟指罵你們後代子孫不肖，成了千古罪人。\n苦苦挨到了今日，終究必須夢醒。\n不是所有故事都有轟轟烈烈的結局，多數時候，會平淡而悲哀，抱著遺憾老去。=The Tang Clan, proud as it is, would not knowingly walk a road that led to certain death. Doing what one knows cannot be done does not always end well. You all knew this day would come, but no one dared speak first, fearing that once their resolve scattered, it would never come together again. If the ancestors of the Tang Clan could see this from beneath the earth, they would clutch their chests in grief, stamp their feet, and jab accusing fingers, cursing you, their descendants, as unworthy—eternal sinners. Having endured until today, you had at last to wake from the dream. Not every story ends in glory; most fade quietly and sadly, growing old with nothing but regret.
\n唐門不奉武林盟號令，亦不向官府折腰。\n但剿滅魔教，護黎民百姓免受妖邪所害，卻是義不容辭。\n從前舊魔教為禍中原，掌門也曾率門人挺身而出，而今風波再起，你輩新人亦不能讓武林盟專美於前，決定響應號召，共赴六道峽決戰。=The Tang Clan answers to no command from the Wulin Alliance, nor bows to the officials. But wiping out the Demon Cult and protecting the common folk from evil is a duty none can shirk. In the old days, the Old Demon Cult brought ruin to the Central Plains, and the Sect Leader once led his own disciples to stand against them. Now that the storm was rising again, your generation would not let the Wulin Alliance claim all the glory—you decided to answer the call and join the battle at Six Paths Gorge.
意見相持，於是你們按照唐門傳統美德，推門出去手底功夫見真章。\n無論誰主張什麼，打輸了就當沒有意見。=Opinions reached an impasse, so, true to Tang Clan tradition, you settled it with your fists instead. Whoever lost the bout was deemed to have no opinion at all.
四師兄也來參戰，虛晃幾招意思意思，沒人碰他一根汗毛，他卻主動湊上來撞人，驚呼一聲：「好強的內力！」然後倒滾出去，爬起來還兀自氣喘吁吁，一臉不甘心的模樣。=Fourth Senior Brother also came to join the battle, feinting a few moves just for show. No one touched a strand of his hair, yet he proactively rushed in to collide with someone, exclaiming, Such powerful internal force! Then he rolled back and got up, still breathing heavily, looking thoroughly unwilling.
小師妹毫不留情與你一國，三師兄當場就想高舉雙手投降，可是身為代掌門，不打又不行，委屈得要命。=The Junior Martial Sister showed no mercy, siding entirely with you. The Third Senior Brother wanted to throw up his hands and surrender on the spot, but as Acting Sect Leader he could hardly refuse to fight, and felt utterly wronged for it.
\n王幫主、溫夫人的遺策為你們撥雲見日，眼前豁然開朗。\n號召不服官府號令的江湖遊俠，組成西武林盟抗衡武林盟，必將使中原動盪，敗了非但唐門覆滅，更將牽連旁人，成則有望東西對立，加上泥教形成三足鼎立的局勢，互相制衡。\n不是為了打破僵局，而是為了將對手拖入僵局。\n如此一來武林盟才會追尋爭鬥以外的路。=Gang Leader Wang and Lady Wen's legacy plan parted the clouds and let the light through, laying everything bare before you. By rallying Jianghu wanderers who defied official authority to form a Western Wulin Alliance against the Wulin Alliance, it would surely stir turmoil across the Central Plains. Failure would not only doom the Tang Clan but drag others down with it; success might set East against West, and with the Mud Cult added, form a three-way balance, each side checking the others. The aim was not to break the stalemate, but to drag the enemy into one — so the Wulin Alliance would be forced to seek a path beyond conflict.
\n菊坐鎮崆峒玄功門時，便曾逆料過江湖局勢，錦香宮易主、南宮遠之逝雖然始料未及，但武林盟結成，受官府驅使向唐門施壓，卻是另一回事。\n為了防止事情惡化到不能收拾的地步，她在你不知情的時候四處奔走，不單編造歌謠傳唱，彰顯你崆峒掌派人神授天命的威光，替你鞏固形象；又以崆峒不得不有唇亡齒寒之慮，苦口婆心勸服崆峒三掌門齊心扶佐。\n而後更以第一掌派夫人之命調用丹霞子，在鐵棋嶺布置沙盤，反覆推演，才終於得出此計。\n號召不服官府號令的江湖遊俠，組成西武林盟抗衡武林盟，必將使中原動盪，敗了非但唐門覆滅，更將牽連旁人，成則有望東西對立，加上泥教形成三足鼎立的局勢，互相制衡。\n不是為了打破僵局，而是為了將對手拖入僵局。\n如此一來武林盟才會追尋爭鬥以外的路。=When she presided over the Kongtong Mystic Skill Gate, she had foreseen the shifting dynamics of the Jianghu. The Jinxiang Palace's change in leadership and Nangong Yuan's demise, though unforeseen, were secondary to the formation of the Wulin Alliance, which was manipulated by the authorities to pressure the Tang Clan. To prevent the situation from spiraling out of control, she acted without your knowledge, spreading songs that highlighted your divine mandate as the Kongtong sect's leader, reinforcing your image. She also used the mutual dependence of the sects to persuade the three sect leaders to unite and support you. Later, she dispatched Danxiazi under the authority of the First Sect Leader's wife to set up a sand table at Iron Chess Ridge, repeatedly simulating scenarios until she devised this plan. By rallying outlaws who defied the authorities to form the Western Wulin Alliance, she aimed to create a confrontation with the existing Wulin Alliance, causing chaos in Central Plains. If they failed, not only would the Tang Clan be destroyed, but others would also be dragged into the conflict. Success would mean a division between East and West, with the Mud Cult forming a tripartite balance, each checking the others. It wasn't to break the stalemate, but to drag the opponent into it. Only then would the Wulin Alliance seek alternatives beyond conflict.
\n唐門一身傲骨不怕死，但也不是犯賤明知必死還趕著投胎，有得一拼，哪個甘心引頸就戮？\n你在會中一語驚人，累積至今的學問成為燈、成為劍，替師門指向前路。\n號召不服官府號令的江湖遊俠，組成西武林盟抗衡武林盟，必將使中原動盪，敗了非但唐門覆滅，更將牽連旁人，成則有望東西對立，加上泥教形成三足鼎立的局勢，互相制衡。\n不是為了打破僵局，而是為了將對手拖入僵局。\n如此一來武林盟才會追尋爭鬥以外的路。=Tang Clan stands with an unbowed spirit, unafraid of death. But they are not those who recklessly court certain doom, knowing the end is inevitable yet rushing toward it. Given a chance to fight, who would willingly bow their neck to the blade? Your single remark at the assembly stunned everyone; all the learning you had gathered became a lamp, became a sword, pointing the way forward for your sect. You rallied rogue heroes of Jianghu who reject official rule, forming the Western Wulin Alliance to oppose the Wulin Alliance. This was sure to stir turmoil across the Central Plains. Defeat would not only bring the Tang Clan's downfall but also drag others into the mire. Should they succeed in setting East against West, adding the Mud Cult as a third force could form a three-way balance of power, each checking the other. Not to break the stalemate, but to ensnare their rivals within it. Only then would the Wulin Alliance seek paths beyond mere strife.
\n你半開玩笑的提議了乾脆直接投靠魔教，借泥教的力量抵禦武林盟的進攻。=You half‑jokingly suggested simply defecting to the Demon Cult and using the Mud Cult's power to counter the Wulin Alliance's attack.
當然是立刻被否決了。=Of course, it was rejected at once.
閒聊之際，說起你曾見過餓鬼道法王劉顎的事情。\n你刻意隱瞞了你和劉顎聯手對南嵩山住持施暴的惡行。=During casual conversation, they mentioned how you had once seen the Dharma King Liu E of the Hungry Ghost Path. You deliberately concealed your involvement in the violent assault on the South Songshan abbot that you committed with Liu E.
\n你到煉丹房中，想起從前給二師兄使喚、斥責的日子，那樣嚴厲的人，偶爾也有耐心的時候。\n他背叛唐門確實罪無可赦，可是如今再想，都似過眼雲煙，恩也好、怨也好，都將隨夢散了。=You stood in the alchemy room, recalling the days when you were forced to serve and be berated by the Second Senior Brother. That strict man occasionally had moments of patience. His betrayal of the Tang Clan was indeed unforgivable, but now, thinking back, it all seemed fleeting as clouds. Whether kindness or resentment, they would all fade with the dream.
你嘔心瀝血，完成了二師兄的研究，令主爐中的萬壽屍心丹得以現世，但是到頭來誰也救不了。=You poured your heart and soul into completing the Second Senior Brother's research, allowing the Longevity Corpse Heart Pill in the main furnace to emerge into the world, but in the end, it could save no one.
主爐的火終年不輟，始終等不到出爐之日。\n縱有起死回生之靈效，也救不了唐門。=The fire in the main furnace burned on, year after year, yet the day it could be drawn from the furnace never came. Even with the power to raise the dead, it could not save the Tang Clan.
這話葉雲裳可不能當作沒聽見。\n煉丹房裡的丹藥救不了唐門，但是千錘百煉成就的你，卻救了她。\n你聽了又悲又喜，你救了雲裳，而她沒有死去這件事也保護了你的心。=Ye Yunshang could not pretend she hadn't heard this. The pills from the alchemy room could not save the Tang Clan, but you, forged through a thousand trials, saved her. Hearing this, you felt both sorrow and joy: you had saved Yunshang, and the fact that she lived on protected your heart in turn.
\n你到正心堂中探望掌門，叩謝當年收留之恩，無論世俗如何議論，在你心中，唯有他是真正的大俠。=You went to Zhengxin Hall to call upon the Sect Leader, and knelt in thanks for the shelter he gave you all those years ago. No matter what the world may say of him, in your heart, he alone is a true Great Hero.
\n你到講經樓中，發現小菊正在寫字，她到唐門雖然時日尚淺，但愛屋及烏，亦不捨你的家園就此敗破，唯恐人去樓空，諸多典籍殘缺失佚，於是自發節錄一些精要，好讓後人知曉唐門故事。\n她也想寫下你的事，寫一個爹不疼、娘不愛的孤兒怎樣臥薪嘗膽、逆風而行。沒有轟轟烈烈的結局也無妨，能夠與她白頭到老，作她一人的英雄足矣。\n有朝一日這個故事寫完了，應該取名叫作《活俠傳》。=You went to the Scripture Hall and found Xiaoju writing. She had joined the Tang Clan only recently, but loving you, she loved your home in turn, and could not bear to see it fall to ruin. Fearing that once everyone was gone the hall would stand empty and its books lost or crumbled to pieces, she had begun copying out the essential passages herself, so that those who came after would know the story of the Tang Clan. She wanted to write your story too — of an orphan loved by neither father nor mother, who endured hardship and pressed on against the wind. It need not end in glory; to grow old at her side and be her hero alone would be enough. One day, when the story was finished, it should be called Legend of Mortal.
\n你到講經樓中，上官螢正在指揮師弟妹們清點樓中藏書、字畫，得三師兄授意，她憑著往日人脈與信用，估了價請呂員外將大院中一切事物典押，換得現錢，分贈唐門師兄弟姊妹作為盤纏。\n反正唐門貴重的從來不是這些陳舊事物，來日她再努力掙錢來贖便是。\n即便你用不著，放著一切如舊供你緬懷也好。=You arrived at the Scripture Hall, where Shangguan Ying was directing the junior disciples in cataloguing the hall's books and paintings. At Third Senior Brother's suggestion, she drew on old connections and her own good name to have everything in the courtyard appraised, then asked Squire Lü to take it all in pawn, turning it into ready cash to hand out to the Tang Clan disciples as travel funds. The Tang Clan had never set store by such old possessions anyway; she would work hard to redeem them another day. Even if you had no use for them, it was just as well to leave everything as it was, kept for you to remember.
\n你到講經樓中，浮塵沐在晨光裡飄遊，彷彿一切如舊，翻開書頁，還有大師兄兒時塗鴉。\n你連忙闔上，唯恐淚珠落下，糊了故人墨跡。=You went to the Scripture Hall, where motes of dust drifted through the morning light as if nothing had changed. You opened a book and found Eldest Senior Brother's childhood scribbles still inside. You quickly closed it, afraid a falling tear might smear the old ink of a friend now gone.
\n你在伙房中碰見小梅，她正在炒菜，不想浪費這許多儲糧，便是一時吃不下，好歹也要捏成飯糰、烘成乾糧，讓大家帶著路上慢用。\n見你實在悶悶不樂的樣子，小梅亦心有戚戚焉，她都尚且不捨，更是無法衡量你的悲傷。\n自認沒本事維繫師門不散，但卻願意陪你赴湯蹈火，誰欺負了唐門，你倆屆時蒙面去找誰晦氣便了。=You encountered Xiaomei in the kitchen, where she was cooking. Not wanting to waste all this stored grain, she thought that even if they couldn't eat it all at once, they could still shape it into rice balls and dry them into rations for everyone to carry along the journey. Seeing your genuinely melancholic expression, Xiaomei felt the same way; she herself was reluctant to part with it, let alone understand the depth of your sorrow. Though she acknowledged her own inability to uphold the Tang Clan's unity, she was willing to stand by you through any hardship. If anyone dared to harm the Tang Clan, you two could mask your faces and go find trouble for them.
\n你來到伙房，這處說來還是你能從外堡被拔擢進入大院的契機之一。\n從前唐門人多，伙房要供應吃食，忙起來的時候，恨不得人人都有三條手臂。又有道是君子遠庖廚，雖說原意是指君子應懷仁心，不忍殺生，但禮記原話便說得委婉，後遭人曲解當作不下廚的藉口，也是理所當然的發展。\n於是你這不必練功、看著也沒啥天賦的外姓弟子，就終於被人盯上，拔到大院中當伙房供人使喚。\n起初你笨手笨腳，經常挨揍。\n就算挑不出你的毛病，也得罵幾句，否則師兄們會覺得心底不大痛快。\n不知不覺，罵你的聲音越來越小，舊人走光，竟輪到你來掌勺。\n今後唐門散了，你再也不必貪黑起床，洗米生火煮飯。=You arrived at the kitchen, which was one of the reasons you were promoted from the Outer Fort to the main hall. The Tang Clan had many disciples, and the kitchen had to supply food. When things got busy, they wished everyone had three arms. There's an old saying, A gentleman keeps away from the kitchen, originally meaning a gentleman should have compassion and refrain from killing, but the original words from the Book of Rites were more subtle. It was later misinterpreted as an excuse to avoid cooking, a development that was only natural. Thus, you, an outsider with no need to practice and seemingly no talent, finally caught their attention and were moved to the main hall to serve in the kitchen. At first, you were clumsy and often got beaten. Even if they couldn't find faults in you, they'd still scold you a few words, otherwise the Senior Brothers would feel uneasy. Gradually, the scolding grew quieter. As the old disciples left, it was finally your turn to be the one in charge of the stove. After the Tang Clan disperses, you'll no longer have to wake up at dawn, wash rice, start a fire, and cook.
\n弟子房中，師兄弟們都面帶徬徨之色，今日起不必練功了，反而茫然若失。\n商量起今後去處，有些人還戀棧江湖，不死心想投別派；有些人厭倦了，想回家再作打算；有些人本就有家可歸，拜師唐門對自己的青春有了交代，如今自然要走回爹娘為他鋪好的康莊大道。\n那麼你呢？你無家可歸，夢想已經不能實現，接下來的事想好了嗎？=In the Disciples' Quarters, the brothers all wore expressions of confusion. Starting today, there was no need to practice martial arts, leaving them feeling lost and aimless. They began discussing their future paths; some were still attached to Jianghu, unwilling to give up on joining another sect; others were weary and wanted to return home to reconsider their plans; some already had a home to go back to, having fulfilled their youth by joining the Tang Clan, and now naturally wanted to return to the broad road paved by their parents. So what about you? You have no home to return to, your dreams can no longer be realized. Have you thought about what comes next?
\n你聽見鍛冶場依然叮叮噹噹，循聲去看，只見小竹此刻依然敲敲打打。\n她想造有輪的椅車，想讓將來三師兄可以偶爾推掌門出去曬曬太陽、吹吹風。\n見你過來，鐵也不打了，笨拙如她，胸無韜略，連安慰人的話都組織不好，身為第一掌派夫人，卻一點忙也幫不上，時時慚愧自責。\n只能把矮小身子挨你身上，試圖支撐你。=You heard the forge still clanging, so you followed the sound and saw Xiaozhu still hammering away. She wanted to craft a wheeled cart, so that in the future, Third Senior Brother could occasionally push the sect leader out to bask in the sun and breeze. When you approached, she stopped hammering. Clumsy and lacking in strategy, she couldn't even form comforting words. As the first sect leader's wife, she could do nothing to help, constantly feeling ashamed and self‑reproachful. She could only press her small body against yours, trying to support you.
\n你到鍛冶場中，感慨萬千。此處造出無數兵刃、木甲，有些造福鄉梓，有些為禍人間，可是器物本來無分善惡，端看人如何使用。\n人若失了心，一味盲從，那麼和器物也沒多大區別了不是嗎？\n武林盟甚至不是唐門的仇家，只是一件大型兵器而已，揮劍的人是當朝官家。\n誰說他昏庸的？這一手豈不是挺狠辣的嗎。=You arrive at the forge, filled with myriad feelings. Here countless weapons and wooden armor were crafted—some benefited the villages, others brought ruin upon the world, yet objects themselves hold no good or evil; it all depends on how they are used. If a person loses their heart and blindly follows, are they truly any different from the objects themselves? The Wulin Alliance isn't even the Tang Clan's true enemy; it is merely a great weapon, and the one wielding it is the emperor himself. Who says he is inept? Isn't this move rather ruthless indeed?
\n你信步在大院閒遊，佇足於女弟子房前，感慨萬千。\n師娘撒手人寰之前，託你照顧小師妹，別讓她寂寞。\n頭幾年小師妹思念娘親，夜夜啼哭，都是你在窗下守護，即便是女弟子房中空無一人的時候，也永遠有你在畔。\n直到她修練天地無聲勢有成，把心冰鎮，收住了哭聲，從此面無表情，你才敢漸漸離遠。=You leisurely stroll through the courtyard, pausing before the Women's Quarters, filled with myriad emotions. Before the Master's Wife passed away, she entrusted you to care for Junior Martial Sister, so she wouldn't be lonely. In the first few years, Junior Martial Sister missed her mother and cried every night; it was you who kept watch beneath her window, and even when the Women's Quarters stood empty, you were always there by her side. Only once she mastered the Heaven and Earth Silent Power, froze her heart, and stilled her tears—from then on wearing no expression at all—did you dare to gradually distance yourself.
正緬懷過往，小師妹本人就推門出來，她可能是世上最念舊的人，雖然不說，卻記著你從前的耐心陪伴，也曾目睹你多次被抓包毒打，當時不曾細想，如今才體悟你的苦心，對你既有純潔無垢的傾慕之情，亦有無窮感激。=Just as you reminisce about the past, Junior Martial Sister herself pushes the door open. She might be the most sentimental soul in the world—though she never said it, she has remembered your patient company all these years, and has also witnessed you caught and beaten more than once. At the time she thought little of it, but now she understands the depth of your devotion, and feels for you both a pure, unsullied admiration and boundless gratitude.
她回首一生除了至親，最重的寶物莫過於你，和雲裳的遺贈而已。\n想要緊緊抓在小小手心，其他的什麼都不要了。=She looked back on her life and realized that apart from her dearest ones, the most precious treasure was nothing more than you and the inheritance from Yunshang. She wanted to clutch you tightly in her little hands, nothing else mattered.
正緬懷過往，雲裳就推門出來見你，指責你眼神不正派。=Just reminiscing about the past, Yunshang pushed the door open and came out to see you, reprimanding you for your improper gaze.
你變心對別的女子示好，她看在眼裡，懷恨於心，想狠狠報復，又始終不忍心，有時釋懷，有時越想越氣，對你自然沒啥好臉色。=You change your heart towards another woman, she sees it all, harboring resentment, wanting to retaliate fiercely, yet always can't bear to do so. Sometimes she lets go, sometimes she grows angrier, naturally having a sour expression towards you.

你二話不說就掏出家當，上官螢只作苦笑，還想你一人積蓄還頂什麼用，可是沉甸甸的銀子拿在手裡，立刻就動容色變，掂了掂便知起碼有三十兩銀子。\n時農工商販之家，朝得百金，暮必盡用，博弈飲酒，以快一時，一有不繼，立見饑凍。\n時人每日工價不過百來文錢，賣魚的窮苦一點，一日甚至不足百文，你一出手便是三十兩，那便是三十貫，三萬文錢，足夠升斗小民一年開銷。\n放在從前，上官螢自然不屑一顧，而今她被逐出上官世家，身無分文，陡然拿到這筆錢財，只覺又驚又喜。\n她也知道你這些錢財來之不易，卻為她的私心義無反顧的交到自己手裡，霎時鼻頭也酸了，有你撐腰，似得千軍萬馬助陣，彷彿一切必將水到渠成，事情還沒著手，就篤定絕對能行。=You didn't say a word before pulling out your belongings. \n四師兄出使丐幫大義分舵，可惜鎩羽而歸。=Fourth Senior Brother was sent on a mission to the Beggar Sect's Dayi Branch, but unfortunately returned in disgrace.
帶上了樊嘯天，卻險些雙雙命喪狼窟。=Taking along Fan Xiaotian, they nearly both perished in the wolf den.
原來那大義分舵的新舵主是丐幫長老派來的奸細，為的便是監督大義分舵，一拿到話柄，便能打著肅清內賊的口號，清除新派黨羽。\n埋伏在側的大仁分舵一進廟來便灑石灰粉，打了大義群丐一個措手不及，那群老派乞丐更是毫不留情，掄棒便往自家弟兄頭殼猛砸，存心殺人。\n若非四師兄機智報官攪局，只怕大義分舵的朋友一個也不能倖免。\n在那之後，大義群丐心灰意冷，什麼俠義云云都是曇花一現的美夢，跟隨王幫主時風光無兩，便當乞丐也有尊嚴、傲氣，待到掌聲消停，仍舊鶉衣百結，目不識丁。\n他們就此散了，或往西，或往南，沒設想目的地，只想遠離丐幫能及範圍，遠離江湖，遠離宋國傷心地。=The new leader of the Dayi Branch was actually a spy sent by the Beggar Sect's elders to keep watch over it, so that at the first excuse he could raise the banner of purging traitors and wipe out the new faction. After that, the Dayi Branch beggars lost heart — all talk of chivalry, they now knew, was a fleeting dream. 四師兄出使丐幫大義分舵歸來，一臉餘悸猶存的模樣。\n原來那大義分舵的新舵主是丐幫長老派來的奸細，為的便是監督大義分舵，一拿到話柄，便能打著肅清內賊的口號，清除新派黨羽。\n所幸者是他為人太過不沉穩，自到大義分舵，群丐對他這個舵主總是愛搭不理，對四師兄這個外人卻當自家兄弟一樣熱切招待，又是喝酒吃肉，又是勾肩搭背，不由得怒從心起，出言相譏，盛怒之下脫口洩漏機密，當場被識破身份。\n這一來，等若是把大義分舵逼上絕路，大義群丐便是不反，也得要反。\n四師都不用勸，他們就紛紛投靠唐門。=Fourth Senior Brother returned from his mission to the Beggars' Sect's Dayi Branch, looking visibly shaken.\nIt turned out that the new leader of the Dayi Branch was a spy sent by the elder faction of the Beggars' Sect, intended to oversee the branch and, upon gaining a key piece of information, to use the guise of purging internal traitors to eliminate the new faction's supporters.\nFortunately, he was too lacking in composure. 丐幫別的未必能有，最強便是人多，單是一個大義分舵，人數就未必少於唐門。四師兄將人帶到外堡，讓擔任外堡護衛的葉雲舟安排食宿，甩手就跑，沒見著他委屈的表情。=The Beggar Sect might lack other strengths, but its greatest one is numbers — the Dayi Branch alone was easily as many people as the whole Tang Clan. Fourth Senior Brother brought them to the Outer Fort and left Ye Yunzhou, who was guarding it, to arrange their food and lodging, then took off without a backward glance, never seeing the wronged look on his face.
丐幫別的未必能有，最強便是人多，單是一個大義分舵，人數就未必少於唐門。四師兄將人帶到外堡安置，空屋不夠，也難不倒這群乞丐，在外堡周圍就地搭起了棚子，不消片刻，新的大義分舵就建好了。=The Beggar Sect might lack other strengths, but its greatest one is numbers — the Dayi Branch alone was easily as many people as the whole Tang Clan. 那外堡是唐門祖先所建沒錯，可也是唐門祖先無德敗家給賣了。\n地契如今握在唐門債主呂員外手裡，租賃給鄉人，四師兄猝然將一群乞丐帶去，呂員外聞言只氣炸了肺，但又怕群丐不似唐門講理，都當乞丐了哪有幹不出來的事兒？逼急了放火燒你家都不奇怪。有倒是識時務者為俊傑，只得忍氣吞聲。=It is true that the outer fortress was built by the Tang Clan's ancestors, but it was also sold due to their ancestors' lack of virtue and mismanagement.\nThe deed is now held by Lü Yuanwai, the Tang Clan's creditor, who leases it to local farmers. When the Fourth Senior Brother brought a group of beggars there, Lü Yuanwai was infuriated by the news, but he also feared that the beggars wouldn't act reasonably – after all, what couldn't beggars do? 上官螢出馬，一頓搬弄是非，將群丐說是特意請來保護呂翁家業的，他才喜笑顏開，怨氣一掃而空，反而千恩萬謝，好酒好肉招待，群丐受寵若驚，虛榮心得到滿足，紛紛都拍胸脯保證定會護呂翁一家老小周全。\n達成了一個皆大歡喜的局面。=Shangguan Ying stepped in herself, and with a little clever talk spun the story so the beggars were said to have been specially hired to guard Lu Weng's estate. 於是丐幫老派得償所願，將新派主力驅逐出幫，大義分舵不復存在，取而代之的是唐門忽然多了一大票外姓弟子。=So the old faction of the Beggar Sect got their wish, driving the new faction's main strength out of the sect. The Dayi Branch was no more, and in its place the Tang Clan suddenly found itself with a great many disciples from outside the family.
\n福韞出使峨嵋歸來，捎回捷報，說服了向掌門。\n峨嵋願與唐門共進退，武林盟興師之日，會挺身而出，負責阻斷點蒼北征之路。=Fu Yun returned from his mission to Emei, bringing good news: he had won over Sect Leader Xiang. \n你替三師兄代班，暫掌職務，端的是苦不堪言。\n還道當上掌門可以翹著二郎腿無所事事，沒曾想日日都有難解的題纏你頭上。\n一會兒要記帳，一會兒要書信應酬各幫各派首領，一會兒得煩心債務，一會兒是唐門產業出了什麼問題，一會兒煉丹房向你請求派人支援採藥，一會兒哪裡用度不足向你請款，一會兒柴米油鹽又沒了，一會兒鍛冶場失火，一會兒棧道崩了，一會兒下雨山路塌了，一會兒地磚裂了，一會兒吃錯假藥的民眾向唐門索賠，一會兒師弟妹來請教武功，一會兒同門打架尋你仲裁，一會兒同門師弟妹兩情相悅想要成親。\n你每日忙完自己的事，還要煩心這許多瑣事，簡直欲哭無淚。\n一聽人通報說三師兄回來，你忙不迭丟下手裡的活前去迎接，從沒這麼盼能見他一面，好把活丟還給他。=You are filling in for Third Senior Brother, temporarily taking on the duties, and it truly is a burden beyond words. 任憑唐衫絞盡腦汁，想方設法，也無緣見到一面。\n正當此時，忽聞山中鐘鳴之聲，峨嵋知客弟子齊聲誦唸佛號。\n他忽然心生感悟，索性什麼也不想了，盤腿便在山門坐下。\n自知從前種種無法挽回，並非不愧，之所以不跪，是不敢墮師門威風，雖然不跪，但要表示虔誠，還有別的方法。\n於是他開始不吃不喝、不眠不休讀誦佛經，將熟讀在心的經文都背過一遍，誦完了又重誦一遍，日夜不輟，直至終於透支體力，暈倒過去，醒來就在峨嵋山上了。\n向掌門感其心誠，終於接見，聽他娓娓道盡經緯，才從另一側面瞭解，對唐門的敵意消散了大半。\n只是他雖痛心武林同道相互攻伐，有違南宮大俠遺志，卻也不願公然和武林盟撕破臉，讓峨嵋弟子因為一己之見，陷身水火煎熬，故此決定兩不相幫。=No matter how Tang Shan racked his brains for a way in, he found no chance to meet him. Something in him suddenly stirred; he stopped thinking of anything at all and simply sat down cross-legged at the mountain gate. 任憑唐衫絞盡腦汁，想方設法，也無緣見到一面。\n正當此時，與他同行的唐嬌嬌突然出手傷人，一拳打扁了知客弟子的臉，強闖上山，唐衫驚慌失措，卻又不能不管，只得跟上，陪她一路打到峨嵋大殿之前，攔不住她出口傷人，也不知她從前在峨嵋究竟什麼位份，那群峨嵋弟子見了唐嬌嬌居然都面有畏怖之色，便是向掌門在她跟前，也沒有掌門架子，解無塵更是把人推出來就躲得老遠。\n可是唐嬌嬌竟不領情，好不容易見著了向掌門卻不讓人說話，亂拳砰砰轟在向無憂身上，唐衫直駭得魂飛天外，以為那日便是自己死期。=No matter how hard Tang Shan racked his brains, he found no chance to see him. 唐門內戰當時，你倆曾經交手，如今你功力固然遠非習比，他亦沒有原地踏地，痛定思痛更下苦功，更被唐嬌嬌摧殘多時，功力大進。\n可惜仍不及你，一番劇鬥之後，仍舊敗於你手，卻似從你行招走式之間確信了什麼事情，敗得一臉坦然。\n他憑自身才智隱約窺見了武學至理的皮毛，窮究到底便是無招無式，體現在世，便是你。\n若在平時，他是不論如何也不敢當面問你，但是唐門大劫當前，顧不得臉面，說不得也只好靦著臉向你請益。=During the Tang Clan internal conflict, you two once clashed. 武學奧義，本來人人自秘，不說各派嚴防他人偷師，便是師父傳授弟子，藏招留一手也屢見不鮮。\n防人之心不可無，你推託敷衍，不肯洩漏，倒也不算心黑。\n他不怪你，只是心下長嘆，告辭而去。=The essence of martial arts is originally kept secret by each individual; not to mention the fact that each sect strictly prevents others from stealing their techniques, even when a master teaches a disciple, it's common for the master to hide a few moves. It's wise to be cautious of others. You're not being unscrupulous by hesitating and being evasive. He doesn't blame you, but he sighs deeply and leaves.
武學奧義，本來人人自秘，不說各派嚴防他人偷師，便是師父傳授弟子，藏招留一手也屢見不鮮。\n若在平時，你也未必肯說，但為師門故，你遲疑片刻，就將畢生所悟傾囊相授，那日在後山得自蒙面前輩的恩惠，又傳承旁人。\n唐衫只聽得熱淚盈眶，渾身打戰，想向你下跪磕頭，卻被攔住。\n他亦投桃報李，將難能可貴的機緣分贈予你，得自峨嵋劍獄的神功《心劍・雷神腳》他雖還練不成，但你說不定有緣練成，以此捍衛唐門。\n你倆相識一笑，此際才算真正盡棄前嫌。=Martial arts secrets are kept close by everyone, and it is no different among the sects — they guard fiercely against theft of their techniques, and even a master teaching a disciple will often hold something back. At any other time, you might not have been willing to share yours either, but for the sect's sake, you hesitate only a moment before pouring out a lifetime of insight. That day on the back mountain, you received a boon from a masked senior, and now you pass it on to another. Tang Shan listens with tears welling in his eyes, his whole body trembling, wanting to kneel and kowtow to you, but you stop him. He repays the kindness in kind, sharing with you a rare fortune of his own — the divine technique won from Emei's Sword Prison, Heart Sword · Thunder God Kick. He has yet to master it himself, but you might have the fortune to succeed where he could not, and wield it to defend the Tang Clan. \n三師兄名聲雖不如大師兄響亮，畢竟執掌掌門，提起他「儒俠」唐陞的，也多是讚美之詞。向掌門對心氣高遠，向來不與白丁為伍，對品德高尚的仁人志士卻又推崇備至，恨不能結交，三師兄人剛到峨嵋地界便有峨嵋弟子在山下集市相迎，向掌門更親至山腰迎接。\n雖然一人學儒，一人學佛，倒也算是投緣，一番長談下來，對唐門種種成見瓦解，但向無憂身為一派掌門，卻不能因一己喜惡，將峨嵋上下捲入是非。\n是以決定袖手兩不相幫。\n三師兄此行雖不能說服峨嵋，卻也不算白跑一趟，峨嵋不響應武林盟，包圍之勢勢必難成，意義不可謂不大。=Third Senior Brother's reputation isn't as renowned as Senior Brother's, after all, being the Head of the Sect. When mentioning the 「Scholar-Martial」 Tang Sheng, praise is more common. Grand Protector values lofty ideals and rarely associates with commoners, yet holds those of noble character in high esteem, wishing he could befriend them. When Third Senior Brother arrived in the Emei region, Emei disciples greeted him at the foot of the mountain, and Grand Protector himself came to meet him on the mid-mountain.\nThough one studied Confucianism and the other Buddhism, they were naturally compatible. 話剛說完，解無塵便落在練武場中央。\n向無憂雖然決定兩不相幫，可解無塵卻未必肯聽，反正忤逆掌門命令這檔事兒，他與你大師兄都沒少幹過，較勁似的拼命給自家掌門添亂，也不差這一樁。=No sooner were the words out than Xie Wuchen dropped down into the center of the Training Ground. Xiang Wuyou had decided to side with neither, but Xie Wuchen was in no mood to listen — defying the Sect Leader's orders was something he and your Eldest Senior Brother had done plenty of times before. Like rivals competing to see who could give their own Sect Leader more trouble, this would be no exception.
還待說些豪言壯語，忽然眼前藍影一晃，夏侯蘭冷著臉現身，將他捉走。\n解無塵遭到生命威脅，勒令不許拿他和唐布衣那套處世之道污染你，她好不容易才有喜愛之人，人生又有一些渺茫希望，不想你太莽撞早死。=Still meaning to deliver some grand parting words, he suddenly saw a flash of blue before his eyes — Xiahou Lan appeared, cold-faced, and hauled him away. \n四師兄出使青城歸來，無奈憑他和鄒掌門的忘年交情，也沒能帶回佳音。\n風雨山一役，南宮盟主亡故，鄒掌門心灰意冷，已不願再摻和武林糾紛。\n不為西武林盟加勢，對武林盟使者也用閉關療傷當作藉口推託，乍聽似是兩不相幫，卻又不禁門人下山，憑自身所見所聞決事。=Fourth Senior Brother returned from his mission to Qingcheng, but even his age-old friendship with Sect Leader Zou could not bring back good news. \n四師兄造訪青城時，鄒掌門正在長吁短嘆，皆因武林大會悲劇悵然，正義不得伸張，是以抑鬱難平。\n他沒對弟子宣之於口，卻想泥教固然邪惡，武林盟只怕也非公正無私。\n他有心除魔衛道，卻不甘為有心人擺弄；他何嘗不知有冤？想站出來說句公道話，卻又孤掌難鳴。\n連人面廣闊的南宮盟主都不能憑言語勸平群俠。人對未知心生恐懼，為了自保所以恐懼催生出憤怒，不正當的憤怒等同惡意，最終導致無辜的血。\n當道士這麼多年還沒見過妖怪，但若世間真有害人妖魔，八成便藏在人的心底。\n剛想著乾脆將掌門衣缽交人，以後潛心修道，好過與江湖俗人同流合污，四師兄便找上門來，說了西武林盟之事。\n鄒掌門只聽得熱血沸騰，宛如年輕了十歲，當即便應下，恰逢武林盟使者到來指手畫腳，也被他一怒轟出門去。\n寧為正義捐軀，不與邪魔為伍；寧作草莽行俠，不事權貴麾下。\n這才對得起他和師弟趙逵年少時所立誓言。=When Fourth Senior Brother visited Qingcheng, Sect Leader Zou was deep in sighs, still haunted by the tragedy of the Wulin Assembly, where justice had gone unanswered — a grief that would not ease. He had said nothing of it to his disciples, but privately he suspected that though the Mud Cult was surely evil, the Wulin Alliance might not be entirely just and impartial either. He longed to root out evil and defend the true Way, yet refused to be a pawn for men with their own agendas. And how could he not know there was injustice in it? He wanted to step forward and speak plainly for what was right, but felt he stood alone — even the well-connected Alliance Leader Nangong could not talk the heroes of the Wulin into peace with words alone. People fear what they do not understand, and in seeking to protect themselves, that fear curdles into anger; anger misplaced becomes malice, and malice in the end spills innocent blood. In all his years as a Daoist priest he had never once laid eyes on a demon — but if there truly were evil spirits in this world, he suspected they most likely lodged in the human heart. Just as he was on the verge of handing off the sect leader's mantle to someone else, to give himself over to quiet cultivation rather than mingle with the worldly matters of the Jianghu, Fourth Senior Brother arrived and spoke to him of the Western Wulin Alliance. Sect Leader Zou's blood ran hot at the news, as though he had grown ten years younger, and he agreed on the spot. As it happened, an envoy from the Wulin Alliance arrived just then to throw his weight around, and Sect Leader Zou threw him out the door in anger as well. Better to die for justice than keep company with devils; better to walk the rough road of a true hero than serve at the feet of the powerful. Only this could honor the vow he and his Junior Brother Zhao Kui had sworn in their youth.
\n出使青城唐門師弟回來，可惜青城派對你們成見頗深，拒絕了結盟之請。=The Tang Clan Junior Brothers sent to Qingcheng have returned. Unfortunately, the Qingcheng sect holds deep-seated prejudice against you and has refused the request for an alliance.

\n當你們派出四師兄那一刻起，就等於拿下了蜀中地區所有中小門派的，大幫大派姑且不說，四師兄做生意時可沒少去這些中小門派走動，那個貪財那個愛名那個好色通通瞭如指掌，投其所好，威逼利誘，唐門名聲怎樣根本無所謂，糊裡糊塗就給他騙簽了投名狀，上了賊船，就別想跑了。=From the moment you sent Fourth Senior Brother out, you had all but won over every minor sect in Shu—never mind the great factions for now. \n出使各大中小門派、幫派的弟子也紛紛回來。=The disciples sent as envoys to sects and gangs great and small began returning one after another.

中小派門中，對武林盟不滿的在所多有，風雨山上釋明口宣一句佛號，只誰殺誰的情況歷歷在目，那錦香宮芳名遠播，一朝被指為魔教，什麼道義交情都不講，非要制她們於死地不可。\n誰曉得接下來輪到哪幫哪派呢？都說泥教危害武林和平，武林盟又何嘗不令人提心吊膽？你是正是邪竟不是自己說了算，還得看武林盟眼色，江湖混成這樣，未免太過窩囊。\n如今唐門揭竿而起，欲召集四方遊俠，結為西武林盟抗衡東方強權，於他們而言時可謂曙光。\n舊時的唐門是孤高、叛逆、不屈的象徵，亦黑亦白，我行我素，從不結黨逐流，唯有天下大亂之時會挺身而出，唐時收難民興外堡力抗玄宗皇帝，救民於水火；二十年前與嵩山攜手，力挫極樂教先鋒，掌門更將萬惡魔魁極樂右使斃於掌下；\n今有儒俠搖旗舉義反抗霸權，這是足以寫在江湖野史的歷史時刻，不僅蜀中門派、幫派紛紛響應，便是外地的聽聞，都按捺不住致書表態，願在決戰之日，與西武林盟同仇敵愾。=Discontent with the Wulin Alliance is widespread among the smaller sects. \n你和三師兄正自感嘆之際，總對二師兄糾纏不休、自唐門內戰以來便不見蹤影的唐仙兒師姊忽然歸來，老樣子看不上你，對你一通亂罵，卻捎回意料之外的佳音，說是錦香宮聽聞唐門欲興西武林盟義師，動了舉宮東來的念頭，這一來就不走了，從此便是鄰居。\n三師兄大喜若狂，一下便來勁了，嘴裡唸叨著必須投桃報李，千萬不能怠慢，張羅接待事宜去了。\n而你多看了兩眼，又被唐仙兒罵得狗血淋頭，不得不說還挺懷念的。=As you and Third Senior Brother were lamenting, Second Senior Brother was persistently bothering you. Third Senior Brother was overjoyed and immediately became energetic, muttering that they must reciprocate kindness and not be negligent, and went off to arrange the reception. 唐仙兒招招手引你到無人樹林，才恢復本來說話語調，只是語氣依舊不饒人，風雨山一別，如今才有機會代錦香宮謝你高義。\n她知你滿腹疑竇，卻似有深意並不解釋，等到時機成熟才能與你分說，現在只要你信她是友非敵。=Tang Xian'er waved her hand to lead you into the desolate forest, only then resuming her usual tone of speech, though her manner remained unyielding. 你知她身份，哪能掉以輕心，畫中仙對你這俗人嗤之以鼻，試想她若對你唐門不懷好意，犯不著特地跑來陪你們吃苦，只消冷眼旁觀，自有武林盟收拾你們。\n你登時啞口無言了，還真半點反駁不了。=You knew who she truly was—how could you let your guard down? 更贈你神功以為謝禮。=She also bestowed upon you a marvelous skill, a further token of her gratitude.
\n仙鶴火閃電帶著小梅的信籤回來見你，信中言簡意賅說了崆峒派不日即將動眾南下與唐門會師，此外都是與你調笑的家常話語。\n事情雖然順利，她卻不知臨時有什麼事情，不回唐門。=Fire Lightning the White Crane returned to you bearing Xiaomei's message token. \n決戰之前那晚，你夢見了以前的事。\n鄉下農村，除非有錢供孩子讀書，還能夢想考取功名，餘下的便是嚮往江湖故事。\n那時常有說書人來，一回一回的講，最是膾炙人口的，莫過於劍俠龍淵率領武林群俠，大戰魔教教主的傳奇事蹟，村裡鎮上，無不敬仰，便是當朝官家也沒那般人望。\n每每聽完說書，村裡孩子都會心朝澎湃，折樹枝作刀劍，輪番扮演大俠與惡棍。\n你從小就不得人疼，吃盡了苦，如何不想學那些大俠，學成一身武功，仗義行俠、威風八面？\n可事實是，沒人看得起你，就算硬著頭皮擠進人群，你連壞人都難有幾回機會當，十有八九你要當樹，負責被震斷。\n你醒轉過來的時候，才終於下定決心。\n洗了一把臉，照鏡整肅衣襟，將老舊護腕扣上，小劍插在後腰帶上。\n走進正心堂，向病臥在床的掌門請命出戰、拜別辭行。=Before the final battle, you dreamt of the past.\nIn rural villages, unless one had the means to educate their children and dream of achieving fame and fortune through the imperial examinations, the common aspiration was to emulate the stories of Jianghu.\nTraveling storytellers often came, recounting tales chapter by chapter. The most popular was undoubtedly the legend of the Sword-Hero Longyuan leading the martial brotherhood against the Demon Cult Leader. The entire village and town revered him; even the Emperor of the imperial court lacked such widespread respect.\nAfter each telling, the village children would be filled with excitement, fashioning swords and knives from tree branches, taking turns playing heroic knights and villains.\nYou, having been unloved and having endured hardship, naturally longed to learn martial arts, to become a hero, to champion justice, and to be formidable.\nBut the reality was, no one regarded you as worthy. Even if you forced your way into a crowd, you rarely got the chance to play the villain; most of the time, you were the tree, destined to be broken.\nYou awoke with a firm resolve.\nYou splashed water on your face, adjusted your clothing in the mirror, fastened your old wrist guards, and tucked a small sword into your belt.\nYou entered the Zhengxin Hall, seeking permission from the ailing Sect Leader to enter the battle and to bid your farewells.
你在那碰見了大師兄，他早料到你會來。\n你若遲遲下定不了決心，就該他去了，他倒也不是不能與盟主一拼，只是特別把主演的機會讓你。=You met the Senior Brother. He expected you to come.\nIf you hesitated, he would have stepped in. He's certainly capable of facing the Alliance Leader, but he specifically wanted to give you the chance to play the lead.
你姓趙，不姓唐，熬到了今天還是外姓弟子，但掌門說過，唐門就是你的家。=You are surnamed Zhao, not Tang, and after holding on all this time you were still only an outer disciple—yet the Sect Leader always said the Tang Clan was your home.
所以就算貪生怕死，你也會挺身而出，保衛家園。=So even if you're afraid of death, you will still stand up and defend your homeland.
你受千錘百煉，錘打至今鍛成的骨氣，無非為了今天。=You have endured countless trials and hardships, hammered and shaped into a spirit of resilience, all for today.
難得登台，再也不想演樹，儘管渺小卑微、不起眼如你，生來世間，無所謂被不被愛，均非襯托旁人的背景，你只是你獨一無二的自己。=This chance to take the stage was rare, and you no longer wanted to play the tree. However small, however unremarkable you might be, born into this world it made no difference whether you were loved or not—you were never anyone's backdrop. You were simply, uniquely, yourself.
也許武林盟言之有理，也許此戰沒有正邪之別，但你等西武林盟堅信自己，聽憑心意，要為弱者鳴聲。=Perhaps the Wulin Alliance is right, perhaps this battle has no distinction between right and wrong, but you, the Western Wulin Alliance, firmly believe in yourselves, follow your hearts, and strive to give voice to the weak.
誰也不能欺你唐門，否則就得付出慘痛代價。為此就算把全武林都捲進來，也在所不惜。=No one can insult the Tang Clan; otherwise, they will have to pay a heavy price. For this, even if the entire Wulin is pulled into it, it's worth it.
你在掌門榻前，恭恭敬敬再三叩首，謝他昔年收留之恩。\n今日便是你報恩之時，他老人所珍視的一切，都有你唐門弟子趙活代為守護。=Before the Sect Leader's seat, you bow deeply and respectfully, thrice, expressing gratitude for his past kindness.\nToday is the time for you to repay that favor; everything the elder values, you, Zhao Hu of Tang Clan, will now protect.
清晨練武場，唐門弟子齊齊夾道場中，他們心照不宣，西武林盟捨你其誰？就算攔著，你也會去。\n\所以躬身拱手，以至高的敬意為你送行。\n你背負眾望，大步踏出門去。=At the martial training grounds this morning, Tang Clan disciples lined the path. They understood each other without speaking: who else could the Western Wulin Alliance rely on? Even if they tried to stop you, you would still go.\nSo they bowed, palms pressed together, offering you their highest respect as you departed.\nBearing the hopes of everyone, you strode out of the gate.
小師妹在道中等著你，小手塞你掌心，陪你散步往赴決戰之地。\n其實她心慌得很，幾度想要開口，求你別去，始終不忍開口而已。\n她也知道不去不行，畢竟那是你的夢想、心之所向。=Junior Martial Sister is waiting for you on the path, her small hand nestled in your palm, accompanying you on a walk to the battlefield. In reality, she's very nervous, several times wanting to speak up, begging you not to go, but always reluctant to open her mouth. She also knows that not going isn't an option, after all, that's your dream, your heart's desire.
夏侯蘭難得早起，在道中等著你，陪你散步往赴決戰之地。\n一路有說有笑，今天的師父似乎特別溫柔，挨得很近。=Xiahou Lan rarely rose so early, but she waited for you on the path and walked with you toward the battlefield. The two of you talked and laughed the whole way; today your Master seemed unusually gentle, staying close by your side.
龍湘特意早起，下山去早市買了雞腿，在道中等著你，陪你散步往赴決戰之地。\n她信你，就像從前追隨父親的背影，憧憬王二壯、崇拜唐布衣，這些人都武功高強、高深莫測，而你不太一樣，你只是證明了自己誰都能贏，這次也不例外。\n她對你的勝利堅信不移。=Long Xiang deliberately got up early, went down the mountain to buy chicken legs, and waited for you along the way, walking with you to the battlefield. She trusted you, just as she once followed her father's shadow, yearned for Wang Erzhuang, and revered Tang Buyi. These people were all powerful and enigmatic, but you were different‑you proved you could beat anyone, and this time was no different. She was unwavering in her belief in your victory.
西武林群俠在道中相候，你每一頷首，群俠便拱手致意，走你走過的路，無聲追隨你的背影。=The Western Wulin heroes await on the road, each nod from you prompting the heroes to bow in greeting, silently trailing your silhouette.
兩雄並立眉山之巔，清晨曙光映耀，萬眾矚目。\n他亦坦率，十日以前趁人之危，今日才論真英雄，對此時此刻來到此地的你，致以崇高敬意。\n天底多的是比眉山更高聳的山，但是山不在高，你我際會於此，便是武林最高峰。\n你們各自代表著東西武林盟，千言萬語不以劍鳴，憾不動人心，故而有此一戰！=Two titans stand atop Mount Meishan, bathed in the morning light and watched by all.\nHe is also forthright, seizing an opportune moment just ten days ago, and only now speaking of true heroism, offering his profound respect to you, who have come to this place at this moment.\nMountains higher than Mount Meishan abound, but it is not height that matters; our meeting here marks the pinnacle of Wulin.\nYou each represent the Eastern and Western Martial Alliance, and a thousand words cannot move the hearts of men without the clash of steel, thus this battle is inevitable!
\n這一切，有意義。\n你不言不語，那刀劍交斫的鏗鏘，便是你趙活響徹雲霄的喊聲，要令天下人豎耳傾聽。\n清澈的意志透過劍鋒震盪，滲透進你心底。\n厚重的意志透過劍鋒震盪，滲透進他心底。=All of this had meaning. You said nothing, yet the ring of clashing blade and sword was your cry, Zhao Huo's cry, echoing to the heavens and commanding the world to listen. A clear will surged through the sword's edge and sank into your heart. A heavy will surged through the sword's edge and sank into his heart.
\n此戰結局，沒有奇蹟。\n你鼓足勇氣也違抗不了天命，人生老是如此不公平。\n你戰敗身亡以後，西武林盟心氣散盡，為武林盟所吞併，動亂弭平，武林陣線終於統一，唯獨唐門例外。\n但你奮戰的英姿令天下俠士動容，千言萬語也說服不得的人，紛紛向你致敬。\n無人記得你相貌醜惡，出身粗鄙，只記得當年眉山之巔，以手中小劍與盟主爭鳴的少年英雄。\n你一如你少年所想，轟轟烈烈的活過，成為傳說，受萬人敬仰。=This battle had no miracles. You could not defy fate, no matter how much courage you had; life is always so unfair. After your defeat and death, the Western Wulin Alliance lost its spirit, was absorbed by the Wulin Alliance, and the chaos was calmed, finally unifying the Wulin front, except for the Tang Clan. Yet your heroic struggle moved all the righteous warriors across the land. Even those who could not be swayed by words paid tribute to you. No one remembered your ugly appearance or humble origins, only the youth who, atop the peak of Mount Meishan, challenged the Alliance Leader with his small sword. You lived with grandeur and splendor as you had envisioned in your youth, becoming a legend, revered by all.
\n刀光劍影交錯，各出看家本領，他孤雲山劍瀟灑如意，你忘形博納天下武學。\n時而巖如山嶽，兆機凝結，時而又猛若霹靂弦驚，轟雷閃電。\n招數使完，隨手便創，劍出勝流星，掌風能撥雲，掃腿作鞭，呼氣成箭。\n恰似名家揮毫書就狂草，看似寫意，實則一撇一捺，無不是心血凝鍊！\n如非親眼所見，怎信當世有如此驚世駭俗的武功？=Blades and swords flash and clash as each of you unleash your finest skills — his Guyun Mountain Sword moves with effortless grace, while you, lost in the moment, embrace every martial art under heaven. At times your stance is solid as a mountain, its momentum coiled and waiting; at others you strike with the fury of thunder and lightning, crackling and roaring. When your techniques run out, you improvise on the spot — your sword outpacing a meteor, your palm wind parting clouds, your sweeping leg a whip, your breath turned to arrows. It is like a master's brushstroke sweeping out wild cursive script: seemingly effortless, yet every stroke is the crystallization of a lifetime's devotion! Had you not seen it with your own eyes, how could you believe such astonishing martial arts existed in this world?
\n二人均在酣鬥之中，漸入物我兩忘之境。\n不約而同想起各自年少，憧憬江湖的初衷，聽著同一個故事，想要成為大俠。\n不同於瑞笙得天獨厚，他是萬裡不挑一的奇才，在孤雲山長成，衣食無憂，又是單傳弟子，有恩師傾囊相授，假以時日，必有成就。\n你卻生來一無所有，滿身塵土，跌跌撞撞。渾身沒有一處強勝於人，稱你凡庸都嫌委婉，本該認命服輸，碌碌無為，終你一生無所建樹。\n然而掌門卻道：那是屁。\n誰都有作夢的權力，難得來紅塵遊歷，何妨輕狂不醒。\n心不屈服的話，再遠的地方你也去得到，所以你偏要逆天而行，突破幾千劫厄，來到今天。=Both were locked in fierce combat, gradually entering a state of forgetting self and the world. Without prior agreement, they both recalled their youthful years, when they had dreamed of becoming heroes in the Jianghu, hearing the same story and yearning to become Great Heroes. Unlike Ruisheng, who had been favored by fate, he was an unparalleled prodigy, raised in Guyun Mountain with no worries about food or clothing, and as the sole disciple of a master who had poured all his knowledge into him. Given time, he would surely achieve great things. You, however, were born with nothing, covered in dust, stumbling along, with no strength superior to others in any aspect. To call you ordinary is already too kind; you were meant to accept your fate, to be mediocre and accomplish nothing in your lifetime. Yet the Sect Leader said: That's nonsense. Everyone has the right to dream. Rarely does one get to wander through the world of mortals; why not be reckless and unshaken? If your heart refuses to yield, then no distance is too far for you to reach. Therefore, you chose to defy fate, breaking through thousands of trials, and have arrived at this moment.
\n武林盟主又怎了？不還是個血肉之軀，和你一樣會流血、要吃飯、會大便。\n你的小劍被格飛，心劍未折，反手一拳砸在瑞笙手背，打裂掌骨，逼他寶劍脫手。\n他亦不甘示弱，立刻衝你醜臉還以顏色。\n拳腳交錯，初時還講體面，後來全然不成章法，變成市井流氓廝鬥，根本不擇手段。\n你好生歹毒，專門瞄準他臉，而堂堂盟主為了保護臉，只得使出擒抱，氣急敗壞之下，竟還張口咬你。\n東西兩忙觀戰俠士無不汗顏。\n終於你倆都鼻青臉腫、面目全非，最後一擊全都軟綿綿，雙雙倒地猶不服輸，繼續吵嘴，他不忘出腳踢你小腿，你捉沙當暗器灑他臉，意圖把他嗆死。\n不知為何，突然都覺莫名愚蠢，忍俊不禁，不約而同放聲大笑。=So what if he's the Wulin Alliance Leader? He's still flesh and blood, just like you — he bleeds, he eats, he defecates. Your small sword was knocked from your grip, but your heart-sword remained unbroken; you countered with a punch to the back of Ruisheng's hand, cracking his metacarpal and forcing him to drop his prized sword. Not to be outdone, he instantly returned the favor, aiming a blow at your ugly face. Fists and feet flew; what began with some pretense of dignity soon collapsed into a common street brawl, with neither side caring for form. You fought dirty, aiming straight for his face, and the mighty Alliance Leader, desperate to protect his own, was reduced to grappling you — and in his fury, even sank his teeth into you. Every hero watching from both East and West burned with secondhand shame. At last you were both bruised black and blue, faces unrecognizable, your final blows landing soft and spent; you collapsed to the ground together, still refusing to yield, still bickering — he kicked at your shin, you flung a fistful of sand into his face like a hidden weapon, trying to choke him. Then, for no reason either of you could name, it all struck you as absurd, and you burst out laughing together.
小醫仙梁有詩再也看不下去，奔入場中，為瑞笙包紮止血。=Little Medicine Immortal Liang Youshi could no longer bear to watch and rushed into the arena to bandage and stop the bleeding for Ruisheng.
靈犀再也不忍情郎受傷，連忙奔入場中，割腕餵以靈血，活他性命。=Lingxi could no longer bear to see her beloved injured, so she hurriedly rushed into the arena, cut her wrist to feed him with spiritual blood, and saved his life.
小師妹見狀，也奔到你身邊，又喜又悲，拍拍你、誇誇你，眼淚撲簌簌掉在你臉上。=The Junior Martial Sister saw this and ran to your side too, torn between joy and sorrow. She patted you, praised you, and her tears fell in streams onto your face.
夏侯蘭連忙奔出搭你脈搏，觀你雖然傷重力竭，一時卻無性命之憂，這才吁了一口長氣，比起臉面，她更怕腹中未出世的孩兒一出生就沒了爹。\n此話出口，你先是一怔，旋即給雷劈了似的彈射而起，激動之下渾身血脈繃裂，一口鮮血嘔出來，仰天倒下。=Xiahou Lan hurriedly rushed out to check your pulse. She observed that although you were seriously injured and exhausted, you were not in immediate danger of losing your life, which allowed her to exhale a long breath of relief. Compared to her own dignity, she feared more that her unborn child would be born without a father. As soon as she said this, you were stunned for a moment, then leaped up as if struck by lightning. Overcome with excitement, your blood vessels burst, and you vomited a mouthful of fresh blood before collapsing backward onto the ground.
龍湘見狀，也奔到你身邊，她熱淚盈眶，既心疼又驕傲，忍不住想大聲炫耀，一時忘了你身受重傷，骨頭都不知斷了幾根，叉你脅下高高舉起，一聽你呼痛，又嚇得脫手將你重摔在地，本來還有一口氣的，這回眼前一黑，忽然就看到了一座橋，橋上有位慈祥老婦在給過橋的人免費發湯。=Long Xiang rushed to your side, tears welling up in her eyes, heartbroken yet proud. She couldn't help but want to boast loudly, momentarily forgetting your severe injuries‑unknown how many bones were broken. She grabbed you by the ribs and lifted you high, but upon hearing your cry of pain, she panicked and dropped you, causing you to fall heavily to the ground. You were still breathing, but this time, your vision darkened, and suddenly you saw a bridge where a kind old woman was giving free soup to those crossing it.
\n時人說起東西武林之戰，無不津津樂道。\n無人記得你相貌醜惡、出身粗鄙，因為那早已無關緊要。\n只知眉山之巔，曾有一位武功高強，足與盟主論劍爭鳴的英雄少年。\n最終說是平手，其實起點就不公平。\n你為西武林盟掙得了尊嚴與和平，結局誰輸誰贏，見仁見智。\n你最終也沒有成為西武林盟主，就像唐門前輩，並非不曾出過偉大的俠客，但你們特立獨行，亦正亦邪，誰沒道理就戰誰。\n總是事了拂衣而去，深藏身與名，只在世道最黑暗的時候挺身而出，點燈照亮人間。=When people speak of the battle between Eastern and Western Wulin, they never tire of the tale. No one remembers your ugly appearance or humble origins, for those details are long irrelevant. All that is known is that on Mount Meishan, there once stood a hero, a young man of great martial arts who could rival the Alliance Leader in swordsmanship. The outcome was said to be a draw, but it was hardly fair from the start. You earned dignity and peace for the Western Wulin Alliance, and whether you won or lost in the end is open to interpretation. In the end, you did not become the Western Wulin Alliance Leader, just as with the Tang Clan seniors‑great heroic figures have not been absent among them, but they stood apart, neither wholly righteous nor wholly evil, fighting whoever was unjust at the time. Always after affairs were settled, you would disappear, hiding in plain sight, emerging only when the world was darkest to light the way for humanity.
\n最終兩盟各自派出頂尖高手，決戰眉山之巔。\n一青一白兩位俠客各顯神通，此戰可謂驚天地、泣鬼神。=In the end, the two alliances each sent their top martial experts to clash on the peak of Meishan. Two heroic warriors, one in blue and one in white, each displayed their skills. This battle could be said to shake heaven and earth, move ghosts to tears.
然而武林盟主在激戰之末暴露出真面目，之所以指使武林盟侵犯唐門，原來是為了他一統江湖的野心，萬幸者是最終伏硃於你小劍之下。\n武林盟群俠此際方知識人不明，都羞慚不已。或是捐款，或是自廢武功，退隱江湖。=However, at the climax of the battle, the Wulin Alliance Leader revealed his true nature; he orchestrated the Alliance's attack on the Tang Clan to fulfill his ambition of unifying Jianghu. Fortunately, he was ultimately defeated by your sword.\nThe members of the Wulin Alliance, at this time, finally understood the truth and were filled with shame. Some donated their wealth, while others abandoned their martial arts and withdrew from Jianghu.
最終你在萬重矚目之下，正面擊敗天之驕子。\n武林盟還蠢蠢欲動，欲將你亂刀分屍，但這一次你不是孤身一人。\n你為西武林盟群俠出頭，他們也為你撐腰。\n武林盟群龍無首，不是誰都熱血上頭，已經不成氣候，就算人多，又怎能抵抗西武林盟的團結？要不了多久，就全面崩潰。\n降者論罪處，收編為己用，不降者後果自負。\n小命要緊，武林盟不敢再造次，以南宮為首，向西武林屈膝稱臣。=Ultimately, under the watchful eyes of countless, you decisively defeated the favored son of the heavens.\nThe Wulin Alliance still stirs with ambition, eager to tear you apart, but this time you are not alone.\nYou stood up for the Western Wulin Alliance, and they, in turn, support you.\nThe Wulin Alliance's dragons have lost their head; no one is rashly driven by passion anymore, and that's become a sign of weakness. Even with numbers, how can they resist the unity of the Western Wulin Alliance? Their complete collapse is imminent.\nThose who surrender will be judged according to their crimes and absorbed into our ranks; those who do not will bear the consequences themselves.\nLife is precious. The Wulin Alliance dares not cause further trouble; led by Nanyang, they kneel before the Western Wulin Alliance and pledge allegiance.
時人說起東西武林之戰，無不津津樂道。\n無人記得你相貌醜惡、出身粗鄙，因為那根本無關緊要。\n只知眉山之巔，天下第一的英雄少年。\n之後北方傳來戰報，極樂教引西夏入侵。\n東西武林俠士臨危皆奉你號令，齊心抗敵，挫敗極樂教野心。\n中原武林終於恢復和平。\n耕陽讀書齋將你的事蹟編撰成書，發行於市，書名為《活俠傳》。\n唐門活俠的大名一朝傳遍中原，無人不知、無人不曉。\n甚至遠至西夏興慶、大宋臨安、金國燕京、蒙古大漠軍帳。\n四國皇帝都知道世上有你這號人物，敬者敬，憂者憂，畏者畏，愁者愁。\n\n你的名字，從今往後便是傳說。=When people speak of the War between the Eastern and Western Wulins, they never tire of the tale. No one remembers your ugly appearance or humble origins, for that no longer mattered at all. They only know of the young hero atop Mount Meishan, foremost under heaven. Later, news came from the north that the Supreme Bliss Cult had led a Western Xia invasion. Heroes of the Eastern and Western Wulin alike answered your call in that hour of peril, standing united against the enemy and crushing the Supreme Bliss Cult's ambitions. The Central Plains' Wulin at last knew peace again. Gengyang Reading Studio set your deeds down in a book and sold it throughout the land, titled Legend of Mortal. The name of the Tang Clan's Living Hero spread across the Central Plains overnight, known to every man and woman, reaching even as far as Xingqing in Western Xia, Lin'an in the Great Song, Yanjing in the Jin, and the desert camps of Mongolia. The emperors of all four nations knew of your existence-some with reverence, some with worry, some with fear, some with sorrow. Your name, from this day forth, was legend.
\n耕陽讀書齋將你的事蹟編撰成書，發行於市，書名為《活俠傳》。\n唐門活俠的大名一朝傳遍中原，無人不知、無人不曉。\n甚至遠至西夏興慶、大宋臨安、金國燕京、蒙古大漠軍帳。\n四國皇帝都知道世上有你這號人物，敬者敬，憂者憂，畏者畏，愁者愁。\n\n你的名字，從今往後便是傳說。=Gengyang Reading Studio set your deeds down in a book and sold it throughout the land, titled Legend of Mortal. The name of the Tang Clan's Living Hero spread across the Central Plains overnight, known to all. The emperors of all four nations knew of your existence-some with reverence, some with worry, some with fear, some with sorrow. Your name, from this day forth, was legend.
\n這一日又到了每月評鑑之時，大師兄卻忽然出現，揚言要帶你去正心堂。=This day again brought the time of the monthly evaluation, when Eldest Senior Brother suddenly appeared, declaring that he meant to take you to the Zhengxin Hall.
你一走他們就拿出骰子和酒食，歡快得不得了。=The moment you left, they took out the dice and food and drink, overjoyed beyond measure.
可正在評鑑你貢獻的當下，\n為了脫身，你斗膽睜眼說瞎話，誇大功勞。\n大師兄雖然不在意，其他弟子卻很惱你。=While your contributions were being evaluated, you dared to lie blatantly to escape, exaggerating your merits. Although Eldest Senior Brother didn't care, the other disciples were very annoyed with you.
正在評鑑你貢獻的當下，\n你明明忙壞了，卻還嫌不夠似的露出了支支吾吾的神情，\n這下沒人能對你不服氣了，你與三師兄簡直是唐門的精神典範。=As your contributions were being evaluated, you had clearly worked yourself ragged, yet still put on a hesitant, mumbling expression as if it weren't enough. No one could hold it against you after that-you and Third Senior Brother were truly the spiritual paragons of the Tang Clan.
正在評鑑你貢獻的當下，\n你實在有點兒心虛，\n支支吾吾了半晌也說不出所以然來，大師兄有意包庇，將你帶離現場，\n還是惹得同門師兄弟們各自忿忿難平。=As they were assessing your contributions, you felt somewhat anxious, stammered for a while, and couldn't come up with a coherent explanation. Eldest Senior Brother intended to cover for you and took you away from the scene, which caused the fellow disciples to be resentful and uneasy.
你得掌門授意，得以列席唐門會議。\n雖說是為了參詳你一介外姓弟子的視角所以破格提拔，\n可也是唐門創派以來第一個有席位的外姓弟子。=With the Sect Leader's blessing, you were permitted to sit in on the Tang Clan's councils. Though it was granted so they might weigh the perspective of an outsider disciple like you, it also marked the first time in the Tang Clan's history that an outsider disciple had ever held a seat.
在你的建言下，唐門上下動員，修繕了唐家大院，家宅煥然一新，人人與有榮焉。=Under your advice, the entire Tang Clan mobilized to repair the Tang Family Compound, completely renovating the family residence, and everyone felt a sense of pride.
\n你心知江湖正逢多事之秋，唐門飄搖如江上孤舟，仍在唐門會議提出雪山決行，辭別唐門。\n三師兄並沒阻攔，不因你從前身份低微、一無是處而看輕你，不因你今日武功高強，備受倚重而挽留你，唐門外姓弟子，到底並非姓唐的人家，不必死守在唐家大院，而是另有重任。\n凡受過唐門恩惠可以立身者，皆當背負唐門意志，決行他鄉，一如當日唐門敢犯天顏那般，不畏人言，毋忘錚錚傲骨，活好自己，總有一天還濟困乏之人。\n肉身可以毀壞，香火可以被撲滅，唐門的意志，卻必須永遠傳承。\n唐門最後一個外姓弟子發起決行，展翅離家之日已至，你終於道別了唐門。=You knew the Jianghu was entering an age of turmoil, the Tang Clan tossing like a lone boat upon the river, yet still you proposed the Snow Mountain expedition at the Tang Clan council and took your leave of the Tang Clan. Third Senior Brother did not stand in your way-not because he thought little of your once-lowly standing and worthlessness, nor because he wished to keep you, now formidable in martial arts and heavily relied upon. An outsider disciple of the Tang Clan is, after all, not of the Tang family by blood, and need not remain forever within the Tang estate, for there are other burdens to bear. All who have known the Tang Clan's kindness and made something of themselves must carry forward the Tang Clan's will and set out into distant lands, just as the Tang Clan once dared to defy the Emperor's own wrath, fearless of what others said, never forgetting their unbending pride. Live well, and one day you will yet aid those in need. The flesh may perish and the incense be snuffed out, but the will of the Tang Clan must be passed down forever. The Tang Clan's last outsider disciple has begun the departure; the day to spread your wings and leave home has come, and at last you bid the Tang Clan farewell.
在你的建言下，贖回了唐門外堡，舒緩居住壓力，不住通鋪，門中弟子亦得隱私，對你暗暗感激。=On your advice, the Tang Clan bought back its Outer Fort, easing the strain on living space; no longer crowded into common dormitories, the sect's disciples gained a measure of privacy, and secretly felt grateful to you.
\n你鼓起勇氣，於唐門家議時向掌門提出了去別派留學的請求。\n念你在派中多年，沒有功勞亦有苦勞，掌門二話不說欣然便應允了。=You mustered the courage to raise, at a Tang Clan council, a request to the Sect Leader to study abroad at another sect. Mindful of your many years in the sect-for though you had earned no great merit, you had endured no small hardship-the Sect Leader consented at once, without a second thought.
二師兄對此不太贊同，不用想也知道，以你這品貌武功代表本門出去，一定會遭人笑話，但掌門既然發話，也只有遵從。=Second Senior Brother did not favor this-it was plain to see that having you represent the sect, given your appearance and skill, would surely invite ridicule. But since the Sect Leader had spoken, there was nothing to do but comply.
大師兄一聽你要出門留學，立即闖入正心堂請命，非但沒如他所願，反而被指派接替你的工作，可謂是報應不爽，大快人心。=Eldest Senior Brother, upon hearing you meant to go abroad to study, immediately stormed into Zhengxin Hall to plead his case. Not only did it not go as he wished, but he was instead assigned to take over your job-a fitting punishment, and a source of public satisfaction.
豈止你不捨小師妹，一聽說你此去將有半年之久不回，小師妹心中也是說不清的不踏實，只是她明白父親絕不放心她離家留學的。=It was not only you who could not bear to part from Little Junior Sister-upon hearing you would be gone a full half year, she too felt an unease she could not put into words, though she knew full well her father would never allow her to leave home to study elsewhere.
掌門特意為你修書四封，致崆峒派。\n這是由於崆峒派掌派人從缺，分由四位掌門分別領導的緣故。\n唐門與崆峒派交情說好不好，說壞不壞，平時也無交集。\n只是唐掌門以江湖地位而言，該與崆峒掌派人齊平，而崆峒四門掌門則稍矮一級，自然難以推辭唐門此請。\n待你收拾得當，便告辭師門下山，向崆峒山發進。\n此去路途遙遠，四師兄怕你耽誤日期，便替你張羅了一匹便宜瘦馬，令你能加速趕路，有馬代步，將行數日，你終於到了秦州崆峒派地界。=The Sect Leader wrote four letters especially for you, addressed to the Kongtong Sect-for Kongtong then had no single successor to its leadership, and was instead led jointly by four Sect Leaders. Relations between the Tang Clan and the Kongtong Sect were neither particularly warm nor especially cold; ordinarily the two had little to do with each other. Yet by standing in the Jianghu, Sect Leader Tang ranked on par with the Kongtong Sect Leader, while the Sect Leaders of the Four Gates of Kongtong stood a rung below-so naturally, they could hardly refuse the Tang Clan's request. Once you had made ready, you took your leave of the sect and went down the mountain, setting out for Mount Kongtong. The road was long, and Fourth Senior Brother, fearing you might be delayed, procured for you a cheap, thin horse so you could make better time. With a mount beneath you, you traveled for several days and at last reached the Kongtong Sect's territory in Qinzhou.
\n這一日你正在擦地，與練功場地板污漬苦戰，四師兄急匆匆揪住了你，便往手裡塞錢，要你替他下山，去田氏鄉人家收購老牛，宰了轉手賣掉，再提些上山加餐。=This day, you were scrubbing at stains on the training ground floor when the Fourth Senior Brother rushed up, seized you, and pressed coins into your hand, telling you to go down the mountain in his stead, buy an old cow from the Tian family, have it slaughtered and sold, and bring back something extra to eat on the mountain.
孰料你攜著錢財下山，找到田家，他們卻又不肯賣了。\n賣牛云云，不過是家人吵架時說的氣話罷了，那牛跟了跟他們一輩子，辛勤耕耘，養活一家老小，田氏小兒子嘴上不饒人的主兒，卻也不忍鳥盡弓藏。=Unluckily, you went down the mountain with the coins and found the Tian family, but they refused to sell after all. Talk of selling the cow had merely been an angry word spoken during a family quarrel. The cow had served them all its life, toiling to feed the whole household, and though the Tian family's youngest son was sharp-tongued and gave no quarter, he could not bear to cast the cow aside once its usefulness was done.
你白跑一趟，怒上心頭，當即便和人家起了口角。=You had come all this way for nothing, and anger surged within you; you immediately fell into an argument with the man.
那田氏嘴力了得，可終究一介匹夫，對上三師兄那樣滿口仁義道德的君子，可以一通胡言強詞奪理，對上你這缺德貨色，卻不管用了，被你幾句搶白，氣得回家抱著牛氣到哭了。=The Tian son had a sharp tongue, but he was only an ordinary man after all. Against Third Senior Brother, a gentleman who spoke nothing but morality and righteousness, he could spout all manner of nonsense and twist words to his advantage. But against you, unscrupulous as you are, it didn't work. A few sharp words from you left him so angry he went home, threw his arms around the cow, and wept.
你聞言啞然，旋即付之一笑，對此結果喜聞樂見。\n那田氏小兒子見你笑了，心上過意不去，請你吃了一碗湯麵，聊表歉意。\n你們坐田埂間，並肩吃麵，就是升斗小民，也有人情。=You fell silent at the words, then laughed it off, taking pleasure in the outcome. The younger son of the Tian family saw you laughing and felt uneasy, so he invited you to eat a bowl of soup noodles to express his apology. You sat on the field embankment, eating noodles side by side. Even common folk have their share of human warmth.
你下山一趟，不想空手而歸，四處閒逛之時，碰上一處人群聚集，一問才知是李大夫門前來了一名求藥的斗笠客，跪了一日一夜都不肯起來，猶如泥塑般，任打任罵亦分毫不動。\n李大夫亦非鐵石心腸，只是他一路走來，見過的壞人太多，再也不肯輕信於人，何況他所求的丹藥，乃是李大夫老年所倚，倘若輕易送讓，他膝下無子女，將來誰又來奉養他？那斗笠客既然拿不出錢財，自然沒有情面商量。=You went down the mountain, not wanting to return empty‑handed. While wandering around, you came across a gathering of people. Upon inquiry, you learned that a hooded traveler seeking medicine had arrived at Dr. Li's doorstep. He had knelt for a day and night without moving, like a clay statue, no matter how he was beaten or scolded, he didn't budge an inch. Dr. Li was not heartless, but he had seen too many villains on his journey, and no longer trusted people easily. Moreover, the medicine he sought was Dr. Li's reliance in his old age. If he gave it away easily, with no children to care for him, who would take care of him in the future? Since the hooded traveler couldn't offer coins, there was no room for sentiment.
幾度猶豫，最終毅然下定了決心。=After some hesitation, you finally resolved yourself with determination.
你越眾而出，介入此局。=You stepped forward from the crowd and intervened in the situation.
你與李大夫素來相熟，是商業夥伴。\n自唐門醫館收掉以後，二師兄所煉製的藥物，便都放在李大夫醫館裡託售，他是知道你唐門真本領的人，既有你出面，態度登時便軟化了。\n取藥出來，又囑咐一番才算。=You and Dr. Li have been acquainted for a long time and are business partners. Since the Tang Clan's medical clinic was shut down, the medicines prepared by Second Senior Brother have been entrusted to Dr.
李大夫本就氣急敗壞，見了你這搶生意的唐門混蛋冒出頭來充好人，更是氣不打一處來，可是看在錢的份上，還是收了你的錢財作為訂金。\n取藥出來，又囑咐一番才算。=Dr. Li was already furious, and upon seeing you, the Tang Clan scum stealing his business, stepping forward to play the good guy, he was even more enraged. 那斗笠客對你深深鞠躬，問了姓名便急著要走，見你毫不阻攔，又停住腳步，除下斗笠，自曝姓名。=The hat‑wearer deeply bowed to you, asked for your name, and hurried to leave. Seeing you didn't stop them, they paused again, removed their hat, and revealed their name.
你默默退出人群，決定不去插手此事，本來與你無關，何必多管閒事。=You quietly stepped out of the crowd, decided not to get involved in this matter. It was none of your business; why bother with unnecessary interference?
為了消磨時間，等待葉雲舟歸來，你決定找零工賺點快錢。=To pass the time while waiting for Ye Yunzhou to return, you decided to take on temporary work to earn some quick cash.
正逢飛石幫急缺臨時工，你便腆著臉上前搭話，差點沒被人打。\n好在你做事尚算勤快，整日下來，也沒偷懶，教飛石幫眾對你唐門中人稍微改觀了一點。=Just as the Flying Stone Gang urgently needed temporary workers, you boldly approached to talk, almost getting beaten. Many villagers had never seen a Tang Clan member display their skills before, and they were all amazed. Although you were doing it for quick coins, you inadvertently spread the clan's reputation.
你毛遂自薦，加入了街頭賣藝行列之中，心想自己好歹在唐門待了幾年，就算不得傳授，手法不精，好歹體魄也算過得去才是，便自告奮勇體驗了胸口碎大石的把戲。\n一槌子下去，你當場口吐鮮血，鄉人見狀大驚失色，紛紛走避。\n那賣藝武師唯恐你有個三長兩短，多塞了點錢給你，倘若你回家一命嗚呼，念著他夠仗義的份上，想必冤魂也不至於纏到他身上。=You volunteered to join the street performance, thinking that at least having spent a few years in the Tang Clan, even if no formal teachings were given, your techniques might be crude but your physique at least decent enough to attempt the chest‑breaking stone trick. A single strike sent you spitting blood on the spot, causing the townsfolk to panic and scatter in fear. The street performer, fearing you might suffer a fatal injury, gave you a few more coins, hoping that if you died at home, your ghost wouldn't haunt him for his kindness.
為了消磨時間，等待葉雲舟歸來，你決定──什麼也不幹。\n難得無所事事，你度過了悠哉的一天。=To pass the time while waiting for Ye Yunzhou to return, you decided — to do nothing at all. Rare as such idleness was, you spent a leisurely day.

You felt disheartened, fearing you had been deceived. Just as your heart grew colder, Ye Yunzhou returned. He said he had given his sister the medicine, and now the medicine had taken effect; she no longer had a fever. Only then did he feel at ease and come back to find you, having prepared a few small dishes and drinks to invite you to share a drink on his boat. You readily agreed, and both of you went to his boat. The wine warmed your belly, dispelling the cold and loneliness of the quiet night on the river. Sharing the same spirit, you felt an added sense of boldness. Don't probe too deeply when the connection is still shallow; just keep exchanging cups. You and Ye Yunzhou didn't delve into each other's pasts, but instead discussed current events in the Jianghu, setting aside all sorrows. You savored the essence of the Jianghu in your heart, feeling a great sense of relief. He was refined yet had a strong tolerance for alcohol, drinking cup after cup, until you could no longer bear the wine. Only then did he suddenly remember a toast, but had forgotten the dish to accompany it, feeling a bit remiss. So he hurriedly left the table, rushing off to fetch the wild game he had hunted and sun-dried earlier that day.
你出艙去吹風，隱約見到寂靜岸邊出現幾點不尋常火光。\n與你一個照面，不速之客便躍上了船頭，自稱閻關三煞，將你當作葉雲舟，客客氣氣的見禮。=You stepped out to take a breath of fresh air and vaguely spotted some unusual firelight flickering on the quiet shore. Before you could react, an unexpected guest leaped onto the ship's bow, introducing themselves as Three Fiends of Yan Pass, mistaking you for Ye Yunzhou, and politely greeted you.
這三人乃是在地有名的惡霸，絕非好相與的，你聽了心頭一怵，已暗暗堤防。=These three are notorious local thugs, not people you want to cross. You felt a chill run down your spine, already on your guard.

你決定裝傻充愣，那三人見狀立時便知是認錯了人，不禁老臉一紅，意欲殺人封口。=You decided to pretend to be clueless, and the three people immediately realized they had mistaken someone, their faces flushing with embarrassment, intending to kill to silence them.

Having faced a threat to their lives together, both sides finally set aside their old grudges — enemies no more, having fought their way to friendship — and formed a bond too precious to come by easily. They held you in especially high regard, and no one idly troubled you for sport again.

你忽然行以大禮，連夏侯蘭也為之愕然。\n說來方才林中的指點，還是你生平頭一次真正得到傳授。\n在唐門中這許多年，纵使師兄們有意相授，也受限於門規，縱是大師兄那般灑脫之人，亦不敢有違祖訓。說來說去都是些不著邊際的空泛話語，一人一句心得要你記住自行領悟，結果便是一部唐門暗器總綱給你翻到爛了，還是難以融會貫通。\n從來沒有試過像今夜這般，給人提點以後茅塞頓開的快感，心中的感動，自然不言可喻。\n夏侯蘭從前如何姑且不論，今日的她可是寧可離群隱居在森林裡，以女鬼自居的女人，世俗禮教壓根約束不住她，一時覺得有趣，便當真收你為徒了，只是約好僅在你留學崆峒期間才算數。\n饒是如此，你也歡喜得手舞足蹈起來，是何門何派都無所謂，為時是常或短也無妨，你總算與這世間的某個人有名份可言了。=You suddenly performed a deep bow, leaving even Xiahou Lan astonished. Even the most free‑spirited Eldest Senior Brother dared not defy the ancestral teachings. 你嚇得魂不附體，連滾帶爬落荒而逃。=You were scared out of your wits and fled in a panic, rolling and crawling.

你幫道士的理由，是因為你妒恨天下俊美男子，尤其是他這樣彬彬有禮，一副品德高尚的款，光看了你就一股無名火起。=The reason you helped the Daoist priest was that you envied every handsome man alive, and especially one so courteous, so seemingly virtuous, as him—the mere sight of him kindled a nameless fury in you.

你問起龍湘此番事了，將來欲往何方，她才猛然想起這回出錦香宮，遊歷江湖，除了自己的目標，也遵奉師命行俠仗義，要為自己、為錦香宮打響名聲。\n臨行前溫夫人給她與眾師姐妹一部名冊，名曰《惜花令》。此冊中錄了許多欺侮女子的風流惡棍，要錦香宮弟子按冊尋訪，核實傳聞。遇有罪證確鑿之輩，便下手除掉。今日對付的陳序就在此冊之列。\n至於她下一個目標，就是你唐門大師兄，飛俠唐布衣。\n你聞言駭然色變，龍湘連忙解釋，必會查證屬實，再聽取他本人陳詞，絕不會胡亂冤枉好人，到時也想請你來作見證。此刻相詢，不過是想想聽聽你的看法而已。=You asked Long Xiang what she meant to do now that this affair was settled, and where she meant to go next. Only then did she remember that in leaving Jinxiang Palace to wander the Jianghu this time, she pursued not only her own aims but also her master's charge to act with chivalry and justice, and to make a name for herself and for Jinxiang Palace. Before she had set out, Lady Wen had given her and her fellow disciples a roll called the Flower-Cherishing Register. It recorded the names of many philandering scoundrels who preyed on women, and the disciples of Jinxiang Palace were to seek them out and verify the rumors against them; where the evidence proved beyond doubt, they were to strike the culprits down. Chen Xu, whom you had dealt with today, was one of the names on that list. As for her next target — it was your Eldest Senior Brother, Flying Hero Tang Buyi of the Tang Clan. You paled at the news. Long Xiang hastened to explain that she would first confirm the truth of it and hear his own account before acting, never wronging an innocent man, and that she hoped to have you stand witness when the time came. For now, she said, she only wished to hear your thoughts.
你選擇幫大師兄開脫，雖說你也沒十足把握，大師兄算不算無辜。=You chose to speak up for your Eldest Senior Brother, though you yourself were not entirely certain he could be called innocent.
你選擇公報私仇，說了大師兄的壞話，龍湘此刻信透了你，還沒查證，便已對大師兄心懷殺意，暗下決心定要除此禍害。=You chose to settle a private grudge under the guise of justice, speaking ill of Eldest Senior Brother. Long Xiang, now fully trusting you, had already conceived murderous intent toward him without even verifying the truth, secretly resolving to eliminate this scourge.
天將亮時雨方停，龍湘想帶費娘子趕去看看日出，找個好地方安葬。便拍拍衣袖，與你作別。=When the rain finally ceased just before dawn, Long Xiang wanted to take Lady Fei to watch the sunrise and find a good place to lay her to rest. She patted her sleeves and bid you farewell.
你回到唐門，交出了雞，圓滿達成任務。\n事後二師兄借花獻佛，將雞湯獻給掌門，也提到你從中出力。=You returned to the Tang Clan, handed over the chicken, and completed the mission without a hitch. Afterward, Second Senior Brother took credit for your effort, presenting the chicken soup to the sect leader as though it were his own gift, though he did mention your contribution.
你回到唐門，因為手裡沒雞而慘遭毒打。\n看你是忘了自己出門幹啥去的，沒雞還好意思回來，存心找打。=You returned to the Tang Clan but were severely beaten for having no chicken to show for it. It seems you had forgotten what you even went out to do; to come back without a chicken took some nerve, practically begging to be hit.
\n山中欲知江湖新事，唯有讀報而已。\n你買了當月的江湖快報，直讀得眉飛色舞，這期新聞不比尋常，精采絕倫，不能只有你知道，正想出門找人大肆宣傳，就與大步推門進來的三師兄撞在一塊，原來他也讀了這期快報，也是一般心潮彭湃，恨不得找人分享。=To know the latest news from Jianghu in the mountains, one can only read the newspaper. You bought this month's Jianghu Bulletin and read it with eyes sparkling with excitement. This issue is particularly outstanding, so thrilling that you couldn't help but want to share it with others. Just as you were about to step out to spread the word, you collided with Third Senior Brother, who had also read the same issue and was equally excited, eager to share it with someone.
\n這天將要中午過去，只有做事耽擱了用餐的你還沒吃早飯。\n伙房的桌擦洗過了，不讓你坐著吃，唯有將冷了的饅頭帶回房裡吃，都還沒咬上半口，三師兄就興匆匆推門進來，揮舞手裡的江湖快報要你讀，想是有什麼特別有趣的內容，讓他恨不得到處宣揚。=By the time it approached noon, only you, who had been delayed in eating due to work, had yet to have breakfast. The kitchen table had been wiped clean, not allowing you to sit and eat; thus, you had to take the cold steamed bun back to your room. You hadn't even taken a bite when Third Senior Brother burst in excitedly, waving the Jianghu Bulletin in his hand, urging you to read it, as he suspected there was something particularly interesting, making him eager to spread the news everywhere.
原來當期快報特刊，刊的乃是武穆王寶藏重現江湖的消息。\n當年高宗皇帝聽信奸臣秦檜所言，一心向金求和，連下十二道金牌召回岳飛，\n岳王爺心知大勢已去，仍抗命違旨，五日之後，才從朱仙鎮撤軍，帶了當地百姓隨軍南遷，安置在南方，才回京面聖。\n岳家軍剛退兵，千辛萬苦收復的河南州縣，轉眼又淪喪於宿敵金兀朮之手。\n然而，那違旨抗令的五日，究竟是為何呢？\n當真只是為了要『讓朱仙鎮百姓收拾家當』，隨軍南遷嗎？\n江湖野史，與史官記述不同。=The special edition of that issue's news report featured word of King Wumu's Treasure reappearing in the Jianghu. Back then, Emperor Gaozong, heeding the words of the treacherous minister Qin Hui, was set on seeking peace with the Jin, and issued twelve golden plaques in a row to recall Yue Fei. King Yue, knowing the cause was lost, still defied the order, waiting five days before withdrawing his army from Zhuxian Town, bringing the local commoners south with the army and settling them there before returning to the capital to face the emperor. No sooner had the Yue Family's army withdrawn than the counties of Henan, recovered at such cost, fell once more into the hands of their old enemy Jin Wuzhu. Yet what was the true reason for those five days of defiance? Was it truly only to let the people of Zhuxian Town pack their belongings and move south with the army? The unofficial histories of the Jianghu tell it differently from the court chroniclers.
傳說中，岳王爺自知必死，卻沒放棄，而是將反擊的希望寄託於傳人。\n五日之中，重鑄陰符。命紅篷王、曾文先生、張憲、岳雲、徐慶等五人，將岳家軍主力一分為五，易為百姓，隨軍南遷，散諸武林為俠為寇。\n那朱仙鎮中的壯丁百姓，皆感召於大義，自請為替身。\n赤膽將士潛伏在野，只待賢臣清君側，撥雲見日，還朝廷一片清明氣象，岳雲再手持陰符，登高一呼，號召舊部，收復大好河山！\n然而，絕地反攻那一日始終沒有到來。\n紹興和議之後，金兀朮派遣使者密會秦檜，將岳飛與岳雲害命於風波亭。\n宋終究亡了。\n而陰符失佚於江湖，五路部眾及其後人有如孤魂野鬼，英魂至今徘徊。\n岳家寶藏，再也無人知曉下落。=In legend, King Yue knew he would die, yet he did not give up, but placed his hopes of retaliation in his successors. Within those five days, he had the Yin Tally recast, and ordered Red Canopy King, Mr. Zeng Wen, Zhang Xian, Yue Yun, and Xu Qing to split the main force of the Yue Family's army into five, disguise them as commoners, and lead them south with the refugees, scattering them across the Wulin to become heroes or bandits. The able-bodied men of Zhuxian Town, moved by this righteous cause, volunteered to take their place. These loyal soldiers lay hidden among the people, waiting for the day a virtuous minister would clear the corrupt from the emperor's side and restore the court to clarity-then Yue Yun would take up the Yin Tally once more, raise a call from the heights, summon his old troops, and reclaim the great rivers and mountains! Yet that day of a final counterattack never came. After the Shaoxing Peace Accord, Jin Wuzhu sent an envoy to secretly meet Qin Hui, and Yue Fei and Yue Yun were put to death at Fengbo Pavilion. In the end, the Song dynasty fell. The Yin Tally was lost to the Jianghu, and the five bands of soldiers and their descendants wander to this day like lost souls, their spirits still restless. To this day, no one knows what became of the Yue Family's Treasure.
而今悠悠八十載光陰流去，這江湖傳說竟又死灰復燃。\n此刻江湖沸沸揚揚，都說點蒼葉家兄妹的曾祖，乃是岳雲舊部，臨危受命，保管陰符與藏寶圖。\n聽雲劍為證，至於藏寶圖，則紋在其妹葉雲裳身上，得之富可敵國。=Now, after eighty years have passed, this Jianghu legend has once again been rekindled. At present, the Jianghu is abuzz with rumors, all saying that the great‑grandfather of the Ye siblings from Diancang was once a veteran of Yue Yun's forces, entrusted with safeguarding the Yin Fu and the treasure map in a time of crisis. The Listening Cloud Sword serves as proof, and as for the treasure map, it is inscribed on the body of their younger sister, Ye Yunshang, granting her immense wealth.
你此刻方始恍然大悟，為何葉雲舟行走江湖要戴斗笠，低頭掩人耳目，原來便是為此。=You only now realize why Ye Yunzhou wears a straw hat while walking the Jianghu and lowers his head to avoid detection‑it's precisely for this reason.
那日閻關三煞低聲下氣，欲窺葉姑娘胴體，並非單純好色，而是為了確認藏寶圖的傳聞究竟真實與否。=That day, Three Fiends of Yan Pass spoke in a low and respectful tone, intending to sneak a glance at Miss Ye's body. It was not merely out of lust, but rather to confirm whether the rumor about the treasure map was true.
這傳聞雖然有趣，但你和三師兄卻只當作是穿鑿附會的故事看待，付之一笑。=This rumor, although interesting, you and Third Senior Brother merely regard it as a fabricated story, dismissing it with a laugh.
你將信將疑，三師兄不禁啞然失笑，細細剖析給你聽，那朱仙鎮除去老少女子，壯丁幾何？只怕搬空了朱仙鎮，也未必能夠填充五路部將的空額。\n何況八十年過去，就算真有寶藏，也早被岳家後人取走。\n你聽了，這才釋然。=You were half convinced and half doubting, but Third Senior Brother couldn't help but chuckle, carefully explaining to you that Zhuxian Town, aside from the elderly and women, had how many able-bodied men to spare? Even if the whole town were emptied out, it might not fill the vacancies of the five routes' commanders. Besides, eighty years had passed; even if a treasure had existed, it would have long since been claimed by the Yue Family's descendants. Hearing this, you finally let it go.
四師兄碰巧回來，聽見你們在說這事，也湊了過來。\n那葉家兄妹人在蜀中的消息，不知怎的走漏了。四師兄這一趟下山走商，到處都聽人談論武穆王寶藏。\n四師兄貪財，卻沒把這事放心上，因為壓根就不信。旁人卻不見得清醒，人皆愛財，一聽聞葉雲舟帶著自家小妹逃離點蒼，本來不信的，也都紛紛起了疑心。\n道聽途說、穿鑿附會者眾，真金雖不怕火煉，卻怕三人成虎，金子也給吞落肚。子虛烏有的傳聞都被傳得煞有其事，霎時掀起一波江湖風雨。\n提刀明搶者有之，捅窗暗窺者有之，還有人盯上了葉雲裳，一派正氣凜然的模樣，假意主持公道，實則是想搏得美人芳心，把人給娶了，到時不是魚與熊掌兼得，愛怎看就怎看嗎？=Fourth Senior Brother happened to be returning and overheard you discussing this matter, so he joined in.\nNews of the Young Master and Miss of the Ye Clan, residing in Shu, somehow leaked out. During his business trip down the mountain, Fourth Senior Brother heard people everywhere talking about King Wumu's Treasure.\nFourth Senior Brother is greedy for wealth, but he didn't take it to heart, because he didn't believe it to begin with. Others weren't so clear-headed, though. People are naturally drawn to riches; upon hearing that Ye Yunzhou had led his sister away from Diancang, those who initially doubted now harbored suspicions.\nNumerous rumors and fabrications spread, and while true gold can withstand refinement, it fears the power of three voices making a tiger real – even gold can be swallowed whole. Groundless rumors were spread with such conviction that they sparked a wave of upheaval in Jianghu.\nSome openly brandished their swords, while others secretly peered through windows. Others set their sights on Ye Yunshang, appearing with an air of righteous indignation, feigning a desire for justice – but in reality, they hoped to win the lady's favor and marry her. It would be a case of having both fish and bear's paw – a situation open to interpretation.
你聽了眉頭一皺，那軟軟糯糯的葉小妹子可是嬌聲喊過你哥哥的。\n如今給旁人惦記上了，還想算計她，總覺得心裏不大痛快。=You frowned at this. That soft, sweet little Ye sister had once called you 'brother' in such a charming voice. Now that others had set their sights on her and meant to scheme against her, you couldn't help feeling ill at ease.
\n這一日你下山到鎮上，到了食時，便如往常一般轉進客棧裡，想叫一碗麵充飢，沒想到這間小小客棧居然高朋滿座，不僅坐無虛席，甚至有人盤坐在地上喝酒。=On this day, you descended the mountain to the town. Upon reaching mealtime, you entered the inn as usual, intending to order a bowl of noodles to satisfy your hunger. Unbeknownst to you, this small inn was packed with esteemed guests, not only with no empty seats, but some people were even sitting cross‑legged on the floor drinking alcohol.
你還道是有什麼新奇菜式，沒忘了小師妹，想著反正山下事情都辦完了，正要回去，若是價錢不貴，又都是鄰居，不妨借個食盒打包上山獻獻殷勤。\n卻沒想到這些人都是醉翁之意不在酒，沒人衝著吃飯來的。=You assumed there might be some novel dish worth trying, and thinking of your Junior Martial Sister, you figured that since your business down the mountain was already finished and you were about to head back, you might as well-if the price wasn't too steep, and since they were all neighbors-borrow a food box and carry some up the mountain as a gesture of goodwill. Yet you had no idea that these people, like the drunkard whose heart isn't in his cup, hadn't come for the food at all.
地上一名乞丐聽見小二與你說話，主動過來接過話茬兒，你自不知他是為了報答那好心小二，不單沒驅趕，還斟上一壺熱茶。=A beggar on the ground heard the waiter talking to you and stepped forward to take over the conversation. You didn't realize he was thanking the kind waiter, so you not only didn't drive him away but also poured a pot of hot tea.
你定睛一看，登時便認出來人。\n可不就是大義分舵的姓花的叫化子嗎？\n旁人認不出他來，就像旁人認不出你來同樣的道理，一看就不是什麼值得用心記住的臉。\n至於你認出他來，也像他認出你來，那是搶菜打架打出的交情，非比尋常。=You looked closer and instantly recognized him. Wasn't this the beggar surnamed Hua from the Great Righteousness Branch? Others couldn't place him, for the same reason they couldn't place you-neither of your faces was the sort worth remembering. But you recognized him, just as he recognized you: a bond forged by scuffling over food, and not to be taken lightly.
問明了事情，才知道這許多人把小小地方客棧擠得水洩不通，都是為了那葉家兄妹來的。風聲傳開，越來越多人圍聚，葉家兄妹東躲西藏也擺脫不了跟蹤，索性不走了，一口氣結了幾日房錢，就此住下，以逸待勞，讓這些貪圖寶藏的人互相牽制，只有迫不得已碰見莽夫意圖強闖，才會拔劍退敵，據悉已住了好一陣子，每天都有人獻殷勤抑或威逼利誘。=After clarifying the situation, it became clear that so many people had crowded the small inn that it was nearly impossible to move. They were all there for the Ye siblings. Rumors spread, drawing more and more people, and the Ye siblings, hiding and running, couldn't escape the followers. They decided to stay, paid for several days' lodging, and waited idly for the enemy to tire themselves out. They only drew their swords when a brute attempted to force their way in. It is said they have been staying there for quite some time, with people offering flattery or threats and inducements every day.
又和姓花的乞丐吵嘴幾句，他們才自承來意，大義分舵確實是受命於幫主，為了寶藏來的，但他們幫主壓根不信有寶藏存在，只怕這謠言害了忠良之後，才派人來暗中盯著，輕易不出手，只在奪寶客們商議之際，冷言冷語挑撥離間，令他們各自心懷鬼胎不能團結而已。\n必要時也替葉家兄妹把賊人打退，雖然沒寶藏，討些普通賞錢卻是可以。=You traded a few more words with the Hua-surnamed beggar before they finally admitted why they had come: the Great Righteousness Branch truly had been sent by their Gang Leader for the treasure, but their Gang Leader himself did not believe any treasure existed at all — he had only sent men to watch in secret, fearing the rumor might bring harm to the descendants of the loyal and virtuous. They would not act rashly, only sowing cold words of discord among the treasure hunters at their councils, so each grew wary of the others and could not unite. When needed, they would also help drive off thieves for the Ye siblings; though there was no treasure, a few ordinary rewards were fair game.
正說話間，又有個不長眼的上樓挑戰，被踢下樓來。=While they were speaking, another clueless fool climbed up to challenge and was kicked down from the stairs.
你料你那葉兄弟武功高強，犯不著你來強出頭。\n你在店門口挨著，靜觀其變，且聽周遭眾人如何議論。=You reckoned your friend Ye was a formidable enough fighter that you had no call to charge in and steal the spotlight. You lingered by the inn door, watching how things unfolded, and listened to what the crowd around you was saying.
山中歲月十年如一日，不出點亂子可說乏味得很，這種熱鬧可不常有，哪能錯過。\n你在店門口挨著不走，且聽周遭眾人如何議論。=A decade in the mountains passed as though it were a single day, dull indeed without some trouble to break it up; excitement like this didn't come often, so how could you bear to miss it? You lingered by the inn door and would not budge, listening to what the crowd around you was saying.
你心中頗不以為然，若你所向無敵，當然要插手管一管。可惜你很脆弱，所向皆敵，路邊野狗壯一點、兇一點的多來幾條，你都未必能贏。\n這麼多人，等下萬一打起來，刀劍無眼，你是鐵定要沒命的。\n反正無論寶藏是真是假，都沒你的份，無端賠命才是真的。這種熱鬧還是不湊為妙，避遠些，早點回家才是正經。=You weren't convinced — if you were invincible, of course you'd have stepped in to help. But unfortunately you were fragile, and enemies seemed to lurk everywhere; even a few unusually large, vicious stray dogs might well be more than you could beat. With so many people here, if a fight broke out, blades and swords cared nothing for whose eyes they found — you were certain to die. Whether the treasure was real or fake, none of it would ever be yours anyway; dying for nothing was the only sure outcome. Best not to join such excitement at all — better to keep your distance and head home while you still could.
有人毫不會閻，提著兵刃上樓，明搶來著。\n葉雲舟也不是孤軍奮戰，昔日闖蕩江湖結交的朋友們都自告奮勇守衛葉家小妹，只是異常熱切，討好諂媚之異表露無遺，唯恐落於人後，從前一口一個兄弟的，如今都互相攻訐，不肯讓人專美於前。\n葉雲舟何嘗不知他們的主意，無話可說，惟有心寒而已。\n話都還沒說開，又有人結夥上樓挑戰，那兩個江湖少俠見獵心喜，表現機會來了，登時就替葉雲舟接了陣。\n來挑戰的還有一人，他聽葉雲舟江湖名聲很好，都讚他宛如山上松樹蒼勁，不畏冰霜悽慘，終歲常端正，不驕不躁，謙沖自牧。是以吃軟怕硬，囂張得很，想兇幾句來個下馬威。\n殊不知葉雲舟連日所見所聞，皆是貪婪嘴臉、滿口子兄弟的膩耳諂媚聲，心寒至極，對熟人尚且還能客套，對這等不相熟卻不懷好意欺上門的，更無半分耐性。聽雲劍出鞘入鞘，轉身進房，那人還兀自不知自己已經死了，說了幾句話都沒異樣，直到他動身想跟隨進房，腦袋才搬家，咕嚕嚕滾下樓梯。\n葉雲舟殺了人，不願再給店家添麻煩，揹著妹妹，跳窗從窗戶走了。\n店中武林人爭先恐後湧出店去，你也身不由己被沖到皆街上。=Some made no attempt to hide their intentions—marching upstairs with weapons in hand, ready to rob by force.\nBut Ye Yunzhou wasn't alone in this fight. 馮史恨不能自搧幾個耳光，告誡片刻之前的自己不要踏入大院，可惜為時已晚，掌門垂詢，他不敢不答，一五一十將寶藏傳聞告知，他倒也不是什麽大壞人，平素所行多半沒有違背俠義，也不忘替年輕後生開脫，固有貪財之人，可是也不少人是當真心懷大義，想勸葉家兄妹將寶藏取出，資助朝廷抗金的俠士。\n心知小命還拿捏在人手，不敢稍有隱瞞，也不諱言自己是想充作好人，居中調解，財色兼收的那種。\n掌門聽他自毀名聲，總算解氣，遂放他一條生路，馮史千恩萬謝，忙不迭逃出大院去，口稱要退隱江湖，還真就退隱江湖了，在遠離唐門的地方置產安享晚年，餘生無論唐門興衰，都不敢再議論半字。=Feng Shi could have slapped himself for ever setting foot in that courtyard, but it was too late for regret now.
