眾人嘈鬧一陣，良久推舉不出人來。\n當即便有一名兇悍補快，以自己地位最尊，名義最順，推開人牆出來。\n這人算是半個江湖人，仗著捕頭身份，欺壓良民慣了，等閒江湖人也不敢與官府正面衝突，都是能讓則讓，因此令他更加瞧不起江湖人，一上來就想來個下馬威，把手裡大刀虎虎生風揮了幾下，口稱「兀那刁民，算個什麼東西，想要造反不成？」緊接著就去投胎了。\n今日官府來的人，可不只他一人而已，但凡有點資歷的都知道唐門乃是朝廷的眼中釘，那可不是針對宋氏江山，是自有唐門以來，就和當官的水火不容。他們這群姓唐的，是天下最符合「以武犯禁」罪名的人，別說官，連官家都打過，前朝唐玄宗入蜀還想作威作福，就被唐門倚外堡為基地，打到君威蕩然無存。\n這捕快一上來不但口出惡言，還亮刀子威嚇人家掌門，乃是求仁得仁。\n再讓推舉出一個人來說話，這回怎麼也沒人敢上，掌門沒好耐心，索性隨手點了一個濃眉大眼的丐幫小子出來。\n李富貴來自丐幫，一臉憨厚模樣，見面就跪了下去，還道他是怕了才行此大禮，沒想到他緊接著就自曝，怕是怕了，不過跪下去不是因為有禮貌，而是腳軟。\n掌門肚裡好笑，火氣消了幾分，倒也不討厭這種耿直僕實的年輕人，面上依然佯作嚴厲，喝問他事情。\n李富貴被掌門一下，忙不迭將所知所想全都一股腦兒全盤托出，從寶藏傳說到丐幫來意，甚至連幫主吩咐要特別提防唐門的事情也說了出來，慢了半拍才驚覺說錯了話，李富貴駭得臉色鐵青，想起方才捕頭的淒慘死狀，當即兩眼一翻，把自己嚇暈了過去。\n其實掌門雖然手辣，卻挺講道理，向來只殺欠殺雜種，只要稍懂禮數或肯講道理的人，都不至於即死。\n對這李富貴有幾分惜才之心，更聽說丐幫授命於幫主，壓根不信有寶藏，此來不過是暗中保護葉家兄妹的，還哪裡會下毒手，招來丐幫弟子，令他們扶走李富貴，還贈一枚生龍活虎丹以示嘉勉。\n有了那捕快作襯比，李富貴只是暈倒，壓根不算什麼丟臉事，反而還傳成他挺過了唐掌門的無形暗器，只是暈倒而沒分屍，足見他功力深厚，對他大大的讚美。=The crowd chattered noisily for a long while, but no one was able to be nominated.\nJust then, a fierce and aggressive bailiff pushed his way through, using his status and name to force his way through the crowd.\nHe was considered half a person of Jianghu, accustomed to bullying the common folk with his status as a head bailiff. 可是見你和葉雲舟頗有交情的樣子，眾師兄弟轉念一想，都覺得連你這種貨色都能交往，這位點蒼劍俠說不定人品挺不錯的，再說他被點蒼通緝，敵人的敵人就是朋友了。\n雖不能說是疑心盡去，可是也沒不盡人情，便留他在弟子房中過夜。\n葉雲舟聽你們說笑打鬧也為之莞爾，點蒼的人都嚴肅得很，很少這樣嘻皮笑臉。\n卻不知唐門之所以風氣如此活躍，多半還是受大師兄所累，人人都學他沒大沒小、幹話連篇。=But seeing how well you got along with Ye Yunzhou, the disciples reconsidered — if even someone like you could be friends with him, maybe this Diancang swordsman wasn't so bad after all. Besides, since Diancang wanted him too, an enemy's enemy was a friend. Though their suspicions weren't entirely gone, they didn't turn him away outright, and let him spend the night in the disciples' quarters. Ye Yunzhou smiled faintly at the laughter and horseplay, for Diancang folk were usually so solemn, rarely so carefree. Yet he never guessed the Tang Clan's lively atmosphere owed largely to the Eldest Senior Brother's influence, with everyone picking up his cheeky, motor-mouthed ways.
之後葉雲舟在鍛冶場中抱劍坐著熬了一宿，你們開窗看他一動不動，似乎睡得很沉，實則他片刻也沒真的睡去。\n一如你們不信任他，他也不信任你們。=After that, Ye Yunzhou sat in the forge holding his sword, enduring the night awake. You opened the window to watch him, motionless, seeming deeply asleep, yet in reality he hadn't slept at all. Just as you did not trust him, he did not trust you.
之後葉雲舟在鍛冶場中抱劍坐著熬了一宿，你們開窗看他一動不動，似乎睡得很沉，實則他片刻也沒敢真的入眠。\n一如你們不信任他，他也不信任你們。\n隔日一早，他便去山中劈竹搭了一個簡易草蘆，又去接妹妹雲裳一起住。\n然而慘遭無情嫌棄，葉雲裳現在備受寵愛，吃香喝辣，哪裡還願去和哥哥吃苦住草廬。=That night, Ye Yunzhou sat in the forge, holding his sword and enduring till dawn without moving. Early the next morning, he went into the mountains to split bamboo and build a simple thatched hut, then went to fetch his sister Yunshang to live with him. However, he was met with cold rejection; Ye Yunshang was now favored and living a life of luxury, enjoying fine food and drink, and had no desire to suffer alongside her brother in a grass hut.
\n這天你心力交瘁，剛想午睡，外邊就有人喊出公差。=That day you were worn out in body and mind, and just as you were about to nap, someone outside called out that corvee duty had been announced.
\n這天風和日麗，你剛想午睡，外邊就有人喊出公差。=That day the weather was fair and mild, and just as you were about to nap, someone outside called out that corvee duty had been announced.
你還想裝作沒聽見，就給師兄衝入房裡打了一頓拖出去。=You still wanted to pretend you hadn't heard, so Senior Brother charged into the room, gave you a beating, and dragged you out.
抓公差的師兄進房見你在睡，剛想開口罵人，旋即又想你近日忙裡忙外，一刻不得清閒，不禁心生惻隱，於是又關上了房門讓你睡。\n你這一覺從中午睡到傍晚，竟沒人騷擾，睡得不能再飽。\n養足了精神，感覺人生又充滿了希望。=Senior Brother, tasked with rounding up men for corvee duty, came into the room and found you asleep. You slept clear through from noon until dusk, undisturbed by anyone, as soundly as you ever had. Well rested, you felt life brimming with hope once more.
只是沒想到你人在家裡躺著，禍事也不放你甘休，師兄弟們從山下回來，見你都臉色古怪，聽三師兄說，才知道嵩山和丐幫械鬥，聽說還是你本人挑唆的。\n你簡直莫名其妙，滿腹委屈，頓時就想到了頭號嫌疑犯，世上會冒充你的，除了那前科累累的晁和以外還會有誰？\n三師兄並非不信你，但為講究公平，只得先帶你進煉丹房向掌行使二師兄稟報經過，另派門人去傳喚晁和上山對質。=You never expected that even lying at home, trouble wouldn't leave you be. You were utterly baffled and full of grievance, and at once thought of the prime suspect — who else in the world would impersonate you but that repeat offender Chao He? Third Senior Brother didn't doubt you, but for fairness' sake he still had to take you to the alchemy room first to report to Second Senior Brother, while sending another disciple to summon Chao He up the mountain to confront you.
縱使二師兄看你不順眼，身為掌刑使依舊鐵面無私，他可不似三師兄墨守成規，想也知道禍端何起，可沒心力浪費在你這無關緊要的傢伙身上。=Even though Second Senior Brother finds you displeasing, as Chief of Punishments he remains impartial and unyielding. Unlike Third Senior Brother, who clings to convention, he can easily guess where the trouble started, and has no energy to waste on someone as unimportant as you.
二師兄可不似三師兄墨守成規，想也知道禍端何起。\n他命你帶著被褥住進將煉丹房代他掌火，一來是為丹藥故，二來也是防你受門人閒言閒語，多生枝節。\n一下山就掌握了晁和蹤跡，住客棧盯哨數日，待掌門號令三度傳召不應，這才出手。=Second Senior Brother is not like Third Senior Brother, who sticks to convention — he could easily guess where the trouble had started. The moment he came down the mountain he had already tracked down Chao He's whereabouts, and stayed at an inn keeping watch for several days, only making his move once the sect leader had sent for him three times with no response.
一聽三師兄說，才知道是外堡出了亂子，呂翁上山求助。\n一如大多數的江湖案件，起因都小得令人髮指，偏生江湖人血器旺盛，一口氣不順，越爭越著惱，惱起來就能提刀殺人，便是道人、和尚亦難免俗。\n何況這回還是僧人和丐幫弟子爭奪布施，爭的還不止一口氣，還有一口飯呢。=It wasn't until I heard from Third Senior Brother that I learned there was trouble at the Outer Fortress, and Lu Weng had come seeking aid.\nAs with most Jianghu affairs, the initial cause was trivial—insignificant to the point of ridicule—but those within Jianghu are quick to anger, unable to tolerate even the smallest inconvenience. Such frustrations escalate, inevitably leading to bloodshed; even monks and priests are not immune to worldly passions.\nThis time, the dispute was between monks and disciples of the Beggars' Sect over alms, a conflict not merely about breath, but about a meal as well.
勸架、和事佬，這是南宮世家的本職，呂翁卻找上唐門，你怎麼想都覺得不安。=Mediating disputes and being a peacemaker are the Nangong family's duty. Yet Lu Weng approached the Tang Clan, and no matter how you think about it, you feel uneasy.

你唐門的手段就是戰他娘親。\n人與人一旦吃飽太閒就會內訌，但是面對天災反會團結。\n要讓丐幫弟子和嵩山僧人和好，最容易的方法莫過於轉移矛盾，為此唐門義不容辭化身天災。=Your Tang Clan's method is to Fight their mother. When people are full and too idle, they will fight among themselves, but in the face of natural disasters, they tend to unite. 三師兄什麼的根本控制不住情況。=Third Senior Brother couldn't control the situation at all.

你在混戰之中喪命，成為唯一犧牲者。=You died in the chaotic battle and became the sole casualty.

矛頭指向你，你簡直說不出的委屈，要是你幹的也索罷了，可你沒撈到一點好處還受冤枉，這怎麼行？=The blame is directed at you, and you feel utterly wronged. If you had done something wrong, that would be one thing, but you haven't gained any benefit and are still being unjustly accused. How can this be acceptable?
矛頭指向你，你簡直說不出的委屈，身受諸般苦，始終想做好人，結果就是這種報應？=The blame is directed at you, you feel an unbearable sense of injustice, enduring all sorts of suffering, always trying to be a good person, yet this is the consequence?
幸好三師兄明理，一想就覺得事有蹊蹺，犯案還刻意留名，這手法聽著有點熟悉，莫不是那慣犯忘了自己人在蜀中，又想故技重施，栽贓於你？=Fortunately, Third Senior Brother is a sensible man; the moment he thought it over, something felt off. 你無端被人冤枉未遂，也不知他如何有幸，犯了錯有他乾娘撐腰，撐不住還有掌門代受，討回了公道，可是心意難平。\n跑到後山去大吼大叫，直待到太陽將要下山了才回大院。=You were nearly wronged for nothing, and there's no telling how he's always so fortunate—when he errs, his godmother backs him, and when that's not enough, the sect leader takes the blame in his place. Soliciting alms was nothing unusual, but what was odd was that he wouldn't pick on the weak—instead he went straight for the local tyrants who preyed on the villagers, provoking them with his sharp tongue until they were furious enough to raise their fists and strike.
你欺善怕惡，竟然去幫那惡霸許大鯨，圍毆福韞。=You bully the weak and fear the strong, yet you went to help that evil bully Xu Dajing, surrounding and attacking Fu Yun.
見義勇為，是俠義本懷，你怎能坐視不理？當即出手，與福韞合鬥那滄幫惡霸許大鯨。=To act bravely in the face of injustice is the very heart of chivalry—how could you stand idly by? You immediately stepped in, joining Fu Yun to fight that ruthless Cang Gang bully, Xu Dajing.

\n你碰到了上官螢，她手一攤就向你要錢。\n你知道她精打細算，但從沒想過她會明搶，她見你不給，還道你想賴帳，拿出借據來，白紙黑字寫得清清楚楚，不是你借了白銀十兩的署名畫押卻是什麼？\n你滿肚子冤屈，取來印泥紙筆一對，上官螢登時便知錯怪了你。\n向她借錢那人與你相貌相似，以她對你的關心，難辨真偽，念著舊情即刻就借出了十兩銀子，沒想到會上當受騙，心中實在怒不可遏。\n冒充你那人拿了錢八成揚揚得意，卻沒想到上官小娘子絕非易與之輩，她虔心禮佛，卻沒有三度容人的雅量，膽敢騙她錢財，那是刨出祖墳都要追究到底的。=You ran into Shangguan Ying, who held out her hand and demanded money from you. This man dared to impersonate your reputation and fabricate lies, yet your second senior brother offered no rebuke, but instead recommended him to be formally initiated?\nThat Cháo Hé possessed a remarkably thick skin; he immediately broke into laughter, showing no gratitude for this generous treatment, and instead put on an act of reluctant acceptance, which infuriated you to the point where you almost drew your sword and fought.\nLittle did you know that your second senior brother swiftly shifted the conversation, his face hardening. He only wanted this man to enter the sect so he could deal with him according to the Clan Rules. Otherwise, he's not worthy of carrying the surname Zhao, not Tang.\nUpon hearing this, Cháo Hé immediately feigned humility, repeatedly offering excuses, claiming that his family had recently passed away, making it unsuitable for him to change his faith and surname, playing up his tragic circumstances.\nYour second senior brother wished he could kill him outright; seeing the two of them side by side, you found yourself surprisingly pleased with your own esteemed status.
二師兄遂要你與他出門去，替自己討回公道。=Second Senior Brother then told you to go out with him and claim justice for yourself.
你等的就是這句話，再看掌門居然也有嘉勉鼓勵之色，連本門師長都贊成你揍人，哪裡還帶猶豫的，你拎著他後領，便大跨步出去，丟到大院之外，才與他動手。=This was the very line you had been waiting for. 你最終選擇息事寧人，心想自己並非鼎鼎大名，要是太加刁難，事後不免為人議論，便輕輕縱放了他。\n三師兄輕自送他下山，聽他一路哭哭啼啼說自己命運乖舛，惻隱之心大動，將自己節儉省下的銀子送贈給他，盼他發憤圖強，不要向命運低頭。\n殊不知他前腳剛走，那晁和便背後笑他好騙，把他當作了當成好騙的傻子。\n他晁和何許人也？那就是個混子、人渣，不騙聰明人，專騙三師兄這種好心人。\n他才不管自己所做所為會糟賤人間僅存的良善，令善人變得不再輕信於人，他自爽他的，他有書讀，只是不愛讀書，又忌妒有讀書的人，恨不得天下學問人早死，不得超生。=In the end you chose to let the matter rest, thinking that you were not so famous that people wouldn't talk if you pressed too hard, and so you let him off lightly. 你恨不得打死了他，而且你也誠實的表達了你的殺人願望。\n三師兄大驚失色，反倒是掌門居然面露嘉勉鼓勵之色，雖然不准你痛下殺手，但打個半死卻無傷大雅。\n連本門師長都贊成你揍人，哪裡還帶猶豫的，你拎著他後領，便大跨步出去，丟到大院之外，才與他動手。=You wanted to kill him so much that you honestly expressed your desire to kill him. \n前回那事剛了不久，這回冒充你的晁和再度上山，這回他找了個靠山，整個人走路都有風，渾無上一回唯唯諾諾的影子。\n他找的靠山，乃是從你唐門出嫁的一位資深大師姑，連掌門都要喊她一聲師姊。\n本門出納帳目改由三師兄接手以前，都是這位師姑一手操辦，她每次回來，都會耀武揚威一番，整治一下小輩，過過前輩癮，這回更是變本加厲，有心要替乾兒出頭，來個狠狠的下馬威。=Not long after the previous incident, Chao He once again came back to the mountain, this time with a powerful ally. He now walks with confidence, no longer the timid figure from before. The ally he has found is a senior master who was married into the Tang Clan, someone even the sect leader must address as his elder sister. Before the Third Senior Brother took over the management of the sect's accounts, this master was in charge, and every time she returned, she would display her authority, scold the younger generation, and satisfy her sense of seniority. 她一聲令下，眾師兄弟迫於淫威，竟齊齊攻向你，名曰對練，大師姑卻似有意趁機殺了你似的。=With a single command from her, all the brothers were compelled by her oppressive authority to attack you together, under the guise of sparring, while the Great Martial Aunt seemed intent on taking the opportunity to kill you.
小師妹遠遠見你受圍，不假思索便與你同一陣線。\n二師兄老早就被吵得心神不寧，見小師妹都挺身而出了，深怕她為了你這不直前的傢伙傷了毫髮，只得介入，也好藉機教訓這些不明事理的愚蠢師弟。=Junior Sister saw from afar that you were surrounded and, without a second thought, threw in her lot with you.\nSecond Senior Brother, already on edge from all the commotion, saw her step forward and feared she might come to harm for the sake of a worthless fellow like you. He had no choice but to step in himself — and take the chance to teach these ignorant, foolish junior disciples a lesson.
二師兄老早就被吵得心神不寧，若大師姑只是不輕不重虐你幾下，他也懶得搭理，可是一個出嫁的師姑使喚門人圍殺同門，絕非門規所能容，只得不情不願介入，也好藉機教訓這些不明事理的愚蠢師弟。=The Second Senior Brother has been disturbed for a long time. 她一聲令下，竟想假以對練名義，使喚眾師兄弟圍攻你一人。\n眾師兄弟對她固然敬畏，終究是敬大於畏，感念她從前的苦勞，以前偶爾上山耍威風，為難一下大家也就算了，如今竟異想天開，意圖支使同門子弟去圍毆自己師兄弟，於情於理都說不過去，人人面有怒容，更無一人聽令。\n師姑從來沒被同門子弟當面駁斥，一張臉漲得通紅，不由得心慌，氣焰消歛，別要下馬威不成，反而把正事搞砸了，遂強忍怒意，攜乾兒子去正心堂拜見掌門了。=With a single command, she intended to use the pretext of practice to order the fellow disciples to surround and attack you alone. This was unreasonable both emotionally and logically, and everyone wore expressions of anger, refusing to follow her orders. The Master Aunt had never been openly contradicted by her fellow disciples, and her face turned bright red with embarrassment. Unable to contain her anxiety, her arrogance diminished; she realized that if she continued to act tough, she would only ruin the matter at hand. 一眾師兄弟中，也有幾個資深師兄曾受師姑指點，格外敬畏，雖不情願與你動手，但被師姑命令所迫，還是不得不與你當眾切磋。=Among the group of disciples, there are a few senior brothers who have been guided by the Martial Aunt, and they hold her in particular reverence. 得到強援，而同門師兄弟亦畏手畏腳，你方竟能以少勝多。\n二師兄既然出手，可沒這麼輕易便放過他們，宣布即日起要繞山晨跑，日課加倍、午休取消，入夜要到正心堂打坐。月考變半月考，不及格者，他來親自督導。\n這日子怕不比地獄還難熬，從軍都比較有盼頭。\n人人叫苦，怨聲載道，大師姑見這師侄如此狠辣，又怕犯眾怒，下馬威已足，便攜著乾兒子去正心堂拜見掌門了。=With reinforcements, the fellow disciples are now hesitant, yet you managed to overcome the odds with fewer resources. Since Second Senior Brother has taken action, he won't let them off easily. He announced that from now on, they must run around the mountain for morning exercises, double their daily lessons, cancel their lunch break, and meditate in Zhengxin Hall at night. The monthly exam has been changed to a biweekly one, and those who fail will be personally supervised by him. This life is surely worse than hell; even serving in the military seems more hopeful. 借旁人之手將你一頓飽打，替她乾兒子出了口惡氣，這才心滿意足，姑且饒你。=Using someone else's hands to give you a proper beating, venting her spleen on her adopted son's behalf, only then did she feel satisfied enough to spare you, for now.
她只道她欽點那人是自己一手調教的高手，要修理你這個不得真傳的外姓弟子不費吹灰之力，怎料你怪招頻出，別說那師兄本來就不想打，就是真想揍你，也未必是你對手，敗下陣來。\n師姑氣急敗壞，可是拿你沒轍，轉念一想，乾脆去向掌門告狀，說你偷學別派武功，催他逐你出師門。=She assumed the man she'd handpicked was a master of her own training, and that disciplining you, an outside-surname disciple who'd never received the true teachings, would take no effort at all. 在她一聲令下，門中弟子列隊排開，分成兩陣對練，打了個筋疲力竭。\n師姑給足下馬威，心滿意足，連隨興指點裝裝樣子都懶，攜著乾兒子去正心堂拜見掌門了。=At her command, the sect's disciples lined up in formation, splitting into two groups for a sparring session, exhausting themselves. 你一眼就看穿這人虛情假意，絕非善類，不過你也不是好拿捏的軟柿子，他假惺惺送錢，你就老實不客氣收下，反正你就是不拿，他也一定會冤枉你拿。=You can see through this man's false sincerity at a glance — he's no good sort. 你不禁艷羨，怎麼你娘親就沒為你做過這些事情？\n你沒收錢，卻收下了蜜餞果子，表示合解。\n他卻不領情，哼哼冷笑，將錢自己收了起來。=You couldn't help but feel envious, wondering why your mother hadn't done these things for you.\nYou refused the money, but accepted the candied fruit, a gesture of reconciliation.\nHe, however, remained unappreciative, scoffing and pocketing the money himself.

四師兄向來不說自己是好人，可對家人朋友卻還是挺仗義的，既是託你的福才訛來的錢，自然要分你一半。\n你推拒不得，莫名其妙收了錢，感其心意，連日勞累混濁的心相也清朗幾分。=Fourth Senior Brother has never claimed to be a good man, but he's always been loyal to family and friends — since it was thanks to you that he'd swindled the money in the first place, he naturally meant to split it with you. 四師兄向來不說自己是好人，可對家人朋友卻還是挺仗義的，既是託你的福才訛來的錢，自然要分你一半。\n你推拒不得，莫名其妙收了錢，又怕他想趁機放你高利貸，錢始終放著不敢擅用，事後一陣子才相信是你想多了。=Fourth Senior Brother has never claimed to be a good person, but he's still quite righteous towards family and friends. To avoid the Tang Clan's tortures, he made a reckless decision, severing his meridians to abandon his martial arts. He even relinquished the Tang surname and declared his withdrawal from the martial world. 大師兄毫不留情痛扁了你一頓，用他的拳頭告訴你一個簡明扼要的道理：「我很強，我才不會死，放一萬個心吧。」揮揮衣袖，飄然而去。\n你望著他的去向，怔然半晌，那些不講情面的拳頭打服了你躁動的心，明明挨了一頓暴揍，心情卻平靜下來了。\n便如往常一樣，大師兄既說去去就回，那便是當真去去就回吧。=Eldest Senior Brother beat you without mercy, using his fists to deliver a clear message: I'm strong, I won't die, rest assured. 討到三師兄的保證，約定下回開始再不寬限，呂翁尚不滿意。\n向唐門提起了一個要求，一個你以為可以順利帶進墳墓的秘密。\n你撒謊的當初，就沒想過這秘密有朝一日竟會像殭屍般破土而出！=Securing Third Senior Brother's promise to no longer grant leniency next time, Lu Weng was still dissatisfied. He raised a request with the Tang Clan‑a secret you thought could be smoothly taken into the grave. 你一個機伶，冷汗從頰邊滑下。\n呂翁所提的那幅字畫，豈不正是你冒充杜甫落款的塗鴉嗎！=A chill of alarm shot through you, cold sweat sliding down your cheek. Wasn't the painting Lu Weng spoke of exactly the forgery you'd signed with Du Fu's name?
三師兄與呂翁攜來的年輕先生對你的字畫過度解讀，\n呂翁越聽越心癢，遂請先生與你同上樓來，看看唐門是否還有蒙塵的名貴文物字畫值得玩賞。=The Third Senior Brother and Lu Weng's young Mister overinterpreted your calligraphy and paintings, causing Lu Weng to grow increasingly eager. 那先生見你談吐隨意，不似讀書人樣，心下不喜，別開三師兄的面，文人的驕氣便顯了出來，對你幾句說話也不客氣了，你好生委屈。=Mister saw your speech as casual, not like a scholar's manner, and felt displeased. Enthusiastically, you summoned Eldest Senior Brother's doodles, only to find they not only failed to achieve your goal but were instead taken as mockery, offending the person. All of this was thanks to Eldest Senior Brother. Thanks, Eldest Senior Brother.
即使想要整些花樣出來，也無計可施。\n於是你放棄了思考，學會放棄也是人生的重要課題。=Even if you want to come up with some tricks, there's no way to do it. So you stopped thinking, and learning to give up is also an important lesson in life.

你一席話點破呂翁心機，以大義為本不亢不卑，字字鏗鏘，更引用了至聖先師的話語，聽得三師兄暗暗叫好。\n三師兄表面訓斥你對長輩師禮，卻附和你的說法，呂翁得不了好處，只得狼狽而去，只是恚怒在心，滿擬下回一定要找回場子來。=Your words exposed Master Lu's schemes, upholding righteousness with neither arrogance nor subservience, each syllable ringing with conviction. 你與三師兄同仇敵愾，一致對外。\n三師兄做主婉拒了呂翁的邀請，使他惱羞成怒，雙方幾乎算是撕破了臉。\n呂翁恚怒在心，下回再來，只怕免不了將有一場硬仗。=You and Third Senior Brother stood united against a common foe. Lu Weng nursed his resentment in secret — when he came again, a fierce clash seemed unavoidable.
你雖動口不動手，卻目露兇光。\n三師兄也與你同一陣線，呂翁眼見討不了好去，悻悻而歸。\n只是恚怒在心，下回再來，只怕免不了將有一場硬仗。=Although you spoke but did not act, your eyes blazed with fury. Next time he came again, a hard fight seemed unavoidable.
你壓根不能忍，立即發狂朝呂翁撲去，幸為三師兄所阻。\n奔出講經樓，你又像瘋子一般追了上去，斯文先生忍無可忍，與你大打出手。=You couldn't bear it any longer and flew into a rage, rushing at Lu Weng, only to be stopped by Third Senior Brother. 最終，帳房先生得到三師兄首肯，帶走了他從前閒時寫就的字帖作為抵押。\n下回開始，便要認真還債了。=In the end, the Accountant secured Third Senior Brother's approval and took the calligraphy he had written in his spare time as collateral. From now on, he would have to repay the debt in earnest.
你為了掩飾區區字畫真相，竟喪心病狂，出手襲殺無辜的帳房先生，更誣陷他奪畫而逃，惡人先告狀，揚言要報官。\n呂翁迫不得已，只好花錢消災，只求息事寧人。\n你的行徑雖為師門免除了部分債務，卻也惹來了一些不好的風聲。=You went to such lengths to hide the truth about a trifling painting that you turned murderously ruthless — attacking and killing the innocent Accountant, then framing him for stealing the painting and fleeing. 你打倒了算帳先生，旋即施展輕功，追殺呂翁。\n不料那算帳先生也不是省油的燈，早有預料，獻策呂翁眾金延請多位武林人士坐鎮，以策萬全。\n這不，錢花得實在。你從追人變成被追，所幸那群江湖人士旨在嚇退你，不願招惹唐門，故而沒有深追，你才得以逃出生天。\n僥倖逃生，你的氣焰也消歛了些。=You knocked down the Accountant, then swiftly used your light skill to pursue Lu Weng.\nUnexpectedly, the Accountant was no ordinary man either. 你打倒了算帳先生，旋即施展輕功，追殺呂翁。\n恰巧碰上了剛好緝凶途經此處的名捕宋悲半路阻截。=You knocked down the Accountant, then immediately used your Qinggong to pursue Lu Weng — only to run into the renowned catcher Song Bei, who happened to be passing through on the trail of a criminal, and who intercepted you halfway.
你情急之下，口不擇言，出口便得罪了全天下的官，所幸宋悲氣度大，不願和你計較。=In your panic, you spoke rashly and offended officials across the land. Fortunately, Song Bei was magnanimous and chose not to hold it against you.

你打倒了算帳先生，旋即施展輕功，追殺呂翁。\n卻被從天而降的小師妹後發先至，攔住去路，勸你不要再追。\n她仍是面無改色，卻已有為師門獻身的覺悟，你不忍令這單純少女獨力承擔，誇下海口，要為師門償清債務，還她一個明亮將來。\n小師妹心下感激，卻沒有說出口，她怕你若不能實現，會終生為了一句道謝耿耿於懷。=You defeated the Accountant, then immediately used your Qinggong to pursue Lu Weng — only for Junior Martial Sister to drop from the sky, having set out after you yet arriving first, and block your path, urging you to give up the chase. 於此雅道，你以外姓弟子身分在正心堂伺候掌門點茶多年，亦頗有心得，泡出來的雖不能與名家手藝相比，卻也是行旅間難得喝上一盞的好茶。\n上官螢暗暗起了惜才之心，甚至動念將你從唐門要來作家丁，也好過埋過在這窮山裡了此一生。=In this refined art, you, as an outsider disciple, had served tea to the Sect Leader in the Zhengxin Hall for years and had gained considerable skill. Third Fragrance's betrayal had already tainted all her most treasured memories; your intrusion was, without doubt, a second defilement.

\n你與相熟的丐幫朋友最後一次切磋，請他指點丐幫擅長的江湖詭計，以免到時猝不及防遭害。你雖惜敗，卻換得了寶貴經驗，滿擬下回絕不能著了同樣的道。=You had your final sparring session with a familiar Beggar Sect friend, asking him to point out the sect's specialty in Jianghu tricks, so as not to be caught unprepared and harmed. Though you lost with regret, you gained valuable experience, confident that next time you would not fall for the same trick again.
看你昔日威風大唐門，今日搶菜搶不贏，打架也打不過，就連作乞丐的都感到同情，左顧右盼，眼見沒人，便往你手裡塞了一本丐幫獨門的輕功秘笈《八荒奪路逃》，叮囑你留得青山在，不怕沒柴燒，也算是仁至義盡了。=Seeing how you'd once cut such a fine figure in the Tang Clan, and now couldn't even win a scramble for vegetables or hold your own in a brawl, even a beggar felt sorry for you. Glancing about and seeing no one watching, he slipped into your hands a copy of the Beggar Sect's own Qinggong Secret Manual, Eight Desolations Escape, urging you to keep the green hills standing, for then you need never fear the lack of firewood. It could be called an act of the utmost kindness.
\n你果真來到人煙罕至的奪魄森林，尋你新拜的夏侯師父。=You had indeed come to the sparsely populated Soul-Stealing Forest, to seek out your newly sworn Master Xiahou.
你順理成章使出了奪魄門無影爪來。=Naturally enough, you unleashed the Shadowless Claw of the Soul-Stealing Gate.
夏侯蘭見你招術尚算熟練，暗暗點頭。=Xiahou Lan observed that your techniques were still somewhat proficient and gave a secret nod.
夏侯蘭見你壓根生疏得緊，還敢以此武功現眼，不由得眉頭一皺。=Xiahou Lan saw that you were utterly unpracticed, yet you dared to show off with this technique anyway, and she couldn't help but frown.
你不使奪魄門所授的秘笈武功，而是隨興發揮，起初尚且有點兒羞慚，後來使發了性，亂打一氣，到也痛快。=Instead of using the secret techniques taught by the Soul-Stealing Gate, you improvised freely. At first you felt a bit ashamed, but soon you let your temper loose, striking out wildly, and found it rather satisfying.
你一套功夫演畢，請夏侯蘭評點，她毫不留情的說你若到江湖闖到，眨眼就會橫死街頭，令你好生受傷。\n然則她傳授武功，卻也毫不馬虎，不以既有招術相授，而是直指你攻守之間的破綻，深入淺出，使你恍然大悟，茅塞頓開，足見其武學見識非同小可，不但自身武功高強，而且善於指點旁人。=You performed the entire sequence of your martial arts form, requesting Summer Lotus's assessment. She mercilessly stated that if you were to venture into Jianghu, you would likely die in the streets within a blink of an eye. This stung you deeply.\nHowever, when she imparted her martial arts techniques, she was equally meticulous, not teaching existing moves, but directly pointing out the flaws in your offense and defense. Her explanations were clear and insightful, causing you to suddenly understand and experience a breakthrough, demonstrating her profound martial knowledge—she's not only a skilled martial artist, but also adept at guiding others.
\n這一日你依言到崆峒山鐵拳巷來報到，要謀個頭路賺取生活費。=On this day, as instructed, you arrived at Iron Fist Lane on Kongtong Mountain to report in, seeking a position to earn your keep.
\n這一日你信步閒遊至崆峒山鐵拳巷。=One day, you wandered idly to Iron Fist Lane on Kongtong Mountain.
鐵鋪門前見了一名鐵匠裝束的綠衣少女，雖然瞇著眼睛，輕蹙眉頭，一副不悅神色，卻似林中新發嫩芽的春筍，清新秀美，惹人憐愛。\n你見狀不由得心中一盪。=At the blacksmith's shop door stood a green‑clad young woman dressed as a blacksmith, her eyes half‑closed, brows slightly furrowed, her expression one of displeasure. Yet she resembled a spring bamboo shoot newly sprouted in the forest, fresh and beautiful, endearing. Seeing this, you couldn't help but feel a stirring in your heart.
鐵鋪門前見了一名鐵匠裝束的綠衣少女，雖然瞇著眼睛，輕蹙眉頭，一副不悅神色，猛盯著你，盯得你心下微怵，不曉得哪裡得罪了她。\n不過不必認識、無須理由便被人嫌棄這種事，你也不是頭一回遭遇了。=A green‑clad young woman dressed as a blacksmith stood at the entrance of the blacksmith's shop. Though her eyes were half‑closed and her brows slightly furrowed, her expression was clearly displeased, staring at you intently enough to make your heart sink slightly. You didn't know where you had offended her. But you didn't need to know her or have a reason for being disliked‑this wasn't the first time you'd encountered such treatment.
孰料她一開口，卻要你隨她進鐵鋪去，莫名其妙向你討要兵器琢磨起來，一副見獵心喜的樣子，嚷著說不要收錢也想替你打磨兵刃。\n你正作為難處，一名身穿藍衣的奪魄門人興致高昂闖進鍛冶場中，臉色一僵，大怒若狂，他只道這少女厚此薄彼，說好要為他打磨兵刃，卻臨時變卦讓你優先，氣得七竅生煙，一張嘴喋喋不休，不計後果，盡挑能傷人的話說。=Unexpectedly, as soon as she opened her mouth, she insisted that you accompany her to the blacksmith shop, inexplicably asking you to let her work on your weapons. Just as you were feeling troubled, a member of the Soul-Stealing Gate, dressed in blue, burst into the forge with high spirits. His expression froze, and he became furious, claiming that this young woman was being unfair. She had promised to polish his weapons but suddenly changed her mind to prioritize you. Enraged, he fumed with anger, his mouth running non‑stop, carelessly hurling hurtful words.
你從旁聽著，防他發難，一見那奪魄弟子邁出腳步，隨即反應，奪回兵器將他格開，與他相鬥起來。\n你技高一籌，正想趁勝追擊，卻被那少女救急心切，從後面拉了一把，這一拉不得了，似有萬鈞巨力施加於你，彷彿被一條飛龍抓了便往浩瀚星河沖天而去，身如騰雲駕霧般飛了起來，撞倒貨架，嵌在一片狼藉之中。\n那奪魄弟子被她所救，卻不領情，說話決絕不留餘地，拂袖而去。=You listened from the side, wary of him starting trouble, and the instant the Soul-Stealing Disciple stepped forward, you reacted at once, snatching back your weapon to block him and closing into combat. Being clearly the better fighter, you moved to press your advantage, but the young woman, anxious to save him, hauled you back from behind—and that single pull proved overwhelming, as though seized by an unimaginable force. It felt like being snatched up by a flying dragon and flung into the vast river of stars: you soared through the air as if riding cloud and mist, crashed into the shelves, and lay half-buried in the wreckage. The Soul-Stealing Disciple, though saved by her, showed no gratitude—he spoke with cold finality, flicked his sleeves, and stormed off.
你被救了起來，頭一件事便是索要賠償，做人實在的很。=You were rescued, but the first thing you did was demand compensation‑how very direct of you.
你被救了起來，雖然感覺好像有哪處骨頭裂開了，隱隱作痛，但在姑娘面前，還是必須逞能。她見你如此硬朗，總算吁了一口長氣。=You were rescued, though you felt as if a bone had cracked, with a dull ache lingering. In front of the girl, you still had to put on a brave face. She saw you so sturdy and finally sighed in relief.
她問你來意，知你來自唐門，到鐵拳門是為留學，這才欣然自報家門，卻原來這位小娘子，便是崆峒派鐵拳門當代的嫡傳女弟子郁竹，更是大鐵舖的主人。\n你怎麼也不信這樣嬌小的姑娘能幹鐵匠粗活，直到她當場露了一手硬功夫，單手凹彎銅錢，連內功也不用，你當場被驚得口出暴言。\n除非練就嵩山鷹爪功一類武功，否則凡人決計沒有這等手勁，她雖是女兒身，卻比你這兒郎力氣都大，你還去質疑她能否勝任打鐵粗活，簡直可笑。=She asked about your intentions for coming, knowing you are from the Tang Clan and have come to the Iron Fist Gate to study. This is why she readily introduced herself. It turns out that this Young Lady Yu Zhu, a Direct Disciple of the Iron Fist Gate under the Kongtong Sect, is also the owner of the Great Iron Workshop. You never would have believed such a delicate girl could handle blacksmith work until she demonstrated her powerful skill right there by bending a copper coin with one hand without any Internal Skill. You were so astonished that you blurted out an exclamation. Unless one has mastered skills like the Songshan Eagle Claw Technique, no ordinary person could exert such strength in their hands. Although she is a woman, she is stronger than you men when it comes to handling heavy blacksmith work; questioning her ability was truly ridiculous.
她問你來意，總使知道你是客人，也無心招呼，草草送客，滿心懊喪竟認錯了人。你前腳一走，一名好事婦人後腳便進了鐵舖，將道聽塗說的謠言告訴郁竹，說你不是活人，乃是妖怪所幻化而成，還會吃人。\n崆峒派有飛天門修仙，專司祭天祈福、畫符驅邪，山人皆信崆峒能夠風調雨順，盡皆仰賴飛天門。而鐵拳掌門雷謙亦為老不遵，閒來沒事便愛說鬼故事嚇唬年輕弟子，是以鐵拳門人無一不信世上真有魑魅魍魎，尤以小竹為最，想起方才種種，更是後怕，還道自己之所以認錯人，是被你妖法所惑，打從心底怕起你來。\n而你回到招待所中，也聽聞小竹那「碎骨魔」的江湖渾名，聽說她力大無窮，不但曾經輕易毀掉師兄前程，還會生撕猛虎，拿血鑄劍，是個心狠手辣的主兒，你得罪了她，下回被生撕鑄劍的怕不就是你了。\n你聽人說得煞有其事，也信了幾分，要知江湖奇人異士無數，寧可信其有，不可信其無，言念及此，不由得膽戰心驚。=She asked what had brought you there, and though she knew you were a guest, she had no heart to entertain you; she saw you off in haste, full of regret at having mistaken you for someone else. No sooner had you left than a busybody woman came into the shop and told her the rumor going around—that you weren't even human, but a monster in disguise that ate people.\nThe Kongtong Sect keeps the Flying Heaven Gate for the cultivation of immortality, devoted to offering sacrifices to Heaven and drawing talismans to ward off evil; the mountain folk all credit the Flying Heaven Gate with Kongtong's good weather. And Lei Qian, Sect Leader of the Iron Fist Gate, being an incorrigible old man, loved nothing better than scaring the young disciples with ghost stories in his idle hours—so there was not a soul in the Iron Fist Gate who didn't believe in demons and monsters, none more than Xiao Zhu. Recalling the whole affair, she grew more frightened still, and decided her mistake had been the work of your sorcery, coming to fear you from the bottom of her heart.\nBack at the inn, you too heard of Xiao Zhu's Jianghu nickname, the Bone-Cracking Demon. Word had it she was monstrously strong, had once ruined a Senior Brother's future without effort, and could tear a fierce tiger apart with her bare hands and forge a blade with its blood—a ruthless one indeed. Having offended her, you feared you might be next to be torn apart and forged into a sword.\nHearing it all told so convincingly, you believed a fair part of it; the Jianghu holds no shortage of strange and extraordinary folk, and it is better to believe than not. The thought alone was enough to set your heart pounding.
\n因為三師兄無心的言語，你想起了拒絕承認的事實。\n那些向你道別、勸你勿再回想的人們，是真實勸過你，抑或是你為了保護自己的心不致支離破碎，而撒下的謊言呢？\n你不記得了。每次觸及這段回憶，人間就像扭曲了一樣陌生又冷清，你熟悉的那些，已經甚麼也不剩下了。=Because of Third Senior Brother's unintentional words, you recalled the fact you had refused to acknowledge. Those who bid you farewell and urged you not to dwell on it—had they truly counseled you, or was it a lie you told yourself to keep your heart from shattering? You don't remember. Every time you touch this memory, the world seems twisted, strange, and cold. Of everything you once knew, nothing remains.
唐門一行人，在歸途道中，遭遇了被逐出丐幫的畜牲道殘黨。\n當中有不少人，是大義分舵的熟面孔。\n倘若縱放，恐怕被江湖同道指罵魔教黨羽，可要動手，又有失道義，四師兄十在拿不定主意，你遂出面，代為決斷。=The Tang Clan encountered remnants of the Beast Path expelled from the Beggar Sect on their journey home. If they let these men go free, they might be branded lenient toward Demon Cult followers by their fellow Jianghu practitioners; yet to strike them down would seem a betrayal of righteousness. Fourth Senior Brother could not make up his mind, so you stepped in to decide for them.
你與師兄弟們向眾丐拱手，誰也沒有異議，紛紛無聲跨上馬背，縱放了這群武林公敵。\n他們雖是武林公敵，卻也是你的損友。\n藍色混蛋們胸中有一把尺，可不光會得罪乞丐，那怕開罪全武林，也依舊自行其是。=You and your fellow disciples clasped your hands in salute to the crowd of beggars, and no one raised any objections. One by one, you silently mounted your horses, letting this group of enemies of the Wulin go free. Though they were enemies of the Wulin, they were also your troublesome friends. The blue bastards had their own measure of things; they didn't just offend the beggars, but even dared to defy the entire Wulin, continuing to act as they pleased.
天有不測風雲，趕路途中，忽然下起瓢潑大雨，淋得你們唐門一行狼狽不堪。\n萬幸山道旁有間茶店，正好下馬躲雨，得以稍息片刻。\n你叫了一碗清湯掛麵，在清冷山雨中吃熱湯麵，別有一番情致，你心滿意足，身心都暖活了不少，只是店家問你要錢，你一摸口袋，才知阮囊羞澀，只得腆著臉去向四師兄借錢，其他師兄弟見了，還道四師兄轉了性，自掏腰包請客，紛紛上前摩蹭四師兄，而四師兄雖然一毛不拔，可也看重人緣，不由得進退兩難。最終忍痛把心一橫，包辦一切吃喝，既買了人情，又賺名聲。\n人生如萍，飄泊無定，且就相聚此刻，縱情高歌。你們師兄弟聚在這間山村小店裡，吃麵喝酒唱山歌，好不快活。\n即使將來分別了，「今日」也會在記憶深處熠熠生輝。=The heavens may bring unforeseen storms; on your journey, a sudden torrential downpour drenched the Tang Clan party, leaving you all disheveled.\nFortunately, a teahouse stood beside the mountain path, providing a place to shelter from the rain and rest for a moment.\nYou ordered a bowl of clear broth noodles, and eating hot noodles in the chilly mountain rain had a unique charm. You were quite content, feeling considerably warmer in body and spirit, but when the shopkeeper asked for payment, you checked your pockets to find them empty. You had no choice but to swallow your pride and borrow money from Fourth Senior Brother. Fourth Senior Brother, though notoriously unwilling to spend a single coin, also valued relationships, putting him in a difficult position. In the end, he gritted his teeth and paid for everything, buying goodwill and earning a reputation.\nLife is like a floating duckweed, drifting aimlessly; let us cherish this moment together and sing with abandon. You brothers gathered in this mountain village teahouse, eating noodles, drinking wine, and singing folk songs – a truly delightful occasion.\nEven when we part ways in the future, 「today」 will shine brightly in the depths of our memories.
\n途中碰到官兵列隊相迎，你們一行人心驚膽跳，還道是朝廷要找唐門算總帳了，宋悲越眾而出，你才知道是他恐怕唐門樹敵太多，途中遭遇仇家伏擊，才特意從各地調召過來替唐門護航的。\n唐門雖有抗旨劣跡，但也不會無事挑釁朝廷，更不曾拖繳賦稅，嚴格來說也算良民，如今朝野局勢變化，大有破鏡重圓的傾向，你思忖良久，決定開先河接受宋大人的好意，與官兵同行。=On the way, they encountered officials and Imperial Soldiers lined up to welcome them, causing the group to be terrified, thinking the imperial court was after the Tang Clan. Although the Tang Clan had a history of defying imperial edicts, they wouldn't provoke the court without cause and had never withheld taxes. Strictly speaking, they were law‑abiding citizens. With the current political changes, there's a clear trend towards reconciliation. \n龍湘聽說你要來洞庭，特意出門迎你。\n一別數月，她像是要追逐趕什麼似的，武功變得更加高強了。=Long Xiang heard that you were coming to Dongting and went out specially to welcome you. After months apart, she seemed to be chasing after something—her martial arts had grown even more formidable.
\n途中遭遇了青城派，你恨不能揭穿申屠龍的真面目，可是面對你的說詞，鄒掌門面露不豫之色，分毫不信。\n話不投機半句多，多言無益，所以拂袖而去。=Along the way you encountered the Qingcheng Sect. There was no common ground between you, and further talk was useless, so he flung his sleeve and departed.
\n途中遭遇了青城派，你恨不能揭穿申屠龍的真面目，但是心知鄒道長無論如何不會信你片面之詞，聽不進耳裡，那便只好用拳頭敲進心裡。\n一番劇鬥以後，鄒博才終於回劍入鞘，對你攔路挑戰掌門的行徑又好氣又好笑，更有幾分佩服你這後生晚輩的膽氣，這才耐著姓子聽你說明原委。\n他早已不止一次收到三師兄的信，只覺這唐三俠未免太不像樣，沒憑沒據含血噴人，懶得搭理。=On the journey, you encountered the Qingcheng Sect. After a fierce battle, Zou Bo finally sheathed his sword, both angered and amused that you had challenged the Sect Leader on the road, yet somewhat impressed by the nerve of this young upstart. 同門師兄弟聞此方知你不惜拿名聲為引，拼命攔路，所欲為何。\n唯有如此，才讓鄒掌門把話聽進心裡。\n若非你有此一攔，那怕三師兄再寄十封書信示警，只怕都無濟於事。=Only then did your fellow disciples understand why you had staked your very reputation, fighting to block the road at all costs. 鄰近岳陽，道上與嵩山派僧人偶遇，福韞告辭以前，將你引薦給一位老禪師。=Near Yueyang, you happened upon a monk from the Songshan Sect on the road. Before Fu Yun took his leave, he introduced you to an old Chan master.
你一見他面，渾身汗毛直豎，還道是千面人魔無念僧，待看老僧老僧合十，慈目低垂，渾身沒一點戾氣，反而大有慈悲祥和之氣，你頓時明白：這位才是本尊，無念僧只是易容成這位老僧而已。=When you saw his face, your hairs stood on end, thinking he was the Thousand Faced Demon, the monk Wunian. 這位老僧沒有半分武林前輩的架子，平凡樸素，然而他的身份，卻是嵩山派碩果僅存的長老，掌管嵩山般若院的覺醒禪師。\n聽福韞說過你的事，特來邀你留學嵩山，不是現在，而是將來，等到江湖太平，風調雨順，國泰民安之時。\n無論會否有那一日，只是單純問你意願而已。=This old monk showed no pretension of a senior Wulin figure, appearing plain and humble. Having heard of your story from Fu Yun, he has come to invite you to study at Songshan‑not now, but in the future, when Jianghu is peaceful, the weather is favorable, and the country is stable and the people secure. 離江湖紛擾，悠悠隔世，往後餘生有如筆墨在紙上寫下的日記，平淡無奇，日復一日，但每一天都不是虛度。你真實的活過，你自己記得。=Separated from the turmoil of Jianghu, drifting through the ages, the rest of your life resembles a diary written in ink on paper, plain and unremarkable, day after day. Yet, each day is not wasted. You have truly lived, and you remember it yourself.
你身邊的花盛開又謝，來去匆匆，而你始終孤獨。=The flowers around you bloom and wither, coming and going in a hurry, while you remain forever alone.
你遠赴西域，尋了穩妥營生，學當地的語言與風尚禮節，花錢買了妻子，到老沒生大病，臨終亦有兒女侍疾，該算是美滿才對啊……。=You traveled far to the Western Regions, sought a stable livelihood, learned the local language and customs, spent coins to acquire a wife, lived to old age without serious illness, and had children to care for you in your final days. That should be considered a fulfilling life, right...?
仗劍天涯之遠，慣看寂寞顏色。天下之大，誰也換不了她開顏淺笑。活該一生煎熬，來贖她眼淚。=You wielded your sword across the ends of the earth, long accustomed to the color of solitude. In all the world, none could win her gentle smile. It is only right that you suffer a lifetime of torment to atone for her tears.
仗劍天涯之遠，慣看寂寞顏色。天下之大，誰也換不了她嫣然一笑。活該一生煎熬，來贖她眼淚。=You wielded your sword across distant horizons, long accustomed to the color of solitude. In all the world, none could win her enchanting smile. It is only right that you endure a lifetime of torment to atone for her tears.
《抱朴子》曰：「周穆王南征，一軍盡化，君子為猿為鶴，小人為蟲為沙。」死後盡歸黃土。=The Baopuzi states: When King Mu of Zhou marched south, his entire army transformed; the gentlemen became apes and cranes, while the petty people became insects and sand. After death, they all return to the yellow earth.
你瞎眼之後，龍湘十分愧疚，將一身劍法傳授給你。你一度憑此揚名於江湖，但是幾年以後碰上了狡猾小人，設陷阱害你踏空，隨後將你活埋了。=After you went blind, Long Xiang, wracked with guilt, passed her entire swordsmanship on to you. For a time you gained fame in the Jianghu, but a few years later you met a cunning villain who set a trap to make you stumble, then buried you alive.
你的後半生都在牢裡度過，日復一日都面對同一堵牆。往事既遙遠又鮮明，回過神來也已經離你好遠好遠了。=You spent the latter half of your life in prison, facing the same wall day after day. The past feels both distant and vivid, and when you come to your senses, it has already drifted far away from you.
浪跡天涯說得瀟灑，說穿便是流浪漢罷。你沒有家。=Wandering the world sounds carefree, but to put it plainly, it's just being a drifter. You have no home.
道可道，非常道。你所悟越深，能言越少，終至萬籟俱寂，天地無聲。你沒有留下足跡，不施不欠，就像自始自終不曾存在。=The Dao that can be spoken is not the constant Dao.\nThe deeper your understanding, the less you can articulate, ultimately leading to utter silence, the heavens and earth without a sound.\nYou leave no trace, neither giving nor owing, as if you never existed at all.
你封劍退隱，一生不再與人動武，活到天命之年。偶爾有人對你友善，但有更多的人無端厭惡你、仇視你、嘲諷你。惡意無處不在，離了江湖亦然，人間就是這樣。=You sealed your sword and retreated into seclusion, never drawing your blade again, living to the age of fifty.\nOccasionally, someone is kind to you, but more people harbor unwarranted animosity, hatred, and ridicule.\nMalice is everywhere, even away from Jianghu; such is the way of humankind.
你的怒火將天邊的雲霞都燒得通紅。報了恩，也報了仇。恩怨皆成灰，席捲上天，隨風遠去。=Your rage has burned the clouds on the horizon crimson.\nDebts of gratitude and vengeance are both settled.\nAll grudges turn to ash, swept skyward, and carried away by the wind.
你學會官場交際，對上逢迎拍馬，對下蠻橫無情。就是面目醜惡，只要權勢夠大，一樣沒人敢說你閒話。只是那些噤若寒蟬的人們、那些終生不來看望你的江湖舊友，心底有沒有瞧不起你，那就難說了。=You're adept at courtly dealings, flattering your superiors and bullying those beneath you.\nYour appearance may be unsightly, but with power enough, no one dares speak ill of you.\nWhether those who stay silent as frightened cicadas, or your old friends from the Jianghu who never once come to visit, secretly look down on you… that's another matter.
你一相情願認為她被溪水沖走了，循著岷江穿流一路向東，直到海邊，可是那裡也沒有她的身影。你每日都看著海，日漸蒼老，悔不當初。=You stubbornly believe that she was swept away by the stream, flowing along the Min River all the way east to the sea, but there is no trace of her there either. Every day you gaze at the sea, growing older with each passing day, regretting your past decisions.
你退隱之後，江湖故事再也不聞不問。波瀾都在頭先廿載，餘生不受盛名所牽。你來過，你走了，也許沒人在意，可是你自己曉得。=After your withdrawal, you paid no more heed to news of the Jianghu.\nThe tumult was confined to your first twenty years; your remaining life was untouched by great renown. You came, you went—perhaps no one noticed, but you knew.
你老年被稱為山中老人，是天下暗殺者的老祖宗。千面人魔的傳說還在延續，恐懼籠罩這片大地。=You are known as the Old Man of the Mountain in your old age, the grand Patriarch of assassins across the land.\nThe legend of the Thousand-Faced Demon continues, and fear blankets this land.
往昔恩怨隨風散，歲月悠悠不染塵，你倆的餘生既慢且好。=Past grudges scatter with the wind, and the years flow by without taint. May the two of you enjoy a slow and good life in the days to come.
江湖人利欲薰心，無人猜得到你不懷好意。你用這把刀給唐門報了仇，未斬一人，刀下已伏屍千萬，血流成河。=Jianghu folk are blinded by greed; no one can guess your ill intent.\nYou avenged the Tang Clan with this blade—without cutting down a single person, yet ten thousand corpses already lie beneath it, a river of blood flowing.
深謀遠慮是假，只有其貌不揚是真的。拜你所賜，唐門的冤屈得以平反，雖然大家各散東西，卻都揚眉吐氣。=The deep scheming was all a front—only that unremarkable face of yours was ever real. Thanks to you, the grievances against the Tang Clan were cleared, and though we've all scattered our separate ways, we can all hold our heads high now.
你倆是隱居的雅士，反正這個時代配不上你們，不妨孤芳自賞、獨善其身，晴時耕牧雨讀書，夏賞荷花冬賞雪，不也暢懷？=You two are reclusive scholars; this era is unworthy of you. Why not appreciate your own company, cultivate your character, and spend sunny days farming and herding while reading on rainy days? Enjoy the lotus flowers in summer and the snow in winter‑doesn't that bring joy?
世人眾說紛紜，都想知道那位頭戴人皮面具的前輩高人是何方神聖，然而，你那天根本沒戴面具。=The world is abuzz with speculation, all wanting to know who that senior expert is, wearing a human skin mask. However, you weren't wearing a mask at all that day.
這一路太長太遠，本來就強人所難，你已經足夠努力了。=This journey is too long and too far; it was already asking too much of you. You have already tried your best.
是日，唐門叛逆全殲於眉山，無一倖還。大院外堡付之一炬，功過皆化烏有。你們活過，只是誰也不記得了。=On this day, the rebels of the Tang Clan were completely annihilated at Meishan, with not a single one surviving. 你活著，卻已死了很久。夏侯蘭後悔那日不該綁著你，讓你多受幾十年煎熬。=You live on, yet have been dead for a long time.\nXiahou Lan regrets that she bound you that day, sentencing you to decades more of suffering.
你有路可活，可你非要做那唐門弟子，笑看生殺，慷慨赴義。=You had a way to survive, yet you insisted on being a Tang Clan Disciple, smiling in the face of life and death, and nobly went to your death for justice.
人死如燈滅，你們燃盡了生命之火，還以顏色。幾十年後，世人依然記得唐門絕響。=When a person dies, their light extinguishes—you've burned through your life force and repaid your enemies in kind.\nDecades later, the world will still remember the Tang Clan's peerless final stand.
世上再無唐門，可是薪火不曾斷絕。有你和小師妹，以及你們未來的家人。唐門最初是一家人，最後仍是一家人。唐家香火，還將繼續傳承。=The Tang Clan is no more, but its legacy endures. With you and Junior Martial Sister, and the family you will build together, the flame remains lit.\nThe Tang Clan began as a family, and will end as one. The Tang Clan's lineage will continue.
你們的旅行，從出發那一日就沒停過，走到哪兒玩到哪，她出錢，你賣命，拜訪過舊友，又不吝情去留，繞遍神州大地，足跡止於崑崙山。=Your journey has never stopped since the day you set out, going wherever the road led and playing along the way. 託上官螢故，趙家成為富甲一方的大戶人家。上官螢漸漸把生意交給你，自己執掌中饋。身為賢妻良母，她從來不打小孩，倘若小孩犯了錯，就打你。=Thanks to the influence of Shangguan Ying, Zhao's family became a wealthy household.\nShangguan Ying gradually handed over the business to you, while managing the household affairs herself.\nAs a virtuous wife and mother, she never hit children; if they misbehaved, she would hit you.
小梅平時賢慧溫柔，只是一受刺激就會犯病將你放倒蹂躪。她曾持刀把方圓百里所有女子都恐嚇過一遍，警告她們不許靠近你。=Xiaomei is gentle and sensible most days, but if something sets her off, she'll knock you flat and have her way with you. She once brandished a blade and threatened every woman within a hundred miles, warning them to stay away from you.
你和小竹造出了精妙絕倫的機關人，藏於池水之下，因為機關構造過於複雜，不得不造得大些，分為人、獅、鷹，可以合體。如此成就，足以青史留名，但你們唯恐機關人遭到惡用，最終還是決定毀去。=You and Xiaozhu crafted exquisitely intricate automatons, concealed beneath the pond's surface. Ah well.
青城派修練講究守中致和，了一化萬，萬劃歸一，一歸虛無。\n所以大抵青城道士都清心寡欲，修養特別好。=The Qingcheng Sect's training emphasizes balance and harmony—the unity of all things, the myriad transformations returning to one, and that one returning to nothingness.\nTherefore, generally speaking, Qingcheng Sect disciples are clear-minded and unattached, with particularly excellent self-cultivation.
江湖曾經有句不太禮貌的老話，說的是：\n「江湖碰得到的青城弟子，都是凡心未泯的半桶水，\n真正厲害的都在山裡，從不爭名奪利，只成他的仙。」=The Jianghu once had an impolite saying: Those in the Jianghu who happen to meet a disciple of Qingcheng are merely half‑filled buckets of water, whose hearts have not yet been tempered. The truly formidable ones remain in the mountains, never seeking fame or profit, only attaining their immortality.
青城派用劍，但強項是氣功。\n青城氣功難學難精，和全真剛好兩個極端，一個深奧，一個親民沒門檻。=Qingcheng Sect uses swords, but their forte is qi gong. Qingcheng qi gong is difficult to learn and master, being at the opposite extreme of Quanzhen's approach‑one deep and intricate, while the other is accessible and welcoming to all.
青城派氣功練到精深處，出劍有雷霆之聲，對手兵刃若是凡鐵，\n一交便折，這我是親眼見過的。\n甚至不必用動刀劍，拿一柄拂塵灌注真氣都能當鐵鎚砸人，再厲害不過。=The Qingcheng Sect's qigong, when practiced to a profound level, produces a thunderous sound when drawing the sword. If an opponent's weapon is made of ordinary iron, it will break upon contact; I have witnessed this with my own eyes. They don't even need to use a blade or sword; just infusing True Qi into a whisk can turn it into a hammer to strike someone, which is truly remarkable.
鄒掌門便是一名氣功宗師，玄門正宗參同秘契，當世只有他一人會使。\n要說有多厲害？我打個比方。\n大師兄、二師兄、我、四師弟疊在一起跟他比拼內力，恐怕也輸多勝少。=Sect Leader Zou was a qigong master. He practiced the Inner Alchemy Secret Formula of the Orthodox Taoist lineage, and there was no one in the world who could use it except him. To put how powerful he is into perspective: if Eldest Senior Brother, Second Senior Brother, myself, and Fourth Junior Brother combined our Internal Force to compete with him, we would likely lose more often than win.
雖說內功是本門短處，但相差如此懸殊，你就該知道青城內功有多厲害。\n大家都知道，只有傻子才去跟青城弟子比拼內力。=Although Internal Skill is the weak point of our sect, such a significant disparity should make you realize how formidable Qingcheng's Internal Skill truly is. Everyone knows that only a fool would challenge a Qingcheng disciple in terms of Internal Force.
……當年舊魔教顛峰決戰最末，正邪各出三名絕世高手，決生死、論英雄。\n盟主大俠龍淵對決極樂教主李仁友、我們掌門對決極樂右使。\n最後一名人選，便是青城鄒掌門的師弟趙逵，對戰極樂左使。=......At the height of the final showdown against the Old Demon Cult years ago, each side sent forth three peerless masters to decide life and death and settle who were the true heroes. Alliance Leader, Great Hero Long Yuan, faced the Supreme Bliss Cult Leader Li Renyou; our Sect Leader faced the Right Envoy of the Supreme Bliss Cult. The final combatant was Zhao Kui, Junior Brother to Sect Leader Zou of Qingcheng, who fought the Supreme Bliss Left Envoy.
那場傳奇決戰，龍大俠的天觴劍擊碎了極樂教主的鬼蓮王刀；\n掌門服毒催谷功力，險勝一籌，誅殺了右使。\n但是第三陣卻敗了下來。=In that legendary showdown, Great Hero Long's Celestial Cup Sword shattered the Supreme Bliss Cult Leader's Ghost Lotus King Blade. Our Sect Leader took poison to force his power to its peak and barely won, slaying the Right Envoy. But the third bout was lost.
趙逵身受重傷，左使逃逸無蹤。\n之後極樂教覆滅，龍大俠和極樂教主在烈火之中消聲匿跡，完結了一個時代。\n但是故事還有後續。=Zhao Kui was gravely wounded, and the Left Envoy slipped away without a trace. Afterward, the Supreme Bliss Cult was utterly destroyed — Great Hero Long and the Supreme Bliss Cult Leader vanished together in the flames, bringing an era to its end. But the story doesn't end there.
悔恨依然煎熬著趙逵，彷彿被魔教詛咒一般，變得偏執而暴戾。\n他武功越來越強，面目也變得愈發猙獰，最後他叛出青城，\n加入了泥教，成為地獄道法王。=Regret still tormented Zhao Kui as if he were cursed by the Demon Cult, making him obsessive and violent. His martial arts grew ever stronger, his face becoming increasingly fierce. In the end, he rebelled against Qingcheng and joined the Mud Cult, becoming the Dharma King of Hell's Path.
而左使則韜光養晦，密謀東山再起，卻因我們大師兄功虧一簣了。\n這事兒下次有空再說。=And the Left Envoy went into hiding, secretly scheming to rise again — but it was our Eldest Senior Brother who caused his plans to fail just short of success. That's a story for another time.
峨嵋派是中原六大派之一，大概也是江湖上最古老的門派。\n最早可以追溯到春秋戰國，創自白猿祖師司徒玄空。=Emei Sect is one of the Six Great Sects of the Central Plains, and probably the oldest sect in the Jianghu as well. Its roots trace back to the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods, founded by the White Ape Patriarch, Situ Xuankong.
離我們也很近。我們這兒是眉山，他那是峨嵋山。\n雖說是鄰居，卻不怎麼親近。=It's quite close to us too. We're at Mount Meishan, and they're at Mount Emei. Though we're neighbors, we're not especially close.
原因無非是他們清高孤僻，而我們桀傲不馴。\n總算井水不犯河水，大的事多少禮尚往來，平素卻沒啥交集。=The reason is simply that they are aloof and isolated, while we are willful and unrestrained. After all, we keep to ourselves and don't interfere with each other's affairs. On major matters, there is some exchange of courtesy, but we rarely interact on a day‑to‑day basis.
掌門向無憂算起輩份，該和我們是一輩人。\n但他鮮少行走江湖，沒啥事蹟可言。=Sect Leader Xiang Wuyou is roughly of our generation, going by seniority. But he rarely ventures into the Jianghu, so there's little to tell of his deeds.
倒是他那位師弟「風神」解無塵，與我們大師兄齊名，\n乃是江湖年輕一輩中的俊傑，他們互許為勁敵，相互砥礪，\n有時針鋒相對，有時結伴同行，不失為江湖美談。=As for his Junior Brother, 'Wind God' Xie Wuchen, he's just as famous as our Eldest Senior Brother — one of the finest of the younger generation in the Jianghu. The two of them have sworn to be worthy rivals, spurring each other on: sometimes crossing swords, sometimes traveling together. It's become quite the tale in the Jianghu.
峨嵋金頂是佛門聖地，派中弟子亦多數信佛，剩下的人則信道。\n武功路子都得自天然，好比白猿祖師模仿山中靈猴所創的拳劍棍法。\n拳是峨嵋通臂拳，劍是猿公劍，棍是猿王棍。=Emei's Golden Summit is a holy site of Buddhism, and most of the sect's disciples follow Buddhism, while the rest follow Daoism. Their martial arts all take after nature — like the fist, sword, and staff techniques the White Ape Patriarch created by imitating the mountain macaques. The fist is Emei Connecting Arms Fist, the sword is the White Ape Sword, and the staff is the Monkey King Staff.
後人追隨祖師，又仿其他生靈，創出蛇形、鶴形、虎形種種拳法。\n講究耳濡目染，由意得形，故曰形意，與本門的忘形篇思想完全相反。=Later generations followed the Patriarch's example and, imitating other creatures, created boxing forms like the Snake, Crane, and Tiger styles. These stress learning through steady exposure and observation, deriving form from intent — hence the name Xingyi, the exact opposite of our own school's Chapter on Forgetting Form.
說說峨嵋派的事吧。\n現如今峨嵋派人人都使拳腳功夫，體魄強健、身手敏捷。\n那你可知道，從前峨嵋派會使劍嗎？=Let me tell you about the Emei Sect. Nowadays, everyone in the Emei Sect practices striking skills, with strong physiques and quick movements. But do you know that the Emei Sect used to wield swords?
不但使劍，而且還厲害非常。=Not only did they wield swords, they were exceptionally skilled at it.
相傳幾百年前，更在唐門祖師創派以前，蜀中更無其他門派，\n只有峨嵋一派獨大，那時峨嵋以劍法享譽天下。\n傳自白猿祖師的猿公劍法，歷經數朝演化，登峰造極。=Legend has it that hundreds of years ago, even before the Tang Clan's patriarch founded our sect, there were no other martial clans in Shu — Emei alone stood supreme. In that era, Emei was renowned across the realm for its swordsmanship. The White Ape Sword Technique, passed down from the White Ape Patriarch, evolved through the generations and reached the pinnacle of mastery.
然而物極必反，有天他們忽然覺得高處不勝寒，就此棄劍不用，\n藏見於心，稱之為「心劍」，以此磨練身心。=However, extremes always rebound. One day, they suddenly felt the loneliness of being too high up and abandoned their swords.\nThey stored the swords in their hearts, calling it 「Heart Sword」, and used it to temper their bodies and minds.
我個人呢，覺得器物造出來便是要拿來用的。\n峨嵋派的心劍太高深了，我這俗人不懂，所以不予置評。=Personally, I feel that objects are made to be used. The Heart Sword of the Emei Sect is too profound for me, a mere mortal, to understand, so I choose not to comment on it.
峨嵋派相當講究輩份，弟子拜師的時候，都按字輩改名。\n比如掌門向無憂、風神解無塵，都是「無」字輩。=The Emei Sect places great emphasis on seniority. When disciples are initiated into the sect, they change their names according to their generation. For instance, the Sect Leader Xiang Wuyou and the Wind Deity Xie Wuchen both belong to the 'Wu' generation.
他們上一代的前輩則是「乘」字輩，如今幾乎都退隱江湖了。\n和本門前輩凋零的原因不同，他們是出過一個惡名昭彰的叛徒。=The generation above them, the 'Cheng' generation, has by now almost all retired from the Jianghu. Unlike the reason our own sect fell into decline, theirs was a notorious traitor.
峨嵋叛徒的名字叫袁乘風，江湖外號「風中奇猿」。\n使的一手猿王棍靈動非常，乃是當年江湖一把好手。\n掌門曾評價過他：「很難打。」=The Emei traitor's name was Yuan Chengfeng, known in the Jianghu as the Strange Ape in the Wind. He wielded the Monkey King Staff with remarkable agility, a formidable hand in the Jianghu back then. Our Sect Leader once said of him: 'Hard to fight.'
很難打這話聽著挺微妙的，就是說穩贏，但是不好對付。\n能讓我們家掌門都覺得棘手，可想而知此人武功有多高了。='Hard to fight' sounds like a subtle thing to say — it means a sure win, but a troublesome one. That our own Sect Leader found him troublesome tells you just how formidable his skill really was.
此人早年還是行俠仗義的正派俠士，\n可是舊魔教崛起時，他急於成名立萬，拎著棍子去挑戰，敗於極樂右使，\n竟然跪地乞命求饒，求取屍心丹吞服，甘為極樂教走狗。=In his early years, this man was still a righteous knight-errant upholding justice, but when the Old Demon Cult rose to power, he grew desperate to make a name for himself. He took up his staff to challenge them, was defeated by the Right Envoy of the Supreme Bliss Cult, and actually knelt begging for his life — pleading for the Corpse Heart Pill to swallow, willing to become a lackey of the Supreme Bliss Cult.
他盜取唐門毒藥，回山下毒，欲將峨嵋一網打盡，作投名狀。\n峨嵋前輩因此不是身亡，便是經脈俱損廢了武功。\n袁乘風則憑此功績，受封為極樂七仙，在峨嵋稱王，極盡荒淫之能事。=He stole poison from the Tang Clan, returned to the mountain, and used it to wipe out Emei in one stroke as his Blood Oath. Because of this, the Emei elders either died or had their meridians ruined, crippling their martial arts. For this feat, Yuan Chengfeng was granted the title Seven Immortals of the Supreme Bliss Cult, crowned himself king of Emei, and indulged in every manner of depravity.
後來呢？後來就被我們掌門用飛燕流星翎砍斷兵器、指頭，\n一腳踢下峨嵋金頂，摔得粉身碎骨而死。=What happened after that? Our Sect Leader used the Flying Swallow Meteor Feather to sever his weapon and his fingers, then kicked him clean off Emei's Golden Summit — he fell to his death, shattered to pieces.
全真派是天下武學正宗，中原六大派之一，嵩山衰退以後，迅速崛起。\n如今大宋、金國都道觀林立，隱然已是中原第一大派。=The Quanzhen Sect is the orthodox lineage of martial arts in the world and one of the Six Great Sects of the Central Plains. After Songshan declined, it rose rapidly. Today, in both the Great Song and Jin states, Daoist temples abound, making the Quanzhen Sect de facto the largest school in Central Plains.
全真派迅速崛起，信眾遍布宋金兩國，更隱然更勝佛教。\n除了嵩山高僧泰半都在舊魔教一役中捐軀的緣故，\n也因為他們強調三教合一，瓦解了教派之間對立。=The Quanzhen Sect rose rapidly, with followers spread across both Song and Jin, and it seemed to eclipse Buddhism itself — partly because most of Songshan's eminent monks gave their lives in the war against the Old Demon Cult, and partly because Quanzhen preached the unity of the Three Teachings, dissolving rivalries between sects.
為了布教而不斷簡化的全真劍法，被大量印刷送人傳閱。\n別說，這招是真的管用，你直接拿一本道書叫人讀，人家還未必理你，\n說是簡單易學、可以強身健體的武功秘笈，那～就不一樣了。=The Quanzhen Sword Technique, simplified again and again for proselytizing, was printed by the stack and handed out to anyone who'd take it. Say what you like, but the trick really worked — hand someone a Daoist scripture and they might not even give you the time of day, but call it an easy-to-learn martial arts manual for strengthening the body, and well, that's a different story.
為此全真劍法也被戲稱為國民健康操，淪為江湖笑柄。\n連街邊的大嬸拿起曬衣竿都能耍兩招。=So the Quanzhen Sword Technique earned the nickname 'National Health Exercise' and became a laughingstock across the Jianghu — even a street-side auntie could pull off a move or two with a laundry pole.
全真創派祖師，早年曾是金國的秀才，兩朝文武雙狀元。\n後來入道修行，改名王喆，道號重陽子，互稱重陽真人。=The patriarch of the Quanzhen School was once a scholar in the Jin Kingdom, a double honor graduate in both civil and military affairs across two dynasties.\nLater, he took the path of cultivation, changed his name to Wang Zhe, and became known as Chongyangzi, hence the title Chongyang Zhenren.
重陽真人是五祖七真中的北五祖之一，\n那是武林前輩中的前輩，跟岳王爺同時代人。\n就像我大宋有文盟主、武霸王，他也是金國的武林傳奇。=Immortal Chongyang was one of the Northern Five Patriarchs among the Five Patriarchs and Seven Perfected — a senior even among the seniors of the Wulin, a contemporary of King Yue. Just as our Great Song had its Alliance Leader of Letters and Martial Overlord, he was a legend of the Wulin in Jin.
重陽真人座下七真，後來都成為一派宗師。\n丹陽子馬鈺繼任掌教，卻遭金朝皇帝所忌，下令送還本鄉，\n將關中事物交給師弟主持。=The Seven Perfected under Immortal Chongyang each later became a grandmaster of his own school. Danyangzi Ma Yu succeeded as Grand Master, but grew suspect in the eyes of the Jin emperor, who ordered him sent back to his hometown — leaving Guanzhong affairs in the hands of his Junior Brother.
那位師弟，便是江湖無人不知、無人不曉的天下第一人。\n今日的全真掌教，長春子丘處機。=That junior brother is none other than the one no one in the Jianghu fails to know — the First Under Heaven. Today's Quanzhen Grand Master, Changchun Qiu Chuji.
只可惜二十年前極樂教與中原正派激戰之時，\n丘道長正受金國皇帝所制，與弟子在棲霞太虛觀修道。\n要是他老人家參戰，極樂教主未必能夠隻手遮天。=Sadly, twenty years ago, when the Supreme Bliss Cult fought its fierce war against the orthodox factions of the Central Plains, Daoist Qiu was under the Jin emperor's watch, cultivating with his disciples at Qixia Taixu Temple. Had the old man joined that battle, the Supreme Bliss Cult Leader might not have been able to blot out the sun with one hand.
現在丘真人仍是掌教，卻時常外出雲遊，端的是神龍見首不見尾。\n不在終南山的時候，都是由座下弟子尹志平道長代掌派中事務。=These days Immortal Qiu is still Grand Master, but he is forever off wandering the world — truly like a divine dragon that shows its head but never its tail. When he's away from Mount Zhongnan, it's his disciple, Daoist Yin Zhiping, who handles the sect's affairs in his stead.
唉，代掌門的辛酸無人知曉。=Ah, the hardships of an acting sect leader — known to no one.
嚴格來說，終南山的全真派，應該稱之為全真龍門派。\n不畫符籙、不念咒語，宣揚真功真行，清靜不動心，行善助人。\n遲早修得超脫淪為，飛天成仙。=Strictly speaking, the entire Quanzhen Sect of Mount Song should be called the Quanzhen Longmen Sect.\nThey don't draw talismans, don't chant incantations, and preach genuine martial skill and righteous conduct, maintaining a tranquil and unwavering heart, and helping others through good deeds.\nEventually, they will cultivate to transcend reincarnation and fly to become immortals.
因為兼含儒道釋思想，武功又容易入門，與青城一比，就顯得平易近人。\n不過相對來說，不講資質，也就難出大器，信徒雖眾，高手卻很少。=Because it incorporates Confucian, Daoist, and Buddhist thoughts, and its martial arts are relatively easy to learn, it appears more approachable compared to Qingcheng. However, relatively speaking, without emphasizing innate talent, it is difficult to produce great masters; although there are many followers, there are very few skilled practitioners.
不過話又說回來，那全真劍法中藏著一層奧秘，\n七人一組可以施展北斗七星陣法，七個大嬸拿鍋鏟都能戰勝武林高手。=But to come back to it — the Quanzhen Sword Technique hides a deeper secret: grouped seven to a team, they can deploy the Big Dipper Formation, and seven aunties wielding kitchen spatulas could beat a master of the Wulin.
傳說中，曾有一位武林怪傑人稱玄冥老祖，自號「重陽敵」。=Legend has it that there once was a mysterious figure in the Wulin known as Patriarch Xuanming, who styled himself as 'Chongyang's Foe.'
這位老前輩曾在陰山一帶佈教講道，融合道家與大漠騰格里信仰，\n卻因國情而不為人所納，遂遷怒於全真教，認為是全真教蒙蔽民智，\n於是下中原找重陽真人比武、論道，結果卻一敗塗地。=This elder once preached in the Yinshan region, blending Daoist teaching with the Tenggeri faith of the desert steppe, but was rejected there because of the political climate. So he turned his anger on the Quanzhen Sect, believing it had beguiled the people's minds, and went to the Central Plains to challenge Immortal Chongyang to a contest of arms and doctrine — only to suffer a crushing defeat.
為與重陽祖師抗衡，他又入陰山壁關，痛下苦功，\n運陰符以養先天，直至六陰純全，陰符功畢，方始出關。=To contend with Grandmaster Chongyang, he retreated into Mount Yinshan, secluded himself, and diligently cultivated the Yin Tally—\ndrawing upon yin energy to nurture his innate nature, until the six yin energies were pure and complete. Only then, upon perfecting the Yin Tally, did he emerge from seclusion.
出關第一件要事，便是上終南山找重陽真人麻煩，\n然而物是人非，原來他閉關三十年間，故敵早已仙逝。=The first order of business on leaving seclusion was to head for Mount Zhongnan and make trouble for Immortal Chongyang. But the world had moved on without him — in the thirty years of his seclusion, his old foe had already passed away.
玄冥老祖悵然半晌之後，狂笑不休，竟想火燒活死人墓，逼活重陽真人。\n七真相繼上前挑戰，就連掌教馬丹陽亦非敵手。=After a long moment of melancholy, Patriarch Xuanming burst into wild laughter and, in a fit of madness, tried to burn down the Tomb of the Living Dead to force Immortal Chongyang back to life. The Seven Perfected challenged him one after another, and even Grand Master Danyangzi was no match for him.
幸好丘真人深得重陽真傳，以「昊天純陽掌」力拼「六陰破陽符」，\n與那玄冥老祖對撼九九八十一掌，直到玄冥老祖使完絕招，\n盡興了之後，才一笑遠去，免了一場大禍。=Luckily, Immortal Qiu had deeply inherited Chongyang's true teaching, matching the Six Yin Yang-Breaking Talisman blow for blow with the Haotian Pure Yang Palm — he traded eighty-one palm strikes with Patriarch Xuanming, and only once Xuanming had spent his ultimate technique and had his fill did he laugh and walk away, sparing them a great disaster.

崆峒派也是中原六大派之一，不過嘛……這說法有種種爭議。=The Kongtong Sect is also one of the Six Great Sects of the Central Plains. However... there are all sorts of disputes over that claim.

你們從前的茶肆，賣了人卻被嫌偏僻，早已棄置不理。\r\n如今低價贖回，加一日修整、宣傳，唐門茶肆方始重新開張。=Your old teahouse – sold off to a buyer who then complained it was too remote, and it had long since been left to rot. Now bought back at a low price, after a day of renovations and some advertising, the Tang Clan Teahouse has finally reopened its doors.
